I've had Timex watches since I was a kid and they either die the day after the warranty expires or they last forever, so I knew what I was getting.  Watch has performed exactly as I needed with the additional benefit that when my husband put it through the washing machine, it didn't miss a second.  It actually has more features than I'll ever use, but I'm just plain tickled.

This watch is the best.  In 2007 I purchased this same watch for my husband and sent it to him in Iraq.  Now, 4 years later the same watch is still working perfect but the poor face is so beat up that one can hardly read the time so figured it was time to replace it.  Bought 2 of them this time and will put the other away to replace the new one when is becomes to hard to read the time.. Takes a beating and keeps on working.  Happy with this for sure.
This was a Christmas gift for my son.  He loves it!  I love the "old school" Timex--it keeps a licking and keeps on ticking.  Good watch for a teen.

This is my third or fourth Expedition.  I have been wearing it as my work watch for years.  I like that it is very low profile so it fits nicely under my sleeve.  The watch lasts a very long time.  I don't believe I have ever had a band break on me.  I usually get a new one every year or two depending on how much I have scratched the face.  When it is time I will buy another one.  Hopefully Timex keeps making them.
Easy, simple to operate and I could swear the numbers are acutally larger than the older expedition models.  Simplicity at its finest.

I owned this watch for several years before losing it at a park. I immediately purchased another one. It has 3 alarms, a stopwatch, a timer, and supports two times so you can set one to a different time zone. The indiglo works great and stays bright, even after years. With a previous model of this watch, I had issues with the soft portion of the velcro ripping up and no longer holding. I have yet to have that with this watch although I don't use it in the water quite as much as my old one, and I think that's the main reason the velcro wore so fast. That being said, this watch is also great in the water. The buttons are easily pressed and the screen is very legible. The watch face is slightly bigger than most so make sure you're aware of the dimensions, but it's not enormous.
Bought this for my brother as a Christmas present.  Good price and nice quality item - my brother was really happy with the velcro wrist band.

Timex has been making these in the same format since the '80s. They always work the same way, which is simple to figure out, it has 2 alarms, large, easy to read numbers, day and date, can be used in 24 hour format, and the Indiglo light button right on the front is a great feature. I like the velcro strap also, very easy to live with. Can't really go wrong for the price.
I got this watch for my middle school son. He likes all the features and the price was right..plus a good size for his arm

My husband is very happy with this watch. However, the instruction sheet is confusing, making it difficult to figure out how to even set the time. We figured it out, but the company should really rewrite those directions.
summary: My husband is very happy with this watch

reviewText: I have had three Expedition watches previously and was quite pleased with all of them (except perhaps the short lives of the leather or rubberesque bands).  Not so with this one. I do like the small and light format and the ease for adjusting time and other functions.The main complaint is the low-contrast face, which makes it comparatively harder to read than the other Expeditions I have had.  That, and I should have been smart enough to guess what an exposed-Velcro watch band would do.  It is a crud-magnet.  A wee piece of rubbish floating by 10 metres away will suddenly change course and attach itself to this Velcro.  Sheep dag, small insects, pieces of plants, old hymnals, volcanic ash, asteroid residue .... you name it, it will become as attached to this watch as a hooker to a southern Democrat.

My wife can hear the alarm 30 feet away while I cannot hear it on my wrist.  Alright I admit I am a bit deaf, but I can hear the alarm clock at my bedside that is powered by an AAA battery. Be careful about pushing buttons while under water as instructions say you should not do that with this watch.

I Have had this watch for about a month now, and am happy with it. I have had it in hot/cold/sandy water, and it has not lost its water resistance.Cons: The watch face is even with the bezel, so scratches easily (I can still read it, though, and the deeper scratches slowly buff out and do not inhibit visibility). The Indiglo button on the front of the watch, so it can be bumped rather easily. For smaller wrists (6" circumference), the Velcro hooks extend beyond the Velcro, so can catch on clothing. In the month that I have had it, it has lost approx. one second.Pros: Setup is very easy. One can't mistake what the words/numbers on this watch say. Great features include the following: time, date, hourly charm (on/off), two time zones, button beep (on/off),timer, chrono (with split lap options), optional night mode feature (light comes on when buttons are pressed), and 3 alarms that can be set to daily, weekends, or weekdays.Overall, this watch works well for active people.

I wear it everyday to everything. The best sports watch I have ever owned. It is even better than my old Ironman watches I wore in the 1980's.Update: The watch has had 2 years of excessve use and is still going strong!
This is the second I have bought. My son burned up the first one on a Scout camping trip (too close to the cooking flame). He's extremely pleased with it.
My daily use watch, I have purchased 10 over the last couple years as I am very hard on them.
summary: My daily use watch, I have purchased 10 over ...

reviewText: This is my third one on these over the years,  I simply love this little watch.  Lasts a long time, and keeps great time.  Not to mention it has 3 alarms, stop watch, and countdown capabilities.

My husband works in the construction trade, and his watch takes a daily beating.  He bought this Expedition 2 watches ago (more than 10 years)and we had a hard time finding an exact replacement last time.  Plus, we had to purchase the Velcro strap (a requirement for him) separately.The casement and display are VERY tough, and have withstood a great deal of punishment without breaking or becoming unreadable.  It is easily programmable, and he uses the alarm function quite frequently.  He also appreciates the indiglo lighting on the watch, but after several years of hard use, this is the feature that has failed.  Pressing the button now makes the screen light up blank with nothing in the display.  I was very glad that we could find the exact watch to replace it here on Amazon!
summary: This watch can definitely take a lickin'!

reviewText: There is really nothing I can say that hasn't already been said.  I could NOT believe how user friendly the watch is. Setting the time was a jif! I didn't even have to read the instructions.  Yes, I am female and purchased this watch for myself.  I will be using it for day hikes, mountaineering, rollerblading and general fitness.  My boyfriend loved it so much, I will be buying one for him too.  Fantastic watch!

I bought this watch because I had the same (older) one years ago. I got a used one as a gift from my dad. I had it many more years after. It lasted for about 12 years or so with ME. It finally gave out and the numbers wouldn't display properly. Since I was quite young when I had it the first time it really took a beating from me. Taking into account that  I had it for some 12 years and it was already used says a LOT about this watch. If you're thinking about getting one I can only say decided which model, or color and just go for it. You will not regret it.
summary: Had one for 12 years.. and bought it again

reviewText: Bought this watch as a cheap digital to wear while working outside/doing things that might damage an otherwise more expensive watch.  Very happy with quality/clarity of the display and the velcro band is holding up well under use.
very good watch for this low price. I have bought two of these watches and they both have worked great.

The features are great, the Velcro works well, the watch is just the right size, not bulky like so many are for men these days.  I really like the band.  It goes behind the watch so it breathes easier, then the watch is attacked by two elastic straps so when I catch the watch on something it doesn't rip it off my wrist right away.The thing that I don't like is the indiglo button sticks out 1/16 of an inch.  That means I am bumping it all the time and it's only a matter of time before the indiglo burns out or the battery dies.  Furthermore it beeps after the indiglo button has been pressed for about three seconds so I can't wear it at night because it keeps waking me up.  This beeping is to tell you you've turned on "night mode" which means any button lights up the indiglo.  It could be a handy feature but with it turning on on it's own all the time, again, I doubt this watch would last long.So close to the perfect watch for me... I'll update this when it dies so you know how long it will last.  I hope it goes several years at least.EDIT April 2014:The battery lasted a whole 7 months. Not worth it. Unless you like to take your watch off so you don't bump the indiglo button. I replaced the battery and we'll see how long this second one lasts.
summary: I love the watch except for one huge flaw...

reviewText: This watch is a replacement for  a Timex Expedition watch.  I have used this model watch for many years.  My old one was so scratched that I couldn't see the numbers in the daylight!  Also, my old one had a metal buckle on the strap, causing abrasions on my wrist.  This new watch is comfortable, with a Velcro type band.  Much better on my wrist.  The best part is it's not scratched up......yet!

I purchased this watch as a replacement for one that I've worn for the past 2 years. I tend to be rough on watches, so I like that I can buy a decent watch that can take a little abuse... Since this was the exact same model as the last 3 I've owned, I assumed all would be well with it. I was wrong, as soon as I opened the package, I noticed that the cover over the face had some odd defects in it, but since I don't wear it for the looks, I just shrugged it off and wore it... After less than 3 months of owning this, we went to Niagara Falls on the Maid of the Mist. Since the watch has always been waterproof, and still claims to be, I never gave it a second thought that it might get wet. Once we got off of the boat, I immediately noticed that there was water under the glass and the backlight had quit working... As soon as I got home, I filled out a Timex Warranty replacement form online and sent it off... $12 later, they sent me a new watch, which so far has been much better, but I'm still out $12, which is almost 50% of what I paid for the watch to begin with... Lesson learned, today's quality is far less than what it used to be.
You can never beat a Timex. This is at least my fifth Timex and my 3rd Iron man watch. They cost a bit more than say a Casio but worth the money.

Second purchase. Comfortable to wear, large numbers can be seen without bifocals. Crystal will scratch so I covered this one with clear packing tape and trimmed it to fit. If you leave it in a cold car, it will have to warm up before it can keep correct time. There is a smaller version that looks almost identical. I bought the smaller one at Wally World and had to go home and compare sizes. It went back.03-11-12 Update on older watch. It never did completely recover from cold night outside.

Nice watch. I haven't owned a watch for a while, but have always had good luck with the Timex brand. I have owned several of their watches over the years. Like the old commercials said: "Takes a licking and keeps on ticking".
summary: Timex Men's T48061 Expedition Classic Digital Watch

reviewText: I bought this watch before a week long camping trip, as I had no working "sport" style watches. Worked great for everything I used it for. Timer was a huge plus for camp cooking. Snorkeled several times with it on and no water issues.
summary: Great watch for a good price

reviewText: As soon as I opened the box, I saw that the display was too dark...not the same as shown here.
I lost my last watch, and ordered another just like it.  It works great for everything I need - timer, alarms, rugged quality, waterproof.

I recently received this watch out in Iraq.  It's taken some(alot) of dust, minimal water(shower), dings and hits in the gym and constant uniform changes(pins feel very secure).  I can't yet put a scratch on it, I don't think I'll resort to a knife to do so.  The alarm wakes me up and the large indigo display is great for a quick glance.  It's very easy to figure out(11b) and program.  It's just a tad thin when looked at on my wrist, but if you don't mind function over form, it's not terribly noticeable...given I am over 200 lbs, if it's not a huge g-force obsenity, it's bound to look small.  I highly recommend it for anyone who prefers fabric bands.

Overall I am satisfied with this watch. I bought it to replace a Timex Iron Man watch I have had for the last sixteen years. The watch is very readable even at steep angles. All of the controls are intuitive and conveniently placed. Buyers should know that the watch band may feel a bit tight on larger wrists, however. I am 6'7" and about 285. About the last inch of the band is a thick rubbery material and so cannot be adjusted down all the way to the end. I would recommend this to all but those with the largest wrists.
summary: Great watch, but the band is a little small.

reviewText: I got this watch for hiking, I just wanted a basic watch that you could see during the day/night and this fit the bill, I really like this watch, light and compact.

This is the second time that I bought this watch.  The first one lasted 3 years through military service and probably  just needed a battery change.  I Wear it daily when I work out so it has been through it all.
Great watch at a great price.  I love the multiple alarms that can be set.
This is a great watch. The buttons are well placed & the manual is well written. The light button is easy to find.The band is first rate.
wasnt sure hubby would like the velcro band, but says it comfortable and likes that he can adjust it easier. watch is easy to program too.

This Timex is a good work watch that can really take a beating, It's comfortable, quick on and off and survives moderate physical abuse. the only negatives are the band, after about a year, the velcro gets pretty weak, still usable but if you bump your wrist on something, it's coming off. The other thing is that the material of the band can get "funky" from sweating with it on, not a deal breaker but you will definetly need to hand wash the band every couple of weeks in the Summer. All in all, it's a good watch! I had one that lasted about 6 years and when the battery finally went out, I just bought a new one because the band was wore out and the face was pretty scratched up.

This is all you could want in a watch. It is easy to control and fits easily, and has several cool features. Its three alarms can replace your alarm clock, its timer can replace a kitchen timer (or any other timer), and its CHRONO mode can replace a one-purpose stopwatch. I didn't realize how much I really depended on it until I lost mine - it makes a world of difference.
summary: All You Could Want in a Watch

reviewText: I had this identical watch for 10 years, it finally died a while back.  it was very abused over that time.  I was happy to find the same watch available again.  It fits comfortably, and is easy to use and lasts for ever.
summary: Great Product at the best price around

reviewText: the watch is good looking and just the right size. but the Velcro band will only fit a small wrist. I could not close the watch band far enough to feel it was secure on my wrist. I returned it for a credit and purchased a casio watch with a larger watch band.

This is my second Timex Expedition watch.  I don't remember how long I had the previous watch.  The only reason I bought a new one was because the button to light the watch face in the dark had not worked in a long time so I decided to get a new one.  The face of my previous watch was easy to clean when it got scratched or something on it.  It's very durable.  I love it and highly recommend it.

I bought this watch for my Dad.  He wanted an everyday watch that he could wear even if he is doing yard work.  This watch is very comfortable and is built to last.  He has had this watch for about two years now and it still looks like new.  He wears this about five days a week.
I love this watch, I like how easy it is to set and the Velcro wrist band is a nice feature.

If you are buying a watch for function rather than for form, this is the watch to get. It is reasonably priced, supports two different times, is water resistant, supports a count down timer, stop watch, and an alarm, etc. Most importantly, it is comfortable to wear.One thing to note: there is a similar watch from Timex with a slightly different strap. I highly recommend this model over the other model, because the "fast wrap" velcro strap is more durable than the strap from the other model (whereas I have only had to replace this model when I misplace the watch, the other model I've had to replace before due to the strap wearing out).Overall, this is a great watch and I highly recommend it.

I just bought this watch a couple months ago and it broke. It says its good up to 100 meters but that's a lie. I went swimming in a swimming pool and it leaked, its still working but i can't read the screen at all. I bought this watch because it was almost like my old watch that worked just fine for 7 years. I took that one scuba diving tons, it  went with me to about 115 feet and it never got any water in it. But this one is horrible it died in less than 5 feet of water.

I like this watch for everyday and particularly for travel.  The dual time zone comes in very handy as well as the other features. It is easy to use and read. They have made many improvements since the model originally came out.  I like the Velcro band also.
summary: Great product for travel, particularly between time zones.

reviewText: My 2nd one, 1st one still going 7 years same battery, Tough as they come, Great value. Ugly but good!
The watch keeps losing minutes, and the light won't come on, anymore.  Took it in for a new battery, and that didn't do anything for it.  Too expensive, $28, for it to fall apart so quickly.

This watch is perfect if you just want something basic that has a timer, alarm/date stamp and indiglo light (it has several other features/functions too).  It looks nice too; nothing fancy, but doesn't look cheap.  Plus, the best feature is the wrist band, which is a "fast wrap" fabric band--much more sturdy & practical than a "buckle" type and/or plastic band.  This was a gift for my husband, and he loves it.

The watch was encased in a flimsy collapsible cardboard box.  Although, cheaply packaged, I thought this was done to save the consumer money.  Trying to get the item out of the box without ripping the entire box to pieces, was impossible.  Still, I thought as long as it works, it would be worth the frustration.  Surprise, watch doesn't work.  I can't get this piece of junk back in the box fast enough to be returned.  I'm glad others had success.  I didn't.

I have had four of these watches. The display is great, visible through polarized glasses and the illumination is good at night also. The band is comfy and doesn't dig into you, though the cloth weave can take on a funk. User interface is easy.These watches always die on me after about a year- water gets in somehow. I live on and in the water and bang the watch up pretty fierce though, so I just keep buying new ones cause they're the best featured watch otherwise...
summary: On my fourth one, nice features but not waterproof

reviewText: "Amazon Verified Purchase" Timex Men's T48061 Expedition Classic Digital Outdoor Performance Chrono Alarm Timer WatchI bought this as a replacement for the pretty much same watch that lasted 20 yrs. I originally bought it for a diving watch, ( a 2nd timing device) as it can go 3x deeper than a human can. I would put it in a drawer after a dive trip, pull it out 6 mo. later to go again, and it never lost a second. I especially used the chrono function on when diving. I have a beautiful Rolex, however, I have developed a huge cyst on my watch hand, and the Rolex weighs a ton, and it hurt. So I brought out my 'old' Timex and began wearing it every day. Well it finally broke, but for a $20 buck watch, to say I got my money's worth would be a wild understatement.To repeat the old commercial, this watch `can 'take a lickin' and keep on ticken'.... I especially like this particular model due to the velcro strap, no buckle, which, with arthritis, are sometimes hard for me to handle.The chronograph is especially handy for timing your steaks if you can stand right by the grill the whole time.
It's inexpensive, durable, and I like the continuously adjustable and easily cleanable fabric wristband. It's not elegant, but it will serve you well anywhere you don't wear a tie.

I've had a watch just like this one for about five years now.  It was still working, but getting kind of scratched up.  But I  really liked the features, like the velcro band and the dial that lights up with a push of a button.

This is about the Third or Forth of these watches I have owned. The Bands usually wear out before the watch and the battery last for years. The only thing about the watch is changing the battery. I did it once and it wasn't too hard. However, the buttons didn't work as well after the battery install. The buttons became very hard to push. Never the less, this is one great watch. The price is good and I decided to buy a new one every time the battery needs to be replace. Highly recommended!!!
Not like the ironman. This watch the inglo light is controled bythe "start button" and is easy to be trunedn on by accident.The battery was dead after a few months of use andI threw the watch away.
I bought the identical watch 12 plus years ago changing the band and adding a battery a few times.  I finally had to replace it when it conked out for good. Its a great sports watch for the price!

I'm wearing this watch right now and I can say this is the best watch I have ever owned. It may not be fancy, but it is durable and functional. I've had it for 6 months and as a fishing guide in Yellowstone National Park, it has held up to everything mother nature could possibly throw at it. Snow, rain, sleet, days of hot sun, and up to 100 feet of water. I am also a diver and when it says water resistant to 100 meters, it means it. This is now my go-to diving watch because the buttons are so easy to push, even with bulky gloves on.The band is surprisingly durable and the velcro snaps together like the day I got it.The only negative is that the face scratches pretty easily, but even with the scratches the time and numbers are extremely legible.If this watch ever does give out, I will 100% buy another.

small , compact, easy to put on, modern design display,I chose. because of nylon wrist bend and it fulfill my expectations. I work as Electrician on building site ,where is so much dust and dirt also I cant have any metal arround my fingers or wrist(can cause serios burn from accidental short cut). This watch have plastic all round . I simply recommended

reviewText: Works well.  Just bought a second one as backup if the first gets lost.  Easy to use, multiple alarms are useful.  Big enough to be very visible, not too hulky.

Been using Timex Triathlons for what seems like 15-20 years.  Really liked them.Just got this Men's Expedition T48061 from Amazon today and it appears there is NO WAY to review Laps and Splits! in which case it departs from what I have been used to from Timex and it is useless to me.  Should not have to carry paper and pen on a long run to write down splits as you go along just because the watch won't display them.If anyone can suggest how to review Laps / Splits I'll amend this review with a quite positive one, otherwise beware if you need the same function in a watch as I do.update:Just got this exact email from Timex: "You will not have the option to recall on a expedition watch."  My question to them was, "How do I review my laps and splits?"Too bad.  What a waste of time - comparing, ordering, testing, being frustrated, shipping back to Amazon.Amazon, if you read this, it would be really nice to have some kind of notice in product description like THIS CHRONOGRAPH DOES NOT ALLOW LATER REVIEW OF SPLITS.

reviewText: This is my favorite watch and the batteries seem to last for over 3 years.  I like the fit of the Velcro strap and the features on the watch (alarm, chrono, etc.).  It is also one of the easiest to set the time on without reading the instructions.  I have several of this model watch over the years and it takes a beating and keeps on ticking.

I chose this watch for its large face and fabric band.  Ease of setting it was an added plus that I appreciated greatly.  the watch is very intuitive to operate; its large button for the backlight makes reading the time in the preverbal blackout of just having awakened extremely easy.  No more having to guess which side button might turn on the light.And of course, it doesn't make a sound unless I want it to.
summary: Easy to set and even easier to read

reviewText: On my 3rd one of these watches and they've all lasted years.  I put them through the ringer too, of a military and law enforcement career.  Once the battery goes dead, the face is normally pretty beat up and since they're so cheap I just buy another.  The band does begin to smell pretty funky after a while.  Sweat and odor build up and you can remove it and wash it; however this shortens the life of the velcro band.  Great watch for those looking for a cheap durable watch.  Timex takes a licking and keeps on ticking!!!
poor design and the light quit working while the watch was still new.  this is a poor watch face design. why do i need two more words?
summary: the lightstopped working within three months

reviewText: I have a parrot who loves to chew my watch band! so I need to replace it alot! this band holds up even to that! It came on time and is great for someone with a skinny wrist like I have. The velcro holds up well and can stand up to parrot stress lol!
the watch came on time and udamaged. it held up very well.it lasted untill batteries went dead about 4 years.

I found this watch for my husband probably 10 yrs. ago.  He is really hard on his watches being a mechanic.  He likes all the feature, backlight, timer, stop watch, alarm.  The band is the best, it has a strap that goes under the watch that helps to keep the pressure off the pins. It's Velcro so easy to remove when needing to quickly.  I only have to purchase new when he either scratches up the face to much or loses it like he did this time.
summary: Husbands go to watch for work!

reviewText: All I wanted was a digital watch that had a few functions (timer, alarms, 2 time zones), was no-fuss (the velcro "FastWrap" strap is a cinch), and was something I didn't worry about banging against a rock or getting wet when I was outdoors. This watch has been through a lot and "keeps on ticking!" One small note - the strap can get a bit "funky" after wearing it for a few weeks/months, but I just scrub with some dish soap and an old toothbrush, let it air dry overnight, and problem solved! Oh, and BTW, this is my second watch of the same model - the first lasted over 5 years of banging, smacking and soaking...  :-)
This is my third Timex Expedition T48061.  I love the Velcro band, and the watch keeps PERFECT time!  The shipment was super fast!  In a few years, I will order another one!
The watch lasted only one month! Took it on vacation, brand new- did not last past the first dive in the lake. It fogged up, then stopped working. CHEAP!!!!

Sad to say I'm getting older.  My eyes aren't great.  My memory is less than it once was.  My patience for technology is limited.  Sorry to take away any "cool factor,"  but this is the most practical everyday watch for me.  The display is large and clear, including the date.  The back light button is big and right in the middle of the watch.  The Indiglo back lighting is excellent.  The controls are clearly marked and intuitive.  Unless I intend to go really deep sea diving (I don't), the water resistance insures I can be absent minded and do dishes or jump in the shower while wearing my watch and it will work.  The velcro strap is easier to manipulate than a standard buckle.  I am a thin man, so I'm very happy this isn't an overly thick and/or wide watch, which would look ridiculous on my small wrists.  Still, it's clearly a men's watch.  Finally, it's a fairly inexpensive watch, so I don't fuss over it getting a little banged up.OK, two notes worth considering:  First, the crystal does get easily scratched and scuffed, which can ruin the display.  This could easily be a deal-breaker for people.  I don't mind, because the scratches are easily buffed out with some polishing compound.  Second, with heavy use, the velcro on the strap will wear out fairly quickly.  Mine lasted about a year.  It wore out before the battery.  A replacement strap is, maybe $7-$10.  Again, I don't mind, but remember $10 is about a quarter to a third of the price of the watch, so it's something which should give a consumer pause.It's not the best looking watch.  It's not cool. It's not fashionable.  It just gets the job done better and more affordably than any other watch I've ever owned.
I have been using this watch for some time now. It's not fancy but keeps great time & has many features.
I have used this watch for years.  When the local store quit carrying these I found them on Amazing On.  They seem like the same ones!

I've owned at least 6 of these excellent watches for decades and I am always 100% pleased.  I use all 3 alarms throughout the day, from waking up to meeting reminders, doctor appointments, etc.  I've used the indiglo light at theaters to find items I've dropped, when looking for front door keyhole in the dark, and of course to tell time in the dark.  The velcro band is great for a snug fit around all wrist sizes, and the water resistant ability is handy when at the beach or swimming pool (I don't need to worry about taking it off).  But the best part is their low price! I am very tough with my hands - whether lifting weights at the gym, working on my cars, or moving heavy furniture, boxes, etc...but these Timex watches keep on ticking!  I usually replace them after I've scratched the bezel, gotten grease/dirt allover them, worn out the velcro band, or misplaced them.  I highly recommend these watches!

For the seller, everything came in a perfect timely manner and the watch was exactly the correct one.For the watch, I've been hooked on Timex's Expedition watch since I was 12. Every time one gets broken/stolen I replace it with it's newer version. I love the multi-time zone mode for traveling, and multiple alarms, and the simple design of features like timers and the light.Highly recommended.
summary: Exactly as Described, and I've Been Hooked for 10 Years

reviewText: It tells the time, and looks okay.But the face seems plastic and scratched way too easily.Would not buy again.

My first concern was that the band wouldn't fit over my hand unless I completely undid the velcro. The band was still a bit smaller than I'd like for my wrist size(the reason for 4 stars instead of 5), but I went ahead and started using it.Setup was pretty standard. The one thing that I just got "WOWED" by was the alarm, prompting me to write this review. You have the standard alarm features PLUS the option of Daily, Weekday only or weekends only. That is the first time on a digital watch that I've ever seen this type of option. Personally I think this feature is brilliant on a watch.
summary: Awesome watch, but band is a bit small

reviewText: This is my third purchase of this watch over the years.  I thought I lost my last one, so ordered another.  I really like the Velcro band because it is completely adjustable.  Unfortunately, after the watch has aged quite a bit, the Velcro doesn't hold well in water so I use a small  rubber band as a keeper to hold it in the folded position.  That's the only reason I did not give it five stars.  Despite this, I think the watch is an excellent value.  I use this watch at home and it gets quite a bit of abuse.  It has otherwise stood up well and I've never had one leak despite quite a bit of swimming and snorkeling.  I use the timer function to remind me to flip meat on the grill and the alarms for a variety of situations.  It has been a very versatile tool for me.
summary: I keep buying this same watch because I really like it

reviewText: My husband loves this watch - his 'weekend watch' ... it replaced the previous one, same model.  The old watch didn't die, just the band wore out (he has had it a few years).  The band is not replaceable - but we knew that going in.  Works well, inexpensive and comfortable.

This is an excellent watch. The reviews of it being too small are not germane to all wrists. I admittedly have an average sized to small sized wrist, but felt the watch was large enough nonetheless. The strap has has no problem adhering so far after one month of usage. The watch itself functions well. Intuitive to operate. Would buy again.

I've had this watch for several months. The dual time feature was very useful when we vacationed in Europe. I use the multiple alarm feature regularly.This is a great watch, easy to use, at a great price.
summary: Great Watch at a Great Price

reviewText: I love this watch. Bought the first one in the early oughts because I needed a sturdy hiking watch. Fell in love with the multiple options for alarms (3), dual time settings (awesome for traveling) timer/chrono function, indiglo option = it was da bomb. When the battery died four years later, I immediately replaced it with the same brand and the love affair continued.Watch no. 2 died just a few weeks ago and I was lost without it. Thought I didn't need to bother now because well, that's what phones are for, right?Well, now I'm trying to get into swimming more and I need a timer. Lots easier to have a waterproof watch around than a delicate phone so I broke down and ordered watch No. 3. Plus, it's so nice to have a basic watch for when I travel that I don't have to take off at security. This is an awesome watch.That being said, an earlier poster was correct. The face is delicate and scratches easily and once the battery goes, it's just cheaper to buy a new one (although I'd really prefer buying a new battery just to avoid waste). And yes, the strap can weaken when you dunk it in water enough so I'd recommend you don't swim with it. Otherwise, you'll have a working unit but a destroyed strap that can't be replaced easily.But overall, love, love, love this watch. Timex, thank you for getting something right and keeping it right.

I picked up this Timex model about 6 months ago. I love the velcro strap. It is comfortable and solves the problem of finding the "perfect hole" in most bands. For me the perfect hole never does exist. If my watch is too tight I move to the next hole and then it is loose and rolling around on my wrist, which I can not stand.This T48061 fits me perfectly. It is lightweight to the point of not even realizing you have it on. The module itself is great. Keeps great time, and setting it is a breeze with the prompts you receive on the screen of the watch during setting mode...great feature.I have used it during chainsaw operation, fence building, and various other jobs and it never misses a beat. I actually bought 2 of them so I would have a back up! For the money this is a great Timex!

Definitely not water resistant. Failed from use in a swimming pool. I've had several other timex expedition products and they were not much better. Expedition watches are not very rugged. I've had it with Timex all the way around.
This is my husband's 2nd Timex Expedition watch.  He loves this watch.  It can take whatever he puts it through, and he is hard on watches - working at the farm and hunting!
good dependable watch.  easy to read face.  what especially works for me is the velcro adjustable band.  this is a replacement for a Timex used for years, which finally gave out.
Great watch - keeps good time. Nice accessible buttons (especially the one on the front to turn on the Indiglo.The alarms are loud enough for me (even to wake me up).
summary: Timex Men's Outdoor Performance Chrono Alarm Timer Expedition Watch #T48061

reviewText: 3 alarmsstopwatchchronograph countdown timer, lapback lightI've purchased this watch many times in a row and have been very satisfied.  Good price too.

Good watch for the money. I wear reading glasses and have no problem reading the time even when I'm not wearing my glasses. If there was glare from the sun I hit the back light button and could see the time fine. Got it completely soaked while kayaking and it kept working.  I haven't really used the alarm and timer other than testing and they work well.

This simple and inexpensive model is perfect. I am wearing them for 2 years and see no cons at all.And pros are:- Smaller and lighter than most other models- Have reflective screen- Have "intuitive interface" with tips - the only watch of this kind that could be easily adjusted without the manual.I don't use stopwatch and other features anyway.

I needed a comfortable, light weight watch to wear while hiking with my dog.  I found it with the Timex Men's Expedition watch.  Easy to take on and off, waterproof, durable on long day hikes; I often forget I'm wearing it.  If you are looking for a simple, comfortable option; this is it.
summary: Simple.  Durable.  Exactly what I needed.

reviewText: My last TIMEX EXPEDITION lasted almost 6 years. I wore it swimming in my pool, in the ocean, etc.The alarm, timer, and light are very dependable.Setting the functions are very easy.The velcro band is the best!You will be very happy with this watch!!
summary: The BEST watch for the price.

reviewText: I have had this approximate model for years. It has a large digital readout, day/date, alarm, night light and a stopwatch. It is easy to read and use, is slim on my wrist (no fat divers' watches for me!), nice looking and inexpensive. In addition, it is non-allergenic to my apparently acid skin chemistry. No base metal finish to turn green and make sores on my skin. I love it.

This watch remined me of my school days and its still a classic. The company that popularised digital watches. Casio makes some cool digital watches that are out of reach for many other watch manufacturers even today. Bought this as a gift for my nephews... Let the tradition continue.

The Casio F91W1 is perhaps the greatest time piece ever created since Harrison invented the first reliable watch in Greenwich England. It is classy, sleek, reliable and the battery lasts 7 years. While most people strive to constantly score bigger, brighter, clunkier and more expensive watches, I'll stick with the basics - thank you very much.

I have had this watch before & this is my 3rd one. I like the price of this watch. It is very affordable. Very tough and can get wet. The alarm feature has worked well for me in the past. The backlight is very good if you are in the movies & want to see the time. I don't have to worry about losing this watch because I could get another one. I would recommend.
I can keep track of the time (it gains about 5s per month), measure my jogging pace, and trade a $60M hedge fund using the alarm, all for $10.  Truly these are the days of miracle and wonder!

I love this watch.  It has all I need - time, date, alarm, and backlight.  It's thin and lightweight.  It's so cheap, I don't fret if it gets washed, dropped, scratched, or dropped in the deep fryer.My only complaint is that the watchband is not that long, and even though I have average-sized man wrists, I have to use the last or next to last hole to wear it, which means there isn't a lot to tuck into the strap band.  If you have big wrists, this probably won't fit you.
The alarm only sounds for 20 seconds, which i slept through on the first test.

This watch has everything I want and nothing I don't.  I wanted a light, stopwatch, alarm, day and date displayed, water-resistance, small face, cheap price, easy to use, and reliable.  I set it to US official time and checked it a month later, it was only 7 seconds fast.  Casio has kept making this time-tested, user-friendly design for a long time, and I hope to be able to buy another one when this one breaks in 20 years.

the features on this watch are very minimal and not well laid out.you can get a very similar looking watch with a LOT more useful features, the Casio W-71not only that, but this watch is featured twice on Amazon; search 'F-91W' and the same watch comes up at $11.48 w/ free S.S. shipping. Even at that price, I suggest not getting it.No month or year on displayNo count-down timeretc.(see my other review on the other offering of this watch for more details)Spend a little more and get the W-71-1V for $18.45.
I bought this watch 10 years ago and I totally abuse it with use.  It just will not die so I can justify getting a new one.  Oh well, on to the eleventh year...

The Casio F91W is a simle timepiece that's super-reliable, water-resistant, and inexpensive.  The battery lasts a long time, too.  I had one and it was just a perfect utilitarian alarm watch.I lost the watch a couple years ago, but this morning's MSNBC report that the U.S. gov't has found this particular watch to be the favorite among terrorists brought back my fond memories of this durable timepiece.
summary: Simple, reliable digital watch, terrorists' favorite?

reviewText: I searched out the Casio F91-W1 as I had such good memories of an early version of a Casio sports watch.  It lasted forever, other than the bi-annual replacement of the band.  On the internet, it looked like this was a simple version of the watch of my memory.As it turned out, it's a basic version of the same, and for the price (less than 10.00) who could complain?  The mechanics all work well, it keeps good time, and provides a chronometer and alarm.It is a little petit...doesn't really look like a man's watch...and unlike the earlier version lacks a count-down timer.  Otherwise it appears to be the usual excellent Casio product.

I bought a watch like this in the early 80s, and since then I've bought many watches, but for some reason, I always return to this classic digital watch as my favorite piece to wear on my wrist. It's light and almost unnoticeable. It doesn't have that many thrills, it's barely water resistant, but it has the simple classic look the digital watches I remember from my childhood. Yes, you can buy a bulky G-Shock or whatever, but this watch is one of its kind. It will not stand out and blend in nicely with any attire, even business suits. Wear it and be proud!
best whatch ever si simple and so easy to use. i want to buy 2 more for my dad and brother

If Casio would make a more durable watch strap, I'd never need to buy another one.  But I love this watch.  The strap usually lasts about 2 years and then I throw away the watch and buy another just like it.It's easy to program and I like the alarm and timer functions.
Have been using Casio watches for a long time. It's a very good value. The last one is still working, but the band broke. I bought a new one rather than search for and install a band.
summary: Excellent watch and a good price.

reviewText: It's an excellent little watch.  It's light, waterproof enough for swimming, keeps accurate time, has a light to read the time it in the dark, and it's cheap enough that it's not a big deal if you lose it.  It's also the watch listed in the Combat Status Review Tribunal transcripts of 18 Guantanamo detainees and given as a reason for their continued detention.  (Wikipedia: "Casio F91W")  It's a unique conversation piece, a political statement, and a practical purchase all rolled into one.
Great watch, great price, GREAT DEAL... How can you beat that!

This is a good, inexpensive, basic watch.  If you just want a watch that will let you know the time in either 12 or 24 hour formats, has an alarm feature and a no frills band, this is the one for you.  It is modestly priced.  This is the watch I've been using in both civilian and military worlds for over 15 years.  The alarm works well in a low noise environment and when you're not totally exhausted by continuous 18-20 hour work days.  I've slept through it it beeping in my ear, then.  Additionally, the ones I've had usually run about 8 seconds fast per month. I also like that it has only 3 buttons to manipulate, to get to all the features, alarm, stop watch, lap timer, to change the date/time, and to illuminate the watch face to read it in the dark. All in all a very good watch that I'll keep on buying.

It looks very nice in person. Looks clean sexy. Not too big, not too small. Perfect size for an averaged size person. This is my first watch and I'm glad I purchased this one. I love it!EDIT: this watch scratches easily. I left it on my car dashboard because it was hot and getting uncomfortable and the bottom of the band (around the clasp) has a bunch of scratch marks. The front glass however is very strong and durable. it always manages to stay clean and scratch free no matter what touches it.

This watch is exactly the watch I was looking for.  It arrived promptly and is just the right size. It keeps perfect time (so far), and it looks nice on my wrist.  And being vain and a sucker for iconic brands, I enjoy having the Swiss Army icon on my wrist.  In fact, the watch looks like it should cost more than it acutally did.  The watch is basic; not too flashy; just right.  This was an early Christmas present to myself, and I love it.

This watch looks great and feels very well built.  A sapphire crystal and Swiss movement for $200 is a great deal.  I was disappointed in the total lack of lumination on this watch, though.  At night, it is impossible to read.
I gave this as a present and it came in great shape and my boyfriend loves it.
This watch is a good value.It is nice to not have to purchase a battery.It is stylish and has a nice sweep-second hand that is easy to see.

If you do and want a very simple-faced one with the very useful light-up feature, this one will go for about a decade before the light up feature dies. I may get another one to take me to the grave!Good, fast shipping from this seller too.

I did not get what I ordered.  Shipping back was not going to be convient and then my son tore the package so I am stuck.  Wish it would have been right the first time.

I had one of these years ago and just recently found them once again for sale.  They do a good job and are VERY light weight.  They will scratch easily and WILL BLOW away so I bought four of them this time.!

The rep suggested that small size is for children and I should order large size for adults.  The two items I ordered arrived promptly.  However they are not the same as what was shown in the pic.  First, in the pic shown on the website, the height of the lenses measuring from top to bottom looks like 1" (1-1/4" at the most), and of rectangular or oblong shape.  The ones I received are 2" in height, and of square shape.  Second, it is too wide to fit behind my two different pairs of glasses and my husband's two different pairs.  Third, the part that was supposed to sit on top of the nose-pads is way too small to even fit.I contacted Maxiaids through Amazon and was instructed to use the return label that was included in the original package to return the items.  When I told Maxiaids that there wasn't a return label, I was then advised to return the items at my own expense.  When I asked if I would be reimbursed the total amount of my order plus the return postage, I was told that "upon examining your (my) returned merchandise, if we (Maxiaids) find that it is materially different than the item as advertised, you (I) will  be refunded for the postage costs".  I was also told in an earlier email that "your (my returned) item must be in brand-new and resellable condition".Should Maxiaids have not known exactly what was shipped when the order was filled, without having to examine the returned items?  Does that mean there are different versions?  Since a return label was never included in the original package, my assumption is that Maxiaids has no intention of paying for any return postage at all.  I also needed to open one package to try it on so the one returned item could be deemed not "brand new" and not in "resellable condition".It's not worth my time to go through the trouble of going to the post office and paying for postage to return the items because I may very likely end up getting  no refund at all.  My past purchases from Amazon included small ticket items (e.g. audio Y cable splitter from Technology Galaxy - excellent customer service for returning/exchanging a $2.90 item) and not too small items (e.g. MacBook Pro) and I was most happy with its service and products.  This is the worse customer service that I have ever experienced.

hey were as advertised and work great. I like to use them with my clip ons and have it extra dark in very bright sunlight and they also block the sun form the sides
