The zipper isn't rough or annoying on your face either. I like these because, when its really cold, the Balaclava heats up the air I breathe and humidifies it as well. I also don't like having to walk around babysitting a scarf all day when I'm out.
This hood fits well, and the zipper in front lets you regulate temperature.  It came in very handy while moving snow this winter!
I highly recommend this balaclava!  Keeps your head nice and warm and stops your ears from falling off when it is super cold out!!!
Great product warm,thanks for being patient with payment,I have a couple of these and really are warm and cozy when cold.
Have used this several times and it is warm and protects from wind and cold really well.  I would recommend

This Balaclava was a lot thinner material than I was expecting. It was decently warm though. My biggest complaint was that the neck does not extend very low. It barely went under my coat collar. Also, I found that with it all the way zipped up it made my goggles fog up. Minor issues though. Overall, it was an okay purchase and got the job done, and the zipper is convenient.
summary: Okay for the money, there are better ones out there

reviewText: The front zipper feature is just great.  It's easy on easy off, especially with the zipper.  It made with quality.  However, I use is when biking.  The cold still got through.  My fix wear a beanie underneath.  It seems long enough in the photo, but the neck could be a little longer.  Without the wind chill factor, I'm sure it would be fine, but for keeping could out when cycle probably not.  The zipper is so cool is almost makes up for it.

The fit is great (although it does not cover the entire neck region and requires a scarf for full coverage).Also, I found the balaclava to be quite warm and lightweight for the extremely cold Chicago winter weather. However, on the first day I wore the thing, the zipper completely fell off! It felt quite flimsy at the start, but I didn't anticipate it to break almost immediately. It may be important to note: I don't have a very large head; it did not at all feel particularly tight in any location: the zipper just broke.
summary: Warm, but broke the very first day I wore it.

reviewText: Ordered this for my significant other because he so graciously cleans my car for me in the winter. This Balaclava kept him warm on the coldest days, could be thicker for the price but otherwise great.

Tough winter.  Wanted non-scratchy head covering.  Really meant for wearing snow goggles not glasses.  Had to zip it down far enough that exhale didn't affect glasses.  At that point, face wasn't well protected.  Probably fine for skier/snowboarder but not for glass wearing snow removal.

When buying head hats/caps & hand-wirst gear/gloves etc.,. usually take a mens medium size. This is Medium-Large size. If it is supposed to be a near snug fit THIS WILL NOT SUFFICE! It does work keeping my head warm when using my 100% Cotton Snow Beanie-Cap Over it. As for my face, when using my Hoodie pulled tight over this keeps my face from the chilly cold windy nights though slight sweat occurs.

The idea of the front zipper to open the balaclava is good, but it doesn't completely open the item, so still an over the head routine is needed. Moreover, the zipper makes the item slightly uncomfortable, a bit stiff. Will look again for a kinder, gentler solution.
summary: Zipper not fully opening and a bit stiff

reviewText: I live in NH and walk my dogs in the wind and cold.  What attracted this Balaclava to me is the zipper.  I had another design and it would squash my nose and I looked like a bank robber.  The zipper allows me to vent the Balaclava and the material is soft, and fits under a hood.  It also looks like something one would wear to stay warm and not to hold up a store.  My head is medium/large and it fits well.  If someone had a large head or a lot of hair, it might be snug.

This Balaclava is very soft micro fleece.  The zippered front is also nice.  Unfortunately, one size does not fit all.  I had to take it in quite a bit in order to keep it out of my eyes.  Fortunately, there are two seams down the back which made for easy alterations.  Also, if you wear glasses, I would suggest using a defogger on them in order to see.  Otherwise, this does the trick keeping the head, ears and face warm on bitter cold days.  I use mine when I take my dogs for a walk.

The zipper fell apart on this otherwise nice balaclava on day one. On closer inspection the maker didnt put anything on the bottom of the zipper to keep it together. The zip just fell right off. Pictures to follow!
I bought this for my brothers who work in the elements. Their foreman and co-workers were jealous and want one too. Good price.
Good fit and cover good against windy cold. Love the fact I don't have to take the mask off in order to drink or eat.
It might not come down as far on your neck as you'd like.  I can still wear a scarf with this, but I was hoping it would be a one size fits all kind of deal.  The zipper is definitely a must.
summary: If you have thick wooly hair with a big head...

reviewText: I wear this in combination with an aviator hat and goggles.  It is warm, convenient with the zipper in front and slips on and off my head easily when the zipper is open.  I also like to wear the zipper down when I am riding in warmer weather but will soon be getting on the freeway or when I need to talk.  The fleece is somewhat thin but comfortable and seems to keep me warm in even the coldest weather.  I really like this balaclava.  We searched for hours to find the right one for both me and my husband to wear on the motorcycle, and this is it.
summary: Awesome! Convenient, warm and easy on/off.

reviewText: I use mine all the time for bike commuting in winter.  The ability to unzip and vent before overheating is great.  I also use it for skiing and just bought another one for my wife as well.As others have noted, it does not come down very far on the neck (bottom of neck on a small woman, middle to top of neck on a tall man) but I use scarves in winter all the time, so it's not an issue.  And, because it stays connected beneath the zipper, you can push it off your head to just being around your neck if you are getting too hot on your head.The top is thin fleece, enough to keep your warm but not so much that you overheat.  The thinness also means it is easy to fit beneath ski or bicycle helmets.The micro fleece is very soft and it airs out nicely if it gets damp from breath or sweat.  It washes and dries well, too.
summary: wonderful for winter biking and skiing

reviewText: Although this is what was ordered and the package it came in was labeled correctly that was not what was inside. Since I needed to cover my face with something I had to use the Serius face and nose cover that was in the package. I sent Amozon an e-mail telling them to check their stock for the wrong product marking but never even heard from them with a Thank You!

the product is no doubt good, the material is soft and very comfortable, in freezing cold of Illinois, its giving me grt protection, i generally wear a woolen cap inside it, for better protection, the zip in front, makes easy to wear it, and protects from chilly winds.. very happy that I purchased it :)
This is really good when you are boating to get to the next spot. Kept my face really warm. Also love the price as well. But I didnt get it to do wrong. Just for warmth on those cold days fishing.
summary: Great for fishing to keep warm while on the boat

reviewText: It was going to be a present for my borther in law and he like it, it keeps you warm and is easy to remove.
Worked well while shoving snow, would have given it 5 stars if it had been water resistant, zipper nice feature allows you to zip down if your getting too hot.
Work in the freezer and this head gear keeps my head and face warm, love the zipper, makes putting it on and taking it off faster and easier

Zipper broke within an hour. Oh it does keep you warm and having zipper on it is a great idea but within an hour of use, the zipper broke and in order to get it off my head had to tear it off so basically was good for about an hour before had to throw away.

I love this balclava it is just what I imagined it to be.  It is middle weight and unzips but not all the way so I can eat or drink while I have my helmet up when taking a break from snowmobiling.I would recommend this to anyone who wants to stay warm.  I even used it riding around the yard alone and it was great it kept me dry and warm.

the material is very comfortable.  bought for cycling in Chicago winter.  Works very well.  Zipper is a great addition.  Allow me to open up the balaclava after I warms up on the bike.  it also reduce fog on my cycle glasses.

Easy on and off.  Liked being able to open the zipper to cool off. I deducted  1 star because the location of the zipper sometimes scratches but not enough to not use it.  I only use it while shoveling and plowing snow at the house.
A little short for my liking. Great price. The cover is warm and does the job required. warm and cozy.

It is a great, warm balaclava. The zipper in front is good for when you don't want your nose covered or to open all the way an wear as a neck warmer. The item I was sent, however is far shorter than the picture. My balaclava only covers down to the bottom of my jaw and 1/2 my neck. Where the zipper pull in the picture is where my headgear ends. If I did not have a tall collared jacket, I would have at least 1" of my neck flesh exposed to the elements. Still a great item, but mine was much shorter.
summary: Item recieved not what was pictured.

reviewText: Fits well on my 8 year old son. Look forward to using it on those windy and cold winter days.
summary: Great for my 8 year old son

reviewText: My nephew, 29 years old, said he needed some kind of mask as he walks to work in Philadelphia. I researched all of the masks and found that people were really happy with this one. When I told my nephew I had purchased this for him and it was on the way, he was hesitant, but when he got it he raved about it! As everyone else had said the zipper really saves him from getting steamy and he wears it all the time. If you knew my nephew and how picky he is about his clothes and accessories you would know this one had to be great. I hardly ever write reviews but I just had to comment on this product!! My nephew is a little over 6 ft tall and 200 lbs and said the neck was not too short, something I had read in other reviews. Great product!
summary: Bought this for my nephew 29 years old and very picky about what he wears - He loved it!!

reviewText: Husband used this as a master mechanic at a steel mill for night shift. it keeps his head warm, but he complained the zipper was a little stiff for his comfort under his hard hat.

HUSBIE WORKS AT CASINO AS A SECURITY OFFICER, WHERE HE GET POSTED DIFFERENT SPOTS,HE COMPLAINS ON HOW HE GETS SO COLD ON WINTER, WHERE WIND IS BLOWING SO HARD,.HOW HIS EARS AND NOSE GETS SO COLD, SO I FIGURED AMAZON HAS EVERYTHING YOU NEED,.AND I CAME A CROSS WITH THIS BALACLAVA, HUSBIE CREDITED ME FOR PICKING A RIGHT ONE.YEY ME!!!!!! HUSBIE IS SO HAPPY I PURCHASED THIS, IT HELPS TO KEEP HIM WARM,.SO I WOULD HIGHLY RECOMMEND BUYING THIS, CAME IN THE MAIL SOONER THAN EXPECTED.THANK YOU AMAZON..!!!!!!!

This fleece balaclava is nice, warm, and comfortable. Using the zipper allows maximum warmth potential. This morning it was in the teens and being outside for over an hour was not bad at all. I would prefer it to be just a little longer, resulting in a 4 not 5 rating.

This balaclava with a zip is great because when you unzip it you no longer look like a bank robber. It still gives a fair degree of protection from the elements with the zip open and you can zip it up when your not near any banks. Fleece is a very comfortable material but this one is thin so not for extreme cold. But its well worth the money and i ordered another as a spare. The zip is lined on the inside so you dont feel the cold metal. I saw other balaclavas with zips + with beaks on them like on a cap. These make you look even less 'scary' but they were made out of bloody acrylic! which is really itchy and i don't know how people wear them.There are better balaclavas out there but this one has the zip, is cheap and is perfectly alright and i would recommend it to anyone who likes balaclavas but doesn't want to be mistaken for a mugger.

I bought this to go under my helmet. The zipper is a good idea, but the balaclava doesn't fit my face very well. it's much too loose and uncomfortable. So I can't say for sure if it's a bad product, but it just didn't fit my face well.
summary: Nice idea, but didn't really fit

reviewText: This balaclava is well made, stands up to use, and the front zipper feature can be useful. I find this balaclava minimally useful and certainly acceptable, but other balaclavas do a far better job.
summary: Not Bad, Could Be Much Better

reviewText: I purchased three of the balaclava covers for my family and they are great! Now let me tell you why- they are very lightweight so you don't have that heavy hat feeling. Easy on and off and the zipper in front allows you to have the amount of coverage that you desire. A small child can even wear this in the cold. And really anyone can wear these. I highly recommend this cover for the cold weather!

This garment is not long enough to adequately cover the neck. Even when worn with a zip-up turtleneck sweater, any adjustment of the hood's zipper causes the bottom of the hood to come out of your sweater or jacket, exposing the neck to the icy cold. Fail!

Sometimes when you remove these things, the static makes you hair stick up straight. The Zipper makes removal easy. Fits my medium head and long hair just fine.  I still feel like a bank robber in it, but I like it better than the others I have.  If you have a big face, it will probably hit under your nose, but it covers mine.
summary: Works well, without totally destroying your hair

reviewText: The person who received this gift stated that it kept him very warm and he likes it very much. He is very happy with it?
definietly does the trick, I really don't like full face helemets, this has kept me fine during the Ky winters
The zipper is an excellent feature, when you get hot you can reach in and unzip it a little to cool off.
The neck is a bit too small and I need to wear a scarf, however, it is still warm and the zipper is great.
It is not as thick as I expected. The fitting is loose. It is not easy to take off unless unzipped.

This balaclava was exactly what my husband needed in Boston. The fit around the head is just right, the length was enough to tuck into the neck of his jacket, and the zipper option really helped to give him air when he was getting too warm. He absolutely loved this, and it was definately worth it!
summary: Very warm and great on windy days!

reviewText: Comfortable as can be and just warm enough most of the time.  I love the zipper in the front to help adjust how warm this rig is.

This zippered balaclava is just right for any winter activity. I bought mine specifically for running, so I can actually talk to people and not look like a thug when I stop places. I also wore it cross country skiing and my mom was jealous of this convenient feature (Christmas idea for next year!). It's great for when you need some airflow during your activity of choice.The reason I only gave it four stars is because they could have made the neck portion longer. Unless you wear a collared jacket/top or secure it with another scarf (seems repetitive, right?), you will have a very chilly  neck. The zipper is a great length, but they could add more fabric underneath to make it more friendly for those of us with normal-length necks....or I'm just tall.Also, for the reviews that are frustrated with the fact that the zipper doesn't come all the way undone- don't let that discourage you! If you are riding on a snowmobile with thick gloves on and you accidentally unzip it all the way- do you want to be fumbling around trying to zip it back up as your party takes off? I think this is a great intentional feature because it prevents unintentional unzipping/losing of balaclava.
This is a great product. I highly recommend it over non-zippered models. You will be grateful that you can zip down when it gets a little too steamy under there.
summary: Great that you can adjust the zipper

reviewText: My husband needed a balaclava to wear when he takes a walk in the winter.  This one fits the bill.  After he tried it a time or two, he wanted to be able to have it open completely when he would  be mid walk.  To make this happen I had to replace the zipper with a seperating zipper, doable, if you have good sewing skills.Would recommend that the maker put in a seperating zipper, we were not able to find one made this way.
I like this item but the chemical smell is very strong when I first used it.  I had to gently wash it and it seems to be mostly gone.  I like the zipper.
summary: Warm but has a strong smell of chemical treatment at first

reviewText: I purchased 2 of these because of the strong NE winters and they work great. When I get too hot I can even pull the zipper down. Worth the money on those killer days.
This item fits well and it is Not going to fog your glasses. Also it is light weight and warm.
Doesn't look like the one on picture,  neck is too short, too thin, very hard to keep it stay, the zipper not as good as what the ads and review telling.
summary: Does not worth $2, don't trust the 5 starts review

reviewText: Okay here is why you might consider this simple, cheap balaclava over the more expensive alternatives:- slightly more generous eye opening, enabling use of regular or safety glasses- overall more generous fit. I dont feel like my head is in compression shorts- more generous fit also means my nose is not being squished to the front of my face-shorter neck area. Allows the tall collar of a parka to zip all the way up and seal properly without extra fleece bunching up under it and strangling you- lighter fleece allows you with slight adjustment to indeed wear a cap over the balaclava. You might not think this matters, but it does- despite lighter or "thinner" fleece, I just snowblowed 800 square feet of driveway from winter storm hurcules in 25 below wind chill and snow blowing back onto me like a blizzard and my head did not get cold in the slightest- ZIPPER. I can take a break, unzip the zipper and drink fluids to stay hydrated without having to un-layer everything- zipper does have a light storm flap on the inside, so no, the zipper will not chafe your chin, lips or noseRecommendation: BUY IT. No, wait. At this price, BUY TWO in case they are discontinued.
I use 4 different head covers of this kind for snowboarding and this is the warmest and largest one I have.I do like it but it gets wet instantly and does not seem to dry very fast.
summary: Warm, Huge, Does not wick moisture very well

reviewText: Not too snug and not too loose, The zipper is great for snack and if needing a drink. Also the zipper options allows you to get all the hot air out of the mask. Love it, probaly will order another.
My fault but did not allow for thickness of the balaclava and it makes helmet too tight.  3 more words
I love the skull emblem on the side.. the glasses were a little big but still wear them...
when first i looked at the watch, i loved it.but once i bought it and arrived into my house, i just fall in love.very elegantgreat qualitytuff usebig size too. meets my expectation

I've been looking for a rugged, digital, clip-on watch, and I thought that in this product I had found what I was seeking. However, the second time I wore it, the watch-band pin, which holds the carabiner and watch together, snapped.This is a huge design flaw. Using a spring-loaded watch-band connection pin means that this "tough" watch is incredibly fragile. It broke my heart to return the watch, because it looked so cool, but if one cannot wear it, clipped to one's belt, what's the point of it? I really wish that Dakota would redesign this watch with a truly "tough" construction. I'd be first in line to try it.
I ordered this on October 19, 2012, received it October 23, 2012, it is now November 17 and the watch has already broken off the clip so much for tough this thing could not even make it a month.
Date,time and and the ability to illuminate at night and large dial is all I wanted.I haven't checked the other features.I thought the 7/8" thick watch was a bit overdone so I gave it a 4 rating.

The watch arrived as advertised.  After 3 days the clip broke and fell off.  The pins that held the clip were spring loaded and departed at sub orbital speed. My expectation was that this watch was rugged and could be used in active sports.  It keeps time and has a clear readable face but the engineering on the clip was not well conceived. Think of it as an attractive piece of jewelry not a robust time piece.
This watch was exactly what I was looking for.  It came within 5 days of being ordered.  Very pleased all around.
I use this watch at work. It is tough and rugged. It attaches to any area on your clothing. I liked it so much I bought another one.

I was very pleased with this watch, as was my son who is now stationed in Afghanistan.  And the good part is, it doesn't get in the way when working or typing, it doesn't create tan lines on the wrist, and it doesn't make your wrist sweat when the temps get to 130 degrees!  It's a perfect little work-out watch as well.

okay, i have to say that it is big, you can see it even in low lite even though it does have a lite so you can see the time, look at the compass, read the date and day, the clip is sturdy and it wouldnt be so big if it did not have a plastic protecter all around it, i like the fact that i can bang it around and it is protected, the time has big numbers so it is a great for the outdoors or whenever you just need to look at the time. and it is pretty easy to set. the only personal thing i dont like about it is that there is no weight to it at all, i like it other then that..  i will use it a lot on shows and outdoor trips....i like it...

This is the second one I have had an love how easy it is to read the time in low light! My first one had the swivel pin break. It is not a good watch to have if you will be banging it around with rough working environments!

This is a good buy as a clip watch. It has all the functions that I need when I am not wearing a wrist watch. It is larger that I expected, but that is not a problem for me. I would recommend it to anyone needing a clip watch for work or play.

I was looking for a watch with multiple functions for travel, heavy duty, multiple time zones, alarms and so forth.  So far, I haven't been disappointed.  It has lived up to all my expectations.  Love the heavy duty clip - out of the way.  Green display and night light option is a plus.  Compass is also a plus for general travel and has kept me out of trouble several times while traveling on vacations while walking around in unfamiliar foreign locations.  A little bulky but I would replace it with an exactly the same if anything ever happened to this one!
Bought this a while ago,  Use it everyday, even when I scuba dive. Just clip it on my bcd and go.  Would buy it again...
Lots of features and you only need the light in total darkness. It's a little big and bulky, other than that , I love it.

It seems watches and I don't get along. That is until I started buying Dakota. My last one lasted almost 10 years. I used to go through 3 or 4 a year. Something with my body chemistry makes them go haywire.  Highly recommend this brand. They are durable, reliable, and reasonably priced.
summary: Most durable watch I've ever had.

reviewText: This watch works fine and the large digital readout is very nice for those who need reading glasses, but have left them somewhere else.  However, it is simply too large, too thick, too bulky.  It is 3/4 of an inch thick and at least 2 inches in diameter.  The advertisement photos do not provide scale, otherwise I'd have chosen a smaller model.

This is the second Dakota watch that I have purchased. My first one was five years old before the battery went bad, so I bought another and replaced the battery in my old one. Now we have two of the best watches around. Everyone asks where we got them because they are so practical. Would recommend them to anyone for any activity!

The watch itself is great but the clip pin will bust off within a month if you are active. I was sliding under a machine at work, I know more than rolled over and it popped apart. I would not buy this model again.

Watch is great however the pin attaching the carabiner clip to the watch keeps snapping....I've had it replaced 3 times already and I've only owned the watch for a little over a month.  You would think for the price they would have come up with a little more rugged design.
Not  a bad fob watch for the price ... compass re-orienting requires a degree in something ... wouldn't recommend it
summary: Operating instructions leave a great deal to be desired

reviewText: It's great for a costume, or any number of things. It comes with a chain, two tags, and a little extra loop chain.Note though that it is really black, not silver or dark shiny metal black, but mat black. It's not that metalic look you might want. It's black.

This dog tag is just as it is described, a blank black dog tag. It seems a bit thinner than the standard steel ones, and feels lighter, also. The tag came with two ball chains, one short and one long. The quality of the ball chain is shoddy, however. It's black, just like the tag, but after use the black paint on the outside starts to rub off and reveal the brass underneath. However, the tag itself does not seem to have this problem. I would recommend getting a steel chain for the tag if you want to wear it.
summary: Alright, but of slightly bad quality

reviewText: This nursing bra is wrong in SO many ways! I totally understand why it';s discontinued. First of all, the color selection was terrible.  It only came in white; however, my order was black, which I was happy with because I hate white undergarments. Next, the straps war way too short  for a full figured (read: plus sized gal) such as myself. Also, the cup size is misleading and way too small. I'm gasping for air because the size is so not what I need, it feels 3 cups too little. Lastly, the picture on the packaging and the website shows a smooth bra front.  Mine are all lace front. I will be returning these bras, which is most unfortunate as my baby is due next week and my package was already late arriving to my home. Better luck next time... sigh. Recap: this ain't what you want! Buyer BEWARE.
summary: this ain't what you want! To the Buyer BEWARE.

reviewText: 6'3" guy here with 36" inseam. Googled that Road Runner carried sports tights for tall people and decided to order. XL Tall fits past my ankle with a 36" inseam. Havent fun with them yep, but the fact that these fit make it well worth the purchase.

With a 36" inseam I was having more that a little difficulty finding a compression tight that didn't look like a pair of nickers. These fit the bill. They look and feel great! I would say they are good for up to 37" inseam.
summary: If you are tall look no further.

reviewText: Maybe these tights are more conservative than a CW-X style or an Adidas TechFit. But it does the job and it is 2x better than a Underarmour or Nike running tights. Very comfortable and even bit of modesty for a running tights. It is also great every climate (Warm or cold).If could be possible I would wear these tights all day long.
summary: Great value tights with a jet performance

reviewText: I'm 6'3" and weigh just under 200 lbs with an inseam of 35".  It is a real pain to find pants and especially any kind of running tights that are long enough; I'm lucky if they make it to the TOP side of my ankle. These Road Runner Sports tights go below the ankle and fit great.  The fit is not too tight, seems about right so far.  Well worth the fifty bucks to get something that actually fits!
This is so funny. I got it for my best friend and she loves it. Too funny and cute for sure.

The cap has a strap that loops through a keeper on one side, but they should have provided a keeper on the right side.  The cap won't stay adjusted without it but just keeps getting looser and looser. I was able to correct this by adding a keeper/slider on the right side, but that should have been provided with the cap.Don't order unless you are prepared to "fix" what the manufacturer left out.
Like the way the hat fits.  I normally wear a size 7. No Velcro on the back of the that I received. Lightweight construction.
summary: Decent - No velcro on back of hat

reviewText: This was bought for my son and he really is enjoying it!!  The quality is amazing and he's very satisfied with his purchase.

Hat seems in good enough shape.  No velcro on back as pictured.  Flag is different color than pictured.  (Dark green instead of tan.)  Misleading photos.  Had I known I would have not had velcro on the back and a green flag instead of tan I would not have bought this item.

Picked up the hat through another distributor, and was a little disappointed with how cheaply made the hat was.  All in all it was a "you get what you pay for" kind of purchase.  Over all that hat has held up fine and for the money you can't beat it for just knocking around.  One interesting thing I will note is that draws a ton of attention in the civilian world.  Army enlisted constantly get pissed off and make snide comments to me while officers seem to like it...guess there in lies the problem ahaha.Civilians for the most part think it is homemade and generally ask me stuff like why are wearing a hat with an American Flag velco patch? or why does your hat have velcro all over it?  I just smile, and go on about my business.  On a few rare occasions I have had guys ask me where to get one and those.Overall it gets a 3 star review because it is cheap, but hey you get what you pay for.
this hat i must say i wear it everyday. it feels good and looks nice good to go out and shoot with to keep the sun off. i love this hat and i will be buying agian from here

This hat is good, but it is on the smaller side.  I wear a 7 1/4 to a 7 1/2 and I can barely get by with it.  The hat will adjust to a larger size, but the bill is small and the depth (from above the ear to the top of the hat) is short.  Overall, a good product, just check the size of your grape before purchasing.

I am usually very happy with all my purchases, however I do feel that I need to let people know that this item is a good quality hat however it says that it comes with a flag patch and it did not.  The only reason that I picked this item is because it came from Amazon and came with a patch, so I am disappointed that it did not.
Great watch.  Great price.  I will never buy a $200 watch for my husband again. What more can I say?

I like timex watches this watch is a little smaller in size than the T5K237,it isn't a womens watch but it is smaller in size than theT5K237 full size watch. I have no problem with this at all, but some might feel that it is more of a female than a male watch. I don't find this to be the case at all. I like it and I also bought the T5k237 full size watch. I like them both.

I got this watch because I saw someone at work wearing one like it. The cost was very reasonable. I wear it on casual Fridays and over the weekend. It's nice to have such an easy to read display. The only thing to consider, if you're considering this watch, is that the band is not very big. I have the band on the second notch, and there's not much play beyond that. My wrist is average size. If your wrist is big, this band will probably be be too small.
summary: A nice watch at a good price

reviewText: Liked the watch, easy to see, needed something I could set to military time, but the band was too short.  Had to return it.

It's a very good watch. It keeps perfect time. And, it does not invite accidentally touching the buttons and changing the display like many digital watches. The strap is very good quality also, The display shows the yime and date vewry clearly-better than other digital watched I have owned.
Just what I wanted at a good price. If this Timex watch lasts as long as my previous one did I will definately be a happy camper.
The description stated this watch has a countdown function, which it doesn't.  As a football official this was the main reason I bought it.  Returned!!

This inexpensive watch has all of the features I need and which I saw on more expensive models. My only issue is the size and location of the days of the week; I find them difficult to see when I'm outside in the sunlight.

This watch has a very large, clear display - perfect for older eyes.  I use it every day for lap swimming.  I have been through more than a dozen watches after decades of running and I have a GPS watch, several dress watches, but the simplicity and functionality of this - at a terrific price - make this a great choice.

This watch is great. Just got mine about 1 week ago, but there is one problem. Most people wouldn't notice this, but there is no option to turn the beep off when switching between the Clock, Stopwatch Etc. But otherwise a great watch for 15 Dollars!
I was looking for an inexpensive replacement for work, I was pleasantly surprised at the ease of use and quality features.

This watch is good value for the price. I'm 55, so I really appreciate the large font. I swim with it, run with it, shower with it, and use the stopwatch functions simultaneously. The only drawback is the easy-to-scratch glass face. It is really easy to scratch.
summary: A good digital watch for the vision impaired

reviewText: It was a great price but I would expect longer than a month of service. The face is starting to cloud up and one of the buttons (the one to make the face glow in the dark) has fallen off.  My 9 year old loved the watch but it can't take a beating.  Wasn't that the old Timex slogan?
Purchased for my 11 year old son.  Waterproof and rugged enough for him to meet curfew deadlines.  Delivered timely and a good value.

I like smaller watches.  This is good quality for the price.  Basic key features. nothing more and nothing less.  Clear Time and Date, day with quick select year if you actually forget what the year is.  Stop watch. alarm, second time zone, great indigo back light.  and that's all you need. Will buy another one when this one needs replaced.

You get four alarm times to set and specific days in the future for each alarm. It's readable and inexpensive. The peeper volume is the lowest of all these types of watches I've owned, not a good feature for the hard of hearing or in noisy environs.
summary: Good options, poor beeper volume and wristband.

reviewText: I had trouble finding this watch.  My son really wanted it and he is very pleased.  Looks very nice too.
So, I purchased this as a requirement for my new job.  Afordable, and me all my jobs and my criteria. Thumbs up.
This watch is simple ,but his simplicity does not mean a bad product.His desing is clear and to see hours at night is perfect.I recommend it.
use the product in my day to day, normal activities indoor and outdoor, hot and cold, I recommend, excellent quality product
Love it....I purchased it for my son ....he loves it......big display...fits comfortably ,will buy for friends and other members of the family.
Still can't figure out how to set the minutes exactly but I can time myself when I'm in the ocean xx xx

...otherwise it seems solid built and easy to read with all frequently used functions, plus 2 time zones.I am giving 1 star simply to warn buyers of the beeping that cannot be turned off, which is annoying sometimes.
summary: 4 off 5 stars for the beeping everytime when any button is pressed

reviewText: I had imagined that this would be larger.  But, it's very suitable as a watch and timekeeper.The value is exceptional.
Nice inexpensive watch. Easy to set up.  The crystal however is fairly cheap plastic and scratches easily and throws off a glare that is hard to read the lcd face.
Works like a Timex...great watch, large numbers and simple interface as expected as I don't even miss my Timex Ironman sports watch.
i never thought that a very cheap watch could do so many things. this is the you always needed. i think that you should buy this watch

I recently purchased this watch for my 12yrs. old son. Since opening it on Christmas morning he has not parted with it. He loves the luminated feature as well as the bold numbers. I would recommend this for any one. Apart from the mentioned features the Resin strap is a plus as it is very durable. A total value for money.
It's inexpensive and full featured.  Fairly large display, 2 time zones, light weight and comfortable.Not cheesy like a lot of other watches in this price range.
summary: Inexpensive but does all I need

reviewText: I wouldn't buy it again.I thought people said in the reviews that this watch was small.  I found it is rather large gets in the way.  If this is a small watch then I'd hate to see what a big watch is like!My next issue with it is the way the watch band is angled.  I don't have big wrists, but the band needs to angle out a good 30 degrees on both side.  When I set the watch on my arm it is held up about an inch away from my wrist.  This lets junk, dirt, etc get under the watch.  This makes the watch uncomfortable unless it's on the side of my wrist, which is a pain to read.I didn't know before but I hate resin watchbands.  It doesn't breathe at all, making my wrist constantly sweaty and itchy.The final complaint is the window.  It's bubbled so it sticks out above the plastic of the watch.  Didn't take long for it to get scratched and I suspect it will become unreadable before the battery dies.The features were fine, buttons work fine, and the price was great.
summary: Must say, I wasn't that impressed.

reviewText: This is a nice watch for the money. My last one lasted 3 years, and for the price, you cant beat it.

The watch face scratched after a few days since it's only a plastic polymer. The paint is wearing off after 3 weeks from friction against other surfaces. I like that it has Chrono, timer, alarm, time, and date. I am eager to test out the water resist feature this summer. It held up well in the shower. Overall, it's holding up and it performs well. I also like that the band is molded so it is much harder to catch on objects and pop it off. Indiglo: thumbs up but it stays lit and slowly fades when you let go. If I ever go a reconnaissance mission deep in enemy territory this excess illumination could pose a problem.

I have all kinds of watches... I have been collecting since I was 18yrs old. I am now 46 and you could imagine the range I have.  Anyway, this time piece I got it to use it in the Caribbean when my wife and I went on vacation last year.  We were told leave your fancy jewelry and fancy watches at home and blend in as humble as possible.  So that what we did and that's why I got this watch.  It is better than the energizer bunny.....it keeps going and going and going.  I cant see to get it off.  This same type of watch back in the 80's it went for about $50 bucks.  For the amount that they charging you should get 2!

This watch has already racked up a bunch of informative reviews, so I'll just add this brief personal experience:I do a lot of working out, including jogging. I also mountainbike. I need a training watch to be rugged, simple, waterproof/sweatproof, have an alarm an a countdown timer. I also don't want to invest too much into a sports watch, as I tend to destroy them far before their natural service lives would otherwise be over with. I have Boss watches and Tag Heuers for professional life - I need near-disposable watches for when crashing my bicycle or banging my hands against iron weights.This watch looks the sporty part, does everything I need so far, and it's so inexpensive that when the battery dies (if it survives that long), I will probably just replace the entire watch with a new one.Four out of five stars due to not knowing how long the battery will last, or just how rugged it will end up being. For $14.88, though, it's already proved itself a bargain.

I was trying to replace an older same model.  They made some changes to the way the timer works, and keep track of time.  It has to be reset every time after it counts down.  The old one maintained the setting and was better for my purpose.
This product is a very quality watch, Timex give much funcionalities in his watches for low price i recomended for gift to a Kid. Its a good first Watch.
hello, I can say "excellent" this is an excellent product, very good watch ... thanks for all ... 100% recommended ... up soon
I got this watch for my preteen son for Christmas.  It was so difficult to get the buttons to work that he thought it was broken at first.

I selected this for my everyday watch, the numerals ( time ) are large enough to see at a quick glance .The time, date, day were easy to set . The weight is comfortable,the band is long so it will fit a big person. Very pleased with the priceand I chose the free shipping option .
summary: Easy to see the time & light weight on the wrist .

reviewText: More or less just what I've come to expect from Timex. A good and comfortable watch. I wish that Timex hadn't changed the button positions, which had remained the same through many watch purchases. However, I'm sure that I'll adjust soon.
summary: Wish that the button positions hadn't changed

reviewText: Watch works well and was inexpensive, but the face is too small. Would make a good watch for a pre-teen.
summary: Good watch - but a little small

reviewText: Use the watch all the time for running.  Easy start and stop.  Love the large face.

It's a reliable Timex, the only problem is that it really is way too large of a watch for my 9 year old son to wear.  I'm confident he'll grow into it soon, but my husband may inherit it before that happens.
summary: Good timex, but definitely too large for my 9 yr old son.

reviewText: Bought this for my son aged 10. Just the right size for him, and it has lots of functions to keep him busy and entertained. He loved it!
My son loves it. Although it is a little complicated to set upfirst, the price is reasonable. Good quality watch too.

I have a few expensive watches but decided to get a watch that I can use when exercising without having to worry about losing or damaging it. This watch fits the bill, it does almost everything you want it to do. I initially thought that the display was good sized, but after using it a couple of times for running, I found that it was not big enough (for me at least) so I decided to give it away and bought another timex with a bigger (44mm) face.
summary: A great work horse for a really great price but I decided later on that the face was too small when exercising

reviewText: Great watch for the money. Held up nicely in the surf and shore pound in Hawaii. Nice big numbers are easy to read in the bright sun. Highly recommended.

I bought this watch to use in the gym as a timer for certain exercises. I put the watch down on a machine and watch the seconds. However the curved crystal causes so much glare that I often could barely figure out what the numbers were. I usedsome fine sandpaper to give it a 'frosted' finish. That helped some but it's still hard to see when there are lights above.Other than that it is a good watch at a good price.

I purchased this watch for my son. He had been asking for another watch for a while. He has torn up several watches before but they were cheaper quality kids watches. Now that he is 11, he has been able to take pretty good care of this watch and well, so far so good. No problems. I would recommend this watch.
rugged yet functional, simple yet worth it. a watch to go in an outdoor situation or were ever you like to take it...

I bought this because it's cheap, but easy to read with large digits.  I sent the first one back because the alarm feature didn't work.  The replacement has a similar problem.  You cannot hear the chime or alarm unless you hold the watch against your ear.  Also, the indiglo is so weak, you can barely see it.  Maybe this is an old watch with a weak battery.  I decided to keep it anyway.  I think I'll replace the battery and see if this helps.  It is comfortable on my wrist and easy to read.  You get what you pay for.  I still like Timex watches.
I needed a work watch, and this fits the bill. It's fairly light weight, and comfortable. Has a large easy to read dial, and has  24 hour setting for the time.
bought it for my husband for Chritmas.  He is a retired handyman.  You can beat a timex for everyday use The low price is a plus.  And it lookd great too
For $15, you can't beat this watch. Had for 2 years, indiglo works great, devent styling, has alarm, stop watch, all the simple things you want in a sports watch. Great value for the price!
This watch is all I ever needed. This is my second one (after many years of abuse) - it is tough, water resistant, good looking and simple. Still plenty of standard features. Very reliable.
The watch fits good and the buttons are easy to hit and self explanatory.  However, you cannot turn off the beeping noise each time you hit a button.
summary: Beeps every time you hit a button

reviewText: For the money you cant beat this product. I originally purchased it for woring out putposes. However I have found myself wearing it everyday...all day. Even more than my more expensive watches. Great Buy!!

I have owned a cople Timex watches over the years and generally like their functionality and design.  However, the watch I received had a nearly non-functioning upper left button (had to push it incredibly hard and deep to get it to work).  All the other buttons worked fine, but had to return it due to this flaw.  The watch is a good price, but other Timex watches I have had in the past, that are only slightly more costly, worked better and had a better screen layout.
summary: Decent, May Have Gotten a Bad Copy

reviewText: Received this last week....straightforward, easy to read watch for these older eyes.  Functions are logical - alarm confused me at first but got that sorted after a couple of days.  Good for jogging, although as noted elsewhere once you hit 30 minutes you can only see the minutes (The vision is going but the legs are still good!)I suspect the crystal will scratch (can't imagine a durable crystal at this price) so I'm inclined to be a bit careful with it.  I think it looks like a sharp piece and while not an Omega - perfectly acceptable for a casual setting.
Exactly what I wanted. Works perfect. No problems. Love the Timex light.  Exactly what I wanted. Works perfect. No problems. Love the Timex light.
Everything on it works so far, it looks pretty decent, and seems to be good quality.  What else can I say?

I buy Timex watches because they are cheap, durable, and they keep good time.  For me, the batteries last a couple of years, and then I throw away the watch and buy a new one.  This is a good model with large display, useful features, and works percfectly.  I'll be buying another in a couple of years.
summary: Large display, adequate features, good price.

reviewText: Watch just arrived. It is a simple straight forward sports watch. Still like Timex for their Indiglo feature. It is one of the industry's best affordable timepiece illumination. The only downside to this watch is personal preference. I do not care much for the date feature. I would like it much more if they stayed with the Ironman style with the simple 2 letter readout (SU, MO, TU, WE, etc...) instead of the black dot. Looks like a work horse for years to come. Have always owned an Ironman and stuck with it but decided to see if quality was across the board. I feels like a nice sturdy piece and may replace my Ironman (temporarily) as it is about to retire.A good inexpensive watch with straight forward easy to read display. Indiglo, a must have...
I use this watch for recreation and when working around the home.  It has fuctioned well and seems to well built.  Delivered as advertised and at a very fair price.

For the price it is okay.  however, the timer does not keep the last number, it resets to zero each time.I've had many Ironmans and these 1440 series of watches have different controls than the Ironman.  No biggie.

This is a great watch for only $20.  My only concern was the water resistance measurement - it says 50 meters, but it really depends upon the situation you're in.  I wore mine while under a man-made waterfall at a health club & the water got in under the face & rendered it completely unusable.  If you use good judgment about when to keep it on and take it off (and you CAN keep it on through almost anything), it works great.  I still ended up buying this same model to replace the one that had water damage.  Highly recommended.

The watch was a gift for my son he loves the watch and how easy it is to set up and to use. My son is in High School so it also is nice that it has a more mature look to it. Over all I am pleased with the watch and I love Timex the last Timex watch I bought my son was in 2003 he still has it but it was time to upgrade for high school.

I already own the Timex Ironman 'Triathlon' GPS watch which I use for running.  I wanted an inexpensive, but attractive, digital with a bit larger time display for casual wear - the time display on the Ironman is only about 2/3 the size of the 1440's.  Setup was easy (normal display items plus daily alarm, 24-hour display and 'other' time zone); display size (the time, at any rate) is quite adequate; the watch is attractive.  All the buttons worked fine for me . . . The only complaint I have is that the 'date' (day of month) display is easily partly obscured by any shadow cast by the high edge of the 1440 logo ledge at the top of the display.  Also, the diameter of the face, at about 26mm, seems a tad small. However, this really is nit picking. The 1440 is a decent, attractive, 'name' digital at an unbeatable price!

I bought this to wear during sports activities, especially water sports.  I haven't worn it in the water yet so can't comment on it's waterproof characteristics.  Other than that, I like how large the numbers are and the features of the watch, especially the countdown alarm.  At less than $13 this is a great buy.
Goes with the 650D drill (and 550), fits great.Simple and cheap way to protect your tool investment.This is the 650 Drill.[...]

I just bought this rash guard in short sleeve as well as long. Oddly the long sleeve is about 1 size tighter than the short sleeves. I bought 2 of ea, so I don't think it was a fluke.The long sleeve at 2 sizes bigger than I wear in street clothes, was still rib showing tight. The short sleeves I could have bought at just 1 size bigger than my street clothes for a little breathing room. I bought 2 sizes bigger & they fit close, but not tight.Other than the sizing on these, they are good quality shirts at a good price. And Beach Depot provided excellent customer service when I had a small issue with one of the rash guards.
This is not a womens XL, maybe a little girls XL ... the material is rough and I would not recommend this product.  I should have returned it but I guess I'm lazy.
summary: Sizing is not womens and material is terrible.

reviewText: receive on time.. like the color.. super cute.. got alot of nice comments from people... i will reccomend this product to others..

I am sooo pleased with these glasses. They fit nicely over my regular glasses, and they do well to keep the wind & dust from messing with my eyes. I put a sports strap on them to keep them snug against my face. The price was surprisingly good, but to me they are worth their weight in gold. Very comfortable. The tint is very good in the sun, even tho' they aren't super dark. They won't fit over larger glasses, but great with mine. I have also bought the clear lense and am super pleased with both. Now I will have to see if they will be durable and last a good while. I hope so.
summary: I am sooo pleased with these glasses

reviewText: Works great for me!
Helps block the wind, but they might as well tell you they are basically like the cocoon sunglasses with extra padding.

I was very pleased with these sunglasses. I bought them to just go over my existing prescription frames on a 20+ hour car drive (no motorcycle). I liked them because they helped keep my eyes from getting dried out when I had the air hitting me in the face. However, when I didn't have the air on, it did get a little warm inside the eye area. Overall, a great experience.

These  are the only padded over-glasses we have found.  Very comfortable.  They fit perfectly over  regular size standard glasses. We have purchased a good number in case we misplace them AND as gifts for friends.

I got this to go over my glasses. I wanted something that covered the glasses all around so I can quit using the clip-ons. My glasses measure 5.8 x 0.5 x 1.8 inches. It's a snug fit, but doable. My glasses are mostly rectangular metal frame. Feels secure. They look exactly as described.Jena

I was worried that these glasses wouldn't fit right over my regular glasses.  I've tried others before and been disappointed with the fit. These goggles are well built, sturdy and air tight.  Perfect under a helmet.  I highly recommend them to anyone who needs over the glasses goggles for the scooter or motorcycle.

I had them for about an hour of riding in my side by side on a sandy trail. i sat them in my passenger seat with my helmet and when i put them back on, there were scratched right in the middle of both lenses. the only thing they could have touched is the seat belt but if they scratch up that bad from that, then they would not last long actually riding with them. i wont get another pair.
Even though the sunglasses are a little thick in the front, they are really good in covering my husband's eyeglasses.  Am satisfied with this product.

I love these glasses.  I got them because I was having eye problems that included several surgeries, and my eyes were very sensitive to light.  Given that, I wanted something that would block as much light as possible.  After my first surgery, the eye doctor gave me a set that blocked the light from the side, and as soon as I was able I searched Amazon for something like that.  I found these, and have ordered several pairs (I lose sunglasses).  They look good, stay on, block the side light, and hold up a whole lot better than my usual bargain basement shades.
summary: Great Light Protection, Sturdy, and a Bargain

reviewText: It does the job perfectly. Fits comfortably. But it's not fashionable.. not that you would expect them to be in the first place anyway. haha. I just use htem in the car anyway, so it's fine.Great product for its price!
summary: It does the job, but it doesn't look cool.

reviewText: These are without question the best over-glasses I have worn/bought.  They fit over my prescription glasses fine.  They do not cause any discomfort behind my ears, even after a full day of riding.  The frames have some flex in them so they aren't rigid or brittle to minor bending.  I've spent a lot of money on a lot of different glasses.  These are the best, and the price is icing on the cake.

I've used shooting glasses and yellow lense sunglasses for sports activities near dusk, but these yellow lenses don't have the same clarification capabilities.  They tend to darken slower than other brands I've used in sunlight, and are more bulky than they appear in the picture, so they did not fit well under my motorcycle helmet.I keep them in the saddlebags, but they are my last choice when I pull out a pair of sunglasses.
summary: Yellow Lenses don't clarify as good they should

reviewText: Global Vision Outfitter Over-prescription Sun Glasses with Smoke Lenses well worth the money but a little too tight for my round face.  Service and delivery were right on time.  A terrific value.  Another Anazon bargain.
They are to square around the eyes and let a ton of air in. I feel it was a waste of money.

too small-should give dimensions in clear inch size-waste of moneyI have purchased over glasses from Lowes without a problem but these are sized to small to fit normal American eyeglasses, they may fit some very small ones but nothing I have worn.

Ordered these sunglasses to fit over my adult son's prescription eyeglasses and they work great. The wraparound style keeps the sun from glaring in from the sides, too.Vendor sent out product promptly and packaged it so the glasses arrived quickly and undamaged. Would buy again if/when needed.

I had my doubts about how one of these would perform when driving my new cruiser.  But, thankfully, there were more than enough solid reviews about it to convince me to give it a try.  I couldn't be more pleased.  Even with my old Scott goggles, my eyes eventually teared up and the lenses fogged up after about 20 minutes of riding. The Global Vision glasses held up and kept my eyes from drying over my prescription glasses and prevented my eyes from tearing up to lubricate them.  As a result, I ordered a second (smoked) pair so I could have proper eye protection for daylight and night driving.  I would DEFINITELY recommend this product.  It is very reasonably priced and easily hold its own against similar glasses three to five times more expensive.

These are great for outdoors medically, I have Bells Palsy and my right side of my face is paralyzed, and right eyelid does not blink, these glasses allow me to be outside in the sunlight and breeze and not have to worry about particles or the the wind irritating my eye.
very nice pair of shades for motorcycle riding and didn't have air blowing in my eyes and does really fit over glasses..

Does not really fit over my glasses, and my glasses are small. I think the problem is in the nose piece. The foam gets in the way of allowing it to fit comfortably. Sometimes these sunglasses hurt the sides of my head. However, it gets the job done when I wear it on and off.
It's nice to be able to still wear these with prescription glasses and they keep the wind out of your eyes

i purchased these after reading some reviews  they will go over small frame glasses but not large they are good for bicycle but will not seal even close for a motorcycle without windshield ok for bycycle  but i would pass for motorcycle

First off, these do fit over prescription glasses, but they are quite loose fitting. I had to buy a elastic to force the glasses to stay on. I don't have the smallest head either. They do offer protection over just using my prescription glasses. But riding in cold weather or when my temperature is a little warm they fog up, dangerously. I mean i have to remove then from my face at every traffic light. They are not that bad when I reach highway speeds. I ordered another set of goggles. Not these. Hopefully they'll work.
These fit over my glasses and are quite comfortable.  A nice product at a good price!  I plan to buy more.
summary: Good fit, quality and good price.

reviewText: Face it, us glasses wearing bike riders don't have much wear over sunglass choices, but I tried these out for the first time yesterday and I like them. They really tone down the brightness which is very nice. I don't get the best seal but my bike has a windshield that blocks most of the wind. I also rode my son's bike with no windshield and they weren't so good letting lots of wind in around them with the resultant tearing up. The price is right and you wont look like too much of a doofus wearing them, but don't use 'em without the windshield.
I could not see where these glasses are anything but yellow tint. Any "change" was pretty much minimal to undetectable in sunlight.
They are big and clunky and heavy and my wife thinks they look ridiculous, but they cover my prescription glasses just fine.
These are the best fit overs I have ever owned !!!!  perfect fit, seals great , very comfortable, would definitely recomend !!!,
liked these alot this is my 2nd pair to put on over my glasses when we were riding the mountain in our sidexside

I know nothing about what's stylish & what isn't. I just figured they were cheap & looked comfortable. So I went to show my brother, expecting him to razz me about what a nerd I am. He asked to take a look at them, then wouldn't give them back until I promised to order him a pair. Who woulda thunkit? I guess I'm pretty cool after all...

I was hesitant at first about purchasing another pair of slip over sunglasses since I had a pair that was not at all what I expected. I am glad I took a chance with this brand, they have a nice padded cushion around the inside lens, they fit great and are perfect for driving. I wear transitional lens however; as anyone that has this type of lens they are not good while driving. These sunglasses are a perfect solution. I highly recommend these sunglasses!
summary: Great sunglasses that fit over your glasses at a great price!

reviewText: Glasses fit over my regular glasses just great.  If your eyes are sensitive to light, these glasses are for you.
Needed to keep the dust and pollen out of my eyes while wearing prescription glasses. Perfect solution for riding in Colorado.
summary: They're nothing fancy but they sure do work well.

reviewText: These glasses fit over my glasses and did exactly what I needed them to do.  I bought them to keep wind out of my eyes on high speed and/or downhill bicycle riding.  I ride my bike downhill to work and without protection, my eyes tear up.  The glasses are not exactly a fashion statement but they are functional and practical.
Bought this for my mom and she loves it.  The inside has some padding which makes it comfortable to wear.
I have a wind screen and at times I need to push them back up. Going over glasses is easy, just wish they were snugger.

I got these to wear over my eyeglasses while doing trail work.  They fit very well, and the holes in the arms allowed me to attach thin shock cord to help secure these to my face even better.  The sun protection was fantastic too.  They look a little odd because of how far they protrude, but I knew that when I bought these, so that doesn't hurt the rating.  The only reason I'm taking a star off is because they fog up when I'm working hard, and that's because the foam seals my face too well.
summary: Not the best for hard labor

reviewText: These were purchased to use with my regular glasses. Clip ons did not cover the lenses properly.so I had my prescription made in a small aspect just for driving expecting these to fit over them.They can't completely slide far enough back.
summary: Nice but don't fit over  regular glasses.

reviewText: Very comfortable over my glasses.I use these when riding.Doesn't make me look like a spaceman like other over your glasses , glasses.

I've bought 5 pairs.  They are so comfortable, light weight, and cover the eyes from the front and side very well.  Would like to see the company come up with a bright orange holder  (like chums) that attaches to the temples securely.  Love these for hiking and driving.  Also wish the company would come up with a version for night driving.

These are intended for protection and better vision during the night and dark, cloudy days. Some wind still gets around them which can only be solved by getting goggles but they are very good at blocking 90% of the wind. This product is quickly donned over my glasses, and will stay in place while riding a motorcycle. The yellow lenses enhance the light that is present making the darkness seem brighter, but I would recommend not using these during daytime due to being too bright and dangerous for your eyes.I bought the normal sunglasses by Outfitter at a local bike shop for $25! These are a steal at this price, so go for it!
And alternative if you already have small prescription glass and can't afford new prescription riding glasses they work well and not to bad stylish
summary: cheaper than buying prescription riding glasses

reviewText: I was skeptical as to weather or not they would fit over my wrap around prescription glasses, but they do.  They block out the sun very well and keep the wind from making my eyes water as I ride my motor cycle.  They also don't blow off when I turn my head to look behind me, or slide down my nose like other fit over sunglasses.The only problems I experienced with them is if I wear them in my truck in the winter they fog up, and they don't fit so well when wearing a tight helmet.For the price these are GREAT.Update - They are very durable.  I've sat on them, dropped them, and left them hanging from my handlebars out in the sun and rain for months.  I was somewhat surprised when I noticed the foam was still intact and not pealing off.  The only thing they don't stand up to is forgetting where you lost them...

I walk my dog every day.  Some times of the year, wind and allergies make that hard.  To make matters worse, I wear glasses and that limits my options.  Tried lots of goggles and over-glasses and these are by far my favorite.  The foam seal makes them almost goggles, with a seal that keeps the majority of the wind out when kept snug by an elastic cord.  They seal well enough that sometimes during hot weather the foam gets sweaty, but it is a small price to pay.  I now wear them all the time when driving too, since it keeps any breezes out of my eyes.  The glare reduction is another plus.  I have several pairs and will own several more before I am done.

In-doors I've gotten away with adjusting light wattages down and wearing a pair of clip-on polarized, dark grey sunglasses over my prescription glasses (can be found on Amazon or in most dept. store sunglass section, get the spring-slider kind over the spring-wire kind as they can accomodate different widths of glasses much better).  The lense polarizing, in particular, makes reading dimmed computer screens much easier on the eyes.THIS product is NOT POLARIZED and it definitely shows in very bright condition.  I purchased these specifically for outdoor wear to cover my peripheral and brow line and they work great for that.  No longer do I have to worry about the stray sunlight or a reflection bouncing into the side of my eyes and the "ice-pick-to-the-brain" effect that comes with it.  The foam padding is comfortable and doesn't get sticky feeling even when sweating.  And the peripheral windows are great for reducing the tunnel-vision effect that other full-coverage sunglasses can have.I would recommend getting a pair of sunglass head straps for these as they do tend to slip around a lot and while fine for walking tend to require a lot of "dorky push-up" adjustment when doing anything that requires moving one's head around a lot.Even after my photophobia pass (I pray), I plan on using these when doing yard work, bicycling, and outdoor activities that involve exposure to straylight, wind and dust (really can't wait to try them on a scooter with an open-faced helmet).-1 star for the lack of polarizing and the slippage factor, but otherwise highly recommended.

I hate to go back to the Shadow 6000 which is sold now as a fashion sneaker but they did serve me well back in the 80's, they just won't wear very long. Also in the drawer are many, many inexpensive pairs purchased at place's like BPS and Gander Mountain.  Anyway, I know a little bit about sunglasses.  These are definitely low end glasses.  I haven't worn them enough to comment about their durability (others have) but, after examining them out of the box, I predict that they won't last over the long haul.  But at this price, what do we expect?  As my old man used to say, there ain't no such thing as a free lunch.  The polarization process works, although not as good as high end versions.  I read elsewhere that the lens material is sub-standard, inferring that some experts have claimed the filtering might be bad enough to cause eye problems.  I don't think I can either confirm or deny the validity of that.  The manufacturer sells a lot of these at sports/fishing/retail outlets and I find it hard to believe that they would make glasses that don't do what they say they do.  Anyway, you probably won't find polarized glasses any better than these, at this price.  The frames are extremely light, having been made with somewhat flimsy plastic but many people prefer that.  As others have pointed out, they are designed (probably) for an average or small/average face size.  If you are large headed, keep looking.
I chose these glasses because they are Oakley look a likes. They are lightweight and not very durable. I would not recommend these glasses to anyone.

I used to buy the polarized fishing glasses at Wally World.  I still would, except that in a small town the selection and availability are very limited, and they won't special order for you.  So, with the help of the reviews here (thank you), I decided to try these.  At $14.40 ea (with free shipping) I ordered four pair.I wear sunglasses whenever I'm outside.  I buy a lot of cheap sunglasses rather than one pair of expensive ones (it hurts when you break them, lose them or scratch the lenses).  Doing this review made me realize what a huge inconsistency in product there is where I used to buy cheap sunglasses.  I always tried to buy the same/similar style, but now I don't think they were even mnfg'd by the same company.  They come in the same package, but it's like a jobber buys whatever is around and packages them with his label.  I've had glasses that were OK and others that variously hurt my ears, pressed into the sides of my head, dug into my nose, pushed off my face, flew off my face (not doing athletics), slipped down my face, and sat cockeyed.  I've had rubber pads pop out, glued on pads slip around and fall off, and glasses without rubber pads.  A few had the frame color painted on - the paint pealed off leaving me walking around with paint chips on my face.  And, of course, some with lenses that pop out.I've had these for about a month and have not experienced any problems so far.  The lenses are narrower (in height) than I like, but they do the job.  The tinting is good, polarization works well and they claim to block 100% UV A&B.;  A snug, comfortable fit and rubber pads on the temples and nose piece keep them secure.  The temples bow around my head (no pinching) and curve in at the ears.  The plastic is pliable enough to hold well but not be uncomfortable.  They are pretty light and at first I thought flimsy, but they are stable, tight, and don't twist and bend.  Hopefully they last a few more months, until the lenses are too scratched up to see out of.  What more could I want from cheap sunglasses (except some scratch resistance)?. . . P.S. I've started adding the price to my reviews.  I find it quite useful to see price history.Update 10/06/12 Still on my first pair!  These glasses have lasted much longer than I thought they would.  The lenses are not yet all scratched up, they're still tight in the frame and the frame is still tight.

It is obvious that you won't be stopping traffic or getting robbed for this timepiece - but that's a good thing, right? This Waterproof watch from Timex goes for under 20 bucks. It's perfect for kicking around & it has a lot of useful functions. So far it seems pretty durable. You can even switch out the wristband if you'd like (so it's not all one fused together piece). Actually, the existing black band that it comes with is comfortable already, so it's not necessary to change it - it's just nice to have the option. In the dark, you get a green glowing backlit face (at the push of a button) which has already proven to be a convenient feature. The light stays on long enough for you to actually see the time, date, etc. There is a stopwatch function & you can program different time-zones - in a separate second screen. Without touching ANY buttons, it shows the date & time numerically, as well as the day in letters (example: Mon, Tues, Wed, etc). It has a big, readable font that's easy on the eyes. The most impressive thing is the waterproofing. I've had other inexpensive watches & they sometimes get moisture inside (condensation). Living in South Florida during the summer, our temperatures reach into the 100's with 99% humidity. Even with a rapid temperature change & being completely submerged in water (a dive into the pool or a quick, cool shower) this watch has proven to be sealed up pretty tight. So, if you're looking for something to keep good time & you like the looks of this watch, go for it! It comes in a box, so it'd make a nice "under 20 dollar" gift too.

reviewText: This clock is a waste of money.  It is currently unavailable and will hopefully never be available again.  To buy this clock is to buy a bill of goods.  One would be better off investing in a sundial.Within a couple of months of purchasing this clock, the battery (seemed) to have died.  I eventually took the clock to a local jewelry store to have the battery replaced.  The clock stops dead and simply will not run longer than an hour or so.  Usually it runs for even less time than that.The entire mechanism looks and feels flimsy, the paper dial and the paper compass rose on the back are glued onto the inner rim of the clock.  The glue has come off of both.  In fact, the compass rose has to be pealed off the back of the clock to put a new battery into the unit.  Doing so is a waste of a good battery and the money spent on a battery.There is no excuse for building or selling a bad analog clock.  After centuries of production and refinements, a badly built analog clock shows very badly upon the manufacturer alone.  This terrible device went into the trash can tonight.
