Very poorly made!I took it to my dry cleaners (who loved the shoe, of course) and they were able to repair the stitch--it wasn't able to be perfect, because the fabric had actually torn out of the stitch, rather than the stitch failing, but it doesn't show and it fixed the problem for now.  The slippers sat on their shelf for a good week and when I came to pick them up, they told me that every customer that had come in had asked about the slippers.  Free advertising!!But yeah, they need to change the fabric that is used for the tongue--it isn't durable enough for what it's being used for.
summary: So cute, so funny, but poorly made

reviewText: I love the concept of these but they are so high in the heal area that your heal slides off of the top of the slipper.  I thought that they might crush down over time to make a spot for my heal but it is an air chamber so it keeps happening.  I bought 3 pairs and the people I gave them to have the same complaint.  We do still were them thought.
A clever product that is pretty well made.  People who help other people work through problems always need humorous and fun outlets, and this product qualifies.
Thats what they are and a hoot to boot.  They make me giggle every time I slip them on!! I'm very happy with my therapist on my feet!!

I took these out of its box and immediately noticed that they look exactly like the picturess of Amazon. They fit perfectly, kept my feet warm, and even have a little cushioning in the sole. Everyone who has seen these at my house love them! They definately are a conversational tool (I think I have heard every Freud joke in existance!). Overall, I would recommend these to anyone who wants to wake up to a little fun and the promise of warm feet!

This slippers are hilarious, and bring a smile to my face every time I wear them. This is a very witty, fun product. The only reason I give it 4 stars instead of 5 is that the tongue part that covers your toes is very breathable, allowing my toes (the coldest part of my foot) to remain cold. Final analysis: cute idea, slightly lacking in functionality.

My Mom and I are both majoring in Psychology and thought these slippers were way too cute to pass up. The slippers are very well made, comfortable, and funny (when you wiggle your toes, the tongue wiggles all around). We LOVE these slippers, they never cease to make us giggle.

Freudian Slippers are the perfect gag gift for the Psych major in your life. They are  whimsical, lend great humor AND they are extremely comfortable slippers!We gave them to our daughter and we had a good laugh when she openened her gift but she continues to wear them everyday because of their comfort. The slippers bring a little levity to each morning.
I received these as a Mother's Day gift and I love them!  Not only are they clever in concept, but they are probably the most comfortable slippers I have ever owned.
summary: Going to have to psychoanalyze why I find them so comfy!

reviewText: fiancee loved these slips.  prompt shipping.  the 'tounge' on the slippers is a little sock that you can put your feet into.  The breast slippers ever.
Gave these as a gift to a psychology professor.  Big hit.  She intends to wear them to class the first day of the new semester.
summary: fun to give as a gift

reviewText: Given as gift to my brother. He thought they were very clever. Arrived as expected in a  very nice sturdy shoebox.
Love them! Arrived quickly and look like I imagined them to be! Comfortable and unique, I get a lot of compliments on them.
I gifted it to a close friend and she loved it! If you are undecided let this be what helps you decide... go for it.
I would recommend these to anyone who recognizes they are neurotic (a group that include the entire population) and who appreciates the benefit of going to therapy!
summary: Perfect for my husband, a certified psychotherapist trained in Freudian theory!

reviewText: I purchased these for my wife, who is a school psychologist.  I'm happy to say she really enjoys them.  She wears a women's size ten.  I was a little concerned the large might be too big, but the sizing worked out perfectly.  Very pleased.
I got the laugh that I was looking for when I gifted these to my Aunt, but they are pretty cheaply made. I wouldn't expect them to last long if you really want them.
These slippers are not only fun , they are warm and comfortable! I love wearing them and explaining them to friends who stop by to visit when Im just relaxing at home!

I am not one to buy "cheesy" gifts, and I actually wasn't even certain this gift would be good for my girlfriend. She is working on her Master's in Psychology, so, when I stumbled upon these, I had a big chuckle. I don't know why, they just caught me as hilarious. So, I bought them on the spot.I figured it'd garner a slight smile, or a chuckle, but when she opened these things, everyone had a HUGE positive response. I had no idea that the red tongues were actually cloth around the wearer's toes, so her wigling her toes made Freud flap his tongue. The perfect gift, and I hadn't given it enough credit!My girlfriend says they "slip" as she walks due to them being so soft and fuzzy, but that they're extremely comfortable.Also of note: Freud's eyes are a little cross-eyed looking in the real life slippers. Not a problem, and adds to the sort of "Muppets", silly feel of the product.

I received these as a gift for this Christmas, every time I see them they make me smile. They are a little big on me but they do keep my feet warm. I struggle a bit walking up the stairs in them as I have to balance them on the tops of my feet. I love the fact that my toes are the tongue and take joy in wiggling my toes at my boyfriend when he is saying something I don't want to hear. They crack us up!

These slippers were better than I expected.  Your toes slip into his tongue and on the bottom it says, 'Size does matter.'  I got these as a gift for my daughter getting her masters degree.....she took them to work to wear while sitting at her desk.  They are a big hit with the others in the office.

Pros: This slippers look great, funny and geeky. Also they are incredibly comfortable, plush and soft. Well made and keep my feet warm.Cons: They can catch a bit of dust, but it can be easily cleaned, so not a big problem.
Sizes run a little shorter. Keeps my feet warm. Gives me a chuckle each time i look at it. Makes a funny gift.
This was purchased for my neice who is majoring in psychology.  It is hard to find such a unique gift in stores.  She loved them for her college dorm.
Bought them for sister who just graduated with psych degree.  Just as adorable as pictured, comfortable, and the large size fit her enormous feet (women's 12).
summary: Tell your thrifty Superego to shut up and buy these slippers

reviewText: I bought these as a gift for my mother-in-law. They were a huge hit! As a previous reviewer mentioned, the tongue part covers your toes, so when you move them his tongue moves. :p

I purchased these for my girlfriend who was a psychology major in college. She had seen them before and had made a point of mentioning it to me several times. I gave them to her for Christmas and she was very excited. Not only are they funny, but she says they are very comfortable too. Additionally, one detail she really liked is that his tongue is actually a sewn-in sock, so your toes are Frued's tongue. Overall, it was a big hit.

Bought these as a gift for my step-sister; she just started her first year at a school for prof. psychology and social work program. She loved them! A fun gag gift for a psych student and apparently warm & comfy too. Highly recommend.
Cute..but sizing seems smaller than advertised. Not comfy or easy to walk in. I had them years ago and they seemed to fit and wear better. Not sure what happened...

This was a gift for my girlfriend's father and he absolutely loved them.  Our families are both essentially based off of Freudian slips and love to laugh...so naturally the Freudian slipper, while campy and silly, is also a hilarious in-joke and super comfy.  The toes go into the red tongue and it makes them that much more hilarious when one starts to wiggle and it looks like Freud's tongue wagging.  I'm not sure Siggy wanted to be immortalized in slippers, but hey, if the shoe fits...

Wife wanted these for Xmas, and since I always can't seem to get her what see wants I immediately ordered these.  They came, I wrapped them up, and she loved them Xmas morning and ever since.  Stop spending money on real psychiatrists and get your mate a pair of these and your emotional relationships will be immediately healed.  At least that was my experience.
summary: Got me out of the doghouse

reviewText: Loved these. Not the most comfortable slippers but not uncomfortable by any means and they get miles of smiles by ppl in the know. Almost everyone knows about Freudian slips and these are just plain fun.

I wrote a review on a pair of pins very much like these, but of different characters from the anime series (Tomo and Chiyo). While I am 100% satisfied with having purchased those, these, however, failed me almost immediately. They looked fantastic out of the package, but literally a day after I pinned these to my backpack, the pointy end of the Sakaki pin  snapped off. Just like that. Maybe it got caught on something, but my other pins get caught and tugged on all the time, and they're still doing just fine. Now that I think about it, the entire pin itself is actually pretty big, perhaps so big that the pointy end couldn't accommodate the weight. Anyhow, shortly after, the Chiyo Dad pin (the cat, of course),lost its front half (the part that makes it...well...Chiyo Dad). I guess these pins are composed of two halves; a colored front half and a silver back half. All I know is that when I looked at my backpack one day, all that was left of that pin was a shiny silver outline of a bipedal cat. What a shame. Maybe his wish of becoming a bird came true and he flew off. Or maybe I just got a bad set.

I bought these socks for my husband and he loves them!  He will run in these socks only and nothing else.  We have bought 2 pair already so he has a second on hand.  They have held up very well also.  He's had them for about 6 months now and they are still in great shape - like new.  I know they are a little pricey, but they are well worth the money.  If you run a lot, these socks are definitely for you.

They are super comfortable and allow breathability for the foot.  My only negative feed back is that after wearing them for a year, holes had developed.  I recommend searching T.J. Maxx or Ross for discounted Teko socks, they are well worth the money.

This was a great buy!  my husband and I both play soccer and it lasted through countless practices without needing to be pumped up again.  the outside is firm, but not plastic-y and hard, just as an outdoor ball should be.  This was the favorite ball on my husband's team.  In fact, it was liked so well that somebody took it.  We are mourning the loss of our excellent ball!

Excellent product and excellent service.  This bag mounts snugly on the rear of the bike and holds a surprising amount of stuff when expanded.  Looks good too.  Comes with a rain cover and shoulder strap.  Zippers look strong.  I'm very satisfied with the bag and the service from both Amazon and Motorcycle Superstore.

This motorcycle carry bag was designed well to fit the motorbike.  It has proved very useful to carry even eggs from my daughters free range chickens. i would recommend it. It arrived timely. Nice red color.

Bag is very well made.  Bungee straps affixed underneath swing out easily to hook onto the bike.  Pockets and zippers are top-notch.  You're not going to go on a 'round the world journey with just this bag, but for daily commuting and shorter trips, it's awesome.
summary: Great bag!  Perfect fit for the V-Strom.

reviewText: I love the bag. Of course this is my first bike, so this is my first tail bag.  Don't have much to compare it to, but I know I would buy it again if I ever happen to lose this one or something.  This bag fits on my GS500F and it doesn't move while I'm riding.  I can fit my lunch box, water bottle and the liner for my mesh jacket in it without expanding it.  I can also fit my boxing gloves, hand wraps and towel. I've also put a pair of sneakers, reflector vest, jacket liner and water bottle.  I've yet to expand the bag.  It comes with a rain cover. I got caught in a downpour without the cover and my stuff was fine.

I have never written a review for anything, but felt compelled to write one on this product.  I've got an '03 Ninja 250.  It's not the fastest thing on two wheels but is enough for my casual rides.  The tail bag fits great.  I agree with some reviews I have read that the amount of stuff you can jam into this bag are deceiving.  With the expansion zippers unzipped, I can fit a laptop, change of work clothes and shoes, and still have room for more.  Zipped up, the bag looks unobtrusive.  I actually prefer the look of the bike with the bag on than off.  You get a myriad of ways to fasten the bag to the bike.  To keep the bag "unstealable" (sort of), I fished a flat strap through the bottom of the bag and around and under my lockable seat.  Then used a bunji in the latches provided on the Ninja.  It doesn't move an inch and yes, someone with a knife could cut the strap, but you'd really need to have a purpose on stealing the bag at that point.If you are on the fence and a chronic review-reader as I am, just get the thing.  You won't be disappointed.

Love this bag.  It makes carrying things on the bike so much easier.  Occasionally ive had to ride in the rain or leave my bike outside and it rained and it was nice to have the cover that came with it so it wouldn't get wet.  I also bought the matching saddle bags which go great in a combination, highly recommend.  But if you dont have to carry much this is the way to go, its much faster to attach and remove than the saddle bags.

This bag is everything I wanted in a bag than is easily removed when I arrive at my destination.  It is secure during transport and has the proper design for it's position on the rear of my motorcycle. Other riders comment on  how it good it looks on my motorcycle.  The price was right and I am very happy with this purchase.

The product arrived a day earlier than projected.  It came in excellant condition.  It was a Christmas gift for my son and he absolutely loves it!  The price was right and I want to thank everyone involved for all their help!Tour Master Cortech Sport Tailbag - --/Black

Excellent bag. I have looked at this bag off and on for the last two years for my FJR1300. My son recently bought one for his FZ6R. He loves it. When I got to look at it first hand I decided I had to have one.Very well made. Great attachment provisions with included adjustable bungees. It is definitely expandable and it comes with a nice rain cover. There are extra small pockets and compartments inside that are very handy. I have a custom made cargo rack on the tail of my FJR and this sits perfect on it. My last bag was very nice but it was a stand up type and it stuck up above the backrest for my passenger. The Cortech is lower and has a stream line look to it.Very pleased with this bag. I haven't had it in the rain yet, but I'm sure the rain cover will work just fine.JB MarkerSoldotna Alaska

Got this bag for my Kawasaki Eliminator.  So far it is excellent.  Fit without any trouble, has  a lot of room, little compartments for pens, papers, rain cover.  Handle will make it easy to carry.  Have been carrying 2 or 3 different bags under a bungee cord net up until now.  Should be a lot  nicer to have it all in ONE bag.  Looks very sturdy, too.  Thank you.

This tail bag is fantastic. It fits my Yamaha fz6r perfectly. It literally took about 30 seconds to secure using the buit-in hooks the bag has on the sides and front, which are retractile too, by the way.Like other customers have said already, size is deceiving. There is plenty or room for a jacket, pair of gloves, iPad or even a digital camera. It comes with small extra pockets at both sides and will extend if needed via zippers, giving you extra room for bigger or large objects.The bottom has a especial material that will protect your bike from scratches. But giving the case is a tail bag, not a tank bag, I don't see any usage. But nice to see manufacturers even took that small detail into consideration.Good quality too! Feels and looks awesome and the hooks secure the bag very well to your bike. It comes with a small rain cover.Please check my posted pictures on the product page to get a better idea of size and how it actually looks like on a real bike. Thanks for reading my review.
summary: Extremely practical bag at amazing price!

reviewText: I ride a Honda Nighthawk 250.  This tail bag (mine is red) is extremely visible by day and reflective by night.  It fits my laptop and work clothes (including shoes) with no problem.  The zip out extensions allow for more storage if needed, it attaches quickly and with absolute security.  It comes with a shoulder strap, padding to prevent any scratches to the bike and a rain cover.
Nice size and zippered pockets, but it doesn't hold it's original shape for long. I wish the elastic cords were thicker, and removing it everyday has become tiresome.
summary: Removing it everyday has become tiresome.

reviewText: Having used everything from saddlebags to magnetic tank bags on my cruiser I have to say this bag rocks!  Heavy duty and holds a ton of stuff.  Just finished a 110 mile group ride yesterday and this bag did the job and then some.  If you're looking for a tail bag this is the one!

I have owned this bag for over a year and love it.  It's super practical: expanding sides when  you need more room, has a nice carry handle and shoulder strap for off the bike, as well as the capability to turn it into a back pack.  I use it all the time!  It's even easier to use now that I can attach it to a sissy bar.

I am so very disappointed. This is my 3rd of this bag, which is such a brilliant design. I've always received compliments on its streamlined, smart appearance even just while toting it around off the bike. The bungees are perfect for attaching to the back of my Honda. And the expandable sides mean that I can ALWAYS fit in all my groceries and whatever else I'm hauling around. I have loved loved loved this bag--and now it's the end of the love affair. The new one has all the same lines and features--it's made from the same pattern, no doubt about that--but even before I touched it I could SEE it's a cheaper, thinner material. [In fact, all the materials--inner, outer, and trim--are a looser or 'bigger' weave; you can tell the fabric will puncture and stress and rip more easily.] And all the stitching is coarser--bigger stitches, less precise. All the logos and plastic parts are identical, as well as all the tags and packaging, so I don't believe it's a knock-off, though I did initially have my doubts. I think the company has just farmed out the manufacturing to someplace cheaper, and it's not hard to see where the corners were cut. (The label inside says "made in China". There's no such identifier in my previous bag, so that may or may not be significant.) It makes me so sad when something like this happens. I ordered a product that had earned my loyalty for its superb design and quality.... and it turns out my loyalty was misdirected. SHAME ON YOU CORTECH! This is a far inferior version of the bag I fell in love with.
summary: BEWARE !!! cheaper materials now being used !!!

reviewText: Great for sportbikes when you need to hold a lot of extra stuff, bag extends on both sides giving it even more room.
summary: This bag will suprise you with how much it will hold!

reviewText: I commute to and from work on my motorcycle every day, sometimes twice a day due to split shifts.  This Cortech Sport Tail Bag fastens to my bike in less than thirty seconds.  I take it off at work and take it with me (I drive a bus) and am in and out of it no less than a dozen times a day.  Easy access, ample storage, smooth operating zippers, the ability to expand it and durable construction make it a fantastic companion.  The rain cover fits over it smoothly and securely.  It probably wouldn't keep it dry in an hour long total downpour, but it does the job in average Seattle area drizzle / rain just fine.  I highly recommend this product.  It is replacing a top notch messenger bag that I have been carrying to and from work.  In fact, I was doubtful this Cortech bag could really replace my messenger bag as I had looked long and hard for just the right one.  The Cortech has seriously exceeded my expectations.  I love a product that just perfectly scratches the itch in your lifestyle, if you know what I mean.  Stop reading, put it in your cart and get it, you won't be disappointed!
I brought this tail bag for my sport bike (Suzuki GS500).It was very easy to secure to the seat. Large enough to fitlaptop, and small packages.I would recommend it.
summary: Nice tail bag which is easy to secure

reviewText: I purchased this item about 2 months ago. I own Kawasaki ninja 650r and always I have problem where to put my things. I am happy now. I use tail bag for my Laptop, mobile phone, bottle of water, etc. I need only few seconds to install the bag on the tail. So if you think buy or not trust me - it is really very comfortable, useful bag for motorbike.

I really expected to have some nattering little things to say about this bag (see my other reviews... it's always something) but it's a great bag.It's bigger than I thought it would be, which is good. It has hooks, which I use. It has velcro, which I'm sure I'll think of some use for. But it's touch, the zips are high quality, there are ample compartments, and on and on.It's my tail bag on a BMW F800GS, and it's just a great fit. Sweet!

Great daily or weekend trip bag.  On/off in seconds, good quality, and looks great on the bike.  Will not hold a full face helmet.  Purchase/shipping was problem free and on time.  Overall, one of the best accesories I purchased for my FZ.

I've gone through 2 of these in the past 4 years. Maybe 3 of them? I have only had one fall off because I forgot to hook it on.The luggage itself is very good. It holds onto your bike with these 2 bungee cords with hooks on the ends and has a pad on the bottom to keep it from sliding. On a standard bike (I had a hyosung 650) it fits nice and snug. On my slightly sportier Honda CBR, it fits poorly and slides a little which makes me nervous. The bungee cords also stretch a little after a year or so.It has the capacity of a school backpack, or about 50% more if you expand the side pockets.The major downside is that I sometimes forget to hook the cords down or zip up one of the pockets and I can't see it because it's behind me. I think I'm going to get a magnetic tank bag now that I have this CBR.
summary: high-quality, but not a perfect fit for all bikes

reviewText: The bag is as advertised, however it arrived with no bungee cords. Although not as neat as the ones shown in the instructions, I bought some and made the bag work. The poor review relates to the lack of a response from Cortech; I sent them an email explaining and requesting they send the appropriate cords and there has been no response for five days. No more products from them.
Great tail bag.  Very versatile and secures tightly with the build in bungy cords.  Looks sporty and holds a lot.

This bag is made from a solid nylon and stitched together well.  It has a lot of space, especially when expanded!  I have my rain gear in this along with a change of clothes, a kryptonite lock, tire repair kit, rag, gloves and kick stand puck.  It can be mounted on its own by velcroing to the strapped down base or locked into the saddlebags made by the same company.  I use this every day on my commute to work and the few times I have needed to put the water proof cover on it has worked perfectly.  A great buy and if you ride a bit and have an iOS device get dark skies, it will tell you if there will be rain over the next hour with perfect precision.
summary: Hold a lot and is sturdy!

reviewText: The tail bag is the perfect addition to the sport saddlebags. In addition to providing more space, the tail bag integrates the saddlebags into a more secure unit that can be easily switched from one motorcycle to another. Like the sport saddlebags, the zipper expansion function is very useful when carrying long items like tent poles.

This Cortech Sport Tail bag has been great for my H-D 883 Sportster.  Just the right amount of storage space for a small gym bag, bottled water, and purse.  The bag stays secure on the (mini-size) back seat with the adjustable tiedowns.  My helmet fits well, by itself, with the sides expanded.  I have to hike my leg a bit higher when mounting the bike.  And the flap on the bottom of the bag isn't all that attractive. Though it's probably functional for the available attachments.  Overall, it's an exceptional piece for storage.  Thanks for the quick delivery!
My second pair in three years. Great product. Comfort, style and great support. .They hold up well and take some abuse. My feet always feel good and my calves look great! Buy them.
Nice looking shoe, but the tab on the heel causes blisters. Other than that, it is consistent with the excellent quality and workmanship I have come to expect from MBT.
These shoes solve a variety of aches and pains: sore feet,bad knees, bad back. Wonderful to find them on sale. Great value.

First let me say I have three pair of these and never paid over 60.00 a pair.  In that price range they are good values.  BUT maybe not for everyone.  AT FIRST they were extremely hard to get used to in walking style.  They were at first unstable to me but after a few weeks they were second nature and comfortable.  You MUST give them a chance and get familiar with the different stride.  After I got used to them I found them pleasing on long walks and wore them all day.  I do have other shoes that I alternate with but must admit these are one of my favorites.  But I know there are others out there who write terrible reviews about these shoes.  All I can say is give them a try.  It is very subjective in nature.  You either love em or ya hate em.
summary: Thewy take some getting used to.

reviewText: I've been using my new sandals now for two weeks and I am really pleased. I can stand for hours without getting tired, and my feet feel quite alright - even after a busy day at the clinic. The only downside is that they get a bit damp inside despite its "airy" look.

I ordered these shoes because of the spring action even though they were costly. Frankly, I can't feel any difference between these and my $60 Nikes. Also, the springs make these squeak a little when you first put them on.As for fit, well, they are a little narrow, but it's OK for me. I'm just pointing that out if that's a problem for you. They could use more arch support as far as I'm concerned.I decided to keep these because I thought the spring thing might make a difference on a long walk. I've used them now, so they are mine. I have gone on several long walks and I find them to be good, average shoes, which I would usually pay $39-69 for.Really think about it before purchasing. The springs aren't going to give you a magical lift. But, if you want a pretty good shoe at this price, go ahead and purchase.

I've been running in Brooks Trance 7 shoes for the past couple years, believing they were the best...I found an article and the website for SPIRA and thought I give them a try.  WOW!These shoes are truly amazing.  I run in 5Ks...up to Half-Marathons.  These shoes help incredibly with the impact on my joints...they're great!  I'm currently training to run a full marathon and with these shoes...it won't be a problem!!The day after I ordered them they were at my doorstep!!  Super FAST delivery!!!  VERY HAPPY!
summary: If You're a RUNNER, YOU NEED THESE SHOES!!!

reviewText: The shoes are fairly light and initially fit well for their size.  They breathe as well as any running shoes.  I was so curious to try these out.  On paper, they sure sell the concept of springs as a good idea for shoes.  In practice however, I found some real issues.  I developed foot pain rather quickly after running in these.  The 3 small springs cause 3 hot spots. It would have been advisable to have a stiff insole to distribute the pressure from the springs more evenly through each region of the foot.When you land on that shoe, you don't feel a springy return - instead, it feels like a regular running shoe with the parts where the springs are located feeling like stiff rigid objects trapped under the insole... so it's a bit of a rock-in-the-shoe feel.  I'm 5'9 and weigh 150 pounds.it's been a nice gimmick that I got suckered into but I would not use these for serious training or competition.  I'll go back to my regular running shoes but I may use these Spiras for walking around the neighborhood.

I bought this hat because I buy so many electrical tools it's ridiculous.  So I figured I'd grab this bad boy to show off my Klein pride.  I was expecting it to be a little lower quality because of the price and hearing it was made in China.  Doesn't matter.  This hat is top notch . a ok
I wear a 7.5, but ended up ordering a 9 after returning at 8. They fit well, work well on the rocks and feel very high quality.

reviewText: I'm not a novice to climbing, but these are my first pair of shoes. I've only used them at indoor gyms, and they are quite comfortable for a climbing shoe. I usually wear an 8, so I got a 9 because these usually run a little small. They fit perfectly. I don't even realize they're on when I'm climbing, because that's the last thing you want to be thinking about. I'd definitely recommend them regardless of your experience!
They are the nearly only climbing shoes my daughter will wear when climbing.  She swears by them...will definitively recommend them

I know climbing shoes can be all over the scale on sizes - that's why I was so reluctant to buy online.  But these FiveTens were two sizes too small.  Come on FiveTen, you can't even get within a half size or one size?  Amazon did a great job with the return, but I wouldn't recommend this shoe.

I love the colors of this shoe, i purchased the exact same size and everything of the shoe i was borrowing from a friend. But sadly they fit about a size to small. But i was able to return the item. They arrived in a timely manner and i was so excited to receive them. Just sad they didn't fit. I ended up just going to a place near my house and spending more money on a new shoe that way i could try it on first. :(

reviewText: This is a very nice time piece for someone who is looking for an affordable dive watch. It features a large face and date, and all the other features required for a dive/tool watch. The offset crown is really nice because of the case size. The band was a stiff polyurethane with 22mm lugs. I replaced it with a Fossil silicone band that is softer and more flexible. The bezel is easy to grip and has a strong ratchet. The luminescence of the hands and 5 minute markings are good. It is the second Momentum watch I own and I enjoy the both.

I had my reservations about the M-1. I had recently tried out the Invicta Grand Diver and was really not a fan of the ridiculously "oversize" dive watch. However, the reviews I read indicated the Momentum was truly a "diver's watch", and though a bit over sized it was designed to handle the job in a reliable way. It is in the very low pricing for a quality 600FT dive watch but I really liked the look of the orange bezel and dark face design. It looks like a working man's watch, and that is what I need.So I have put my M-1 through some paces. The oversized face is actually a benefit underwater, for those of us who still use analog dive watches for redundant systems to track bottom times. The orange bezel helps with quick location in low visibility, is easy to see underwater and the bezel is easily adjusted even with thick gloves. But it has robust enough ratchets that it will not slide off your settings unless you really try. The silicone band is large enough that it will fit over a bulky drysuit or the top of your gloves, and is textured so that its grip is nice and reliable. It is as comfortable on your bare wrist as it is over top of your dive suit.There is a slight issue with the irradiation of the hands and the hour markers. They charge quickly, but do not seem to keep their charge for very long. While diving in limited or no visibility this could obviously be a problem. A dive light will charge the watch very quickly, but this could truly be an issue if you find yourself without an external light.Overall, this is a reliable, functional dive watch, and a great value at the price. It is a blue collar working watch, with a little flash and appeal.
Good watch for the money, I have worn seiko dive watches for the past 35 years, just thought I would try something new.  No real complaints, it fits all of my needs at a lot less money

After receiving the watch and setting the time/date I have noticed that it would only run with crown unscrewed.Once the crown is screwed in, even only a couple of turns, the watch stops. I checked it, and with crown unscrewed it did run for the 45 minutes till I tried to screw the crown in again.When trying to screw the crown back in, the minute hand on the watch moves about a minute forward. When unscrewing the crown, the minute hand moves back. Something is wrong with the movement. I have never seen any other analog movement do that.As I said, I like the design of the watch quite a bit, brushed matte finish is a solid look. The packaging is a huge disappointment. Watch came in is some cheap recycled afterthought of a box. Definitely earns the company the clean environment points, but does nothing to protect the watch in transport. The middle section of the box that is supposed to hold the watch in place is a single folded over layer of cardboard. I have seen paper airplanes more rigid then that. Even watches that cost much less offer much better and more protective packaging.I really wanted to like that watch.This British Columbia based brand had a solid reputation according to some older reviews. Looks like even they got bit by the cost cutting bug..
summary: Looked great and that was an only positive.

reviewText: I bought this watch as a gift for my husband and he loves it! It's comfortable and the perfect size. I was a little nervous because some of the reviews I read said that the band is cheap but I don't think it is at all. He hasn't used it while diving yet so I don't have anything to review on that point. Otherwise I think this was a great purchase!

I just got my Momentum M1 Deep 6 and I am very pleased with it so far. This watch is very large.  I have and 8 1/4" wrist, I think it might not fit someone with a smaller wrist.  It is large, but it doesn't feel that large and heavy on my wrist.  The case is 48.7mm wide and 13.3 high.  It is not as thick as a Citizen Ecozilla or Seiko Tuna Can, which is nice because it doesn't feel ungainly. It is a very sharp looking well made watch with a very solid feel.  The unidirectional bezel is very smooth with positive clicks you can feel. The movement is very crisp and quiet.  Everything about the watch is large and bold, the numbers, lumes, and date are easy to quickly reference even against the black background.  The crown seems very sturdy with a nice thick stem. Even the rubber band seems very nice.  I think this watch would also look really good with a NATO strap and might get one for it someday. I'm not a diver so I won't be able to do any hardcore depth testing.  I am very active in the water though and plan to wear it daily.  I also haven't had time yet to test the lume brightness, length of light, or time accuracy but will update my review in a few weeks.  I haven't owned a whole lot of watches.  A few Timex, Casio, Swiss Army and Seiko, but this watch is definitely worth the $127 I paid for it.  If you are looking for a large, quality, solid dive style watch, this is definitely worth looking into.  I was also drawn to it because of the 2/4/6 warranty. At the end of two years you send it into St. Moritz/Momentum in WA, and they will service it for you and extend the warranty another two years.  Then after the fourth year you send it in for service and get it extended another two years.  Have heard good things about their service.  I highly suggest this watch if it fits your criteria.
summary: Awesome dive watch for the money!!!

reviewText: Let me say from the start of this review thet this is a great watch. I have just returned from diving in the Dominican Republic and  did not intend to use this watch for the deep dives I had planned. I was wearing the watch because I just like the the nice burnt orange color of the bezel ring. I normally dive with watches that are well over rated for the depth I dive such as the Deep Blue Pro Tac Diver 1K or the Victorinox Black Ice rated to 500 meters. But on one particular two tank dive last week I left the dock headed out to dive a wreck sitting at a depth of over 150 feet wearing the Momentum watch. At this point I should state that I am a NAUI certified Master diver and a certified cave and overhead diver with several hundred dives as such. So it goes without saying if you are not certified beyond recreational diving please stay within your training level. On with the story... So I made the decision to take the Momentum down to the wreck with me. I use a Sherwood Wisdom intergrated dive computer so I knew if the watch failed me at depth I could count on my computer for a safe dive. At an average depth of 130 feet for 25 minutes on a repetitive dive chart I was very pleased that the Momentum M1 Deep 6 stayed tight and sealed! So there it is... A nice looking watch that out performs it's price range. The time piece is accurate. And the bezel ring is snug and does not "drift" forward while wearing it. I personally changed one thing about the watch and that is I put a fast wrap strap on the case. Nothing really against the factory strap I just prefer the comfort of fast wrap straps. This watch is also easy to read above and below the surface and maintains the illumines glow through the night! Just note that only the hour and minute hands along with luminus dot on the bezel ring remain bright enough to see through the night. I believe this a good time piece for the money and would highly recommend it to my friends.

The band material is not strong and will eventually crack and then break soon after. I'm hoping the $9Timex Men's Q7B725 Resin Performance Sport 20mm Black Replacement Watchbandwill easily fit and last much longer than the original.This is an excellent every-day watch for work or the outdoors. This does the trick nicely, although I encountered several problems.First, the included adhesive discs don't provide enough adhesion on an angled and textured service like my Dodge Intrepid's dashboard. I found out that I not only had to buy a package and pay for shipping, I also had to pay an $8 minimum service fee. The customer service rep was so unprofessional in our emails he didn't even capitalize his words. When I finally got my watch back a couple of months later, not only did the watch click as loudly as ever, one of the buttons on the side was broken and I couldn't even use the digital component. When I sent an angry email, the finally gave me a decent rep who immediately sent me a whole new watch. reviewText: Very pleased with this mount! I've got a Polar RS100 heart-rate monitor and this mount fits it perfectly. The Timex mount is great in that it just flexes apart and pops on or off, so if you don't ride with the monitor all the time (or want to switch it between bikes), it's no problem. I'm using this with 31.8mm handlebars on a Cannondale Six carbon road bike, and the grip is just right (I don't have to tighten the wrist band on the watch too much, but I can imagine with smaller diameter handlebars, you might have to).  Some of the other mounts at Amazon require a 'large' size for the thicker road bike handlebars, but this seems to cover just about every size. My only possible complaint would be that it might look better in black, as opposed to the vaguely military looking green, but it's mostly concealed by the watch and looks pretty sleek. I've now got a wireless Cateye speed/cadence computer on my stem, and the Polar HRM beside it on the handlebars when I'm seriously training, and the combo works perfectly.

nice simple product. fits nicely on the handle bar and i suppose would fit most watches. would probably get another one if i need it.

This is a pretty simple piece of plastic, but it makes my Timex GPS watch exponentially easier to use on the bike.  They could have engineered something much more complicated that would not have worked any better.  Simple is good, and I expect this to last for a long time.
summary: Does what it is supposed to do

reviewText: I recently bought a Garmin watch holder and it turned out to be a fairly huge and heavy lump, that was over wrought and a bit tacky with a giant GARMIN printed on it.  This is much lighter and cleaner and functions a bit better so far.
summary: Still Kind of Big, But Smaller than Garmin

reviewText: This product fits a normal Road Bike handlebar perfectly.It's been cut in strategic places to make it curve around the handlebar more easily. Fits snugly, and you can probably attach any watch (I am using with a GPS Casio Solar) around it that has a watch band. Lightweight, which fits my needs on a 200+ mile one day ride where weight can be an issue. Probably cost $1 to make it, but worth the $9 to me because it says exactly what it will do. Made in China.

these where the tallest boots I could find and work well - about 4" higher than standard rubber boots.They were not packaged well though - one boot was folded over and has a permanent crease in it.And attempts to get a replacement one failed after various phone calls.  Labelled Remington but made by a 3rd party.

Boots are supposed to be scent free,(yes- I did descent them prior to use, its an ingredient used in NO-camo Rubber) not the case…. Opening day of bow 9/28/13 nj, had a massive 9 point walk in about 30yards ---- stopped dead in his tracks and winded me. I take serious DE-SCENTING measures and come to find out these boots are not scent free.

First off, I don't particularly care about these being scent-free as I am not using them to hunt. That said, there is a very strong rubber odor on them that diminishes a bit over time but never really goes away.I bought these to wear for fishing- being able to wade out a short distance to launch my boat and to get it back on the trailer really helps. These aren't seeing daily (or even weekly) wear for me. I bought them in October, and used them a few times in October and November, then not again until February and March. As of the middle of March (probably less than 15 times wearing them) they have developed cracks in the rubber about halfway up the calf. This makes them pretty much useless for stepping in 10" deep water as they'll fill up.
It was very awkward and when you cut it to fit around your ears (as the product states to do) it makes it even worse. We were unable to use this.

Of course, the photo of the product makes it look great, but in reality it doesn't even come close to looking like this, but wasn't expecting it to either.  There is a 'cone' on the top that won't go away.
It's fair. It is waterproof. It's heavy, uncomfortable and you're unlikely to walk very far with it. If you need it to just shovel snow out in front on a storm, it works.
summary: These boots are NOT made for walking.... "Nancy Sinantra" lol...

reviewText: Legs were long enough to fit an inseam of 44 inches, you have to be over 6 ft to wear these.I did take them to my tailor to cut and hem 4 inches off and Im 5 '7" .
This worked perfect to a costume for my nephew of 3 years old we just had to adjusted them because were  a little big for him. he love it

These boot covers fit well, stayed up well, looked cool, and were pretty durable, but when you pull the boot cover over the sneaker it makes the sneaker unable to grip well (indoors).  If you try to line them up with the edge of the shoe, it doesn't last long before they have slipped under to the tread again.  My son ended up just pulling them up to his ankles (he's four).  It looked funny to me but he didn't care and he had the "boot effect" up to the shin.  Also, if you were going to wear them outdoors, the wearer would be walking on the material as it falls under the tip of the sneaker.  I am thinking that they would not last long on pavement based on the material - a sort of thin, semi-stretchy nylon.
summary: good sizing but made for slippery sneakers

reviewText: Our almost 5 year old likes to dress up and prefers to have accessories, so this was just added to the mix.

I bought these as the final piece of my sons power ranger. Costume.  He is 5, very tall and of average build.  The problem I had with these was that they wouldn't stay up. I had to buy Velcro to attach to them and the costume to try and help it stay up.  Also, they didn't fit well around the shoes.  Much of the "boot" was on the sole of his shoe and thus they had holes in them by the end of the night.  These definitely were not built to last.
My baby thinks they are the best things ever - however he's know asking for some boots!!They are a little big but I would rather they be a little big than too small.
Worked good as Boot Covers for a Mike the Knight costume at Halloween (tucked in so the top wasn't visible).
My husband absolutely loves these shorts! Good length... not too long, not too short, and they are also very lightweight and comfortable.

What doesn't show up in the picture is the watch face is reflective so the silver hands absolutely blend in and you can't tell the time under any lighting situation. This watch really looks cute in the picture, but it sure is different in reality.
summary: Cute, but don't waste your money

reviewText: OK.  Starts very tight out of the box. I had to check and make sure I had gotten the Wides that I ordered.  They are marked W. I switched the laces to plain, one color because I didn't want the multicolored ones. At that point the shoes seemed to open up, not nearly as tight. I endured a few more days of tightness, although not as tight as it was initially. I hoped they would stretch out a bit. I have tried with different socks, and some days are better than others, but the bottom line is uncomfortable.On the positive side, they are nice in the fact that they are almost full mesh, and breath well. Nice hot weather shoe. Great heel support, too.All things being considered, I would rather return them and not worry about whether they are going to hurt my feet today or not.
Love Saucony. This is the best one yet, especially the dark color works for trail runs.

I have ordered and received two of these smocks.  They are super comfy and stylist. Sadly, they are sized for someone 5' tall and stick thin.I ordered the XL. I'm 5'8' 41" bust, 32" waist, 40" hips. This smock is skin tight and the hip slits come all the way up to my waist. Shoulders are only about 16" across the back.I love the feel of the stretchy fabric, but it needs to run with better sizing.

This is my fourth pair of icebugs with the bug grip sole and I love, love, love them.  I live in Homer, Alaska where we have very icy winters. These boots are the best on ice they also provide reasonable footing on bare surfaces although I do not wear them on hardwood floors.  I would not step out the door without my ice bugs.  I wear them a half size bigger than my regular shoe size.

These shoes are a life saver. My father passed away in September, and I know how my mother likes to shovel snow! (go figure) And I wanted her to be safe while doing it all alone. She goes a little over 200lbs and she loved them. She felt as safe as I did knowing she had them. So no accidents this year. We live in Pa and this winter was the perfect test for them in icy conditions. The only thing you have to be aware of is DO NOT WEAR them on hard wood, laminate, linolium or any other smoth surface. Just make sure there are rugs over these surfaces if you have to walk on them. Just like my german sheppard who didn't like these types of floors because he would slide, or fall down which scared him., The same happens if you walk on them. I also bought myself a pair and, soo glad I did since the winter ice was here this year. The shoes were true to size and verry comphortable and warm.Delivery at Christmas was verry fast also. So this is a must for any elderly person who worries about falling.
summary: Glad I bought a pair for myself

reviewText: I bought these last year at the end of the season, so finally tried them out this year.  They are comfy, sturdy and most importantly have a great grip.  I have used them only to get around the city after the first icy snow storm.  The steel  studs are not useful for regular clear sidewalks, so I went back to my normal boots when the sidewalks got better, but will pull out these the next time there is a lot of snow and ice, particularly ice.  I wiped out a few times last season and don't wish to repeat. I do change shoes once I get indoors, the studs click when you walk on tile floors, okay on carpet though.
My daughter was a bit picky but when she received this costume, she loved it!Material is soft on skin and the design is so cute for her age. Perfect for Halloween.
Overall good boots,good in snow,good support around ankles. Worth the money.The toe box should a little wider,other wise nice fit.

I wore my first pair through the Sierras for about 11 backpacks, some offtrail, and for a gnarly 6 day trek above 14,000 feet in Peru that averaged about 16 miles a day. They fit my size 10.5 AA feet right out of the box (with thick socks) and never a blister.  The soles are really sticky and fantastic for rockhopping etc. The first pair finally started to fail after the third 6 mile bog crossing in Peru, where claylike mud was suctioning the shoes almost off my feet. The toecap started to peel off and the front part of the toe separated from the sole. Not surprising considering how much I'd challenged these shoes. I ordered a second pair and I'm into them about 75 miles of hiking. The black toecap on one is starting to peel off. Otherwise great shoes. Oboz makes a great shoe and 3 of my friends swear by them. They are pretty stiff boots though so if you're mostly a dayhiker go with the next model down. Without my full pack on, this model feels kind of clunky.
summary: Except for the toecaps peeking off, these are the best mid-duty hiking boots I've ever owned

reviewText: I really like these boots; they are a great fit, provide lots of support, and my feet stay dry. The only down fall is they take a little bit to break in (no more than a week of wearing them for an hour or so a day will do the trick). I would recommend these to friend.
summary: Great boot, takes a bit to break in

reviewText: I have owned many hiking boots in my 69 years and these are by far the best fitting boots ever. They are a narrower fit and that is what I have been searching for for years. Every other brand I have tried I ended up with blisters on my heels, on my big toes, on the pad under my toes because no matter what socks I tried I could never get the other brands to stay firm enough on my feet. They always ended up sloppy and rubbing.

I had read many reviews of other boots that indicated that there would be a "break-in" period where one could expect they may not be comfortable.  The Oboz Women's Wind River BDry Hiking Boots were comfortable at first wearing and I expect they will only become MORE comfortable as I continue to use them.  I have hiked with these in many conditions that could compromise an inferior brand, but these have stood up to damp and/or wet conditions and rugged terrain.  I love the look, I love the comfort, I love the fit ~ and the price fit my pocketbook very well.  These are winners in every respect!

I was a die-hard Merrell boot wearer until I bought my first pair of Oboz.  Now that's all I buy.  These boots are supportive but flexible, and they have a good sole.  They are tough, waterproof, and comfortable.  I've hiked in New England and the Southwest in Oboz, and I love the brand.  This Wind River boot is the original Wind River, which is far better than the second version.  It is substantial enough to handle backpacking with a 30 pound pack, but isn't stiff and unyielding like the second version.

Bought these boots from EMS 2 weeks before leaving on a 12-day backcountry hike in Denali National Park in Alaska.  I broke them in as often as I could and hoped they would survive 6-8 hour/day hikes.  They did and were amazing as we trekked across mountainsides, tundra and even through rivers.  Kept my feet dry through <4 inches of water and wicked away what they could.  Pair with a nice merino wool sock and you're good to go.

My foot problems include flat feet, over-pronation, bunions, and nerve pain due to two webbed toes.  These boots, from the first wearing, were comfortable and supportive. I can walk, no, make that HIKE for over 90 minutes in these boots completely pain free!!  Wowie!
summary: problem feet pain-free in Oboz boots

reviewText: Considering what I paid ($210) for these boots I was expecting a high quality boot that would last. The rubber/sole is already detaching from the heel after less than 1 year and they are definitely NOT waterproof.

I'm reviewing my new OBOZ Wind river boots, they are NOT broken in yet and have had only a little bit of wear. That being said. I initially tried on Scarpas for my 1200 mile thru-hike next summer, the scarpas were great but the toe box pinched just a tiny bit and the store didn't have a bigger size. I was a bit sad about this, but the shoe guy told me to try the Oboz, I was hesitant, but I figured trying them on couldn't hurt........And they DID not hurt one bit, no pinching, tight spots or rubbing. I tried them on with a medium weight smart wool that I will be using on my trip. I have flimsy ankles and high arches, so finding a boot right off the rack that didn't immediately have pressure or pinching was awesome...I'll update my review as I break them in. I do want to mention that Waterproof membrane can only go so far, it does not protect your feet if you submerge the boot also the clerk was adamant about the fact I would need to use additional waterproofing.  Oboz brand is consistently in touch with their customers via their FB page and will probably be willing to look into why your boots were not waterproof!

40% of the time you are using a stethecope, you need a watch and a watch on your wrist gets all wet if you wash your hand frequently and all dirty if you don't, plus watches are in the way of gloves, etc. This is an excellent concept-I wish it didn't break the second day of use. The clear plastic part of the face chipped and fell off, and it no longer keeps time consistantly.This is worth $2. I would pay $20 plus for something just like this that would last at least a year.
summary: great concept, bad quality,too high a price what you get

reviewText: What a great idea!  I do not like to wear a watch.  Been a nurse for 7 years and can't believe I went so long without this.  It's nice and light weight and I find the red demarcations for 15 seconds to be very handy when checking apical pulses.  Setting the time is easy and while I've only used it a few days, it seems durable but is also just plastic so it may break in time, we'll see.  I would give it 5 stars but it would be really nice if the number marks for the time (5 second marks) were bold or darker so they were more easily distinguishable.
I keep losing watches (or forgetting them in the middle of the might), so this is great. Clip it on and forget it.

I was really excited to have an analog watch on my stethoscope however the concept was great with size and all but the product is poorly made. The watch immediately would get stuck and the seconds hand would not tick away. I ended up throwing this product away even before my shift started.

I have this for weeks and it still running. So far I have no problem with its accuracy. It tells me the right time :). Although I could hear its ticking sound as I do my auscultation but its definitely distinguishable from the sounds that Im trying to listen to. Works for me.

The stethoscope watch is great, but it is not tight enough on the tubing of the stethoscope, it goes up and down and I have to hold it in place to watch it.  Frustrating when working in pediatrics and the patient is very mobile.
summary: Not tight enough on stethoscope tubing

reviewText: Overall, I like it. It fits my Littmann Master Classic well, but it slides up and down freely. Which is nice in certain situations, but it cant be a little hard to keep hold of. I think it could be a little cheaper, considering how simple in design it is. But I needed a watch on my stethoscope, and it serves its purpose well. Would recommend.

Bought as a present for daughter , she's taking emt training.It was a good idea, but it was small and not easy to read.Didn't get to actually use it as it was damaged in transit. Had to return it ,amazon is so good about returns.
Love it! Product arrived on time, as prescribed. Some places won't let me have a watch. With this attached to stethoscope,; it works like a charm.
This is a very good product. It's Very light weight, small, easily attaches to stethoscope. Easy to remove for cleaning.
It would not stay clipped to stethoscope, or rotated around when I tried to use it, difficult to read, numbers are very small
Ordered this for myself and Love it.  Should have bought sooner.  Have had it for awhile now and no issues.
This fits nicely on my stethoscope and is a wonderful solution to wearing a watch. I especially appreciate the 15 second marking.
Wonderful idea - after I bought mine, the extern ran out and bought one as well.  Then mine broke into many pieces after having it for less than 2 months.Please make this sturdier.
i hate wearing a watch at work & this is perfect. teh only problem is you have to have someone stretch the stethoscope while you push in on because it is very snug when attaching it

I'm a NICU nurse who occasionally gets floated out to care for well newborns & post partum moms. Our hospital changed to digital room clocks, so this stethoscope watch has been incredibly helpful! It's loose, so it falls down next to the bell, but if you work it just right, you can hold it & the bell with the same hand. Easy to clean & easy to read. It's almost perfect & hopefully in the redesign they'll make it hug the tubing tighter... If they do, I'll give it 5 stars.

I ordered this clock to go with the Littman Classic telescope that I ordered and when it came in the mail it was in pieces. I thought I could put it back together but it wasn't working at all and wouldn't stay together when i tried to put it on the telescope. Total waste of money.

This is an ingenious idea, it eliminates the need to wear a watch and having to remove it to wash your hands. It puts the watch directly in your line of vision when listening to the heart. Awesome product
I like the idea of this product. I wish it didn't slide down my stethoscope so freely. Would be better if it stayed in one place.

This watch has made my job much easier. Counting breaths and pulses in children is now, literally child's play . The only problem was it being a tight fit for my cardiology stethoscope but it does fit nicely
My only drawback on this is that it needs a small piece of paper to hold it on your stethoscope to keep it from sliding all over the place.

I bought the stethoscope watch for my wife who is a nurse. Product arrived on time and as pictured. However, the watch does not fit snugly onto the Stethoscope rubber tubing. I filled the gap by using a rubberband which helps, but buyer should be aware. Nice product otherwise.

My daughter is an EMT.  I got this as a stocking stuffer and she loves it.  Although she doesn't use it as sold.  She clipped it on an ink pen and everyone asks her where she got it.  They want to buy one.
easy and very convenient to work with. grips well and helps with keeping an eye on second hand when taking vitals.
Second hand never worked consistently. Tried several batteries. Second hand skips ahead and stalls. Makes this great idea a useless product. :(
Very cool idea for a product. . .big problem hooking it on tube as you hear the ticking of the clock when listening for sounds. . .not good and expensive shipping. . .
I use it every day.  It is easy to read and light.  It fits my stethoscope well.  I wish it has back light for night shift.
I just had it for a couple of weeks. I had my stethoscope around my neck and suddenly it broke into pieces. I wasn't even moving. Very disappointed, I could not even glue it back together again.
Watch with clear view of the time, even from far away, firm attatchment to stethoscope. Rating text with extremelly boring and demanding rules.
I loved it at first.  It was a great idea.  After using it less than 2 months the second hand fell off inside the crystal and it was unusable.  It had not been dropped or misused.
summary: Broke before I had it for 2 months.

reviewText: Another perfect gift for any new RN.  My daughter is a new RN, and we had been trying to find a 24 hour watch.  This was the perfect fit for her stethoscope.  We also purchased a pretty pink Casio digital wrist watch.  All is good and all smiles!  It was like sending her off to Kindergarten her first day at school!

I hate wearing a watch but as a nursing student, it's a must. It fits a little loose on my stethoscope but its not an issue and I'm sure a tiny rubber band would fit under it and keep it in place. I definitely recommend this, not to mention, every one else loves it too.

Great idea because I have large wrists and I work at a very busy animal hospital and can never find a watch that fits.  The only problem is the clamp is not tight enough so the watch is always sliding down and twisting around.  I like it and use it but sometimes it can be very frustrating when you're in a hurry or when you're tyring to deal with an emergency.
The timer does not fit snug on my stethoscope.  The attachment piece is too loose and falls.  I am using it as my backup.

the only reason i have it two stars is because it tells the time. However, when hooked to the stethoscope, I could not hear any heartbeats over the clicking of the clock. Great in concept, but i just suggest you to use a watch.

I purchased this watch hoping to use it on my stethoscope but as soon as I opened the package it literally fell apart.  It was broken in the package and fell apart as soon as I tried to take it out of the packaging.  I tried to snap it back together but it wouldn't work.  I really wish it would have worked.
This does not fit the tubing tight enough, it just spins.  I will just stick to my watch, thanks anyway.
I like having my watch on the stethoscope especially when assessing babies but I don't like how this one slips around on the tubing...  wish it fit tighter and didn't move around.
summary: does the trick but not top notch

reviewText: Fits perfectly on my stethoscope! Will definitely come in handy! Shipped very quickly and packaged nicely. Will definitely recommend to fellow nurses!
What a great idea! Super easy and convenient.  Also a nice distraction for the children. Beats wearing a watch. I have one on each of my stethoscopes.
I really like this watch, however it never faces out where I want it to. It is loose enough that it just kind of swivels on its own. Can't wait to find a black one!

I was very surprised at the small size. It spins around and slides down the tubing and is usually just in the way.  It is difficult to read, except in bright light. I have gone back to using my wristwatch.
I always forget my watch so this handy stethoscope watch makes my life easier.  It was easy to attach, and readily seen.
Love it...I do not have to wear a watch now and it works great when checking on babies and kids.
You really have to shove it on your stethoscope to get it on and in the process it tore a hole right through the tubing of my 3 yr old stethoscope. Now I have to pay $80 to get it replaced!
summary: Tore the tubing on my stethoscope

reviewText: Short and simple, it is worth the price. I am not a watch wearing person. I am a nurse. I have received so many looks and 'thats cool' remarks from doctors and nurses because it is a smart idea. No looking at your wrist will counting the apical heart rate. No more forgetting your watch, if you came prepared with your stethoscope you are all goodd to go. Plus it is in miltary time, no conversions, although we can all do it in a spilit second.
love it. light weight and available every time I pick up my stethoscope.  No need to wear a watch anymore, my cell phone took the place of that.  No Healthcare worker should be without this product.

I was super excited about having this attached to my stethoscope, as I have forgot my watch on more than one occasion. But 2 days after putting it on my stethoscope, it broke. The watch it self, would not longer stay attached to the holder. I had to super glue it, now....if I need to replace battery. I won't be able to.
This is the greatest watch ever. It helps make my job so much easier. I'm an EMT and this watch it's right where I need it when I'm taking my vitals. Love it and highly recommend it.

This is my second one and it is so handy when you only have two hands.  While it is true that you can hear the ticking when using the stethoscope it is pretty quiet and not at all difficult to slip off for short term needs.  I have not had any difficulty distinguishing between auscultation of an organ and the ticking - I love this!
I own two of these and am happy with them.  Wish they had a glow in the dark feature, but other than that, it is nice to always have a watch with your stethoscope.

I ordered this thinking it would be more efficient to have a watch on my stethoscope but this is not the product.  It's not for me anyway.It's really small for one thing. The face measures in at about an inch.  It's not bad for a wrist watch but for a steth, you need it get in a little close to the patient to see it or hold your steth at a weird angle.  The numbers are too small and it ticks weirdly loudly.This was not the product for me.
summary: Not as useful as I would have thought

reviewText: the crack was small decided to use it anyway and it came off stethoscope somewhere between facilities I was visiting, within 1 week it was lost.

This little watch is just that, little.  I need my glasses to see it.  It appeared to be bigger in the photo so I was hoping I wouldn't need my glasses.  It is about the size of a quarter and ticks quite loudly to be so small.  I'll stick to my big-faced wrist watch.
Returning it, I tried to slip it over the ear piece portion but it fell off.  I always wear a watch anyway.
summary: I could not get it to fit on my tubing

reviewText: This watch's "mounting bracket" is too big for 3M Littman stethoscopes.  It just spends around and around.  Defeats the purpose of taking an apical pulse while looking right at the watch if it always spends around backwards.
It stopped working after only 1 month of purchase, cheap and really not worth the money, find a better one elsewhere.

My fiancee is a nurse, and being a nurse (at least a conscientious one that does things properly), she needs to disinfect/clean her hands, watch (and anything she touched or touched the patient basically) after seeing a patient.Obviously, a hand watch is a PITA to clean thoroughly every time, yet one needs it to measure pulse.  I got her this watch, and the day she went to work, the entire nurse rotation wanted to get one too!  it's that convenient to not have to touch your watch (then have to clean it), or even hold it, freeing your other hand.I was worried that, it being a mechanical watch and attached to the stethoscope, that clicking would be heard through it, but it's not (due to the way the stethoscope works).  the watch is loud-enough to hear ticking as the stethoscope hangs around her neck, she says, but again-not through the ear pieces when listening to pulse.obviously, highly-recommended.
Nice fit on any stethoscope the price is a little higher then normal should be around 4.99, but a great item

Very lightweight, inexpensive. It was hard to get onto the tubing of my Littman, had to kind of shove it; the back doesn't go all the way around the tube, but it def. won't fall off. Once on it does not stay in place, slides up and down tube, which may  drive me crazy. I'll have to fiddle with it and try to put tape between the tube and watch. I'm guessing it could catch hair a bit, but most nurses want their hair up out of the way, anyhow. (who wants to risk poop in their hair at work? Nursing isn't really that glamorous). It doesn't seem durable because it is so light, I'm hoping I'm wrong, but if I have it for a few months that'd be ok due to inexpensive. Seems wipeable so I can use sanitizing wipes on it.

This watch had saved me a trouble of wearing wrist watch at work as it is very lightweight, attaches to steth tubing well without falling off. I had one steth watch previously but lost it along with my stethoscope. Got a new one after a month because it's very comfy. Highly recommendedPrestige Medical Analog Stethoscope Watch

reviewerName: Natasha N. Mohammed "Natasha N in New York"
reviewText: I'm a nursing student and I thought that this would be a more convenient way for me to count the heartbeats per minute, but the numbers are really small. I can see the red part very well to count for a 15 second period and then multiply by 4. Other than that, this product is great. I don't have to wear a watch, which I've always hated, especially when I'm cleaning patients and my gloves slip below the watch and I'm not sure if anything has gotten on my watch so I have to go clean it just in case. It's more convenient for me. I just wish the numbers were bigger.
clip is way too small for most proper steths and whats more are so hard that you can easily damage the tubing of your steth (puncture) if you force it.

Great item...everywhere I go Nurses ask me where I got it! It's very handy if your a germ-a-fob like me....! I don't like having a watch attached to my skin when caring for people with all kind of diseases so....this was a very practical and good item for me!
Works well and fits my stethoscope perfectly! Now everyone at works wants one too. Displays both military and regular time.
I bought this as a gift for someone graduating nursing school. It is as described. The numbers are are small and it is lightweight but that's not a terrible thing. Overall I was happy with it.

first- I gota say, im gentle on my stethoscope. im a nursing student with with a littman cardio III. before you judge, I got it cheap-how could you turn it down? this watch is a tight fit on my stethoscope, but it fits. this is not why I say it is cheap, just a fact incase you buy one anyway. I say it is cheap b/c after doing a 12 hour clinical shift one day a week for less than a year, the casing around the watch face cracked by the stem to change the time and now will not stay attached. im shopping for something else, I wont be getting another.

Although the stethoscope watch works, I did not receive instructions on if or how to change the battery, and for the kind of money spent, I hope I can do so.  It is too loose fitting, after about a week it is flipping around on the stethoscope, so it really requires me to turn it back to where I can look at it.  Not terribly happy with it, but.....oh well will know better next time to not buy something online like this that I cannot return now.

A product created with a very good idea in mind: Make acquiring vital signs more efficient for healthcare professionals by eliminating the wrist watch. Unfortunately, I discovered this product was flawed within the first use. When listening to apical heartrates, lung sounds, and blood pressures, I can hear the ticking of the watch through the stethoscope. The clicking watch (being connected directly to the stethoscope tubing)is both loud and distracting. This device is meant to simplify, but ultimately it makes assessment more difficult.

This item is very basic. It works. However u would expect it to fit the width of basic steths. Its too small for littmans. I put it on the metal bridge then of course I can't see it when in auscultating

I hate wearing a watch in the clinical setting, so I decided to buy this stethoscope watch.The pros: it's very easy to read and the red line indicating 15 seconds really simplifies things. It's also nice not to have a watch on my wrist, getting in the way and being a source of contamination.The cons: It's extremely lose on my stethoscope: I have to push it up to the fork at the top, where the tube get's thicker, to keep it in place. And despite being loose, it's very very hard to get it on. I permanently scratched the tubing trying to force it into the stiff, narrow opening.Another major con is the fact that it is SO loud. I can always hear it ticking on my shoulder and it can hear it when I'm trying to listen to heart or lung sounds!!I'm going to use a power tool to cut off the backing they provided and then I'll superglue a clip to it, so I can remove it whenever I want to. Once that is done, it'll be the product I was looking for in the first place.::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::EDIT:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::I made a discovery today that I feel I must include here, in the interest of fairness. It's extremely easy to put this watch on your stethoscope after all!!! All you need to do is slip it on over the exposed metal of your ear piece and push it down towards the 'Y'. This way, it is easy to remove when you want to use your stethoscope, but don't want to hear the ticking.
summary: Easy to read, but loose and very loud.

reviewText: I bought this shoe from my LBS because I read a review here about how the shoe size runs small, and I didn't want to mess around with the possibility of a mail order return. Here's my what I found. I take size 9 1/2 with Merells and Chacos, and a size 10 in Rockports. With these shoes size 10 fits perfectly. So I think the sizing is about right - at least for a medium-sized foot. Your mileage may vary.Something I learned from my LBS is these shoes can be resoled by Five Ten for a nominal charge. That's almost unheard of in this disposable world! Nice to know they offer this service. The shoes do seem very well-constructed so it may well be the soles could wear out before the rest of the shoe.I find these shoes very comfortable for pedaling. I think the ventilation is actually pretty good (I can feel air getting through the top of the shoe and cooling my foot) and so far I haven't managed to sweat these things out even on a fairly strenuous and long ride. I am more concerned about how warm they will be when the weather gets cold. Also, the sole is pretty stiff, which is what you want for bike riding. I think the sticky sole feature is dramatically overstated by most reviewers. I find these stick like a pair of tennis shoes, which is not bad (and way better than Vibram-soled hiking shoes).If I am going to do much walking or standing though, I don't find them to be very comfortable. There is not much resiliency in the sole or insert, and foot support is pretty poor for walking. If I am going to be walking or hiking much, I bring a pair of shoes for that (the joys of panniers). Again, your mileage may vary, I have lots of foot problems so I am very picky.I think these shoes look pretty good in black/grey and work with most casual wear.Addendum 8/10/2012: Lately I've been riding my bike to the gym and it turns out these shoes are great workout shoes!
