reviewText: These are every bit as attractive as they seem and great for slipping on before you step out the house.  I'd use a gel insole if you want greater cushioning.  They're great for dog owners who need to get something on quickly and easily for a trip outside.

It took me forever to make up my mind about these shoes.  Taking them to Ireland for vacation.  So glad I picked these, they are so comfortable.  I will get a lot of use out of these.  Very wise choice.

I had a similar pair of shoes for at least 15 years that I used as my outdoor shoes (gardening, taking out the dog, the trash, etc).  Not sure what brand.  At any rate, those were finally falling apart.  I found these, and put them on my wish list for Christmas.  Tried them out, and the fit great.  They feel warm (important for me, as my feet get cold easy, even in summer).  And they're pretty.  Too much snow to wear outside now, but I look forward to giving them a good trial come spring!

These are great shoes - practical, yet absolutely adorable.  I agree with the other reviewers that they run very short.  I initially bought a 7 (my always size!) and my toe was right to the end.  I was a bit concerned that the 8 (no half sizes!) would be too big, but they were perfect.  I rated 4/5 stars because of the fit issue.  I wore mine barefoot, but they are also fine with a very thin "wicking style" sock.  You know the type that is for athletic shoes, but not much thicker than a trouser sock.  I suspect a sock like that will help with the feel of wearing a rubber shoe.
I am very happy with my Sloggers.  I have some muddy areas in my yard and the sloggers keep me mud free and are easy to clean off.  The fit is good too.

I love these shoes. I have a few different pairs of shoes but end up wearing these 90% of the time because of how comfortable they are. I wouldn't jump in any puddles with them but for normal everyday life in rainy Portland, OR they're great.

These are perfect for rainy days.  They are comfortable, a lot of style and I have gotten compliments each time I have worn them.  I  have been trying to find a low cut "rubber boot" or as I call it a rain shoe to wear on rainy days. I tried finding a "shoe" like this for two years. I wear them with my dress clothes on rainy days and carry my dress shoes in a bag but I might add that these are nice and cute enough to wear with my dress clothes as well. They are well made and true to size. I love, love, love these rubber shoes.
summary: sloggers women's rain and garden shoe are perfect for rainy days.

reviewText: These are just what I was looking for to replace my old ones that finally wore out. Soft,comfortable and flexible for slipping on and off.
Great for slip ons for walking the dog in wet weather. Ordered the next size up and they fit great.
Love, Love, Love them...they are so comfortable...
I use these for rain shoes more than I do for gardening. They are very nice shoes to run errands in. Very comfortable.

Got these to wear in the garden but with sockets they are as comfortable as slippers .  I wear a 7.5 and have trouble with shoes being too narrow. In an 8 these seem perfect. Cute enough to wear to the store or out on a messy day. These would be a good alternative to tall boots for watching soccer or baseball games on wet fields.  Great for the price.
I bought these because I have to walk through mud when I'm at work at times. I'm a nurse and these are perfect for the rainy days. They are comfortable all day, and match my scrubs!
summary: Have to walk through mud at work!

reviewText: These shoes are very comfortable and are made very well.They are great for gardening and all kinds of wet weather.I wear them all the time.The patterns are lovely and really add to the beauty of the shoe.The one downside is they do not come in half sizes.

I was looking for a durable & waterproof garden shoe at an affordable price. The ones I had worn for over a 2 years had finally fallen apart & the same shoes were now over $60. When I found the Sloggers I figured it would be worth a try. They are cute & quite durable & have exceeded my expectations for the price.
I've had several garden shoes and these are my fav so far. I appreciate the little tab on the heel making for easy removal. Thanks, Sloggers!

These shoes fit great and are comfortable, keep your feet dry in the mud and rain, but do not offer good arch support for hard labor. I work 11-12 hour shifts at a large farm and by lunch my feet hurt. But for light gardening at home I would recommend these. I've had several compliments from customers about how cute they are!
summary: great for light gardening but not for long shifts at farm!!

reviewText: I wear a narrow size 9.5, and other reviews advised to order up a size, so I got a 10.  They are a bit large, but with socks, I can hold them on.  The removable insole makes them comfortable, easy to clean, and I love these for gardening.  Before I had the sloggers, I was either wearing flip flops, which isn't safe, or ruining a perfectly good pair of white tennis shoes.  These I can just hose off, leave by the door to slip in every morning when going out to deadhead flowers, pull weeds and water.  They do run a bit narrow, which is to my advantage, and I can see that had I not ordered up a size, they'd have been a tad short.  Get yourself a pair, order up a size, and enjoy.
summary: A tad large, but great for gardening

reviewText: They fit great and are comfy to walk my dog in the snow or just a sloppy wet day !!!
the shoes are fantastic.I wear them when I'm doing yard work and in the garden. They do everything I hoped they would!
I chose this rating because the shoes feel good, wear good & I would recommend them.  The only thing is, they don't come in half sizes, so order up a size!
summary: Really comfy, feel good, very wearable.

reviewText: With the fall wet weather upon us these Sloggers are just what she was looking for this year.  Great fit and color.
summary: Just what she was looking for

reviewText: These are my very first pair of garden shoes.  They are so comfortable and so easy to slip on and off, now I understand why some people wear them everywhere.  I will be buying another pair whenever these need to be replaced.

I like the shoes.  They are cute and a bit of fun.  They work for my gardening and for bird-feeding.  I have worn them just to ride in the car without going in anywhere.  But the padding isn't all-day comfortable for me.  They are better than zoris for comfort but not a lot.  My flip-flops would take me almost as far but don't protect the feet - and allow more sliding off the shoe in early-morning dew than these do.  I wear a 7-1/2 and ordered the eight.  Since there are no half sizes - I'm not sure going down to the 7 would have worked.  But honestly, I think there Should BE half-sizes...Insoles only go so far in taking up the room depending upon where the slack might be found.  A nice shoe.  A decent price.  But not perfect.
summary: not what I would call "all day comfort!"

reviewText: These are awesome! I ordered the black pair earlier, so these aqua/multi are my second pair.  We have had a LOT of rain in Ohio, so I have been wearing them as "regular shoes". Every time I wear them I get at least one compliment, and everyone wants to know where to get a pair for themselves. They are very comfortable and keep your feet dry. They are also very easy to clean! (The insoles come out and the entire shoe is waterproof.) Love these! Oh - they're great for gardening, too! ;o)

LOVE these! These were my Mother's Day present (from me to me). They are durable, and the inner liner keeps my feet very dry and comfortable. The pattern is super cute, too. I would say these run true to size - I normally wear a size 8 and that's what I ordered. There is about 1/2" of space at the toe. They do not feel tight at all, but I have not worn socks with them yet. AND they're made in the USA!!

I normally wear a women's 6.5 W shoe, and that means that usually 7 works pretty well for me.  With this shoe, I keep twisting my ankles when I'm working in the yard.  The shoe is really too loose in the heel (this is for the Slogger shoe), and my feet just slip sideways.  Constantly.  I've never had this happen before.  I do have a narrow ankle, so this might not affect most people this way.  Other than that, the shoe is very comfortable, appears well made, and seems durable.  Also, my mom got the same size shoe in a different color, and hers fits much better.  What can I say... I wish I had noticed this while trying it out in the house, so I could have returned them.The insole did not help... it made the shoe tighter across the top, but my heels were still lifting up and down, and I was still twisting my ankles.  I finally got inserts that fit inside the back of the shoe.  That helps a bit.  But, between the cost of the inserts and the cost of these insoles, the shoes are no longer a good deal.  They're pretty, and they are comfortable, but who wants to twist her ankles all the time?  (If you walk on paved surfaces all the time, this may not be an issue).
summary: The ankle/heel is very loose, have twisted my ankle many times, otherwise it is very comfortable.

reviewText: This shoe was everything I hoped and more! Easy to clean,Comfortable and can be worn while doing a variety of activities. The sole is substantial and the footbed is like that of a normal shoe, not cheap rubber shoes that I have often seen. This is the perfect indoor-outdoor shoe!

I was somewhat disappointed with these shoes.  After reading reviews saying they ran small, I got one size larger than I normally do.  Unfortunately this caused them slip up and down when I walk.  If the heel part would have been taller, maybe they would stay on better.
Love these sloggers they are great for garden or just outside just spray them off with garden hose and keep on going
These are great because they are waterproof. They are also very comfortable to walk in. Perfect if I have to walk on wet grass or in a puddle.

These garden shoes are more comfortable than I could have imagined.  I purchased them because I wanted closed in shoes to stop garden damp, dirt, twigs and atones from getting into my shoes which means I have to stop, take them off and remove the bits.  This was happening so often it was becoming tedious.  I love these shoes, they are easy to slip into without bending down, they don't come off when I'm doing stuff and they just so comfortable.

I ordered the next size up and have found them to be a bit loose if worn without socks (which were OK in the cooler early spring). I can definitely say they do well in muddy areas, and rinse off well. Not too heavy. Just starting to try them without socks and will need an insert for shifting around as I walk. But they don't fall off or trip me. Better to be a little spacious than too tight. After I brought, then I saw them in garden centers for $15 higher.
Ordered these after seeing a friend having a pair - like them - enough to consider order the taller version.  Only change I'd make is wish they were a bit lighter weight.

I ordered my normal size.  They don't really stay on your feet.  They do keep my feet dry but I need a pair if shoes that fit.  I have almost twisted my ankle several times.  Got a size 8 and might give them to a girl who wears a 9.5 because they don't slip off on her.  Go figure.
I love them so much, they are so comfortable that I wear them all the time because they are so easy to just slide your feet into and go.

Good garden shoes are hard to find. These look fine. The shoes look as pictured. The fit is snug. Can't tell yet whether or not they are durable. The only problem was slight, the tag at the top seam was ragged. This may or may not be an indicator of broader quality issues.
These shoes are wonderful.

I had a hard time finding an affordable garden shoe. You could find clogs, but I wanted a shoe. This shoe fits true to size and is very well made and comfortable. This is definitely a premium made shoe. I found the same shoe at our local garden center for a lot more money.
Love these!  They are comfortable and super cute.  Just the ticket for all your barn chores and cute enough to wear to the store when you are done.
summary: A "Must Have" if you love to work outside

reviewText: I read all the reviews and wasn't sure if I would like these.  I really love these shoes.  Our soil is sandy and all my outdoor footwear picks up so much dirt, especially when it's wet outside.  These are great because I can stick my foot under the hose and rinse them off.  They are so comfortable.  I have trouble finding shoes that don't pinch my toes; this has not been a problem.  The only reason I gave them 4 stars is because they don't come in half sizes.  I ordered the next size up and they're fine with socks, but if I run outside and slip them on barefoot, the heel part tends to slide up and down.  But that is such a minor thing that I would definitely recommend these. I'm thinking of ordering another pair in a different color.
Very easy to get on and off, nice color and design. Would recommend this product and an excellent price for the shoe.
summary: Very nice shoe for the price!

reviewText: great gardening shoes, keep my feet dry
Perfect for wet weather and very comfortable and fashionable.  Great value.  Almost wish for rain...just kidding.  So many colors available

I bought two pairs of these garden shoes. One was for my sister for her birthday. I put the other away for myself for spring. I can't say if I like the shoes because I can't find them!!!! But my sister wears hers all the time, and says they are very comfortable. She says she would buy a half size bigger than her shoe size if she buys a second pair.

I love Sloggers! I have a pair of Slogger boots a friend gave me as a gift & they're great for really muddy days, but I also wanted a pair of these shoes. I wear these every day while I'm out working in my yard & veggie garden; keeps my feet clean & protects me from various critters hiding among the plants (scorpions, centipedes, etc).

Color is not as perceived in picture.  Not as pretty.  Most importantly, they do not keep the grass out.  My feet were still green with grass upon removing the shoes.  Which was the whole point of garden shoes.  There was no return slip or papers of any kind in the box, so can not return.  Disappointed!!!

These are the greatest shoes ever made.  The only complaint I have is their traction could be better.  I love all the patterns they come in,  the price is awesome, and who can complain about "made in the USA"?

I've been searching for low footwear that was easy to slip into and waterproof for some time now--something I can wear to run out to the garden or give the dog a quick walk. I stumbled across Sloggers here on Amazon while looking for something else, and decided to order a pair in the Midsummer Black, because the price was so reasonable and the reviews were mostly positive. So glad I did! They came in this morning, and I have them on now. I have a large foot for a woman, size 9, and fallen arches as well as arthritis. These are very comfortable, and run true to size (not a wide width BTW), and a very good fit. They are a well designed, American made product. I'm impressed and so I ordered a pair of size 7 in Midsummer Blue for my mother for Mother's Day to go with her rose bush and watering can. This is a real winner.
Fantastic to garden in,cannot beat them for mowing the lawn and so comfortable to wear. Recommend them. Will also be wonderful to wear when camping in the bush.
I purchased these as a gift for my outdoor gardening mother.  She loves them and wears them.  Her neighbors have given her good compliments for her selection of footwear.

Sloggers  what a great pair of rain shoes, especially for those days that are warm but not quite fall. Comfortable fit and stylish. Received lots of compliments and they are reasonably price. Give them a try. Fit true to size.
very cute, exactly what I was hoping for.  Could be a little taller around the heel but can't wait to wear.  I wear 8.5 so ordered 9.  Might have been able to go with an 8.

Great gardening shoes. Nice roomy toe box. Super comfy and true to size. They will make a funny noise if you wear them without socks, likely due to air inside. In the sun they are hot, but I wear them almost everyday. Not a bit sorry. A great garden shoe.

This is my third pair of sloggers, the other two were slip ons.  They don't fit exactly like real shoes...but not too far from it.  Very comfortable, very light, very much serve their purpose (walking the dog in wet grass).  I think I'm hooked--planning on getting more like this and maybe some boots.  To add:  These are made in the USA!!!

I loved these shoes so much, I got a pair for my sister, and she loves them, too. They are well made, sturdy, great for slipping on to go out into the yard, and pretty enough to run to the store. I wear them barefoot, or if it's cold out, I slip on some socks. I would say the run true to size. I wear an 8 1/2 or 9, and the 9 fits just fine.

I am in love with this garden clog.  I sometimes wear this shoe in the spring or fall as a casual shoe to run errands.  Its especially nice when the ground is a little wet but not necessarily cold since it isn't insulated.  I receive compliments on them all the time.  I also wear these gardening or washing the car.  I just hose them off to clean and use Armour All to shine them up.  The size runs a bit large.  I ended up giving my first pair to my sister, who also like them and ordered another a size smaller for me.

I've owned horses for 3 years and just now purchased my Sloggers.  Wish I had know about them in the beginning!  They're so easy to get in and out of and they keep my feet dry.  I love my Sloggers and will never be without a pair!
The perfect shoes for walking the dog in the morning with the dew on the grass. They are comfortable and the price was good as well.

These are very comfortable but they slide up and down when I walk. I wear a size 8 and if I had gotten a 7 1/2 they would be too small. I think in the heel area it is a bit wide. They look good, good price.
summary: Very comfortable, but slide up and down. Great look

reviewText: They fit well, are comfortable, completely waterproof, fun colors available.  And the fact that they are made in the USA is an extra bonus.  Great shoe at a great price.

These arrived yesterday and I immediately put them on an my foot slid right into them. Perfect fit and so so comfortable. I love the arch support and the overall comfort. I went into town today to a nursery to buy some plants and decided to wear them. They were so comfortable I forgot that I had them on.  I would truly recommend this shoe for any avid Gardner.  I can't say enough about them. I would like to see more solid colors in them, but other than that I am happy with the leafy pattern I picked out. Really cool!
Have at least one pair in my closet at all times. Now up to three pairs as of today and counting

I wear a size 7 and ordered the same size despite reading previous reviews. They fit perfectly and are incredibly comfortable to wear around the house or outside doing yard work. The pattern is pretty and the colors are vibrant. Great product!

I got these shoes in the mail a few days ago, and except for brief moments of sleep (brief because I LOVE MY SHOES and I want to put them back on!) I have not taken them off. They are, by far, the most comfortable shoes I've bought in a very, very long time, and I went online immediately and order two more pairs.Four stars instead of five because you really need to wear socks. Otherwise, they fart. You know what I'm talking about.

They are easy on/off and versatile. Doesn't matter of you get them dirty-the whole reason I bought them! Only drawback is that your feet sweat if you wear them without socks as I like to do.....but then....they are rubber-I knew that anyway!Quick and easy if you are running out to the store

Bought these for the garden -- what a pleasure to go out in the early morning and not have dew-soaked feet.  But they are attractive and comfortable so I've taken to wearing them on any rainy day -- the better to dance through the puddles.
This is the most comfortable garden shoe I have ever had!!  I sometimes wear them shopping.  A good fit with no rubbing or binding and waterproof!
Nice coloring and the fit is perfect. I am a gardener and slip them on whenever I go outside.  If they get muddy I either hose off or bang together to remove hardened mud!

These shoes look great; feel great; are great.  Slipping them off at the door is the best bit.  In the garden; on a rainy day; they are useful/practical  anytime in fact.  I've worn them with and without socks.  The soles help with walking  in dirt/mud etc.  Best of all they are made in the USA from recycled materials.  Thanks.

These are cute and are a great idea, but they are definitely not for people who typically wear a wide. I wear 8.5 wide and can usually wear a 9 medium/regular, but these squeeze the middle of my feet so badly that my feet are in PAIN after five minutes.
I would recommend this product, in fact I am purchasing a pair for my husband.  The only down side is that if you have been walking in the rain, the shoe makes a sound as if you are passing gas.

These are great, stays dry inside even when the outside is soaking wet.  The size is the only thing I would like to comment on if there is anything not positive to say.  I was used to working in Crocs for gardening and they are roomy and airy.  These are fitted like a shoe and my shoe size is what I ordered and it was correct.  If I were to order another pair, I would order another half size up to give me that extra room that I am used to.  When I do that, I can determine if that works for me or not.  Hope this helps someone.
summary: Big Gardener loves these cute shoes

reviewText: I love these shoes for my garden and in the house. They are so comfortable and in the yard they are waterproof.

I actually bought these to use when I was taking my dogs out on cold and/or wet Spring days in Maine.  I love them. They are comfortable and very well made. They just slip on - much easier than putting on boots for the rain or wet, cold grass.I then donned them when I actually did work out in the yard doing spring plantings. No more wet, dirty sneakers! And to clean them,  you just rinse them off.They are reasonably priced and exceeded my expectaions.
This Christmas gift for my wife was perfect.  She teaches at one of the local universities and her trips in from the parking lot will a lot safer with these sloggers!!!
Perfect for the garden, and those early morning walks about the yard. Comfortable, light and waterproof. Now I need a pair for my summer cottage!

These rain shoes are nice looking and good quality.  The size ordered (with the inserts) do tend to slide at my heel even though I ordered the suggested size with the inserts.  Nevertheless, I do not anticipate running in these shoes just gardening and walking in wet grass and muddy driveways.
My mom loves these garden shoes I bought for her! Super cute pattern and they fit really nicely! Great buy.
I love the selection of patterns this product offers....size is true to fit.  Would definitely recommend this product to an avid gardener.

I have come to enjoy gardening, and realized that tennis shoes just didn't work well when needing to go back inside the house on occasion.  They fit well and are very comfortable.  I'm ready for Spring!
I'm going to buy them in the boot, I love the fact that I can just slip them on and off.

If I could give 1/2 stars I would give this shoe 4 1/2 stars because the heel slips and a heel pad will make it feel too small. But, for my purposes it is great. I use this to garden so I can take my shoes on and off easily as I come and go outside and can easily be hosed off.What I love most of all is the price. I purchased this on a Warehouse deal for $8!  Thank you Amazon!(I wear a size 7 and purchased a size seven so I would say this is true to size)
summary: Love this shoe for garden and rain

reviewText: These shoes are so adorable and so nice to be able to hose them off after being in a muddy garden. I wear them on rainy days also, they are a little big so I do have to wear a sock, but worth it.
summary: LOVE, LOVE, LOVE THESE GARDEN OR RAIN SHOES!

reviewText: These are a great value!  They are durable and waterproof, as well as attractive. I would recommend them as a reasonably priced item that fills the bill for keeping your feet dry in the garden.
I love these.  Comfortable, waterproof.  1/2 sizes, order up and wear with socks or buy extra insole.  Will definitely buy again.

...and I find them a bit variable in size, but all have been totally comfortable.  Last summer I wore sloggers everyday, six days a week at my outdoor job.  This pair is snug fitting (but not too tight for a good, midweight pair of socks) and offers good support for my elderly feet.
summary: This is my third pair sloggers

reviewText: Third Pair:I have a pair of my own, bought 3 years ago and I love them.  These were purchased for a daughter.  They fit perfectly and she loved them.
I loved them even more when I saw them up close.  Very comfortable to wear and easy to clean.  I'd buy another pair.

These shoes fit perfectly - I wear a 7.5W and ordered a size 8. They are warm enough to wear in the early spring when everything is starting to thaw. I use them around the yard and the sole is thick and non-slip, yet do not make my feet feel heavy. I would highly recommend these garden shoes for yard work / walking in the rain / splashing in puddles. :)
Got these as a gift for my mom. She loves them and has gotten many compliments in them. Excellent find
Great quality.  The shoes came within days of ordering.  They were a gift for my mother-in-law.  I gave them to her on a Friday night late, and she had them on bright and early in the morning.

I don't wear these for long periods of time, but they're great for slipping on at the door to take my dog out in anything but significant snow accumulation.  I haven't had problems the times I've decided to walk my dog in them once we're out, either.  It seems others have found this great use for them, too, given the two paw print designs!  I think I'll be a customer for life!
summary: Love these for taking the dog out!

reviewText: Love these sloggers . . . not just for garden work, but they are terrific for rainy days, cleaning house, cooking and working in the art studio. Worn with socks they are comfy enough to wear all day, are not heavy and keep my feet dry and dust free, especially nice because we have two dogs and I have to clean/sweep dust a lot, so I was constantly washing my nice slippers. Now, I wear these instead. In the art studio, I can stand at the easel for hours, and my feet don't get fatigued, also any paint/graphite/whatever, will wipe off. Cut a little small; I wear a 7.5 M and the Women's 8 is just perfect! Hope to get another pair to keep in the car.

These were a gift for my mom.. gardening  is her summer hobby and she loves them so much she wears them even when we go shopping..they are very comfortable and cute...recommend you get a size bigger my mom is a size 5 and 6 fit her great...I might just get a pair for me!!!!

I love the Slogger garden Shoes.  They fit my wide foot, are very durable, Provide good support, are flexible and comfortable.  Wears well with or without socks. And I'm happy with the selection of colors and prints.  No more dreary green.

These garden shoes are a perfect blend of slip ons and weather proof shoes...I use them for all outdoor chores and dog walking.Good for alost any weather mother nature throws at you...except snow of course.Thumbs up for these slogs!
summary: fit well and perfect for outdoor chores and gardening!!

reviewText: I like the way these look and they felt good until I realized that both times I have worn them I ended up with damp feet.  I have a large piece of property that is very wet in the spring, so I bought these specifically to keep my feet dry.  I have not stepped on anything that could damage them, so I do not understand why I am having this problem.  It's perplexing.

THESE ARE JUST GREAT. This is the second pair for me, and wear them all day they are  so comfortable.  I have two dogs that I take out several times a day and in the morning the ground is wet and my shoes and feet are dry.  Highly recommend them.  I have arthritic toes and these do not hurt them, I'm pain free a;; day.  GREAT.

I needed shoes that I could wear in a nature preserve while walking our dog daily. It gets muddy there in damp weather. Finally, I found these and they're perfect for my needs.  First of all, they're extremely comfortable.  And I love how I can keep them looking nice by simply hosing them off.  And this particular design is so spiffy with the white dots on black. I've even had nice comments on them.  I have other Sloggers in more of a clog style but these are better for our walks in the preserve because of the higher heel area - they stay on my feet while walking through uneven and sandy ground.  I've tried so many other shoes for dog walking but finally found these that really suit my needs.  I can't recommend them highly enough.  Must add too, they are very well made.

I've had crocs before.These shoes are very, very bottom heavy, feels a little like carrying a weight around on teh bottom of my foot.The weight is all very noticiably all in the bottom.Fit is too big.
summary: These shoes feel heavy and clunky.

reviewText: This show is a bit heavy and sits a bit low on the ankle.  I wear size 10 sneaks, but 9 1/2 show, so I purchased a size ten slogger and it was too big so I returned them.  I am considering the slogger ankle boot but am not sure what size to order.  I am afraid a 9 may be a bit too small or hard to put on.

I had been wearing Crocs for their easy on and off capability, but had a problem with them because small rocks kept getting in the shoe on the raw land that I work.  The Sloggers are a perfect solution.  It is harder for me to pick up small rocks and other debris since there are no air holes and it is easy on and off.  When I work outside I want to take the outdoor shoes off easily before entering the house.  I can leave the Sloggers outside even in the rain by the front door.  They wash up easily too so I can wear them going anywhere after a hard day of dirty or muddy work outside.

I found that these Sloggers are good for my gardening chores. I love to see my flowers and trees looking good. I can slog around in the muddy garden and not get water leaking through or mud. When I take them off I just rinse them under my basement faucet and they are good to go again.
I love these shoes for running out to our garden and compost pile. They are easy to put on. The fit was great. I have narrow feet and wondered if they would slip off but they don't. Good price also.
I love these shoes.  They are very  stylish.  Great for Seattle weather and outdoors.  Very comfortable and a Great find. Love the color.
summary: i love them.  great for Seattle weather.

reviewText: They are heavier than they look, and my heels slip out of them on each step.  Does not work for me because I have a foot injury.

They are better.This is my first pair of this type, but my third pair overall.I love Dloggers.These Garden Sloggers are excellent especially as they are non slip AND they look bood.One must always look good while gardening.  :-)
Goes on easy, very comfortable.  We've had huge amounts of rain here and I wear them every single day.  Made in USA a plus!

It turns water which is just what I wanted.  They are not good enough to walk in for any distance.  Even with extra arch supports there is not enough support.  I love them for gardening  a half to one hour at a time.

I LOVE this shoe. It fits comfortably (I wear an 8 and I ordered an 8), looks great, is well made and I'm extremely happy with it. I had been wearing a similar shoe to take the dog out but the shoe has holes on the top and sides and my feet would get wet after and during a rain.  This shoe keeps my feet dry and the dirt/mud can be hosed off.  Unlike others leaving feedback, I can run in this shoe and do not have any problem with the heel slipping.  This shoe is so attractive and the price is right.  I will be buying more Sloggers.

I love my sloggers. I wear them every day out in the garden. Very well made & beautiful too. I like the nice thick soles. The only thing I'd like better is to be able to get 1/2 sizes. I wear a 7 1/2 & had to get an 8. I have to put addl. insoles in them to make them fit better. Other than that. I LOVE MY SLOGGERS!

These shoes make me happy because they look so bright and pretty on dark days and are really comfortable.  They do keep my feet dry, although if you are walking in long ,wet grass, the upper part of your feet/socks can get wet.
Just what I wanted and ordered. Easy on, easy off, water proof. Attractive enough to leave on while running errands.

I wear my sloggers all summer.  I have an outdoor pair ( to get muddy) and an indoor pair to keep clean.  They truly are all-day-comfort.  I even wear mine to the store.  Thanks  Carolyn  in  Missouri
summary: This my second pair, I love em

reviewText: I needed waterproof, protective shoes for my volunteer hours in sea turtle rehab and also easy-to-wash shoes to wear when throwing clay around because I'm very messy. These are comfortable and the price was a good deal! I would definitely buy them again and recommend them. PLUS, I'm probably the only Leopard wearing Zebra shoes.
I recently purchased these sloggers.  I received them before expected...on a rainy day.  They came in very handy keeping my feet warm and dry.  They are also quite pretty.

I use these shoes for rain shoes so I don't ruin my work or regular shoes. They're comfortable, protect against the rain, and seem to be true to size. On top of that they're pretty and so much fun to wear!

I couldn't be happier with these.  I needed something to slip on and off easily.  I am in and out of the house all day with the garden, the dogs and I am an artist so I do a lot of painting outdoors.  They are soooo comfortable and durable.  Easy to clean.  I practically live in them and for the price and made in usa and from recycled materials...perfect.  I usually wear anywhere between a size 7 to 7 1/2 and sometimes 8.  I got the 8 and figured I would buy the insoles if they were too roomy but these are perfect. without the insoles so I wouldn't say they run big.
Very comfortable! I highly recommend them. Great durable shoes. My last pair  would have lasted forever, if not for the puppy.

These are great garden shoes.....much sturdier than my current ones and really cute if you love gardening the way I do.  They will be great for keeping my feet dry in the early morning damp grass, when watering the gardens, or working after a rainy day.  I gave them only 4 stars for the following reason......  The shoes overall fit very well and seem to run true to size, but the heel "slips" ever so slightly when I walk in them......probably due to the fact that it's not quite a full heel (but more heel than a clog).  It might just be how the shoe fits me, and I am not sorry I purchased them.......they are fun to wear!

I am a nurse and so one told me about these shoes. This is my 3rd pair and My feet feel amazing in them and no longer hurt and throb after a 12hr shift. Highly recommend for anyone on their feet alot.

Well if you think you are going to trek anywhere for any length of time be prepared to change shoes. These shoes are good if you are just going out to get the mail..any length of time walking or standing on your feet you will be sore...very little padding in shoe.  Shoe is cute and does have nice color and does fit appropriately.

The shoe is lightweight, cushy insole, comfortable to walk in, doesn't pinch anywhere, good tread/grip when walking in the garden and pavement, waterproof and well made.  The shoes looks just like the picture.  I love 'em!

Great for those early morning dog walks and the dewey grass! When the weather doesn't call for boots, but I don't feel like getting my feet soaked, these are a good alternative to sneakers. I'm about to garden in them, and look forward to simply rinsing them off when I'm through. Pretty comfy, too.The only downsides would be... they don't come in half sizes and the three or four design choices feel a little old fashioned. These Sloggers are not insulated, so keep in mind that your feet will still feel chilled in the damp or cold weather even though they won't be wet.

These shoes are great in the garden as they keep your feet dry.Best gardening shoes I have ever had.My foot size is 5 1/2 so of course I ordered a six.I can wear them with or without a sock and they do not flop off.In fact I have a second pair of Sloggers which I wore on a 3 mile walk and they were good for walking.Will definitely order these again when budget permits.

After reading all the reviews, I was rather confused as to which size to buy so I bought both a size 8 and a size 9. I normally wear an 8 and 1/2, and if they made the Sloggers in half sizes, the shoes would fit perfectly.... but I have decided to keep both sizes anyway. I wear the size 8 without socks for quickly watering my plants and flowers every morning, and I wear the size 9 with a thin pair of cotton socks for all day gardening and mowing. And I honestly could not be happier. They are very comfortable and light-weight compared to Bog's Rue Pull-On shoe. I ordered those as well, and had to send them back because they were too tight across the top part of my foot, and uncomfortably heavy. Though I must admit, they were very well constructed and might possibly last longer than these Sloggers, but they are also more than twice the money!I feel the Sloggers are well worth the price, and would highly recommend. Oh, and by the way... I really like the tulip green print color! :)

This shoe is practical, very pretty, waterproof and very comfortable!  I'm getting lots of compliments on how they look.  I forget to take them off when I'm done in the garden because they are so comfortable.
Just what I needed for early morning weat in the wet grass.  The sloggers fit well and protect my feet.  thanks.
I  am really happy with these gardening shoes, they are easy to get on, comfortable and practical. Will recommend to others.
I bought these shoes for rain (for when I didn't feel like putting on huge rain boots) and they work perfectly! I get compliments on them all the time and they were definitely worth the money.
Terriffic clogs and very pretty. They work well in the garden or going out to get the mail on rainy days. Very sweet little shoes.

A friend of mine was wearing these and I got jealous!!! They are so cute and go with everything and are very comfortable. To heck with wearing them in the garden, bought two pairs in different colors and get many compliments on them. Being a slip on is a bonus also.

I love these shoes to garden in! Although they are a little big because they don't come in half sizes I really like them. They are comfortable and unlike gardening clogs your heals stay clean. Another bonus is that when they get dirt inside or out just hose them, let dry and they are ready for another day in the yard!

These are really cute, and I am going to try carefully heating them with a heat gun while having  a foot stretcher inside to see if I can increase the top of the foot shape.  It is quite low (for me, I do have high arches).  It is snug enough that your foot might fall asleep or get cramps from the circulation being cut off!  But the width is nice and wide - since I have wide feet they may be a bit big for a normal B width foot.  The tops fit a lot like Nike sports shoes - I cannot wear those either for the tops are so flat that my foot's circulation gets cut off.  The design is for flat footed feet - so are these little rain shoes.  But the floral designs are very fun and actually look great in the plastic finish!  There is a nice cushion pad in the bottom so that you really could walk around in them all day - so great for those really inclement weather days in the spring or summer!
summary: Really Cute but  snug over the top of foot

reviewText: This was a gift purchase for a friend and she was happy with the garden shoe. They have held up real nice.
I wear an 8-1/2W in regular shoes. I ordered the 8 and they do not slip nor are they to tight.

Just what I needed, a comfortable waterproof shoe. I use them for watering my garden but they are also nice enough to wear to our local restaurant (when it's wet outside).Very Satisfied. Also my one shoe got wet inside after I left them out in the rain and it dried without any problems.I'm Happy !!

The shoes are perfect for working in the yard and garden.  They are very comfortable and fit perfectly.They are everything I was looking for.  The only thing I would have liked would have been a lower price.

great slip on for a quick run to the mail box or doing something quick. no support so when worn for any length of time feet begin to hurt. No breath ability so feet sweat as well when worn for lengthy times. going to try to put in an insert and see if that helps with the lack of support. love the colors. item arrived quick and on time.

I bought these shoes for my mom and she loves them.  She said they are very comfortable, fit true-to-size and helps to make her more stable while working in the yard.  She recommends them to anyone looking for a great garden shoe.
Perfect for rainy or damp places. My pup, my Sloggers and I hike through the park every day here in Tacoma.

Let's start with the cons... They're heavy. They slide up and down on my heel, though I bought my exact shoe size (a half size smaller might've been better, if half sizes were offered).The pattern/design colors are not as bright as shown in the photo (bummer). Water does not go through the shoes, and sometimes I end up walking around in two sloshy pools (unless I take the Sloggers off and dump the water out, of course). They don't dry quickly either (good when the greenhouse is hot, bad when the weather's cold.)Now the pros... I'm doing seasonal work in a nursery/garden center, and these are far more comfortable than my Crocs. The support must be great, because I don't have any back or leg pain after walking in them all day. And they protect my feet from pain when stepping on stones...and I step on a lot of stones. The fact that water does not go through the shoes helps in the reverse...I can step in puddles without water leaking in (I just have to avoid my feet when watering the plants). The Midsummer pattern/design is fun and well-suited to my job environment. The insoles are removabable and replaceable. I can wash everything, both shoes and insoles, in the washing machine.Overall, I would definitely considering getting another pair of Sloggers. But in a brighter color this time. As long as the cost is low, like this pair was...along with free shipping.  :-)
summary: Not quite what I hoped they'd be, but I'm happy.

reviewText: I purchased these garden shoes for my mother on Mother's Day. She absolutely loved them! They are very comfortable, stylish, and affordable.

I couldn't believe these "Sloggers" are so well formed and protective when they cost so little.  They are super both for working in the garden and for wearing on rainy days to work.  The only thing I disagree about is their suitability for all-day wear.  They do not have enough support for that, but for several hours at a time,  they are tops.

I don't wear them often but I am not dissatisfied when I do.  They are cute, keep my feet clean, are a snap to clean, live happily in the garage, and are comfortable.  When I do wear them I tend to forget they're on my feet; they aren't welcomed in the house unless they've had a bath.  I'm Happy !

I love having garden clogs that wash off easily and dry quickly.  I'm less tempted now to go out in my good shoes, something I often do in my excitement to get out and "just do one quick thing in the garden."
summary: A little wide, but does the trick

reviewText: Choose item because its made in America and was looking for rain boots also.Love the shine...and slip on effect.
summary: They are even good for taking long walks,  very comfortable and fit perfect.

reviewText: The fit is just right and they are nice and flexible (for when you are kneeling on the ground to work in the garden.  They are also ideal to slip on for dashing out to walk the dog when it's raining hard. No muss, no fuss (and the added benefit of being able to resist the mud-stains that inevitably ensue when your big labrador retriever gets excited and steps all over your feet when out on the aforementioned walk)

These offer the foot much protection, together with the sturdy ribbed bottom and the very supportive removable innersole. The soft edging makes sipping them on and off a real plus- great for a quick walk with the dog! The only problem? They are almost too cute to slop up!But clean up is a breeze. A true find- reasonably priced and a very superior made in the USA product!
summary: The perfectly cute, slogging around outside shoe!

reviewText: I bought these rain shoes for me.The Rain shoes are shiny and comfortable.  They have a nice tread on them.
Great quality and construction of this garden shoe.  Fun designs and colors to choose from.  However, the shoe is very heavy and uncomfortable for long days of garden work.

I LOVE these shoes and you can't beat the price. I buy most of my shoes on line because I wear a 10 Wide. I usually have to return most of them. When my Sloggers arrived I put them on and wore them the rest of the day. They are the most comfortable shoes I have ever owned. I live in them. They are great for rain and gardening or just wearing as a daytime shoe. When they get dirty I just take out the in sole and hose them off and they look brand new. I am going to order another pair. I got the black ones with white polka dots. I have gotten lots of compliments and many of my friends are now ordering them. I highly recommend the Sloggers.

This is a great shoe for walking, gardening, etc.  Better looking than most tennis shoes but equally as comfortable.  These shoes are really easy to clean and the slip on feature is great.  I bought two different colors and have fun wearing them

I bought these for my daughter who absolutely loves them. She doesn't drive and does a lot of walking, to and from bus stops etc. On rainy days they keep her feet warm and comfy and dry. She wears them at least once a week now that we are in our rainy season and they are holding up beautifully! They look nice with jeans and she's received many compliments on them! I'll be buying a pair for myself!
summary: Best pair of rain shoes ever!

reviewText: I bought these because I needed waterproof footwear. I work at a dog grooming salon and my feet would be soaking wet. I bought some boots but they were heavy and would wear me down. I bought these because they received good reviews.-I have to agree with them. They are comfy and I don't mind wearing them all day. They keep my feet dry and are easy to slip on and off.Edit:  My feet do get wet a few times since they aren't as high as boots. (It helps to wear long pants to cover the opening) I am very satisfied with them though. As I mentioned before I prefer them over boots, and over regular tennis shoes.

These shoes are even cuter in person.  I felt like a fisherman, describing the one that got away -- I loved them THIS MUCH -- but that just about how wide they were on my feet.  Just couldn"t keep them on.
summary: Too Much of A Good Thing

reviewText: Absolutely love these will be buy a second pair just to have. Cheaper than mucks but just as good and look adorable too. I use them to garden, cut grass go to baseball fields and rain and snow. Would recommend you buy them.
Love the shoes as they fit great, look great and are so comfortable. Very happy with the purchase and highly recommend these to anyone looking for a shoe to garden in!
Bought a second pair. One for in the house and one for outdoors! Would recommend to anyone. Good buy for the cost.

Very comfortable well made shoes. I have wide feet due to bunions and these are very flexible and don't bother it. The cost of the shoe is quite reasonable.  I spent 4x more on another popular brand and had to send them back.

The Sloggers is a great product, but the sizing is off. I ordered a size 9, which I have always ordered.There should have been something noted regarding the sizing. I will have to return these for a smaller size as they are way too long and wide. Returns are not always easy w/ Amazon when one needs to speak to a real person.  I also did not get a shipping invoice or return label. I have always been satisfied w/ Amazon, just wish they made it easier to speak to a customer service "person".
Love my sloggers! I wear them every day, rain or shine! They are super comfy and if they get dirty, they wipe clean easily. Great purchase!

These shoes are great for the garden. Easy to put on and take off. They are easy to cleans and have sole that  grips really well. My foot is 6 1/2, so I bought size 7 and and insert. the shoes are still a little too big but stay on with no problem.
Love the rain clogs . They are extremely comfortable ( true to size ) and the pattern is  very attractive , even more so than than the photo . Will want to try other items in this shoe line .

I wish I had gotten these years ago. I didn't realize what I was missing. They are a great fit ( I wear a size 8) with or without socks. My yard/garden gets wet and muddy, no problem when you have these sloggers on! I also have 4 dogs--  an accidentual step in the wrong place,well these shoes are like new after a rinse with the hose. I went to the garden center and looked down, had on my sloggers! They are that comfortable! Thinking about getting an other pair in a different color/ pattern, I like them that much.
Love Sloggers, no sizing information!!!! I got the wrong size and it cost me $13.00 to ship them and get the right size. So much for my good deal~~disappointing.
They fit great and are comfortable all day. Make a great rain shoe for going to the store or working in the yard.

I would like to see these come in half sizes, but if I put on thick socks they work fine.  I purchased these so when I take the dogs out in the rain my feet don't get wet.  They work perfect for that.  The treads keep me from slipping and my feet say warm and dry.  They will get lots of use. They are comfortable and seem to be well made, and there are a lot of patterns to choose from.
The way the  print is layed out on the shoes makes them look like two different shoes!  One shoe looks yellow, the other dark blue.

These are attractive, to be sure, but I have the same complaint as several others.  The back of the heel is too low and the shoe easily slips off at the back.  Had to return... Would like to see the company re-design this shoe...
love it

I ordered these for my wife, an avid gardener because it is always wet and slipperly where she works. They performed far better than we expected. Quality was better than shoes we looked at for 3X the price. One of the few gifts my wife keeps complementing.

These will be great for my springtime cleanup in the yard once the  snow melts. With two dogs, I think you know what I'm talking about !!  The crocs have holes and sneakers are harder to rinse off.  I am a size 7.5 and so, ordered an 8. They fit fine for the purpose I need but I would've liked a half size smaller, I think. I would not be able to wear them walking around sightseeing...kind of loose for that purpose, but okay for the yard,rainy days,etc. They aren't bad looking (husband didn't complain about the looks of them like he does about crocs) and the best thing: Made in the USA! I wish I could buy everything made here.

My friend bought a pair of these for me along with some garden tools and gloves.  I wore these shoes outside for pulling weeds, watering the grass, washing the car and my feet stayed dry.  They are comfortable but because I have a narrow foot I put some rubber sole / inserts in mine.  They provided more "cush" and I found them great for wearing to the grocery store or Post Office.  Quick to slip on and off and I had no problem driving in them.  I am going to order their Flings (thongs) next and give those a try.  I consider them a great value and they are fun to wear - they make gardening a little more special.

I usually wear a 6 1/2, but for gardening shoes I like to order up a half size, because I garden in winter too, so I can wear woolen socks.I wore these all day, and had woolen socks on. It must be said that these shoes don't make your feet smell like Gouda/ plastic/ rubber.They are very comfortable, they have a thick in-sole.I have bought other brands before, but they were hard under my feet and they made my feet smell like something out of a sci-fi movie.As a very avid gardener, I totally recommend these. My feet didn't hurt at the end of a long day in the garden, they are completely waterproof, they come off easily, they have great tracking for muddy land.They stay on your feet and don't slip off.If you have to get inside and outside quite often, these are the way to go, as boots are harder to kick off in under a second.And for this price, I wouldn't hesitate either!

I was looking for something more water resistant than sneakers but not quite as hearty as hiking boots for outdoor gardening.  These slip on an off easily, and my feet never get wet.  all day comfort is true - I don't even realize I am wearing them.  If you are looking for a solid gardening shoe, this will do the trick.
They do keep the water out, and they are super cute...but they created horrible horrible blisters, in some weird places!
I do a lot of gardening...These are the perfect shoes, fits great and the dirt washes right off. A must buy for any gardener.

Love, love, love these garden shoes!  Not to mention, their made in the good old USA! :)  The shoes run a little large, I wear a 6 1/2 woman's shoe....and ended up buying a size 6, (which fits PERFECT).I'm so happy with these garden shoes!  Thank you!

Love these shoes.  They are great for when I'm working in my garden and doing yard work.  I have two pair now and keep one at each entrance for when I need to run outside quickly because they are easy to slip on.  Also like that you can take the insole out and clean the entire shoe with a garden hose.  Great shoes!

Perfect fit, don't know why I haven't bought these in the past.  I keep them outside and slip them on when I work in the yard.  There so comfortable and well made.  Sometimes I forget I'm wearing them and walk through the house.  Just wipe off and there like the day you bought them.  Still comfortable without socks but don't slide on as easy.  Wish there was a tab at the top of the heel.

I was so excited about getting these for the garden and doing errands.  Unfortunately, they slip off the back of the heel, so I had to return them.  One would not think they would do this, as the heel looks high enough, but every step resulted in this.  I am very disappointed as they had received such high recommendations.
Heavy, clumsy and ill-fitting  These shoes went right back. What more is there to say. Just not for me. Blah blah.
I enjoy my sloggers so much, I have recommended them to other garden friends.  I particularly like the floral print.

I always have to buy wide shoes, so I was a bit worried whether or not these would fit. However, they fit my size 10-wide feet perfectly, and are very comfortable. The mud and muck doesn't cling, so I am able to wipe them off very effectively. Highly recommend them!
This is my fourth pair of Sloggers. They are so comfortable and great for gardening as well as for rain and snow.

Just bought these in anticipation of slogging through the fairgrounds at New Orleans JazzFest. Last year was envious of the locals with their waterproof boots walking right up to the foodstands without their feet  getting caked in muck! It always rains a couple of the days at the Fest so this year I'm prepared!. A little lower on the ankle then I expected.  Comfortable with wearing around the house so I think I'll be able to walk the 8 or so blocks to the fairgrounds in the pouring rain with some comfort. Bought a half size up per other recommendations. I usually wear an 8 or 8 . Slightly big in the heel but fits in the front without pinching my toes. Wearing it around the house with thin socks comfortable. Would not be able to run, however (ie for cover). If bothersome a larger insole might work. Bought the shoe style because  it's usually warm during JazzFest and I don't want my feet to get too hot. Plus easier to pack.  Love the color/design! wish Sloggers came in half sizes!!
I love my shoes.  Great comfort.  Nice look.  They are just hard to find in the area and was not sure of size.  But turned out to be my favorite Dog walking shoes

My daughter and I wear these shoes daily working in our poultry operation.  They are comfortable all day, clean up easily and well.  I would recommed this product to anyone who needs dry feet and easy clean up.
I am very happy with these shoes.  Perfect fit- I wear a size 7, bought a size 7.  Very comfortable and pretty too.
Grabs sidewalk & street well when it rains . No slipping. Needed a little heavier sock as a little loose in the heel  other wise fits fine.

I just got these and have only worn them a few days.  It would have been nice to have the 1/2 size option, but for the company I can see where it might not be economically practice.  I wear them all day when I'm outside; I actually forget I have them on, they are so comfortable. I plan to buy another pair,  and will  also look to see if there is a size and or style/color my husband would wear.  We both do lots of gardening.  They do collect a bit of mud in the grooves, but all shoes do that. It's that time of year in NY.  I take them off before I come in the house.Update: I've worn these every day since I received them for gardening.  They are awesome!  Haven't had any issues so far!

These shoes are so cute and very comfortable.  Great for dog walking (no more grassed stained sneakers) and yard work.  I have lots of issues with my feet and can wear these all day with no discomfort.  Order usual size.  So happy that they are made in the USA.

These shoes are alittle bit big ,which I expected, because they didn't offer 1/2 sizes. However, I really like the ease of wear while working in the garden, especially when they get muddy, just rinse them off and they're good as new!
This is the best garden shoe that I've ever had. Fits comfortably and is very durable. Can't go wrong with this brand!

Bought this for my mom for Mother's Day and she's been wearing it every day since.I was concerned that being made out of rubber, these would be too heavy for my mom who is 65 and gardens for hours at a time daily but I needn't have worried. The shoes are padded inside and around the top so her feet are cushioned.She barely notices the weight and just loves that her feet are dry after watering all her plants. After  a quick hose down of the shoes, they look good as new. Highly recommended!

I absolutely love them...They are extremely comfortable, keep my feet dry in the early morning dew, while gardening.  And, I can even wear them while mowing my large lawn without getting sort feet.I did go down a half-size, and may have done well with a full-size down, as they do tend to run large.  I kept the larger size thinking I'd need heavy sox in the early spring, but that hasn't been the case.  They are really roomy in the toebox, which hasn't turned out to be an issue for me, since the stretch band seems to do the job of keeping them on.
I found these garden shoes to be very comfy and very pretty. They fit good and clean up real nice.

I have owned a pair for gardening for several years.They never lose their colorful look.I bought an additional pair for walking my dog on the golf course.They are ideal to go through the grassy areas in the morning after everything has been watered down.My feet stay dry and they are very comfortable!I used to wear old sneakers but they got nasty and smelly very fast.The Sloggers are wonderful and I find them quite stylish.
I liked these but chose the ankle high booties.  Fit perfectly and very comfortable besides being extra cute.  Comfort insoles are wonderful.
I really liked this shoes so i don't have to buy the long boots.  The only problem that I found was that the inside sole is not going to the front all the way and it feels strange.
summary: Great acquisition instead of the rain boots

reviewText: These are great shoes for going out or gardening. Super comfortable and very well made. Just love them! Awesome design!

What more could I want? Comfort and these fill that bill too! Every morning when I take my puppy out in the spring, summer and fall, these are my go to shoes to wear. Great for digging in the flower gardens too! Just rinse and go-the shoes are clean!

I love my Sloggers! No more boring or ugly garden boots for me. I first saw Sloggers on a home shopping network for a higher price AND you had to pay shipping charges- more than I wanted to pay. Then I found them on Amazon for a lower price plus free shipping. Sloggers are not only stylish, but easy to slip on and light weight foot wear. Very comfortable for wearing not only around the yard, but I've also used them as rain boots while out shopping during inclemate weather.
She just loves to put on her Sloggers and go out side and work in the yard , and then she pulls them off and washes them down with the hose and they are good..
Fit perfectly. Made in America. Fun design. Comfy. Easy to slide on. All around great work shoe. What more could you want?!

The quality is good but I need to wear socks so they don't slip so much on my feet. I usually wear a 9 1/2 or 10. I ordered a 10 and my toe goes right to the end. I'll keep them, but I wish they were a tiny bit longer.
Love the shoes.  Saves my regular shoes and these can be hosed off.  Great for the garden.  Would recommend to anyone.
Bought these for working in yard/garden.  Great waterproof shoe.  Comfy and fit good.  Easy slip on and off.  Love 'em.
I like them a lot and they pit perfectly.  I live in Seattle so I need they a lot.  I use them a lot.
This is a very comfortable shoe and it does the job of keeping my feet dry when it is wet out. It is soft and comfy!

Do not like the material at all... this shoe is nothing like the other Slogger's I have...  I picked this Slogger because of color and design which I like... but do not like the plastic type of shoe material... not as sturdy as the others that I have that I have bought from local hardware stores....
summary: Sloggers Women's Rain and Garden Shoe

reviewText: Extremely small fit.  Also very thin.  Wanted a shoe to wear during rainy weather in Georgia, but too small and too flimsy for all around wear.

These are perfect! They are waterproof with a nice, soft lining. I bout a 1/2 size up from my typical size. With athletic socks, they fit perfect. My heel does not slip out. These kind of fit like Dansko scrub shoes.Your feet won't breathe well in them b/c they are waterproof. I bought these not for gardening, but as a rain "shoe" instead of a boot. They hold up well to puddles. Great buy, great price!
These shoes a great for rainy days, even snow. They easily wipe clean. Got a lot of good comments on them too.
Really good for yard work, cleaning the coop. Very comfortable. Very easy to clean. I highly recommend these shoes. I use them every day.

The shoes seem to run slightly larger than my shoe size(7 1/2) but I ordered the insert and they fit well now. I love the comfort and convenience of being able to wash them off after working in the yard and garden. Great selections of patterns and colors.

I love these shoes! They are perfect for the yard, taking the dogs out, getting the mail, working in the garden.  They rinse off with water and are attractive enough to wear to the store.  The are comfortable too.

These replaced a pair of Muck Boot clogs that I'd worn (heavily) for at least 10 years.  I got them in lieu of another pair of Muck Boots for two reasons:  the reviews were good and the cost was about half that of Muck Boots.  Surprisingly, they are more comfortable than the Muck Boots and keep my feet just as dry.  The size 8, my usual size, fits perfectly, even with thick socks.My only issue is the shoe does not come up as high on the back of my heel, but I will probably get used to over time.  This is the only reason I gave 4 stars instead of 5.  I wanted a plain brown color, which is not offered, but like the bright pattern I chose much better than I expected..It remains to be seen if they last as long as the Muck Boots.  At half the price, I'll be content if I get 5 years.
I have worn these shoes in Europe, Mexico and at home.  They keep my feet warm and dry and are very comfortable.
Love the colors, goes on and off easily, very comfortable . Wish it had been a bit taller, pant cuffs get wet sometimes

I got these clogs for gardening, short dog walks, and muddy treks around my yard. The fun, bright print caught my eye and, before I knew it, these were on my doorstep.I was pleasantly surprised by the construction of these shoes (made in USA!). The nylon fabric around the ankle area and the "comfort insole" add a degree of unexpected comfort.DO NOT expect these shoes to breathe or be great for rugged terrain: they are essentially rainboot-style shoes afterall.DO expect them to keep your feet from getting wet in moist conditions.Do expect to get a lot of compliments when you wear them out.

Very nice quality.  These are works of art that will make the business of gardening a little more fun and lots more clean.  The shoe is totally immersible once you take the inner sole out so cleanup is easy.The colors are divine....I had way more trouble deciding on the color/pattern to order than deciding on the type of garden shoes I wanted.I recommend these shoes to all gardeners -- and even non-gardeners who just want waterproof shoes to gad about town in,
I chose the sloggers because I don't like  the tall rubber boots,too hot. These are perfect,and they're fashionable. Thanks a lot.
I like these shoes for the summer, they are wide and fit a little loose in the heel, but it will serve the purpose for the summer
I gave this as a gift to my daughter for gardening. Sh loved the.  Wears them to soccer games or just whenever outside. She says the are very comfortable.

First time I put these on, they felt too snug. Second time, same thing. Maybe my feet have shrunk but now they're so comfortable, I took my dog into the woods and didn't realize I had them on. I bought them for gardening and it's great to keep them outside where I can slip them on before venturing into wet grass or muddy flower beds. And they are really cute.
summary: Didn't think I could wear them

reviewText: I would give it 5 stars for cuteness, 1 stars for comfort and use as a serious garden shoe.  If you want a waterproof shoe for running around and don't need a lot of support or just for very light gardening, these would be ok.  BUT, if you need support or are a serious gardener, these just don't cut it.  I hated to send them  back as they are the cutest little shoes, but if you can't wear them, what's the point?Need really good garden shoes-it has to be Jolly's.  Clunky, ugly, but great support and you can wear them for ever.  They are serious garden shoes.

I was looking for easy on easy off garden shoe that keeps my feet clean and these fit the bill. I should have chosen a lighter color as the black can heat up if I am standing in the sun. I also would have liked the back of the clog to be a bit higher, however they don't seem to fall off and they are easy to pull on and off.

reviewerName: Criss Ittermann "The Crisses / Rev. Criss Itt...
reviewText: I bought these for rainy and dewy mornings but now I wear them both around the yard while taking care of my chickens and sometimes forget I'm wearing them and go out to professional networking events while wearing them.  I've even gotten compliments on my Sloggers!  I can't wait to order another pair.  They're pretty, comfortable as all-that, and worn with cotton socks I can get away with wearing them for hours and hours.  As someone else said, fashionable to go to the supermarket -- but even better they're comfortable enough to wear all day.  Don't breathe well enough to wear in really hot weather for long, but that's because they're waterproof! :)  Great fall & spring and rainy summer wear, grippy enough soles to wear on icy winter mornings if you wanted (but be careful as always!).

I wear 8s and ordered 8s. The sizes definitely run large by about half a size. I put on a super thick hiking sock and the shoes were still loose. The insole seems fine and comfortable, but it is removable and there is nothing inside the shoe when that is removed. At the heel there is an open plastic grid. Hence the insole squeaks inside the shoe. I am contemplating whether to keep them because of this. The brightness of the white polka dots on black isn't as pronounced as online, it is almost gray. The outside looks well made, but of course haven't worn these outside yet to see if they actually stay dry.
I bought these for my daughter because she kept stealing mine (same brand), she loves them! They keep your feet dry on rainy days, but don't make your feet sweat like some other brands do.
They have a nice sole. I expect them to last a long time. The back is a good height high enough to keep my socks dry walking though the wet grass but low enough to be easy off.

These shoes fit great. They are a little loose with normal socks, but fit perfect with heavy socks. I'd say the sizing runs a little bit big, but not by much. Half sizes would be great! These shoes are awesome. They are the perfect slip ons to wear when walking the dogs, whether for a quick potty walk or on a long walk at the park. I can slog through wet grass without my feet getting soaked, which, after all, was the point of buying them. So far, they seem to be holding up well. We'll see if they survive an Oregon winter!
We have had a really horrible winter and these shoes come in handy when all that snow starts to melt.

I ordered two sizes of these beautiful sloggers (8 and 9 -- size 8 is my normal size).  Unfortunately, neither one of them fit with the 8 being REALLY small and the 9 being REALLY large.  I think I needed an 8 1/2.  My opinion is that these don't run true to size, so be aware of that when you order.
I needed something I could easily slip on to go out to our chicken coop and garden.  Great traction and great to walk through wet grass.
On dewy mornings or after a light rain.  Presentable enough for wearing in public.  I'm toying with the idea of ordering a second pair.

I have short, wide feet.  I usually order a 7 wide and was a little concerned when these weren't available in a wide width.  They are very comfortable either with or without socks and my toes have plenty of room.  I love being able to walk in the early morning wet grass and doing my gardening without my feet getting wet.
Cute shoes.  Iam a Home care RN and these will be perfect for rainy days. Everyone that sees them loves them.

I received my shoes within one day. That was Great.The shoes fit perfect. I usually wear size 8 to 81/2 in tennis shoes. I read some of the reviews and almost bought a size 9. I am SO glad I stuck with the eight. The slogger fits perfect. If you do wear a 8 1/2 you will have to choose a somewhat snug fit with an eight or consider socks with a size 9, since these shoes do not run in half sizes. I hope this helps you choosing a size that is right for you.

These are perfect for working in the yard and garden. No more dew soaked feet. The dirt sprays off easily. They are bright and cheerful on a rainy day. The soles have a good grip on slippery surfaces. They slip on easily.

The sloggers are great shoes to wear while walking the dog in the rain.  They are comfortable to wear and easy to get on especially in the dark when the dog is jumping all around wanting to go out.  I would really recommend this product to anyone who needs a good water proof shoe that has good tread on the bottom so you won't slip when it is wet or muddy outside.
summary: Sloggers a great walking shoe in the rain.

reviewText: I love these rain shoes. They feel like a comfortable sneaker and of course are waterproof. I take a size 6 and they fit great.

So this shoe on a friend who was gardening. It's washable and I decided to use it in the medical fiend. Well, what a big welcome my associates have had for a comfortable shoe that will add some pazazz to our uniforms. Some of my co-workers got on line and already bough a pair. I'm sure I'll be ordering many more---two so far. Very very comfortable and a life time warrenty to boot or should I say shoe. deb g.

reviewText: I love these shoes.  No more tracking in mud on my sneakers.  Easy to wash, too.  Need a pair to leave at every door, though.
Shoes were purchased to wear taking dog out, keeps my feet dry and are easy on and off, very happy with them.
they are beautiful.I needed a 9 and a half and dont remember if  they had any half sizes. Will  order these type of shoes again-very comfy !!!!!

I ordered these to wear in a medical office, they are not only fashionable, but comfortable right out of the box.  I will order another pair for my mother!

I got these garden shoes as a Christmas gift for a person I had no idea what to get for them and they had seen my garden shoes and said they liked them.  I actually wear mine as shoes when it is rainy and muddy out.
summary: A great idea for a Christmas gift

reviewText: OK, so my wife got these shoes today and she is very happy with them.  She normally wears size 6 in wide but because they don't come in wide we ordered her size 7 and that was the right thing to do because her instep is wide and would not fit in size 6.  THe shoe is slightly bigger in the front for her but with a sock it fits great and having a little room for toes is good too.

I bought these with no previous knowledge about the brand to replace my Muckers.  LOVE them, they have a nice arch and are very CUTE.  Wore them to physical therapy the other day and my therapist loved them.  He even asked where I purchased them and wrote the name down to order some too.

I purchased these shoes because in my job I work at a nursery and water lots of plants.  These keep my feet dry and no more wet sneakers & socks.  The only issue, is of course they are plastic/rubber and your feet do sweat.  I like them and would buy them again.  The color selection is great too.

These are great.  They are high enough in back to keep out the dirt that the lower styled back lets in. They are easy to slip on and off.  I get a lot of compliments on the style, color and design as well.

I was looking for a pair of garden shoes, ones that were easy to slip on and off as well as clean, and these caught my eye.  I wear a 7 1/2, and after reading a lot of the reviews, I decided to order a size down (7) instead of a size up as recommended.  I am so glad that I did, they are a perfect fit.  I can wear them with thin socks or without socks.  The toe area is roomy so my toes have wiggle room and are not cramped.One thing to note...as one reviewer wrote, the back is not as high as a normal shoe and does slip out like wearing a pair of backless clogs.  The nice thing though is that the backs are soft enough that it doesn't cause blisters.I don't plan to wear these shoes around town but will definitely wear them on rainy days.  My yard and driveway are dirt and gravel; considering getting another pair to keep by the basement door.Forgot to mention...these shoes are great for HIGH ARCHES!This review was written by DARLENE, not my husband Mark.

reviewText: Very comfortable and so nice for rainy Oregon weather and working in the garden.  I have recommended to many friends.

My daughter and I each have these and we love them.  Easy to get on and off and perfect for working out in the yard and in the chicken coop.  Cute too!  I wear a 7 1/2 and got these in an 8.  This is my second pair and I will get more when these wear out.

I use these for walking around and working in the yard but sometimes find myself wearing them in the house too (after rinsing them of course).  I had seen them at a garden store where they were $35 and decided to look for them on Amazon.  Sure enough, there they were for much less!  Great purchase!
Great fit - fast delivery. I'm very happy with them. Now I have some waterproof shoes to wear to the dog park!

reviewText: We thought that size 8 rain and garden shoes (with the insoles) would comfortably fit my wife's size 7 1/2 feet...but these are ALMOST too tight. I was ready to return them but she says she'll make 'em work. We'll see.

reviewText: These shoes are great, not only are they stylish they are durable.  Gardening does't have to be drab when you can add a little color in your garden attire.  Love them.
