reviewText: The quality of the shoes is excellent, as is their attractive appearance. These Sloggers are well constructed and sit well on the foot. They seem very sturdy, although no rain has fallen here yet. Best of all, they arrived very promptly, just as my garden work was beginning in earnest.

Previous reviews said it ran narrow, but these shoes are really tooooo wide for my foot.  I wear a 9 - 2A (width).  My foot slides around in this shoe and my heel slides out easily as well.  I took the insoles out of a pair of old sneakers and put them inside theses shoes on top of the sloggers insole and that has helped a lot.  The sole of this shoe is too  "spongy" to be able to use it digging in the clay soil that I have here.  The black band around the top of the shoe does not fit snuggly on my foot and things like mulch & dirt can get inside this shoe.  The shoes are waterproof and I have hosed them off several times so that is a plus.

I had been looking at these for months and finally purchased them. They fit well and are true to size. They are comfortable and my co-workers love the design. I needed a touch of spring and these fit the bill. Walking in the rain is a little more fun now.

I bought a more expensive pair a couple of years ago and they were uncomfortable. Purchased these a size smaller than my regular shoe size and they are perfect. Very comfortable. Not too hot.  The neck of the shoe is tight so none of the dirt I am throwing around gets in the shoe.  Where light sock with them. Got them wet in the lake and within a couple of hours they were dry again. great value and shoe.

I love these shoes when it comes to taking out the dog or running errands in downpours! The fit wasn't great but I bought a pair of insoles and now they fit much better. I wouldn't run a marathon in them but a trip around town in them keeps your feet dry.
fits well, easy to get on,comfortable, and the price was right. Perfect for all my garden tasks, and look good for outings in the rain.Easy to clean.
Received these shoes when expected and am so happy with them.  They are very comfortable and so pretty, fun to wear when I have to stop my garden work and go to the hardware store.
They're really comfortable and cute. I wear them way more than I thought I would and they go with practically everything!

I step into these Sloggers every time I go outside as I am generally on the way to the garden or chicken house or horse field.  So I no longer track muck into the house.  They are comfortable and do the job - and look cute besides. Love 'em.

my husband brought a pair home to me, and I liked them so much I wore them all day. When this pair came in the mail, I had my daughter try them, and she looked at me hopefully. I LOVE these shiny, shiny, rain shoes.  They look good and work well.  I can wear them all day if I want because they have a fabric lining.

Fit great and comfortable! I love these shoes, I wear them all the time! I would consider buying another pair just for another print because there are so many to choose from.

I absolutely LOVE these shoes!!! They are so comfortable. I have a high arch & they fit so good. The only complaint I have is they get so HOT in the summer. That will be a plus in the winter. I will consider the boots in the winter. Have a blessed & peaceful summer.Sincerely,Deborah B Sandridgedbs

They are great !! - much better than the previous pair I had from Gardeners' Supply- a flatter and more stable heel and a little give around the shoe opening. I know where to go next time I need another pair and will recommend these to friends/family

I highly recommend these.
Used to just wear slippers=dirty feetThese are great and I can wash them off each time I wear them
These garden shoes are great for the rain and for muddy conditions.  They rinse off easily.  The fit is slightly big.

I was looking for a garden shoe.  These were a good choice.  The back is a bit loose but not to the point of any problems.  They are a good fit and for the price are great.
I use these when I am cleaning out the chicken pen.  They clean off well and keepmy feet dry.  The size was a true fit.
Quality,comfort, and very reasonable...great styles to choose from. They are exactly what I wanted... I wear a 6.5 shoe and ordered a 7 and they fit fine....

reviewText: I bought these for my sister who is a nurse. she is on her feet 12 hours a day. Someone told her about these shoes and how comfortable they are. She is thrilled with them. She cannot believe how much better her feet feel.
I need to return these.  They are nice, but a bit too big for me and not really my style.
Comfortable, quirky looking.  I can hose them off, let them dry, and put them back on.  Perfect for what I needed.

I've been searching for reasonably priced garden shoes but was not willing to pay $40 for a pair.  I ran across these shoes in Amazon and the price was twenty dollars less.  Nice shoe bed, keeps my feet warm and dry and oh so comfortable.So if you are looking for a good garden shoe, this is the one!!!!

reviewText: I'm very happy with my Sloggers Garden Shoes! They are a half size larger than my actual shoe size and are a little loose. From other reviews, I was expecting this. These are great for any use around the house, gardening, camping, rainy day, any time you don't want to get your feet wet/muddy.  Comfortable and durable.  I will always have at least two pairs for as long as they make these (one for home and one for the camper).  Always get comments on them too on how nice they appear and that they are cute.

reviewText: The Sloggers are true to size and attractive. They are very comfortable, and I can't wait to try them out in my garden this summer.
I never write reviews but made an exception for this product. They are lightweight and waterproof. My other clogs were slip ons and water, dirt and debris would always get into the shoe.

The support these provide is very nice and I love that you can remov!e the inner sole to wash it or replace it.  My husband has a pair and he loves them, too
These are really cute shoes! Fit true to size right out of the box. So comfortable! Highly recommend! Will keep!
Just right to slip on when I run out for a walk with my dogs.  Exactly what I was looking for!

These Sloggers are awesome! Just what I was looking for. Comfortable, inexpensive and American made. Can't beat that combination. Everyone is asking about them and I'm sure they'll be a hit. Love, love, love them and I'm fussy!

Got a pair for myself and bought a pair for my Mom and we just love them.  They are safe outside as they do not slip on pavers, etc.  We do a lot of yard work and they are just fabulous!

These are the best gardening shoes I have ever owned! They are comfortable and attractive. When dirty, I just hose them off.

I am a teacher and I will often wear the shoes to school. The kids love them.  I'm on my feet all day and I'm happy to be wearing the Sloggers.  In terms of sizing, I bought my size and they fit.

I like my Sloggers, and would absolutely LOVE THEM, if they weren't so BIG!  After reading a bunch of reviews of this product, I bought up a bit because that was what most said.  Well, they are REALLY BIG, so I need to be careful walking about the yard. If I'm doing a LOT of work outdoors, I'll put on sneakers, and these will work well for wet stuff.  But I slide all around in them and they come off, of course, easy. But I don't want to twist my ankle!  Nothing wrong with the shoes, but I think had I bought a size smaller they would have been perfect!

I bought these hoping they would be good for my work as a dog groomer. Getting my shoes wet has been a constant problem. I am able to put my orthotics in them, after removing the insole. The heel does slip a bit, but this does not bother me. My feet do sweat a bit (I wear socks), but overall, they are working out very well, and there are many 'looks' to choose from, also made in the USA.
These are great for walking in the rain, doing yard chores, and keep my feet completely dry. I think they must run a little narrow as I have very narrow feet and these fit fine.

These are more supple than any other garden shoe I have ever had.  They also have a nice cushioning innersole. I am going to get the higher boot also, to use  when walking my dogs in the higher grass. I currently use a Croc muck style boot but they are so stiff compared to the Sloggers.
These are the most comfortable shoes I have ever worn as someone who spends 12+ hours a nite walking in a hospital. The price can't be beat!

I bought these for working in the barn - cleaning horse stalls, sloshing big water buckets and the like. It's just too hot in the summer to wear traditional boots (at least for me). The Sloggers garden shoes are very comfortable around the house and they are indeed waterproof - that alone makes them a worthwhile purchase. They have a really cushy lining inside. I also like the tread on the bottom of the sole - solid enough to walk in mud and slippery ground without sliding around at all.The ONLY complaint I have and the reason I am leaving a four star rather than five star review is the heel & overall fit. I wear an 8 1/2 normally in sneakers and boots and 9 in high heels, so I ordered the size 9. I figured even if they were a tad wider than needed, socks would make up for the difference. They fit fine with regard to actual measurements. However, with every step the heel is very loose and feels like it's going to slide off my foot. They feel like those backless clogs instead of a solid fitting shoe. The height of the back of the shoe is lower than a traditional shoe and higher than a traditional clog. DROVE ME CRAZY for the first few days and now I've gotten used to it & it's fine. Just a warning though if you need the support of a regular back or heel, then these probably aren't for you.************************UPDATE Oct 2011*********************************************After wearing these Sloggers every single day since I bought them I am still very happy with them. They are indeed waterproof - I stepped in what turned out to be a deep puddle, immersing the shoes to the very top edge. No damage whatsoever inside or out. My foot was dry inside the shoe. I was concerned that every day use would stretch them at the ankle area or it would weaken etc - so far it's just like new. I will buy these Sloggers again in the future for sure!
summary: Very comfy interior linging, solid sole, short heel - UPDATED Oct 2011

Prompt service...good quality...will recommend to family & friends who garden as much as I do.  This is my first purchase from amazon.com.  Thank you.

reviewText: These are great for working out in the yard and wearing when raining, easy to slip into and comfortable to wear.

I LOVE these shoes!  I wear a size 9 1/2, sometimes 10 running shoe so I bought the size 10 slogger --- fits great, whether barefoot or with socks.  EXTREMELY comfortable.  Can even dig with shovels and feet are fine.  Clean up couldn't be easier.  Insole can be removed and washed, even replaced after long use.  Love the designs and colors available.

These were in my Amazon cart for the last month.I stopped by the little local feed store and they had these yesterday at  $33.99.Only two colors to choose from but I figured I would get a pr just to see how I like them and I can order other colors here.I tried them with thin black fuzzy rayon "dress" socks after sitting in a conference all day.My feet were prob as swollen as if I had been walking around.Most of my shoes are 9M. I have a some 9.5M ; no 8.5, 9N, 9W. 10. I bought size 9.They felt very comfie in the store-better than the lowThe Original MuckBoots Daily Garden ShoeI looked at as an alternative. The Muckboots have more room in the toebox and didn't seem to have as cushy foot suppot.When I got home and put them on with Smartwool hiking socks the fit was really snug everywhere.The arch is a little farther back then mine. I didn't notice it in the store but did when I walked around on hard floors at home. I don't feel it with hiking socks-I  am not sure how thin I can go with socks before I feel it. I have ~high arches and buy neutral non-pronating runneing shoes.I decided to change the Slogger insole for a Superfeet and 2 diff types of Dr Scholls insoles.All of them, as cut for my shoes/boots, are too long and too wide for Size 9 Sloggers.I will have to cut a new pr of insoles (~$15) to fit these; then they will be too short/narrow to use in my shoes :( (see below)So Size 9 runs more small and more narrow than my 9M shoes/boots; Size 10 was way too long for me in the store-I could stick my thumb between my toes and the end.I don't have foot problems re bunions, corns, etc but if you do these could be tough because they are narrow and won't give.They have been very comfie today and kept my feet warm during our 5th? 6th? ice storm of the winter.I have an ouchy knee. The Dr says to wear flatter more flexible shoes than my clogs and super cushioned thicker shoes. These are very flexible and the drop from heel to toe is not noticable.I am concerned how if I will be able to wear these this summer when feet are more hot and swollen after working outside.They are not as forgiving as my 20 yr old Jolly fashion garden clog with the large toe box and open back.If they are too small/hot for summer I guess I'll put them away until next fall.Added 1 wk later:The Slogger's insoles are very thin and wrap up around the foot from the arch to the heel. When removed, you have a solid footbed upfront but the heel is an open hard plastic grid of 1/2" cubes. It is too uncomfortable to stand in the shoe without some insole bec of the heel.I cut and triedDr. Scholl's Massaging Gel Insoles, Women's 6-10, 1 pair (Pack of 2).They are too thick (hard to believe) in the toe box with regular socks so my toes are cramped. I also openedDr. Scholl's For Her Insoles, 16 Hour, Women's Sizes 6-10 colors may varyThey are a slim 3/4 length design with a fabric top. I positon them in a good spot where I can't feel either the front or back. With snug fit in thick socks the 3/4 length insole keeps getting pushed arounfd.So I left the Slogger thin insoles in the shoe. I want something with more cushion can't think of another insole that my feet+socks+insole will fit. I useSuperfeet Green Premium Insolesin hiking boots and running shoes. They are awesome,~thin, stiff and have a unique shape. There are other thicknesses, each has its own color, and one might work.They are just too expensive for me to experiment with. The ~narrow heel will be a problem area to fit; I am not aware of a replacemnt insole with a trimmable heel.They have become my go-to shoes inside/out. I have had less joint pain in my bad knee(s) and hips sice wearing them.I have driven in them and they are very flexible and as easy to wear as if in normal shoes.The slick shiny top sheds anything that gets on it really easily. I stuck my feet under the downspout in the rain and things rinsed right off.The bottom is harder to clean than my smoother surfacedAlpro Synthetic-Clogs ''Jolly Fashion'' from Polyurethane in Green with a narrow insole. I have imbedded mud+yard debris in some of the lugs right now.They have been a life-saver through two more ice storms with 1-2" sleet, power outages, trips to woodpile, bird feeders, storm clean-up, glazed ice on deck/steps. If I walk cautiously on the early AM ice on my deck, these have the best grips of many of my boots.The tread cleans on my astro-turf or coir door mats.I have knee surgery soon and I have had less discomfort wearing these than in my Jolly Clogs.One cool feature-I am used to an open back. This heel bends flat and is thin enough that I can step on it so I have an open back. Works if I am in a hurry and don't want to take the time to put them on properly. I will let you know if it splits from me standing on it.I wore the bright summer turquise floral color under dark straight and boot cut pants. The sole is black so the color doesn't show. In wet wetaher I wore leggings and ankle length pants. I stopped to check on a neighbor after our storm/flash flood. I eyed a deep puddle in her drive that was inavoidable. These are cut higher than I perceived-I didn't get a shoe full of water.If only they were just a teeny bit bigger or had a half-size, they would be almost a perfect garden/yard/house shoes.I have not had any dog experience with these. I wrote in my Jolly clog review how great they are for dog duties. I am not sure how these will be re dogs stepping on my foot, the "oops!@#$%" pooper scooper yard clean-up or dog parks. I don't feel like these are as stable as my clogs for the 1-3 block dog walks. Perhaps someone else can coment.

They keep your feet dry when watering the grass and the traction on the bottom is awesome for when the cutting the lawn on the slope in my back yard. I would definitely recommend this shoe as well as purchase again for myself although next time I will know to go with my actual size as opposed to buying in a size larger based on previous reviews.
summary: Too big but I love 'em anyway!

reviewText: Shoes are waterproof and stylish and very comfortable. They are well made, fit true to size, seem durable and not the cheap plastic soles that I've seen on more expensive shoes. Thrilled that they're made in USA
They are comfortable and keep my feet dry :)  I can wear them with or without socks (heels do slip a little bit but it's not a problem).  They are cute too!
I was happy to get these , they fit perfectly and they are comfortable to wear , in the garden ,as well as, grocery shopping in the rain.

From the reviews of this shoe I couldn't tell if it would run true to size or not so I took a chance that it would and ordered my 'regular' size. Of course with shoes sometimes an 8-1/2 is my regular size and sometimes a 9-1/2 is. With this shoe there is some tightness in the toe because it needs to be about 1/4 inch longer. No doubt the size 10 would be falling off.I gave the shoe 5 stars because it is, in theory, the perfect shoe for working on my garden. I can't fault it for being a smidge too short to be as comfortable as I wish it to be.I might try stretching the toes and will update this review if I'm successful.UPDATE: I used a shoe stretcher to add a very slight bit of length to the shoes and they work well now. I'm very pleased with the purchase; I use them all the time when gardening. I think a 10 would have been way too big.
fast shipping, a bit pricey, but everything is. These are awesome for wearing in the yard while working...I highly recommend

being in a wet area i find this item wonderful--so much so i have a set at both major doors. great for running out to fill bird feeders, or to mail box on wet days [a lot!] fits well easy to put/on/off. comfortable, AND IT WORKS, yeah. This would work for gardening, a wonderful replacement for those hot gum boots in the summer. nice colors.
I looked far an wide for shoes that were waterproof AND comfortable, I have found them in Sloggers. I love them, they came fast, and were undamaged, enough said.

They run true to size and are really cute. I wear them around town and get lots of compliments. A teacher-friend of mine wears them to school! I thought they would be hot but they are really quite comfortable.

They are made of a quite flexible, stretchy plastic, so although I often have trouble with the ankle opening size of slip-ons, these were no trouble. If anything, the opening could have been smaller.  I normally wear an 8.5, but ordered a 9 based on the info. Wrong move. I walk out of them in normal socks, and even very thick socks don't quite make up the difference, and insoles don't really help much, either, as the thickness of the insoles raises my heel and exacerbates the 'walking-out' issue. (And add to the cost.) I should have gotten the size 8s, as the stretchiness of the plastic would likely have let them fit fine. Wish I hadn't worn these outdoors and made them non-exchangeable - they seemed OK until I tried them on mud and hills.I do like the flexibility of them, and the removable insole when it comes time to hose them off!
Fit isn't most comfortable. I find that I can't wear it long while gardening due to lack of support.  Also, my feet sweat if weather is warm.

My new Sloggers are great. Very comfortable, easy to clean, and keep my feet dry in wet grass and muck. Their design is quite stylish considering they are plastic shoes. People outside of my home admire them. My young teen son thinks they are hysterical and claims to be embarrassed when I wear them- AND YET he slips them on every chance he gets. (I'm trying to get a photo of that for the record.) I think he'd want his own pair if they didn't have flowers on them... maybe they should make some Man-Sloggers so the guys can have some fun too.
They are made well. They are  the most comfortable rain shoes ever. Would and have told all my frirnds as bout them.
I liked the color and the panseys. They are slip ons but have a back to them.  I have enjoyed them a lot  and they are very comfortable.
Good product for a reasonable price. very comfortable to wear and easy to slip on and off. I would recommend it.
summary: Sloggers women's rain and garden shoe

reviewText: I have received so many positive comments about my fun-looking shoes! Quality made, easy fit, I'd buy them again in a minute. I tend to have narrower feet, and I don't have a problem at all with these fitting comfortably. (BTW, I am female... it is not evident from my userid.)
These turned out to be surprisingly comfy and they don't make your feet stink which was my worry, but they're lined with fabric inside. Great for cement projects.
Not only do these Sloggers keep my feet dry and comfortable, but they are attractive shoes too. I'm no fan of boots, so these work perfectly for gardening or running around in the rain.

Bought these shoes for walking to class in the rain. I usually wear an 8.5 to 9 so I ordered the 9 and they fit perfectly. I love them and can't wait until it rains more! Plus they are made in the USA which is awesome!

So cute, so many compliments, so fun to jump in puddles. They're heavy and hot but I don't fault them for that as I feel that's the price of sturdy rubber. I also love my knee-high Little MisMatched boots but they're really hot so I keep those for when it's a bit cooler or if I'm going somewhere super wet and muddy. Love these! It's raining, will wear them today.

I wear these outside to garden, walk the dog and go to the store.  Very comfortable.  They're holding up great so I ordered another pair because I was afraid I wouldn't be able to get them again.  I even bought my sister a pair.  Well worth the money.
I had another pair (different brand) that kept sliding off.  These fit and feel great, I don't want to take them off.
Fit is a little loose because they only come in one width which does not fit my narrow foot well. But they don't slide off and they also look cute.
summary: Great for the garden and quick trips outdoors

reviewText: These shoes are great...very comfortable and I like the look of them.  I was going to get Crocs, but wanted something with more of a sole that didn't slip like the crocs, and these work great.  I did walk my daughter a few blocks with them on, and the sole of one of my feet began to hurt, so I wouldn't recommend them as walking shoes, but for gardening and general wear, they are great!
First experience sending for shoes and was a great experience.  It fit the needs and meet my expectation and more.  All in all a positive experience.
Size runs very small. Did not get a bigger size because I want them for a quick on/off garden shoe and don't know if they would be comfortable to work in without socks.

Ordered these shoes so I could get the free shipping for orders over $25 but I got a whole lot more. The other reviews helped me select the perfect size (size 9 slogger for a 8-8 1/2 shoe size). The colors are great and this retired lady wears them in the garden and to run errands. Thinking about getting the short boots also.

These are just what I was looking for in a garden clog. VERY COMFY and so many styles to pick from. Fit true to size. They have a nice tread but may bring in some dirt if you come into your house. Definitely recommend.
These are great shoes for working in the yard and they are comfortable.  The best part is that they are made in the USA

I love this shoe.  Love the pattern, fits great, and very comfortable.  Your foot fits right in the shoe, which I like.  Also bought the matching boots.  They're just the right height.  I wear my garden shoes every day when I'm in my yard, they'd also be good for rainy days doing errands.

These are so comfortable, you'd wear them anyway. I got these for working in the garden. They slip on and off easily and can be rinsed off with the hose. I did, as advised in earlier reviews, choose 1/2 up to a 9. They fit great.
I love these shoes! This is my second pair, as I have the other color available also!  they  are wonderful  in the garden, including bog garden work; and.can be easily hosed off!
I love my new sloggers! They are great to slip on and get to work in the garden. Waterproof, mess-free and stylish!
These shoes are perfect for gardening and rainy days and actully I wear them all of the time! They are great!
Great shoes and quick on off.  These fit the bill when in a quick hurry to water or taking your time to work in the garden.
Like these shoes.  Stretched a little but I just wear extra socks.  They are cute and if I run out to the store in them they still look cute
These are fantastic for this time if the year .. splash around and still look cool.  Will be on my every year list ...love !!!

I bought thes shoes for a trip to Scotland?Ireland because of the rain. I rerceived them today and wore them all evening.. they are so comfortable for rubber shoes and so cute! I can't wait for my trip to wear them all over rain or shine!
LOVE THESE.....EVEN PURCHASED THE HIGH -TOP ONES ALSO!!!! WILL BE ORDERING  MORE  AS GIFTS FOR THE FAMILY .'ALL DAY COMFORT'  FOR SURE.

I had a pair of garden clogs for years and years, but they split on the top.  I looked on line and found these.  Not only are they great for working in the wet grass/ground, I've even worn them to the store.  They are comfortable, and, I think, look rather stylish!

These are SO comfey & truly waterproof. I've had so many compliments on them. Size up 1/2 size. I actually got the "half sizer" liners, but with heavy socks, they fit great. I bought my daughter & siater a pair as well.

reviewerName: Geri Taran "In The Company of Writers.com"
reviewText: They're most comfortable with cotton socks but that creates the need for a half size larger shoe. Sockless is OK but not great. I really am happy with them anyway, so far.

I bought these for myself and for my daughter and we both are completely satisfied.  They are great for gardening and are very comfortable.  They are also sturdy, as I have had mine for a few years and they are good as new.
Love these garden shoes, they are comfortable with or without socks. I may buy another pair. . . . . .or two.

I bought these for gardening. They are exactly as pictured, cute and amazingly comfortable. I am not a skinny girl and I need comfort on my feet, these fit the bill.The only negative is they are a bit heavy.But on the whole I am very happy!
I bought these for a summer cottage where you never know about the rain. They are sooo comfortable and slip on and off easily.Great in the garden, too.

These shoes are great.  They are very comfortable ....very comfortable.  Just a small touch bigger than size.  I take a 9 and ordered a 9 and they are only slightly big.  Only negative thing I could say is that I wish they had more color/pattern selection.  Played in pond with daughter today..... Certainly waterproof!

Overall, i like those shoes, i'm glad i've bought them, and plan to use and buy similar shoes in the future. The cons are small compare to the pros of having an inexpensive shoe that is nice, water resistant, and not made from leather, which matters to me. But let me just add the less than perfect aspects: they are nice, but not as nice as in the web picture, they are comfortable, but with only full sizes sold, for "halfers" like me the fit is not lose but bot tight either (and although the size is larger, they still look rather gentle). They are water resistant but you may feel the coolness of the puddle and think you are wet. Plus, if you sweat inside, you will find yourself with wet socks. But so far they don't smell bad, as some more expensive and promises-loaded shoes eventually did. And all that did not prevent me from wearing them a lot and being happy with them.
Great for "slogging" around!  Went out arrow hunting the first day. Just washed the dust off with a hose.  No dirty tennis shoes to worry about.
I keep these by my back patio door to slip on when I want to run outside to feed the cat or get the mail
Very nice looking and looks as though I can even wear it. (Special needs.) I am so thrilled to find pretty shoes.

I have a hard time finding comfortable shoes that I can take off and put on quickly, as I have a wide forefoot but narrow heel. I found Sloggers Rain and Garden shoes so comfortable for walking, wearing around the house, in the garden and driving long distances that after a month's trial I bought two more pairs.  I have even been able to coordinate some of the black-background flowered ones with dressy tops and wear them to parties with dark jeans or leggings, and have had many compliments from women who assume they are high end designer shoes. The solid black is nice too. As long they Sloggers keeps the price reasonable and quality high I intend to have multiple pairs.
summary: Comfort, style, perfect fit - good looking and versatile!

reviewText: Unbelievably comfortable. When I put them on I thought I could wear them anywhere (not just the backyard). Excellent for gardening as they slide on and off easily and can be hosed down. Cute designs. I love these. Great price. I highly recommend the boots and the shoes.
summary: I bought the boots in the spring and just got the shoes.

reviewText: Nice, but why did they put such an aggressive sole on a garden shoe; brings in mud in the grooves.  Also, the pic doesn't really show that the back is between a real clog & a regular shoe.  For the dirt & wet, would have preferred a regular height back.

I bought two pairs last summer. I figured that I would use them for the summer and still get use out of them for winter. I bought LL.Bean and the shoe was great quality but they no long stocked it. I thought I would try these. Well, The verdict is in and they did an excellent job.The reason I bought these in the first place was they are easy to slip-on and off and they are good snow shoes for fast trips in winter. I live in Chicago and our winters can get wet. Driving the kids in the morning was simple. I didn't have to tie anything and didn't need hands to get them off. The traction on the bottom of the shoe has groves so slipping and sliding is minimum.They are great gardening shoes in the summer. My daughter was wearing them brief yesterday to take are our annual flowers outside. She stepped in mud. All I had to do was wash them off with the hose and hang them out to dry.I did take one pair with me camping two weeks ago. They are great with the morning dew, we got poured on once and my feet were dry. I didn't need the other shoes I packed.The only problem I have is wearing them in sport activities like basketball, a hike..(no support for the ankle)or running. The shoe is not meant for that but I thought I'd mention it. I'm an 8 1/2  so I had to go up a half a size. I wear socks in the winter and my feet expand in the summer.

I bought these for next years gardening season.  My feet are 8W, and these are 8B....they fit a little snug, but are very comfortable.  Since I live in Michigan, I haven't been able to use them yet due to our snow levels.  We've had a couple breaks in our snowy weather, and I've worn these to wash my car in our driveway.....the digits stayed completely dry....beats my crocs!!  I've also worn them down to the mailbox in the winter (we live on a hill with a long driveway) and the tread on the bottom allows for a good grip and keep my feet dry!!  They squeak a little when I walk....but they're so cute....who cares!!  I'd recommend these if you want to keep your feet dry!!

Not going to rehash all the wonderfully true comments that have already been stated, but wanted to give props (or stars) to these wonderful shoes--water-proof, comfortable, warm, stylish and easy to clean.Highly recommended.

Living in Florida and with a passion for gardening, these are absolutely the way to go if you want comfort, fun, and relatively clean feet at the end of a long day of digging in the dirt. I go through at least 4 pairs of sneakers a year and even with socks on, my feet would be filthy. Got my Sloggers and they fit perfectly (lots of toe room), didn't get hot (was afraid they would make my feet sweaty), and rinse off easily. Loved 'em so much, I bought the boots!

I don't usually write reviews but this shoe motivated me to do so.I needed a comfortable shoe for commuting in the rain and this shoe exceeded my expectations. It was totally comfortable right out of the box plus I get compliments from strangers ("I love your shoes!") every time I wear them. Other comments talk about the somewhat low back of the shoe, but that hasn't bothered me and the slight stretch across the top works well to hold my foot snugly in place.
summary: Love these shoes... not just for the rain!

reviewText: They were everything I had hoped they would be!  It was a gift for my daughter and she was so pleased.  The colors were great and she said the feel was fantastic.

My husband and I needed something easy to slip on to do a yard chore or take the dog out. Grass gets wet at night and the dew is heavy in the morning. We have had a lot of rain as well.. A quick trip to the mailbox or to the garden for some fresh veggies and my feet are still dry. I hate wet feet or even worse wet socks.  Sometimes I forget that I am still wearing them a little longer than needed, like in the house!. I wear a half size so I ordered up to the next size. I also ordered the insert since I did not know if they would fit at all.  They are roomy enough for a heavier sock in cooler weather.  I ordered larger black shoes for my husband, a whole size larger because these are women's shoes.  I would recommend these shoes. A great value for the money.
Run large.
I love the color  they fit great .i wear size 8 but for gardening ,i wanted to be comforable  so that why i got a size bigger .
I bought these as a gift for my wife.  She was very happy with them as they are conveniently left by the door to the garden.  They keep her feet nice and dry.
summary: Exactly what I was looking for.

reviewText: The other reviewers are correct.  Order the next larger size.  They work well for doing chores and kicking off in the mud room as I come in.  Wish they were a bit higher and more rigid in the back, so i could just step into them.  They are flimsy enough that I must straighten out the heel each time I put them on.  Other than that, They have good traction and wash right off with the hose.  I would recommend them.

I bought the ankle high slogger and love them on cool days in the yard.When the humidity came back this season, the ankle high sloggers are NOT the shoe for yard work.This garden shoe IS!First off, Slogger's are made right here in the USA. American  made, and they are proud of it.Very well constructed, not a drop of rain, mud or worms willl get through these shoes if you wear them in your garden to weed, plant or water. They are not only useful in the garden, if I forget I am wearing them (they are so comfortable, you will forget) and wear them out to the store or wherever, I can't tell you how many compliments I have received! Time and time again, my garden shoes are fashionista standouts!!Today I wore my Sloggers to cut the grass. No grass clippings stuck to my shoes, and my feet were comfortable throughout the grass cutting. Tossing my ugly old grass stained tennis shoes to the curb, Sloggers rise off and look as good as ever!I got the paw print shoes, they are so comfortable they are my favorite dog walking shoes! Ever!If you cut grass, enjoy growing veggies or flowers or will melt if a rain drop lands n you, these Sloggers are the shoe for you.You won't be sorry!!

The reviews sounded good, but these are even better than the reviews.  They keep my feet dry, have great grip in the soles, and feel like a natural part of my feet, because the upper part of the shoe stretches and adjusts to fit my foot.  And they just plain look fun! Great buy, wearing them a lot, and delighted that I have them!!!

My son also likes my Sloggers and as we were going out to lunch on my birthday last week, he asked me to wear my "hippie shoes" as I was selecting shoes to match my outfit.  Of course, I did wear them as we dress for our men don't we?  I also wore them to the Yankee Candle Store and the ladies there just loved them.  Wow!  I love them too.  I love them so much that I ordered the boots as well and they should arrive this week.  I have really broken in my Sloggers, today doing some muddy, wet gardening on my deck.  The colors in the shoes match an Anuschka Travel Tote that I have, it being beautifully painted leather.  Perfect match.  Also, a perfect fit with plenty of room for toes with no tightness any where. I emailed the picture of the shoes to my best friend who was on vacation.  She called me from a hardware store at Myrtle Beach to ask my shoe size as we had talked earlier of the Sloggers.  I think she has bought me a pair of pink Sloggers boots.  Oh, by the way, just wash them off with the hose and you're good to go.

I bought these due to the mud being all around me as the snow melts, plus I wanted something to wear in the garden. At first they were a bit uncomfortable right in the middle of my foot but as I wore them, they became just fine on my feet. They are waterproof and I can attest to that as I have been in the water and mud. I would recommend these garden shoes and in fact, the taller one's that go to mid thigh would be good too, and those are on my list. They colors are quite spiffy too!
thought they were cute so i bought a green pair and a blue pair for my sister. love the paws

It's hard to find products made in the US, and when I do, I try to spread the word.  The only reason this doesn't get 5 stars is because of the sizing.  I wear an 8, but wanted to wear socks with this (for work, I sometimes have to load trucks in the rain), so I got a 9.  Perfect with socks, slightly loose without.  Beyond that, they are beautiful.  I ordered a second pair for myself and one for my gardening nut sister, who will absolutely love the print as I do.
These shoes are awesome.  Very light and easy to take on and off.  I would def recommend these for the active gardener.

reviewText: I saw these shoes & fell in love with them. I wanted a pair of cute shoes to wear when it rained. We have had alot of rain this summer . They look great & keep my feet good & dry.

summary: great for early morning dew dog walks!

I love them.  Thinking about buying another pair in a different pattern.  Everyone at work all want a pair after they saw mine..  Two thumbs up!

From everything that my girlfriend is saying these shoes definitely deserve 5 stars.

The grill is everything I expected, because I had seen it a  friend's house. The replacement cover fits well and the color is right too. The garden shoes are nice and fit well.

Have not gardened in them yet, but I love them!!  They're cute, they fit nicely, and I'm assuming they will just hose off when they get muddy, which is why I got them in the first place.  I end up ruining hiking boots and tennis shoes out in the yard.  They do look cute with my jeans though too.
Work great for slipping on and running to the garden or in the yard. A little big for me width wise but other then that they are a good rain shoe.
Very comfortable and affordable. Love the different colors that you can get. Price is fantastic for such a great shoe. Want another pair.

Not very happy with my purchase! Received it scratched!!! I have had so many compliments when I wear these. Yes I wear these when I am visiting nurseries and hardware stores and sometimes in my garden when the other pair is dirty. Beautiful design but a bit difficult to put on.

I really like these shoes.  I wear them working out in the yard or when it is raining.  They very well made and super comfortable.  I would highly recommend them.  In my case the size was true.  I also felt they were a good value.

Wow. I am moving to Oregon from sunny CA where it rains a lot. These are so well made and really cute! I even went back & bought a pair for my daughter when she comes to visit me. Please they are made in the good "Old USA..

These slip on easily to run outside and water or do whatever. I have even worn them out on occasion forgetting I had them on. They are comfortable and have a thin lining in them so they don't feel heavily plastic when you put them on. Very nice color and pattern on them too.

I love these rain shoes! I've used them more times than I wanted to in Florida this year because it has been such a wet fall/early winter and I need to walk the dogs rain or shine!  These shoes fit well and never slip or slide in the puddles!

I have not experienced the summer time with this one, but I would imagine it won't breathe.  Still, it is reasonably priced and a good buy!

Great for rain when you don't expect to walk in any deep puddles, fit to size, took a day to break in but after that very comfortable especially for rain boots as in my experience rain boots are miserably painful to wear with very little support, these sloggers have support I need at least for wearing every so often
I ware these out with the dogs. I am able to kick their toy balls,and they protect my feet when it rains.Not a bad color as it was the cheapest one. I do recommend.

.The Sloggers Women's Rain and Garden Shoe with "All-Day-Comfort" Insole, is perfect,I love it.Thank YOU.I am really  happy and contended.

I received these lovely shoes today, along with the 'half-sizer' insoles, and was immediately struck with the well-made simplicity of them. So far trips to the muddy/slippery/semi-frozen back yard have been great!  I'll be ordering the boots in the future.Thanks, Sloggers!

reviewText: I love them!!! Yay! I am a dog walker by day and I needed something to walk in on those rainy days that was comfortable and easy to get on or off.  These fit the bill.  They are really great and your feet don't seem to overheat.  I bought the boots too and they are also comfortable enough to wear all day and they have remained waterproof.  Love these shoes and the boots.  I wear athletic socks in them and ordered my usual size 9 and they fit fine.

These are great for gardening. The soles have very good tread so you don't slip even in mud. They are also very comfortable. The removable insoles provide arch support and have just enough give. They pop out so if you've gotten some water in the shoes, you can pull out the insoles to dry them out. Mud will just pop out of the tread when it's dried out. Plus they're cute!  I've been using these for a couple of months now and am very satisfied with my purchase.

reviewText: These shoes are extremely comfortable.  Fit was exact and they have been a must have if you are working in the yard a lot.  Even if you aren't, these are great for being outside and getting dirty.  I wasn't sure how they'd look when I saw them in person and they look better than they do online.  Great shoes.

I live in southeastern Michigan where winters are cold and messy. I wanted a comfy, slip-on shoe that would keep my feet dry in the muck and slush while out shopping or to and from work. That's EXACTLY what my Paisley Sloggers do for me! Plus, I have gotten more comments -- "Cute shoes!" -- than I would have imagined. They make going out in the icky weather fun! Well, almost.Also, they are warm (I do wear heavy wool socks with them) without making my feet perspire like old-fashioned "plastic" shoes.I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them. In fact, I have.
summary: Sloggers Women's Garden Shoe - Comfy, Waterproof, FUN!

reviewText: These are absolutely one of my favorite shoes to wear! Don't use them just to garden! They are so comfortable and attractive I wear them on rainy , slushy days, someone always admires them.
summary: Don't wait to plant your flowers!

reviewText: I put these shoes on immediately from the box!! Perfect fit.  I love them.  Would recommend these to anyone who are looking for a good pair of low-cut rain shoe.

I ordered these rain shoes because price was decent and I always wanted short not tall rain boots, so when they arrived they looked good and I tried them on- they were sliding off my heels when I was walking, i think maybe it is half size up?- I wear 8-8.5 in sneakers, but purchased size 9,cause they don't have 8.5,and u don't really want tight rain boots, so you should order exact same size I think, not size up.I liked them but didn't wear them in a rain yet...

I love these shoes.  They are really suitable for gardening when it is too hot to wear gumboots (wellies).  They have a good strong sole which is not in danger of being penetrated by thorns etc and this is a real plus. I have recommended them to my friends.
Love these! Perfect for barn work! Garden work is a cinch with these too! Just hose them off and I'm done!

I was a bit sceptical about these but was pleasantly surprised when they arrived!  Comfortable, keep the feet dry, stylish! I am going to get another pair, a higher slogger boot to wear when the water is really bad.  I find these to me more stylish but where I live practicalility is more important.  Sloggers have proven to be both!
I simply love these stylish shoes, and will wear them outside the garden too.  I would recommend them for anyone,
Totally love these shoes for dog walking. Forgot to take them off and wore them all day once. So comfortable compared to traditional gumboots. I want another pair, they're so pretty!

I love these shoes. They are so comfortable and feel like slippers. Wish I'd bought these a long time ago. I used to wear the slip on clogs. The were very uncomfortable and hard to walk in; I was constantly slipping. I even fell of my porch wearing those clogs, yikes! I have worn these Sloggers all day while working in my garden and my feet are never tired. I highly recommend these shoes to everyone and especially if you are a 'hard core' gardener.
Am very pleased with these shoes which I use for gardening. Used to use some rubber slip-ons but they killed my feet after a long day. These have some good support, and so are much more comfortable.
These shoes are comfortable, easy to put on and take off.  The only downside is they don't come in half sizes.  I needed an 8.5 but took a 9 which is a little big.
This is my second pair of these.  Last ones lasted 2 years.  Wore them constantly for gardening, etc.  Good comfort

So far, they have been very comfortable and durable. I've used them a few times and washed them out with rain barrel water and left them outside to dry after gardening. They give more support than my last pair, too.
I had a pair of these and my granddaughters said they wanted a pair.They are great to slip on and off going in and out of the house. You can evenwear them to town or even work.

I LOVE these clogs.  I wear them gardening and sometimes for running out to the store in the rain.  They do fit loosely, but they are a rubber shoe and that is to be expected.  I love the removable insole and the lugged bottom.  These aren't a supportive shoe so if you are looking for that, pass them up.  They are a fun shoe to wear, keep dirt and water off of your feet and have great colors.  The only drawback so far is they do make your feet sweat in the heat.  I can deal with that given all the other pluses.
I just built a new house and I am doing the landscaping.  Lots of dirt and mud get on my shoes, but I just hose them off when the day is done.  They are very comfortable and keep my feet clean.

The Sloggers are all they claim to be and more.  Completely comfortable all day, kept my feet absolutely dry.  I wear them to walk my dogs in early morning.  Grass, puddles, accidental steps in poo....feet are clean and dry and shoes rinse off with garden hose.  Love them...only wish I'd bought them sooner!
I love these Sloggers for working in the yard. They look good, are comfortable and keep my feet dry. Thank you!
I needed waterproof shoes that I could slip into and out of easily.  I am always going in and out of the house while doing garden projects.  These shoes are just right for this application.
They are very comfortable, and they keep my feet dry and clean while gardening.  I would recommend them to anyone.
they're alright not bad but if your working in a soggy garden or yard and the sun is shining down well the rubber gets real hot and burns your feet. Would not buy again.
I give the Sloggers a 5 star rating, pretty color, easy off and on, and very comfortable, keeps my feet dry.
summary: I love my new garden shoes, easy off and on and very comfortable.

reviewText: These shoes have held up well with all the outdoor activities I do--landscaping, horseback riding, gardening, etc.  Must wear them with socks, though, because they "fart" when walking if worn barefoot.  They actually fit better with socks--which is a relief since I have wide feet that are sometimes hard to fit.
I love these shoes! Fit just right, I am a 6 1/2 and got a size 7, these are wonderful

I've been wearing these shoes going on two years now.  Not only are they great garden shoes, but I also wear them when I'm out in the rain, and when I go out to shovel snow.  Since I wear a half size, I had to go up to the next full size.  To take up the slack, I wear a medium thickness socks to snug up the fit and keep my feet warmer in cooler weather.

waterproof as advertised and comfortable. only complaint is my feet are so big i wish they had bigger sizes. warm and if you wear thicker socks there is no heel "popping out" my friend wears them to deliver newspapers and her socks are never wet.(says her feet are warm too)
I love these shoes!  They can be a little warm on a hot day but work well in the garden or just out on a rainy day.  Very stylish!

Since I read the other reviews and bought a half size larger, I can't find anything wrong with these.  They came on time, and they are really cute.  These are the most comfortable shoes ever.  I can slip right into them, and go out in the yard, or empty the trash, no matter what the weather. Then, I can kick them off easily at the door so I don't track through the house.  They keep my feet warm.  I have worn them a lot, and it is just now gardening season!  I will buy another pair when these wear out, but I don't expect that to be soon since they seem to be  really well made.
summary: I rarely give 5 star ratings, but there is nothing wrong with these.

reviewText: a great shoe for the garden or just to wear around the house. The ankle area is a little wide, go with your original size for a shoe..comfortable and colorful !!

Love the shoe, the print not so much.  However it was not worth exchanging the shoe since it's just for gardening. Everyone thinks I'm wearing camouflage, need to look very closely to see paw prints but still great shoe
They fit nice and snug at first but as soon as they warm up they give with every step, similar to stretch jeans. I find them very comfortable and they keep the wet weather out.
summary: get lots of compaments on these

reviewText: I wear these shoes every time I work in my yard and currently I am working in my yard daily.  My foot is narrow so I wear socks because the shoes are wide and it keeps the shoe from slipping. This shoe has a high back which helps to keep the shoe on my foot.  I like wearing these shoes a lot better than trying to wear old tennis shoes that let my feet get wet when I am watering my plants or planting new ones.
I love these rain shoes. They are so warm and keep all water outside the shoe. Thank you very much!
Super comfortable, great for rainy days and yard work.  And made in the USA is all the more reason to consider these trendy little rain shoes!
I keep these by my back door to slip on to take my dogs outside.  It's perfect for after a rain or while it's raining.  My feet stay nice and dry.

Since I am a senior citizen, a shoe needs to be comfortable.  It also needs to be versatile because I work in the yard and in the house.  I can throw the shoes into the washing machine, and they come out clean and shiny.

The last garden shoes I had lasted 10 years, but they were not nearly as nice, and as comfortable as these, and I paid more from them from a "name brand" store.  If you are a gardner and love comfortable, yet sturdy and easy to clean garden shoes--you can't go wrong with Sloggers!  Love the design as well.
so far i like them a lot.  have tried it on but not worn them for an extended period yet.

This is my first pair of true garden shoes, but my second pair of Sloggers.  The Sloggers are great for gardening and wearing around the farm.  Wasn't sure about ordering the animal print, as I'm not into that, but went ahead and got these anyway.  They're actually very nice looking and, like my other Sloggers, very comfy and waterproof.
summary: Garden shoes you won't be ashamed to be seen in!

reviewText: This is my second pair of Sloggers and my first pair of the full shoes.  I'm not an animal print fan, but these aren't too showy, and they're kind of fun.  Hope they last as long as my Sloggers clogs have lasted!  Definitely worth the little more you pay for them.
summary: Second pair of Sloggers - love them!

reviewText: These garden shoes are fantastic! They get double duty, yard and my go to shoe when it is raining. They are comfortable, durable, easy to clean and attractive~

These are my 3rd pair of gardening shoes in about 8 years.  My first pair of sloggers are still around but not nearly as comfy and pretty as these.  Last year I bought these exact pair and loved wearing them doing my gardening.  Then my GSP decided one day to pick them out of the shoe bin and eat them! So today I bought them again because there's no other kind I'd rather have and my original 8 yr. old sloggers hurt my feet.
summary: Buying 2nd pair after dog ate my 1st pair

reviewText: WAY TOO BIG, falls off my foot and it is very uncomfortable. I actually got a blister on my heel today after 3 hours of wearing. I recommend buying the boot which is true to size, No blister there.Comfortable fit.

I have very narrow feet and I have a hard time finding shoes to fit me.  Reading the other reviews that were saying the shoe was meant for people with narrow feet sold the shoe to me.  They fit great.  They are so very cute.  I get compliments all the time.  They seem comfortable so far.  They do keep your feet warm which has not bothered me like other reviewers.  I will definitely wear these until they fall apart and then order another pair!
These shoes are awesome! I couldn't be happier with how comfortable they are and cute too. They're perfect for rainy weather and gardening.

These are very nice, soft, flexible, comfortable, high quality garden shoes. They were purchased for my Mom as a replacement for the pair my puppy chewed up (which were not nearly as nice as these). My Mom was thrilled with how beautiful the color and design of the shoes are.My biggest praise is the for the speed of shipping the shoes. I ordered them on Friday morning and received them Monday morning. This was over the Easter weekend no less. I'm very grateful.

Got these for my wife for Xmas, and she absolutely loved them!  Great color and style, and with the 1/2 size insert (she wears an 8 1/2), they fit perfectly.  She said they are also very comfortable, as she wore them around the house the entire day.  Her comment was that they rode up in the back at first,but after being on her feet an hour, they stopped doing this (probably warmed up some).  She is a happy customer.

I have been looking for shoes to wear when I am gardening or mowing the lawn or just in the backyard with the dogs.  These are the most comfortable pair of shoes ever.  They fit just a tiny bit bigger than  I wear but I bought the insoles and they are just fine.  They wash off very easy, look really cool when I wear them and I am just happier than anything that I found these.  The fact that they are made in the USA was a wonderful surprise and that is why I bought them.  I try to buy things made in this country to keep jobs for us here.Thank you for such a wonderful product!!!!  I truly love them and hope you never stop making them!!!

LOVE THIS SHOE. I AM VERY CLOSE TO WORK SO I WALK EVERYDAY & IN THE MORNINGS, THE GRASS HAS WET DEW ON IT SO I HATED PUTTING ON MY RAIN BOOTS & WALKING TO WORK. I BOUGHT THESE & YOU CAN EVEN TELL WHAT THEY ARE. MY FEET STAY NICE & DRY!! PERFECT SHOE!

My mom asked for new garden shoes for Mother's Day.  The ones she had, were worn out and, quite honestly, horrifically ugly.  I had seen these gems on Amazon before and thought they would fit the bill.  I ordered two pairs and she was happy when I gave them to her.  I recently saw her since she's had a chance to wear them for outdoor work and she raved that they were far more comfortable than the ones she had before and, obviously, better looking.  She commented on the arch support they offered.  I have never tried Sloggers, but based on my mom's review, an considering replacing my current garden shoes (a name brand, foam type shoe with holes in them--comfortable, but I like to have options) as my feet tend to get covered in grass clippings and there's no protection from moisture in what I have now.  There were plenty of color choices in the Sloggers and the price was right.
Love them!!!  They are great for gardening.I also love just slipping on to go to the store. I have recommended them to friends too.

These are comfortable, although they don't offer my flat feet the support a tennis shoe does, but I bought them to wear short-term, not for lengthy gardening chores.  They are great to slip on for a quick dog run, and I love the water-proof quality.  They don't have much ventilation, so your feet will sweat, and the fact that they are not true backless clogs make them a tad more difficult to slide my feet into (but that feature also keeps my heels dry and warm); all in all, I am quite pleased with them.  I wear a 6 1/2 so I sized up to a 7 and I am glad I did!  [And they're so much prettier than most gardening shoes...]
This again was a good find.  I love the color but more than that, the construction is good. And it wears well with or without socks.  I look forward to a long wear.

This is my second pair of Sloggers.  Each time I wear them, everyone comments.  They are very comfortable.  The pair I bought last ear I wore fishing from the shore, did not have to worry about wet shoes and have great gripping to get the edge of river or lake.

This is the first time I have purchased Sloggers. They fit well and seem to be made well. I am looking forward to wearing them to my trip to VT in a few weeks. They will keep my feet warm and comfortable. Plus, the look terrific. They come in several different patterns.

I have fairly narrow feet, and these fit perfectly, so I might guess they would be too tight for those with average or wide feet.  I was worried about the insides being comfortable barefoot, but they have a cushy insole and the rubber is sort of fabric lined, not so much so that you can't hose them off, though.  It appears that the entire shoe, with the exception of the tread, is molded from a single piece of plastic, so as long as the plastic stays in tact, they are truly waterproof. They're plenty comfortable barefoot, or I could imagine with a thin sock.  I was a little surprised that the back was so low, more like a clog than I expected, but that's ok with me.  The print is very cute, too.

The fit was perfect, good rugged construction, good supportive insole for long work hours outside and of course the colors they offer are just plain fun. Price was way under  competitors. I would buy again in a minute!
They look good enough to shop in, they are great in the garden or wet conditions, and best of all, they are comfortable

Ok, I love the Slogger Clogs so bought these because they have a closed heel...and like a dummy, thought I could get by with them for short runs to the barn this winter.  Well, "winter" isn't here yet, and these sloggers are SUMMER SHOES.  (Jut like their name says!!!)  I wore them all fall and my only complaint is that they are not particularly supportive.  I did have to be careful not to twist an ankle.  Now why the CLOGS would seem much more "supportive" to me then these...who knows.  The clogs are built way more rugged.  Snowing here in Maine, so it's time to pull out the LL Bean boots and slog around in those until spring.I would probably not buy these again only because I like the clogs so much better.  I definately recommend the Slogger brand!And folks....THEY'RE MADE IN THE U.S.A.  which is always a top consideration in my buying choices.

Very happy with this purchase.  I was surprised at how comfortable they were and offered some arch support.  they had room in the toes and did not slip.  can be worn with socks.  Good quality and I am looking at also purchasing the boots.
These are great shoes for walking my dogs in the morning when the grass is still wet or it has rained.  They are easy to get in and out of and comfortable.

We just moved into a new house and construction is all around us. Needless to say, it's a muddy mess around here! We have no grass, yet, so I needed something to stick on quickly to run our pooch outside to do her business. I'm pretty hard to fit, big, narrow foot, but these work well. They slip a little bit in the heel, but that's to be expected with an average-width shoe on my foot. They do the job I wanted them to do and that's what counts. FYI, I got a 10 and I'm a 10 N in most shoes, but I can keep these on.
summary: Pretty good shoe to run outside with the dog

reviewText: I bought these to wear on a mission trip to the Dominican Republic. They warned of the mud problem there.I was pleasantly surprised with how comfortable the shoe is. I wear a 6.5 so I ordered the size 7. It was a little big and fits good with a sock.

I have not seen these in any store, but was impressed with the description on Amazon.  They didn't disappoint...these Sloggers are comfortable, durable, and everything they were described to be.  Time in my garden is a joy.  Please don't ever discontinue them....but they seem to be manufactured to last forever.
summary: Great footwear for the serious gardener

reviewText: I'll have to see what I think over time, but right out of the box, I'm really pleased. I bought these to replace a pair of the leather topped/rubber camp moccasins by a major retailer that I'd had for years...until my dog ate them. My pet peeve with those was the sheer weight of each individual shoe. These Sloggers are nice and light, and at least initially, seem very comfortable. I bought my usual size, and these fit as expected (over a pair of thin socks). I had looked at Bogs and Mucks, but really didn't want to spend that much for something that might eaten by the dog...I just wanted a pair of shoes to wear in wet grass chasing said dog, or to do yard work. I think these fit the bill. The fact that they're made in the USA is an unexpected plus, and they're attractive enough to were around town on a rainy day.
summary: really cute and at a reasonable price

reviewText: Great and so far so good.  Good fit,comfortable less expensive than anything on Zappos.  I have a long narrow foot, so need socks.
summary: Sloggers rain & arden all day comfort

reviewText: Great for outside garden work in SoCal, cleaning out the coop and general walking in the dirt.  No rain to speak of yet...
These shoes are great for gardening.  They are durable and easy to slip on.  My only complaint is that they don't come in size 5.

Saw these in a local garden shop for twice the price.  Ordered them and couldn't be happier.  Easy to slip on and off when going in and outside to work in the yard.  Don't have to worry about wet tennis shoes anymore.  Feet stay dry and very comfortable.
The way the shoe curves at the big toe made it uncomfortable but otherwise it was everywhere else a very comfortable shoe.  It also slipped on the heel.
summary: The curve of the shoe by the big toe

reviewText: Maybe these are actually a five...They are colorful and comfortable and keep your feet dry in rain and shallow mud situations. Next time I would buy the ankle highs.

They appear to run very small as I could barely get my foot in with out a sock.I had a pair very similar by Sporto and loved them but they are no longer available so I was looking for a replacement. Sporto is far more fashionable and the size was very close to any other shoe I have.When these came there was no paperwork in the box so I'm not really sure how to return them. I have sent a request asking how to send them back and in return get a size 9W in hopes they will fit with socks. I never imagined wearing a size 9 but if that is what it takes I would like to exchange them, Look forward to hearing from you soon.Thank You, JECarmine
These are very comfy shoes! So glad I got them. I got them to wear in the garden &i wear them all over the place! Very pretty also!
I love them.  Wear them out to feed the animals and in the yard.  Very comfortable and well made.  Would recommend highly.

Best purchase I've made all year and it's October.  I highly recommend you purchase these a half size larger than you think = I use them as my 'outdoor shoes' when taking puppy for a walk so I can still wear my slipper socks and do not have to change socks and shoes to go out.  PLUS - They are gorgeous.  I wish I could wear them to work!  :)
Comfortable, keep me warm & dry when walking my little dog.I would highly recommend them to a friend !
I just love my new sloggers...There very easy to slip on and take off...Now I enjoy walking out in back yard in early mornings and later in evening without worring about my shoes getting wet.
Easy to slip on & off & perfect for wet conditions when neither snow boots or sneakers are appropriate.  Also, the print is nice & cheery.
summary: Just what I was looking for

reviewText: I wear these for my outdoor and gardening work and they are soooo comfortable it is unbelievable.  Would definitely buy these again.
They are comfortable and fit very well.  Had many compliments on them.Great to wear on rainy days and also working in the garden.

These garden shoes are cute and fairly comfy however the heel cup is shallow. My heal slips at every step so they do not feel secure on my feet...they have more of a clog feeling. I wear a size 8.5 ( half sizes are not offered) so per their instructions I ordered a 9. They are a bit sloppy. They do offer "cut to fit" half size insoles however since these insoles would be in addition to the standard insoles they would be too bulky for my foot and make my toes rub the top of the shoe. I'll probably keep the pair I purchased but I will not order another pair.
I've always worn old tennis shoes while gardening.... These are great shoes that keep my feet clean and out of the mud and dust. They are easy to wash off and dry immediately.  Very comfy!

These are wonderful! They fit perfect! The only downfall is they don't breath so they do make your feet smelly. I suggest buying some foot odor powder or spray if you are gonna wear them often, I wear mine almost everyday as regular shoes.
After reading some reviews I was a bit afraid about the Sloggers fitting my right foot (with a bunion), but they are very well design and comfortable.... No complains from my foot :)
i purchased these with a Christmas gift card, longing for Spring. They are much sturdier than similar garden shoes...and just adorable! Can't wait to wear them regularly once the ground thaws :)

I've gone from zero to two pairs of Sloggers shoes, the premium clogs and the Sloggers 5102BK08 Women's Midsummer Garden Shoes.  After working in the garden in filthy dirty soil and mud in Crocs, I'm thrilled to have these more comfortable and definitely more durable shoes.  To top it off, both pairs are so much more attractive!  Both pairs of my Sloggers are a size 8 and I usually wear a 7.5 in shoes or a 37 in Birkenstocks.  They are very comfortable and will fit well also with socks.  The size 7 would have been snug with socks.  When wearing these shoes, I am more protected and do not need to wear socks.  The black insoles are more cushioned and soft than most other garden shoes and they are removable for cleaning or airing out.  The design of these shoes is great in that there is a little ledge at the heel end of the shoe which allows the wearer to use the opposite shoe to step onto it, thereby aiding in the shoe's removal.  They can easily be hosed off, so dirty shoes can be quickly cleaned and protected.  The lovely pattern on the shoes is not symmetrical and I've noticed that the pair I received has less of the orange and blue than those in the images on Amazon.  Mine have more of the green.  I'm a rather obsessive shopper in B&M stores, and I'm sure that I would have gone through each and every pattern to find the perfect complementary pair.  Better that I ordered them from Amazon and received a perfect pair!  By the way, these shoes need not be limited to use in the garden -- they are lovely and quite wearable in public.  They are very stylish and I am restraining myself from buying another pair in blue!  As a friend reminds me, I have only one pair of feet.
summary: Comfortable garden shoes in batik like pattern

reviewText: Just what I needed; they live by the door to my garden.  Good fit, comfortable, easy to clean when needed.

I've purchased taller boots.  It's very cute and has nice shape for rain boot. I got size 6 and is my usual size but it was tight that I can wear it only barefoot or with nylons. If you are  planning to wear it for gardening or walking your dog in the rain, I would go a half size larger.  But wait!  They don't come in half sizes.  Try one size larger.  One more thing... I thought they were heavy.Update:  My size seemed to be popular that I finally found the right size and pattern.  It is rather heavy for what it is.  But it became one of my favorites.  Love them!

I walk my dog on the beach every day and enjoy the comfort of these shoes.  I wear a size 8 and ordered a size 8- fit me perfectly.  The best item I ever purchased on Amazon- I plan to order another pair !

I rarely write reviews, but in the two weeks I've had these, I have thought so often of how much I love them that finally I was compelled to be proactive and log into my account to figure out how to do this. These are the greatest waterproof shoes ever. From the moment I put them on they were totally comfortable. I wore them to work one day, accidentally -- it was raining and I had my shoes to change into, but then left shoes in the car. No problem, they were comfortable all day. So -- wore them the next day, too! I have worn them walking my dog in the rain, and then last week took them to Portland, Oregon -- assuming it would rain and I'd wear them walking with my dad. Well, as it turned out, it didn't rain, but I'd forgotten my regular walking athletic shoes, so these were it. We walked up to five miles each day and they were totally comfortable. I love them for walking in the huge and muddy dog park with my dogs (the real reason for my purchase); these wet spring days as the water drains over the trails, I can tromp through without worries. Some in other reviews have mentioned that they slide a little on the heel -- and this is true. But it is not uncomfortable or annoying and it doesn't not cause any troubles. I highly recommend these. (I bought the mid-calf height boots in the same size as well; haven't had a wet enough occasion to warrant wearing them, but look forward to that; I'm confident they will fit as well.)
These are okay, but they don't have arch support like stated.  That is why I bought them and was disappointed.  Also, my ankle slips out when I walk.  I wouldn't buy again.

reviewText: I got these shoes just as it was beginning to rain in our area. I was able to walk through all the puddles and wet grass I needed to. I work at a preschool and these shoes are perfect for the job. I am on my feet for 9hrs a day and they are so comfortable. At the end of the day I don't want to take them off. I will get another pair in a different style. The sizing was a perfect fit. I have gotten a lot of compliments on them and all I can say is they are great!

I purchased a pair of these last year and loved them so much I purchased a pair for my daughter.  They look nice, are very comfortable and keep my feet dry when walking over damp grass.  I keep them by the back door so I can easily slip them on and off when I need to go out for a bit.  Mine have held up quite well...they still look new.  Would highly recommend.
I really like the bright colors, the comfort and that I can wear them all seasons.  They were slightly too big though but with thick socks they work well!
I've enjoyed wearing these in my Florida garden this entire gardening season and expect to get several more years use out of them.  They're easy to slip into and rinse off easily.
I ware it every single day when I play with my dog and work my dog. It's help a lot. Little tiny proble is sometimes sands go into the shoe...that's all

I have enjoyed working in the yard in my new sloggers.  Our yard is so muddy now with all the rain and snow.  The only reason for not giving 5 stars is because I have to wear a thicker sock to keep them from flopping.  I ordered my usual size so I don't know if smaller size would have worked better.
I replaced an older pair  of another kind that had cracked and leaked, found these shoes to be beautiful and what I needed to work in the garden, lawns and fields, happy with them.  Also comfortable.
So cute. Fit great. Very comfortable. They are so pretty. I love the colors.Good quality. Can't wait till it rains.
Certainly pretty and fit but a bit heavy which surprised me. That makes it a bit uncomfortable so I don't really use.

Loved the shoe-(style and pansy pattern!) and bought a half size more than I take and was surprised to find it just a bit too tight for true comfort.  Can't fit a sock under, but it will work for quick jobs in the garden this summer.
I love the shoes and also the customer service . I actually wear these shoes to work, so my feet don't get wet . Very pleased

I wish I had bought these years ago when I first started gardening.  I love them.  They are comfortable and keep my feet dry and clean--not as hot as rubber boots in the summer.  We have had a wet spring and summer here so I have been wearing them a lot.  I would definitely purchase again!

I was struggling along using sneakers and then got a pair of these. They are comfortable as well as nice that when your feet get wet when watering you stay dry. My only complaint so fairs that occasionally I get those funny squeaky sounds when I walk in them.  I am not fond of how they look but do love how they feel and work.
I ike these rain shoes and they are comfortable even wearing for a whole day.  My only criticsm would be that they are a little heavy.
Very handy for walking around in my backyard to fill the bird feeders.  The fit is very accurate for my size 9 feet.
It was an excellent choice for my friend.  With 3 dogs she's out walking in all types of weather.  She loves them.

I usually wear an 8-8 1/2.  I ordered size 9 because of all the reviews saying the sizing was smaller than normal.  They were way big even with in extra insole. I returned them for an 8 and they were perfect.  I have a wide foot so maybe that's why the 8 fit so well. First day I wore them on a hike and they felt great.  Good support, cushiony feel.  I love them.

reviewText: I love my Sloggers!  I wore them to work one day (medical facility), intending to change.  I did not change my shoes.  I received so many complements.  They are so comfortable. I love this shoes , They are perfect for garden work .When the get muddy & dirty just slip out the insole and hose them off ...Great shoes

reviewText: I initially ordered Sloggers Premium Garden Clogs (open-heel), but reasoned that the Garden Shoe (closed-heel) would be better for my wobbly ankles than the open-heel model. I normally wear a 9-1/2 Narrow and I have high arches. The size 9 open-heel clogs were too short and too wide, even with two sets of insoles.  The size 10 open-heel clogs were much too long and too wide. I returned them and ordered the closed-heel Garden Shoes in a size 10. Eureka! These are my new favorite shoes.My new favorite shoes accommodate two sets of insoles (including the ones that came with the shoes) for a comfortable fit. I wear socks because shoes always fit better and feel better to me with socks. My heel comes up with every step, but this really isn't bothersome; it's what clogs do, and the Garden Shoe really fits like a clog that is both secure and comfortable.I tried some beautiful, high-quality, leather dress clogs in a couple of different top brands. But the hard rocker-bottom contour was not a hit with my high, rigid arches. My Sloggers are so comfortable that they beat out the much more expensive competition. I'm thankful to be beyond the need for fashion to override comfort!I find my new favorite shoes comfortable for walking and standing. My original intended use for my Sloggers was to wear them in the garden and walking around in our pasture, wet or dry, so I wouldn't ruin my leather shoes or boots. I don't like the hassle of putting on and taking off sneakers, and I no longer even own any. Sloggers are ridiculously easy to clean with a hose or a wet paper towel.My Sloggers quickly became my primary shoes; I wear them everywhere now, except to bed. :) I've ordered another pair in the Basic Solid Black to have a pair that will go with anything.I think Sloggers are attractive and comfortable and sturdy enough to go everywhere my life requires me to go: home and yard, errands in town, church, and court to watch my (attorney) husband's trials.  I have received compliments on my Sloggers since my first day of wearing them. It occurs to me that cashiers who stand all day would love Sloggers! With the gel insoles I inserted and the thickness of the traction soles, they do make walking and standing on concrete floors less fatiguing. I even tested them on a Wal-Mart trek, which normally leaves my lower back, knees, and ankles feeling splintered. I have fibromyalgia, as well as arthritis in my spine from neck to tail, and in my knees and ankles. I survived Wal-Mart intact with zero pain!I would say that Sloggers are a terrific value and well made in the U.S.A., which means a lot to me. Amazon offers free return shipping on shoes, so there's no risk in trying them.  For me, they're keepers.
