They rinse off easily, so if you happen to misstep, you won't have to go scraping through tall grass to pre-clean them.Bonus: they are pretty comfortable! I have arthritis in my knees and ankles, and these shoes let me enjoy my outdoor chores without whining. People with normal joints should have no trouble. The insole is cushy, though they do make my feet sweat quite a bit. Not a shoe you want to wear to the store or for a long haul at all. You'll be squishing and feeling pretty gross if you do. The fit is accurate, according to the size, though you'll want to wear thin socks if any at all. They also have a tab at the back of each heel so you can peel them off without having to bend over and use your hands. These rain shoes appear to be very well-made, and they actually fit well in the length and width. However, they seem to be cut low at the back of the heel. As a result, they slip when I walk. I thought for a moment that I received the clogs accidentally, but the packaging checks out. I'll probably keep them because it would cost a fortune to send them back (the rubber is fairly heavy). But I still need a pair of rain shoes...

reviewText: Enjoy saving my other shoes when going to the garden.  Although these are heavy in weight, it is so nice just to hose them off.
I love these shoes. They are perfect for gardening in any weather, light weight and waterproof.  Plus they are really cute!
summary: These are the best gardening shoes I have very had!

reviewText: I thought my feet would scream in these shoes because they're plastic. But surprisingly, I wore them all day without having to remove them. And when I did remove them no one fainted from my feet because they weren't sweaty.

I usually wear a 7 so that is what i ordered.  They were very tight so I reordered In an 8.  These fit good but the insole In the toe area was smaller than the shoe and made the shoe uncomfortable.  Has anyone else experienced this?  Not sure if it is a defect or they are all like this.

I absolutely love these clogs - very comfortable, easy to slip on and off yet fit snug enough to keep wet and dirt out. I love the cute pattern as well! I highly recommend these garden shoes. I am tempted to buy another pair in a different color while they are available at such a great price! Shipping and delivery were easy and fast.

This is my second pair of Sloggers.  I really love them.  I have to tend to plants and animals, and these shoes are them best for slipping on in a rainy day.  They fit perfectly and comfortably; they wash off with a hose.  I would recommend them!

Easy to clean and to slip on and off, but they don't offer much support. I find I have to be very careful while wearing them in the yard lest I twist my ankle. They offer less support than my boots, but I can put these on and take them off in about two seconds and without needing to sit down. And when they get muddy, I just hose them off and let them dry in the sun. Note: the polka dots aren't as perfect as they appear on the pictures. The dots seem like they're printed on the backside of the clear plastic slogger material, and you can see the warp of each dot as the material bends to make the shoe. This warping might not be as noticeable in a different pattern, but it's very obvious with the geometric layout of the round dots.
summary: Easy to clean and slip on and off

reviewText: Perfect fit, right color, all as promised!!! Perfect for rainy days, working in the garden, or in the medical field!Much Love & God Bless-Miranda

I bought these for my mom for Christmas and she loved them. As soon as she opened them up they were on her feet just walking around the house. My mom gardens a lot so I am always looking for stuff to help her (especially if it means i get some dilly beans out of it!). They are water proof, durable and i feel great about purchasing it because it is made in the USA.

They are a gift for my birthday later this month - Thanks Mom!  I cannot wait to wear them.  They are sweet and look even better in person.  Very well made - Made in the USA from 100% recyclable material - Excellent!  I am an 8.5, so I ordered the 9 since there are no half sizes.  They fit fine, a tiny bit loose, but not enough that I need the "Half Sizer Insoles."  They almost seem too nice to wear for gardening.  But hey, they'll make me feel happy whilst weeding!  There are so many patterns to choose from, I know I will order another pair....or two.  I definitely need a pair for a Rainy Day.
I purchased these shoes for myself and my coworker. We work at our local hospital. These shoes are very comfortable and allow us to show school spirit for our Panthers!

I live out in the country and wear these all the time, even to work!  They provide excellent traction and they are watertight.  I have gone through a lot of shoes and boots, but so far these are holding up in my extreme environment.  Now, if they would just offer them in more colors...They were a little tight when I first got them but after constant wear they fit perfectly.
The colors are wild and dark - very unusual & eye catching. They are comfortable to wear and keep the water and mud out - what more could I ask!
summary: I love my new gardening shoes!

reviewText: I bought these to wear working in the garden. I had some slip-on clogs, but dirt and water was constantly getting in through the holes, so my feet were always muddy...had to wash my feet before I could go inside. These shoes are completely water proof and very comfortable to wear. I bought my normal size and they fit perfectly. They are really easy to slip on and off. There is a small rubber tab at the base of each heal that provides leverage; with the other foot, you push on the tab to easily pull off the shoe. They have a removable, washable liner. The tread is very solid and allows me to stomp on the shovel when necessary to get through our clay soil!! All in all, I really love these shoes!
Love these!! I run a kennel and grooming shop.. They are perfect for work! I wear them daily and they are very comfy! Two thumbs up! I will definitely buy another pair or two.
I also have the matching hat - that should tell you how much I enjoy this product.  I've never been disappointed by an "Sloggers" purchase.

I walk dogs early in the morning, rain or shine. I have several pairs of shoes that are water resistant but came home with wet feet every AM. I have feet issues, too, that make boots or shoes without padding or insoles impossible to use, so went looking for something that would keep my feet dry, be comfortable for my funky feet and easy to slip on and off to take my pups out in. THESE are PERFECT!! They fit without socks but will accommodate them in cooler weather, so that's a bonus. Easy to clean and cute enough to wear to work, though perhaps TOO waterproof to be comfortable there all day....feet wouldn't be able to breathe. I will be looking for others on sale!!

I love these shoes!  I work out in my garden and yard any chance I get, so I spend a lot of time in these shoes.  They are so comfortable, keep your feet clean and dry, are easy to slip on and off when needed, and the inner lining comes out for easy cleaning.  I can give them excellent testimony that they can stand up to a great deal of abuse.  When I rinse mine off, they still look and feel like new!
summary: one of my favorite pairs of shoes!

reviewText: Not the warmest boot, but they don't have to be when I'm wearing them for mostly mud conditions. Easy on and off. I do  have a little problem with my one toe, feeling a little squished after a few hours of wear, but that could be that I have had some surgery's on that toe and it's a little sensitive.  All around good boot, and mostly comfortable. Size runs true.

reviewText: I wear a half size, and bought the cut-to-fit insole, but still the shoe is a little roomier than I expected.  I just wear thick socks and it works out OK.  They are great for rainy, slushy days, or just for a fun, colorful comfy walk-around shoe.

reviewText: The first time I put on these shoes I quickly forgot I had them on they are so comfortable and flexible. They are easy to slip in and out of going in and out of the house. They are water proof and can be hosed off and left to dry.
Rain shoes worked great I work outside so I have several different rain shoes for different days so that my feet stay dry.
If you are purchasing this shoe prepare to purchase this shoe at least a size and 1/2 bigger due to they run small. I do love these shoes.

Love these shoes. They are cute and comfortable, even better than I expected. Great price and made in the USA. I wear a 10 with a slightly wide foot and these fit perfectly. They slip on and off easily, but don't slip off while I'm walking. They keep my feet nice and dry and do pretty well at keeping dirt out. Do yourself a favor and buy these shoes!
summary: Perfect fit, price and style. Get yourself a pair!

reviewText: Love , love love, these shoes. Toe box is roomy and feels so comfy on the feet, even when wearing them all day. Does not slip off my heel. Multicolors in the design match many of my solid tops, Great with jeans, especially practical on rainy days. Even cuter than pictured.
They can be worn anywhere,so fun!No fear of mud in these high tread shoes. So easy to put on and take off yet snug when worn.I can't garden without them.

reviewText: Shoes fit true to size and so COMFY! Received overnight and just in time for rainy days in the Northwest.
summary: My dogs are gonna love me for getting these shoes!!! Dog park here we come!!!!

reviewText: Like the shoes a lot.  Sizing is an issue.  Found that if I wore socks they were too tight. The color is nice and the shoe sturdy. A great rain shoe.

I am always in the garden and doing yard work.  I have worn crocs until now.  These fit perfectly and are very comfortable.  I really like the pattern on the black sloggers.  I am ordering a 2nd pair today!
they are what i need now but we will see how long they last colour good and fit is fine
Great shoes. They fit perfectly and are really cute and comfortable. I would definitely buy this particular brand again. 100% Satisfied
I own 4 pair of Sloggers  and they are so comfortable. And I get compliments on them all the time as they are very colorful!

Serously thinking about a 3rd pair to use as comfy winter slippers with thick socks

reviewText: footwear usually between size 8-8.5, so i ordered a size 9 since it was recommended to order half size up. i purchased the liner that was 'guaranteed' to make it fit, but it didn't work and the shoe is still a bit large. might not be the fault of the shoe though, as my heels are narrow and pop up out of the shoe. i rated the shoe 'ok' because i wanted something that i would be able to slip on and off for stepping out onto lawn quickly and  easily. it works ok for that, a tighter fit might not have been as useful.

reviewText: I love these - they are really really comfortable to wear. I work in my garden most days and have found my sloggers to be the best garden footwear I've ever had.

I just received my Sloggers. I Love them and they are so comfortable. I got the ones with pink, yellow, and purple flowers. These are really nice and worth the money. Now my daughter wants to buy a pair; she likes them too. Oh, I wear a size 8 1/2 shoe, so I ordered a size 9. They fit perfect with socks but a little loose without socks. I know a size 8 would be too tight.

I LOVE these shoes to work in my flowerbeds.  They keep your feet dry and are comfortable to wear.  I normally wear a size 8 shoe but ordered these a size larger because someone said they ran a little small.  The 9 is a little large, but fine to wear doing work in the yard.

Perfect for rainy weather, but not for wide feet.  My feet feel a little bit squished in the shoe because it's really not wide enough for a wide foot.  Also, it slips up and down on one of my heels, but not the other one.  This is annoying because I really love these shoes.  Overall it's a good product if your feet are normal or narrow width.

Just what I was looking for. I wanted something I could slip on easily and were good for wet conditions.  Was concerned about what size to order, but they were true to size.  Some reviews mentioned they were somewhat wide. I normally wear a medium width shoe, but these seem fine for me. Will probably get a second pair.

I was they came in 1/2 sizes the fit would have been better. But, buying another pair so I can wear one set in the winter with thick socks, and one set in the summer with thin socks. You can wear this for dress up. Or to drag around in the mud. Great shoe!One you habv them on it like you forget there on.
summary: Awesome show Love it. Srious;y one of the best shoes I have ever bought. Only thing is I wish they came in half sizes!

reviewText: These shoes are too good to work in the garden.  I had to increase the width a bit but all in all this was a good purchase.

I purchased these along with the Slogger Garden Clog.  I wear them to trim mow as well as when the garden is especially wet and muddy.  They obviously have a higher cut than a clog so you have more protection.  They have a removable, cushioned insole that can be washed when needed.  I do wish they came in half sizes.  I normally wear size 9.  The garden clog is perfect in the 9, but this is a bit snug especially if I want to add a thin sock.  It's fine for what I need, but I wouldn't want to wear them all day.  I love the pattern on the shoe--a unusual little pop of color.

I bought these (not on Amazon) in Nov 2012 for wearing around the house.  They are actually very comfortable to me and I started wearing them out and around.  Next thing I knew I even wore them when I was flying.  The easy on/off make them great for going through security plus they are roomy on my feet allowing for some swelling that I invariably have.I get positive comments on the looks of these shoes too!  I would recommend getting a pair of Sloggers - I don't think you will be disappointed.Oh - I typically wear size 9-10 depending on the shoe.  In the sloggers I wear a 10 and use the 1/2 size sole.  Hope that helps if you are thinking about getting a pair of these shoes.
summary: Great shoe to wear when traveling!

reviewText: I love my new Sloggers! They fit great, and the insole is easy to remove and rinse off. The only thing I would change about the shoes is the sole. They have deep tread on the bottoms, which is difficult to clean out. The mud of a damp garden packs in the tread, and before long your shoes feel like 10 lbs a-piece! Love the bright fresh colors!
My wife loves these garden shoes; they fit well and are perfect for the garden and outdoor chores, plus they look good
They are extremely comfortable.  I am going to buy another pair to wear around the house or out and about - they'll look great with jeans.

I'm a croc-aholic and always wear size 8. These fit snug in size 8, without socks, so sent them back for. 9, which I've never bought in my life and ordered the half-sizer. They are fine now. If you are 7-71/2, OK to buy 8 but a true 8 will need a 9. As for the half-sizer,  go to WalMart and buy them. An expensive add-on. The shoes are darling and I wear them often. Very comfortable.
summary: Love the shoes but DO buy a size up.

reviewText: The sticky rubber soul is great in the ice and snow. I was sliding in my regular shoes, put these on and I couldn't have been happier.
I had expected the back of shoe to be higher, like regular shoes and they're more like clogs. They're comfy to walk in but can't wear them all day.
A lot more comfortable than I thought they would be. Only down side is today I see they are on the deal list for $18 something.

I just received the package with these this morning and they haven't left my feet all day. They're very comfortable. At first, I was concerned. These aren't shoes that you can simply slip on and off.  I have a high instep which sometimes has made wearing clogs and clog-like shoes problematic. The fit is snug mid-foot but I can wiggle my toes. I wore them all day around the house and  they already have loosened up just a bit over that short time. I suggest wearing a thin pair of socks with them during the breaking in period.They are every bit as shiny as they look in the photography.  Reminds me of patent leather shoes- should they be reserved for formal gardening?  I wish they were available in a matte black. That's my only quibble.As was stated in the Details part of this page - if you need half sizes,  order a size up. There's something you can order from the manufacturer's website that will help compensate for the difference in size.
These garden shoes are great, good support and fits are true to size. I even wore them to work one rainy day!

I bought these for when I mow grass and when it's raining to walk down and check the mail. They fit a little big but I wear them with colorful socks so they are fine. I usually wear a 7 1/2 so I got a 7 and I am very pleased with the fit. They motivate me to mow the grass. I love colorful things.

I wanted these as my yard and barn shoes. I've previously had muck boots.  These are much more light weight and definitely cuter.  I've been wearing about a month and they haven't broken down yet.  I think because they are not so rigid that the sole is a little harder to knock the mud out of.  If you won't be walking in mud, no problem.  They will be hot in the summer but that's to be expected.  Usually with my previous shoes made of neoprene I'd get cracks in the toes and these are made differently so I hope that doesn't happen.  They are comfortable.  I have a regular foot, not wide or narrow.

...These just came the other day and tried them on today.  I also ordered the inserts that adjust the size a half size down, e.g. I bought a 9 and wear an 8.5.  I first tried them on w/o the insert and I was able to step into the shoe.  The arch was a little off for me and while I could step into them the heel was very loose and my heel tended to come out of shoe when I walked.  Then I tried them with the insert.  It did improve the heel experience in that the shoe didn't slip like it did w/o them, however, now I could not step into them w/o using a shoe horn which for me, defeats their purpose as being a quick on and off shoe for the yard.  So, I am returning them.  I should point out that I have some arthritis in my feet and am not that limber, so others may have a different experience.  They did seem to be very well made and I believe, are made in the United States which is great!
Very classy and colorful gardening shoe. I get compliments on these shoes every time I wear them. They are nice and warm too.
Love my new garden shoes.  So much more comfortable than my old ones and much prettier. My chickens love the bright color.

I had several pairs over the years for gardening.  I decided I needed some logical shoes for walking the dog at night, in the dog park during the day, and the rainy night walks.  These are my go to slip on shoe.  I now use them before and after my cycling shoes.  They slip on quick, comfortable, and look good.  I live in a very bi dog loving community and every one envies the sloggers with dog prints!Received shoes on time.
I wear a size 8 1/2 or 9 in sneakers and a 8 in dress shoes.  I ordered a 9 and thought they might be a litle too big after reading the reviews but they are not.  Very easy to clean too.  Love them!

These are great, very comfortable and extremely well made.  Very much worth the price.About the sizing - I am a size 7 1/2, and I deliberated for a long time about whether to get the 7 or the 8.  I really didn't want to spend the extra money on the half-size insoles.  I still do wish the shoes themselves came in half sizes... But I ended up buying the 7 and it has worked out well.  Since they are for gardening and yard work I am usually wearing light socks or even no socks.  Also, the rubber upper is very stretchy. So the 7's actually don't feel too tight at all.  I think the 8's would be too big.
summary: Love them!  Also my 2 cents on the sizing discussion

reviewText: These are the best gardening shoes I've ever owned.  They are comfortable and the mud and clay just rinses off easily.  When these wear out, I'll buy another pair.  I shopped around and Amazon had the best price anywhere.  Love them!!!!
Colorful and comfortableI also bought a raincoat that matches rather well. I'm very pleased, it was a good purchase.

These shoes, which I purchased to keep my feet dry on rainy days and to wear in the garden, are simply fantastic. First day I wore them in torrential rains they were comfortable for the entire day. Haven't yet worn them in the garden but I am expecting the same results. They look good and feel great.

I've had my pair of sloggers for multiple years.  The only thng I've had to replace is the insole, and I opt for a more comfortable gel insert anyway.  These have been through mud, snow, and everything in between.  I consider this a great purchase.
I love my new garden shoes.  They have lots of support and clean very easy (I hose them off when they get dirty).  I like them so much I ordered a pair of boots.  I also love the colors.

reviewText: I really love my sloggers. All the children from school noticed my shoes and loved it. it's comfort and I was really happy with it because my big toe was getting burnt by the hot water that I use to clean. I would recommend this shoe to others.
I love slipping these on to go do a quick task in the garden or for a whole day of work in the garden. They are comfy. I wear them without socks, and so far I have no complaints.

very stylish - pleased with purchase.  This was a gift on her Amazon wish list.  Good craftsmanship.  So easy to send as a present.

Very happy with this purchase! Very well made and comfortable to wear. I use them while gardening and walking the property. They can get dirty and are easy to clean. They are a bit narrow so you may need to size up! I think they are meant to fit snug on the foot. Definitely recommend!

Great for walking dogs, but they are too wide, need to make in varied widths, Would buy this product again.

These are the most comfortable garden shoes I've had!  I normally wear 8.5, but as other reviewers suggested bought the 9's.  I was tempted to get the inserts but decided to give it a try first and found that I didn't need them.  Love the fun print, as well.
I had moles before but my ankles kept slipping out of my shoes. These are perfect-easy to slip on and off and easy to hose down!

For warm weather gardening, I need garden shoes that are easy to put on and take off, easy to clean, and comfortable.  I tried Crocs but I finally had to admit that they were not doing the job for me.  I have lots of pine straw in the yard and kept getting bits and pieces caught in the air holes in the Crocs; also, my feet just got dirty with all the dirt and mud coming in through the holes. Additionally, I had some trouble getting the Crocs off quickly with the strap getting caught on my heel.  So, I knew that I needed to try something new.  Based on the reviews for these Sloggers, I ordered a pair that I have been using now for several weeks.  They have solved my problems because they do not have air holes...no pine straw getting caught or sticking my feet, clean-er feet, easy to put on/off.  I haven't been aware of their being much hotter than the Crocs but I try to garden early in the morning before the summer heat settles in for the day.My only reservation is that for some climbing up/down a few hilly places in my yard, the Sloggers slip a bit but I'm learning how to wear them safely.
Very very comfortable, easy to slide on but fits secure around the foot.  Love to wear them even just around the house as well as out on a rainy day.  Not just a garden shoe.

I have been wearing sloggers for a few years now and they are great for 3 seasons here in Pa.  Great for walking the dog or feeding the critters in the early am dew or rain..,don't hesitate to try a pair...also go great with jeans for casual outings

reviewText: After my dogs made a meal out of my last pair of garden clogs (grrrrrr), I went searching for a replacement pair. And truthfully,  I wanted a pair that fit my size 7 1/2 (wide) feet (with a high arch) a bit better, so I didn't return to the original source. I found 'em! After spending the better part of this past weekend in my garden, wearing my new Sloggers, I can attest that they truly are "all-day-comfort(able)"! I ordered the size 8 (as the sizing chart recommended going up to the new whole size) and they fit perfectly!  I did wear a pair of light anklet-type socks, but that was more because of the chill in the air than anything. I sloshed through some muddy areas (we've had lots of snow-melt lately) without getting my feet wet, and afterwards, with a good wipe down, my Sloggers look good as new! Of course, I had to order the pair with the paw prints (!), but I've warned my dogs that these are off limits! (And, I've put them on a shelf to remove the temptation...:-) Hooray, Sloggers! These are a winner!!

If the streets are just wet, these are nice to wear outside to save my good shoes from getting wet.  I do wish I had bought just a plain black pair, as I feel a little conspicuous in the wild colors.  I am having a bout with heel spurs, but they won't work if I am having more than an ordinary flareup because they ride quite high on the heel.  I have had an old pair purchased at a local hardware store, and they are showing no signs of wearing out.
I am waiting for spring to start the garden and will see how they work in the dirt/mud environment. They fit fine and seem like they will be OK.
summary: Fit good and look good but we'll see....

reviewText: They have great traction, are water proof and very cute! Have gotten many compliments on them..Am going to buy another pair!

These are cute rain shoes, and the price is great for the overall quality, although the seams on the tops are obvious, and they do look like plastic - but these are cheap/inexpensive shoes... The insole is comfy with good arch support, and the bottom is made of sturdy, thick material with good treads. The shape of the shoe fits well with a roomy toe box, but the stretchy fabric around the entire circumference of the opening is too loose, causing them to slide off the heel; a smaller size would be too short. As reviewers have said,  the back of the shoe is lower than most shoes, and they feel more like clogs than shoes. The manufacturer should raise the back of the heel area and shape it to better fit the heel so that it doesn't slide.I like that the print on the pair is asymmetrical instead of having both shoes mirror-imaged. My pair has disappointing color & pattern arrangement: not enough orange for my liking, and then only on the sides and back; there seems to be much more black than in the pattern of the shoe shown on the screen. They're still cute though.The shoes slip on and off easily - off course, because they're too loose around the opening! The little ledges on the heels are nice to step on to remove the shoes without using your hands - clever idea; however, because they're so loose you don't need to step on the ledge to remove them.I would really love to give these a 5 star review, but since shoes need to fit properly for comfort and safety, and because these slip along the heels I just can't. If the manufacturer would make them to fit properly and safely I would. I can only wear these around the apartment complex to check for mail and for trips to the dumpster, etc., and do quick errands via car with them.Being made in the U.S.A. is a positive. Thank you to the manufacturer for not going overseas!Note: On the following day I received my pair of Bogs Rue Gum Sole rain shoes and love them. They fit beautifully, are well made, and don't slide on the heel, and are made for a wide range of temperatures from 85 degrees F. to sub-0 F.. I wore them in the house for hours, and didn't want to take them off. Although normally the Bogs Rue  cost  more than three times  the price of these Sloggers, I was able to catch a pair for only $25.06!
summary: Would get 5 stars if they didn't slip on heels

I had a broken tailbone that never healed properly, and as a consequence, when I stand still for any length of time, my tailbone and lower back throb and the muscles seize up. I didn't experience this at all in these shoes; in fact they allowed me to stand still in comfort for a much longer amount of time than any other shoes I have! I've tried Shape-Ups and MBTs that claim to offer back pain relief, and these simple shoes beat both of them.I'd definitely recommend Sloggers! They work well inside, too ... reviewText: I was concerned at first with how thin they are but very warm n comfortable even in the snow. Love the lip on heel for hand free on and off!

As these shoes described to be for "Rain and Garden" shoes with all day comfort, that is what I thought I would get from these shoes.  And the fact that they are made in the USA is what put the final decision for me to purchase 2 pairs of these shoes.  It is so terribly unfortunate that this is one of the worst purchase decisions I have ever made but how was I to know these shoes are neither for gardening nor rain, unless when it is raining, you prefer wearing shoes that fill with water AND have no way to drain.  That's right!! That "all day comfort" consists of your feet sitting in water the entire time you wear them;  you literally "slosh" when you walk because your shoes are full of water.  Maybe they would make a better planter...but no, the plants would suffocate from lack of air and drainage.  It's a shame I cannot have faith in product made in the USA.  Please DO NOT WASTE YOUR HARD EARNED MONEY on the worst pair of gardening shoes ever invented - I don't know what they were made for, in fact.  If you want shoes for gardening or to keep your feet dry/protected from rain, THESE SHOES ARE NOT FOR YOU.  They literally fill with water and unless you remove the shoe and empty the water,  you will have plastic material (that cannot breath) around your foot that is filled with water that remains in the shoe for as long as you wear them.  With every sincerity, I am in no way exaggerating.  Although they are more expensive, stick with the Lewis Clark.  They may not have cute, fancy designs but they are a fantastic garden shoe that have a mesh material allowing the shoe to constantly drain from any water that may get in it and your feet to breath and truly stay comfortable, rather than keeping your feet water logged and miserable the longer you wear a Slogger. In addition, the sole on the Lewis & Clark's will last a life time with a fantastic grip; UNLIKE the Sloggers.  It's disgusting to have bought such a pitiful, misrepresented product.
summary: If you are looking for a good gardening or rain shoe - RUN AWAY FROM THE SLOGGERS - RUN AND NEVER LOOK BACK

reviewText: These are great.  I wear them when I walk my dogs near a golf course on wet grass.  I used to have some made by Sperry Topsider and they were $80!  These are better.  They are really comfortable for a mile walk.
These shoes are just what I was wanting for working in the yard or garden. I have even worn them to work, but I put in better cushion soles since I stand a lot of the shift.

The sloggers are a little large on me by I have really narrow feet.  I have placed and insert in them and they work well.  They are a little heavier than I would have liked, but all in all I am pleased.

I absolutely love this shoe.  They are great for taking dogs out in the back yard in all kinds of weather. Fit fine in summer and if they feel too small when socks are needed come cold weather, I'll order a larger pair.  They are surprisingly comfortable.  I also like the pattern. They are fun!  Recommend highly!
I needed these for walks with my dog after times when it has rained or even in the rain keeps my feet dry.

I chose these Sloggers because I'd seen and tried them on at Tractor Supply.  The provide great support and the soles are firm enough to use on shovels.  The liner does come out, but its not washable and its hot so my feet sweat.  Also, they only come in whole sizes so they slip a little on my heels, but I don't think socks would fit.
summary: Cute but still looking for the perfect gardening shoe...

reviewText: great for gardening and running to the hardware store or nursery, I just hose them off when I am done and throw them in a wire bin outside
It's hard buying shoes for somebody with them not seeing or trying on but these were an instant hit!  To a owner of bogs and every other type of shoe imaginable.

I so love this shoe. I wear them everyday to walk my dog and all day on rainy days. Fit is a little loose but that's with thin socks I normally wear a 7 1/2 or 8 in regular shoes. My feet are always dry and warm when I take the dog out and the mud rinses right off so happy with this shoe. I was even happier to see that they are MADE IN THE USA and quality made.The price is super great too.

Have no problem with these clogs. I do wonder though why all garden shoes have the bottoms like this. If you do set in stuff, say old figs, persimmons, etc, then they get stuck on the bottom of the shoes. I still have to say I love the shoes cause they're so cute, even for a size 9. I'm sure if they were smooth on the bottom then you would be slipping and a sliding. Can't have it all!!

These rain shoes arrived and are so cute.  I am very upset because they are just too big all the way around.  I read reviews and it said they run short and I take a half size so I ordered up.  Unfortunately, my foot is narrow and it would not have mattered going down or up a size, they would have been too wide.  These rain shoes are a little heavy so they just slipped right off my feet.  I hate that they don't fit because they are so cute and I love the design that I ordered.  Unless you have a pretty narrow foot, I would not hesitate to buy these cute shoes!
I love these shoes.  They fit well and keep my feet dry.  They are easy to spray off and clean.  Great purchase.

I can't stand a certain kind of garden shoe. These are terrific, very comfortable for all day wear, but do wear them with socks.  I don't like the feel of the shoe barefoot.  I wear them daily for running some errands in farm land.

I have purchased Sloggers twice before but they were the clog style. I especially like these garden shoes because they cover my entire foot, have good traction and they are very comfortable. The only negative comment I have is that the cushioned insoles squeak when walking but it is not a problem. I wear them everyday for light gardening and when I sweep debris from walkways, driveway, etc.. I would purchase these garden shoes again and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a good-quality, affordable garden shoe.

I did not purchase these to do gardening in, but simply for when it rains. They work! Not only are they warm, comfortable, and waterproof, but I get tons of compliments on the unique design. Also, these shoes are more than what I was expecting in that they have a very sturdy sole. I was just looking for something that would keep my feet dry in the rain, but they exceeded my desire. I will definitely be purchasing another pair in a different design.

I wear an 8 and a half, so I bought the size "8's" and they fit just fine.I love these sloggers. They are comfortable, and waterproof.  The insole is nice and soft while still giving ok support.I love the colors, the style, and that they so easily slip on and off.  They have enough tread on the bottom to keep me from slipping on most surfaces. Clean up is easy- just hose them off.The comfort band of soft squishy black material around the top of the foot opening is part of what makes these shoes super comfortable to wear, in wet environments.  These win with me!

I wear in ordinary shoes 8.5. There was so much talk about size on these reviews I was hesitant to order these cute shoes. I decided to order an 8 and see how they fit. PERFECT! good support, still good toe wiggle room. Quality rain shoes. I am very happy with the size 8 and the purchase.
This is my third pair.  They are cute and great for outdoor work.  The only negative is they are heavy.  I wear 8-1/2 and prefer sizing up to get the fit I prefer.
These shoes are so comfortable and cute too!  Great for gardening or just "slogging" around my yard.  They fit perfectly too!
Wonderful garden shoes.  When it's dewy in the morning or after a rain shower, these will keep your feet perfectly dry and comfortable.  I'll be using these on a daily basis.

Bought them for a horseshow where it was expected to rain.  They are light and waterproof and attractive.  I wore them with sox which made them more comfortable.I bought a half size larger than I usually wear and I bought the sizing liners but I did not need them as the sox did the trick.

good value for the price, good selection of colors and patterns, the back on the heel is lower than most shoes but I was expecting that so make sure the shoe fits properly, I ordered both a size 8 and a size 9 the 8 fit well, I have a wide foot and these are perfect. Do remember these are rainboots so your foot will get warm

I love these gardening shoes!  They're comfortable and colorful...very cute!  For anyone looking for gardening shoes, I highly suggest getting a pair.  There's many patterns available...take your pick!

I bought  these shoes so I do not have to wear my rain boots in light rain. They are listed as garden shoes but I wear them in public with jeans and I have received many compliments. Love them. Highly recommend.

These shoes are great for yard work - they slip easily on and off, and don't slip on wet rocks or other surfaces.While they will be fine for watering your garden or walking through a bit of mud, if you hit a large puddle you'll be sorry. The insides take a while to dry and aren't very easy to clean.The material is very sturdy, and they're pretty comfortable -  however, I wouldn't suggest wearing these out for walking long distances on pavement.
summary: Great for yard work that does not involve large amounts of water.

reviewText: these are the bomb,  I love the look, the fit is great and they keep your feet warm and dry.
These are comfortable and functional. My wife hates walking on wet grass and they are practical in that aspect. I wish they made some for men.

I love the Italian print and color! The print falls differently on each shoe as if they were artwork! The added bonus is they give support to the feet and comfortable..so far so sweet! Easy to clean, I ordered a size up as recommended in other reviews and they are a bit roomy but with socks aok....Best of All They are MADE IN THE USA!!
summary: Comfy! and Love the Italian Print & Color!

reviewText: I bought these because I have the same boots and I think they're great, so decided that the low clogs would be good for warmer weather work in the garden. They fit well, protect me feet from wet and mud, and are very comfortable. I wear orthotics, and can just take out the insole that comes with these clogs and slip in my orthotics.

Finally a waterproof shoe that fits, as close as I have found.  Tried other cute and popular brands from Zappos; great company, but I tried 4 pairs of shoes, 2 brands in 2 different sizes, and had to return them all.This pair of Sloggers is the least expensive, the most flexible and comfortable, and still really cute! Just had to insert stick-on heel grippers for a better fit.

I usually wear a 7.5 for shoes. I ordered an 8 because of previous reviews about the sizing. They fit big on my feet and I had to return them. I was dissappointed but they were super comfortable and stretchy. The quality seemed great with a thick sole. It would be best to order a size down.
Bought these for my mom to walk the dog and she loves them. If you are in between sizes, size up. :) Oh and she says they're SO comfy! PS: The pattern is funky but it's not too crazy and loud.

Love these shoes, comfortable, attractive, I wear them everywhere. I bought the size I normally wear, and they fit perfectly. I may have to buy a second pair for garden use, which is why I bought these in the first place, they just haven't made it to the garden yet, and probably won't. And I LOVE that they're MADE IN THE USA!!
These rain shoes do exactly what I expected when I started shopping for an alternative to my Bogs (my tall boots).

Size fit perfectly, sweet looking, and insoles are very comfy.  I like the convenience of slipping into to them to check my flower beds when it is wet outside. However, they do not have enough support to be able to weed a garden in them, hence 4 stars instead of 5. They are plastic, so expect to get hot feet if the sun is out, but also expect to have nice, dry feet! Won't find a better price anywhere!
I bought these for gardening, but I can envision wearing them on a rainy day. They feel great. Don't seem hot like most rubber foot ware and are true to size.
These are the best!! And the price this seller has them for is the lowest! I use these when gardening and they stand up to everything!! I wear a size 9 and that's what I ordered. They fit perfect.

I have tried these shoes out by wearing them all day to both jobs. I have not had any problems with them. They also passed the "muck" test.. After a foot of snow and then several days of rain, they did not come off my foot in the mud and muck and then rinsed right off. The best part about these garden shoes is that they are made in America!

Sloggers shoes were ordered for wear while working in flower gardens and watering and pruning shrubbery.  Theyare ideally suited for this type of outdoor use.  Also, the wear very well when walking the dog around the neighborhoodon wet days (after the rain passes).  The ease in putting them on and taking them off is also a real benefit.  I highlyrecommend this product
summary: Sloggers Women's Rain & Garden Shoes are exceptionally well made, very light weight and very comfortable to wear.

reviewText: These are just perfect for the garden.  They keep my feet warm and dry.  They also clean up easily and look spiffy as well.

Wow! I've looked for shoes to wear around the yard and garden. I just came in from wearing these after two days of rain. The yard is wet and mushy. My socks stayed dry. They are extremely comfortable to wear. I love the variety of colors and patterns. I'll be buying the boots later today! I wear a size 7 and ordered a size 7; they fit great!

I love these shoes, but wish they came in 1/2 sizes - took one star off for the lack of 1/2 sizes.  I use an insert, but they are a bit long, which inserts would not remedy. So, they slip in the ankle a bit, but the edges in these shoes are lined, so that helps prevent pain on my skin when they slip.  I also have the ankle boots, which are not lined at the edges, and they rub my skin and cause discomfort.  I would buy these again but not the ankle boots again. Love the playful designs and colors, though!
summary: Love these, only wish they came in 1/2 sizes

reviewText: Bought them for my wife and was surprised at how much she loves them.  She wears them to Curves sometimes and comes back telling how the other women like them.

I wear an 8.5 with a high instep so I sized up to a 9.  The shoes stay on my feet and are light, flexible, and comfy.I have problems with plantar fasciitis, so I stuck someDr Scholl's arch supportsunder the insole.  The shoes and the arch supports are playing very nicely together, so now I can wear the shoes all day without fear of foot pain.
summary: Can customize with stick-on arch supports

reviewText: These garden shoes are super cute.  Well made.  True to size.  Perfect for gardening or rainy days.  Surprisingly, they are very comfortable, too!

They are funky, fun and functional.  I like it that they are light weight and comfortable.  The only draw back to them is that when I'm gardening on a slope, they slip off my feet.  Even with that drawback, I would buy them again.

I need a pair of shoes that I can put on anytime of the year, to go to the mail box, or greet someone who comes to our home, since we live in the Pacific Northwest and it rains a lot.  These are so comfortable.  I am thinking about another pair.  I highly reccommend these.
The Sloggers are great!  I can work in the garden and just hose them down.  They are also good for just every day wear. They are so comfortable they are like wearing slippers.
My sloggers do just what I hoped they'd do. They are more comfortable than I expected and they are easy to slip on and off. Plus, they are cute.
They do what they're supposed to do and are very comfortable. Great for walking n the rain. We have thick sticky soil, so a special garden shoe really helps, because they wash off very nicely
Although I haven't had the opportunity to really put them to the test, I am impressed so far. They fit well and seem sturdy.
I wasn't sure when I ordered these if I would like them, I wear them all the time I am in my yard even when not gardening very comfortable
My sloggers are so cute and fit perfect. They say all-day- comfort and it's true, I bought these to wear when working in my garden, but I have found myself wearing them everyday. Just a fun shoe!
I had heard about these from my Master Gardening class. They fit great and are very comfortable for working in the yard.

Really like this shoe.  The color and pattern is great and they are comfortable to wear.  I slip them on to take my dog out in the dewy mornings and on rainy days. Also, wear them when I am gardening. Would have given 5 stars except that they sometimes make a funny sound when I'm walking - like a fart.  As strange as it is, it does not bother me enough to not wear them.  It might if I was wearing them in public.
These shoes are perfect for walking the dog in the morning and evening dew and on rainy days.  Excellent quality and perfect fit.
Comfortable enough for long dog walk in rain with rather deep puddles on street crossings. Plus they are better looking than the "barn boot" type low rubber boots.
Cute and idea great but very large on heel. Will not stay on my foot when I walk. To go down a half size would make them to short in the toe.
summary: Cute and idea great but very large on heel

reviewText: I needed a waterproof shoe for rainy and snowy days. I got these in black so they could be worn with anything. I wear them anytime there is precipitation. They are comfortable enough to wear all day. Now I'm tempted to get a pair in a cute pattern for spring. I thought the price was very reasonable. I highly recommend the Sloggers.

I love these garden clogs, hard to imagine a rubber clog could look so pretty! I ordered my regular size 8 and they fit perfectly so don't order a size up, they are comfortable too! I plan to buy these as gifts for my garden "buddies"
summary: You will love these yard clogs!

reviewText: I wear an 8 and shoe was true to size.  Very comfortable shoe and goes well with any outfit.  I love the insoles.  I plan on purchasing a few more pairs soon.  Great selection of colors...something for every personality!
summary: Got the ankle boots and these and love them both.

reviewText: I like the style, variety of colors - prints/solids and it appears to be made well made (won't fall apart after a short time).  However, the pair that I received is a little larger on the L side, so my L heel slips out while walking.  Interestingly my L foot is ~1/2 size larger than my R foot, so this time, my L foot was not happy, but my R foot was happpy... :-).  Also, the sole in the L shoe felt a little thinner on the front L side compared to the R side, so I put in a Dr. Scholl's air pillo insole on the L and it appeared to solve both issues that I had with the L shoe.
I keep these outside the door in the rainy season, and pop into them when headed outdoors.  Washing the car or feeding the horses, they're very handy.
summary: Easy to slip on and off

reviewText: perfect to slide on and go out anywhere, store, yard, ect.. were a little loose, but used the insole for perfect fit
I ended up sending mine back because they run smaller than my shoe size. Have not reordered yet. Like the looks of them and  they seem to be well made.
These are adorable and so comfortable. I plan to wear them for my job grooming dogs. I wish the pawprints were a little more clear, it is hard to see what they are.

These are much more significant than I expected.  They are actually a little on the heavy side due to the serious soles they have!  They're super nice.  I bought these for my Mom who wears a size 8.  I normally wear an 8 1/2, but I tried them on and they fit me fine - very comfortable!  I see what people are referring to about the back of the heel.  It's not that they sit too low on the heel, but rather there is too much space between the back of the shoe and the back of my heel so they feel like they slip off when walking.  I'm going to suggest to my Mom to put heel stickers in the back, if needed.  This is an easy fix to a super great, high quality, inexpensive gardening shoe.  The color I got was blue tulip.  I looked on another site for a picture since Amazon only had the thumbnail size, and they looked very light blue.  In reality they are more like a bright true blue with a dark blue and pink pattern.  They're very pretty even though they aren't the color I expected.
Love these especially for walking the dog with all the rain we had!  I keep them by the door to slip on for errands and mail retrieval.  Very comfortable and attractive.
Great for working in the garden. My feet stay dry. Worked especially well when our basement got flooded this fall. They kept my feet warm and dry during the clean up.
Haven't had an opportunity to wear these boots, but they are just what I was looking for.  Very cute and the price is more than fair..
Fun and comfortable, holding up well so far. Would buy again and recommend to friends. Hope they go on sale soon!

I am in love with these garden shoes. I am delighted with how thick the sole is, no worries when shoveling the dirt or cutting the grass. I just put the inserts in to the washing machine and they washed up perfect, I am letting them air dry before reinserting them into my sloggers!!

A friend of mine got a pair of sloggers and I loved the look so I ordered a pair.  They are so comfortable and can be worn for anything.  Two of the little boys in a after school program I work on told me how cool they were.
These are the most comfortable shoes!  Spent hours gardening yesterday and my soles weren't burning.  Received compliments on the design.  Will be ordering another pair soon.

I walk a dog early in the morning and my runners always get really wet in the morning dew so these waterproof clogs have proved to be perfect. They look like something my granny might have worn but it beats having wet feet - just don't try to run for the No 30 bus in them ;)

A friend told me about these shoes.  I find them to be very comfortable.  Quick and easy to get on.  I walk the dog with in wet weather.I bought a pair for my cousin's wife because I like them so much.

Got these initially as garden shoes as advertised, but ordered 3 more pairs to wear at work. Love, love the funky designs and comfort to match,  and the frequent compliments from staff and patients. I prefer these over my Dansko clogs any day, and what a bonus that they cost about 1/5 as much. These are great to wear with my nice variety of colored scrub sets. I usually wear a 7 or 7.5 medium and read hundreds of reviews before deciding to order a size 7 rather than going up a size as many recommended. For me, this decision was best as they fit like a glove and feel just right. I also really like the low height of the heel and cushiness as the Dansko's feel too high and hard. Kudo's!!!
summary: For all day, every day comfort!!

reviewText: I purchased a pair of Sloggers-a garden shoe to wear in Alaska in the winter.  They worked perfectly and I did not slip or slide even in the worst of slippery conditions.  I love these Sloggers.  They are great for more tnan gardening!Sloggers 5102BK08 Women's Midsummer Garden Shoe, Size-8, Black

Love the pattern, love to wear them around. They do an excellent job keeping my feet dry, I often forget that I have them on. They are offered only in whole sizes, though, so for my half size feet, they are large. I highly recommend that you order the fit adjusting insole they offer....it makes the shoes fit much better.

These are awesome rain shoes, especially for the price. The rubber is soft and pliable, but waterproof. I was excited about that, as many rain boots are made of very hard rubber/plastic that make it difficult to move your foot. These flex easily when you walk. The soles have a high arch that feels more substantial and supportive than most shoes (and according to a local shoe store owner, would allow you to add a support insert), and the pattern is nice. I went into a high-end shoe store while wearing these, and the owner wanted to know where I got them and how much I paid for them. She was excited and shocked when I told her they were about $25 on Amazon!
summary: Great rain shoes for the price - attractive, comfortable, and utilitarian

reviewText: I originally bought them for gardening, but they are so comfortable I wear them on the weekends.  They are great on a rainey day.  The tread on the bottom allows you to walk on wet surfaces with no slipping.  Great to wear any time of year.

These are great garden shoes!! They fit maybe 1/4 - 1/2 size large, but I would not personally order down. Since they are rubber and your feet cant breathe, they may swell and make the shoes uncomfortable. I wore them for over 8 hrs today and the sides of my feet (at the pinky toe bone) was a bit sore, but not so much that I couldnt work. Easy on and off. Especially for short breaks when you go into the house. You dont have to track dirt everywhere. Just bang them on the ground or hose them off to remove mud (i prefer banging them on the ground after the mud has dried so they dont get all wet inside and i can put them right back on the next day.)
I originally got this for the garden but found them to be a great walking in the rain shoe.  They have a pretty nice arch support so you can literally wear them for hours.

Got my shoes today.  I usually wear a 7-1/2, but after reading some of the reviews I ordered a size 7.  They fit great with a little pair of socks.  Just a tiny bit loose in the heel, but my foot does not come out of the shoe.  I really like them and plan on wearing them this summer in the garden and the chicken coop!

I ordered these shoes prior to a trip to Vancouver, BC and Alaska. They were/are perfect. Everyone wanted to know where I got the wonderful red shoes. My feet never bothered me even after doing a good deal of walking and of course, they stayed dry!

A high school classmate introduced me to Sloggers about three years ago during a rainy day on the coast of NC. I now have three pairs fall, winter and spring...absolutely love them!!!!!!!!!  They are warm and keep you dry in this cold, bitter weather in Kentucky with thick socks or tights. A very good buy!! Do order a size up. I usually wear an 8.5 I always order a 9 and they are perfect.

I absolutely love these!  I am a confirmed wearer of flip-flops, but our new home simply has too many stickers and oak leaves (ouch!).  I needed something I could wear through deep oak fallouts and deep dirt without having black feet every time I set foot outside.  These are great!  I love that my feet stay dry and clean even in my wet gardens.  I hose them off and the insoles easily come out for cleaning.  The designs are a bit gaudy for my taste, but kinda cute and growing on me.  They are waterproof shoes and as such, they don't breath as well as other shoes, but I expected that and it's the price you pay for waterproof.  They are COMPFORTABLE.  I can wear them all day long with no foot pain at all and I'm a runner, so this is HUGE for me.  I prefer to wear them without socks (that flip-flop, barefoot person thing, I guess).  Looking forward to getting the ankle-high ones for winter gardening.
these shoes are very cute and comfortable. A good value for the money. I would suggest going down 1/2 size as they run a little large.

I have worn my new Sloggers numerous times and they are wonderful.  I have even worn them when the weather was sunny and dry.  They are very comfortable, easy to slip them on and off and very stylish too.  I often wear them on my walk through the woods with my dog.  They keep my feet dry and comfy.  Love my Sloggers. Taki
Sloggers are a fabulous looking footwear with extreme comfort! I highly recommend these for work, gardening or anything!!  A must have!

Color, fit, craftmanship all absolutely wonderful.  Read the information regarding fit from the manufacturer it is dead on, with that info ordered the appropriate size and have been nothing but happy!

These are great for slipping off and on.  I bought this pair for when I am visiting other farms.  I can easily clean them with bleach so I don't track germs from one place to another.  They are comfortable and can be worn without socks in the summer or with a thin pair in the winter.
These shoes are exactly what I was looking for.  They slip on quickly and are comfortable! They are great looking and can be worn to the chicken coop, mailbox or into town.
I brought a pair of these from a store and I had to have another pair so I purchased these and I wear them faithfully and I continually get compliments.

Yes, it's hard to find the perfect fit and cute as well... but these not only were that, but also helped with water nor dirt not getting my shoes when I do gardening; plus they are very comfortable. Can't wait to by my 2nd pair.

I enjoy the dog walks in the morning or rainy times because I'm not coming back in with soggy shoes now.  I wish they came in half sizes as I really needed a 6 1/2 instead of a 7 but the positive outweighs the negative for me.
Super comfortable shoes for running in and out of the house with .. good fit and fun colours! No returns here!
Great shoes for gardening or just wearing around. Fit perfectly. Very comfortable and they look very stylish. I would recommend these to others.
Love these garden shoes! They're cut and really comfortable. The price was really affordable too. I'd highly recommend them to any serious gardener.

I got these for a cheap replacement for a pair of Muckers that I wore out. They have some great prints to choose from but the whole sizing thing is just unfortunate. I had the same problem with my Muckers. I have a thin narrow foot size 9 1/2. The shoes only come in whole sizes so I ordered a 10 and the 1/2 size inserts. Unfortunately the foot entry hole is so big around that my foot is still swimming around in all the extra room. I also added a set of heel grippers hoping to take up some of the extra space in the back but the heel area is pretty much straight up and down and doesn't cup in at the ankle to hold your heel from slipping up and down. I bought two pairs after reading all the reviews and they are both still sitting in the box. Not sure what to do to take up all the extra interior room of the shoe itself. Eat a lot of salt so my feet swell I guess...
What's great gardening shoe! No more wet feet from the clogs I had. Love the funky colors and patterns! Brightens my gardening days!

I love this for a gardening shoe.  I wear a 6.5 so as directed I bought the 7.  Shoe was so big I had to put in two of the Sloggers half sizers.  My heal still rises up when walking.  I wear scrubs to work and had planned to wear these but it is too annoying to walk in all day.  Would have been better to return for size 6.UPDATE:  Received comment from president David Hoyt of Sloggers.  I was sent a size 6 slogger shoes at no charge!!!  I can wear the size 6 shoe without socks and it works perfectly.  I am extremely pleased at the personal service from the president of the company.  I will proudly wear the shoes to work with scrubs and highly recommend Sloggers.
Beautiful shoes! Right on for size! Cleanable and attractive.Comfortable as well.I have several pairs of all different colors
These are wonderful, comfortable, and true to size.  Perfect for leaving by my back door for when I work in the yard or garden.  Cute enough to wear out on a rainy day.
Very comfortable slip on shoe to walk the dogs in during our rainy season. I enjoy the beautiful blue color including the pawprint design.

I find these garden shoes to be very comfortable.  As noted in other reviews, they do slide up and down on the heel a bit but the lining is soft so not irritating and I don't plan to walk miles in these shoes.  I tried the half size inserts but they made the shoes less comfortable.  Seem to have good traction and cute.

Bought it as a Christmas gift.  Couldn't decide between the blue or the black pair.  I went with the blue.  My gift was a hit.  My friend absolutely loved them.  Looking forward to purchasing a pair for myself.

We've had a rainy summer and I was tired of wet feet when I went out for chores.  These shoes keep me dry.  They are MADE IN THE USA  which was a big selling point for me.  They are well made and durable.  Only complaint  I have is that they run about a half size too big.  I will definitely purchase again.
LOVE THEM

These garden shoes are made heavy duty, they have a great tread & are very comfortable with or without socks! I have had a lot of compliments on them since I wear them to town & everything. Very stylish looking. I got a great deal on them threw amazon & had free shipping. Shipping was pretty slow but all & all I am very happy.
So comfortable I wish I could wear them everywhere...plus cute! I did buy size up as everyone recommended, thanks.Quality material did not stink like rubber products from China.
I love these shoes very much they are very comfortable and well made for the price  I'm glad got them
great fit, price was nice too. I wear them all the time on the farmthey stay right at my front door. easy on,easy off

Clogs are very comfortable.  Ordered sz. 8 for my 7 1/2 wide feet and the fit is perfect.  Easy slip-on, keep feet warm and dry.  The thick sole is flexible, keeps the cold from the pavement/ground out.  Great for wet, winter days of dog walking.  No air venting, so your feet may sweat.  Get socks that wick away moisture if you intend to wear them long.

I bought these and a pair of the boots to match , and one or the other is on my feet every time I go outside.  They are so easy to slip off and on and so far durable. I wear them in the garden, woods, meadows and streams, and they are sturdy enough to keep my feet well protected and dry. My daughters love them too (they make great gifts).  High quality product for the cost. I wear a 6 1/2 shoe, and the size 7 works perfectly for me...just slightly large so easy to get on and off. Definitely recommend. No problems with the purchasing or delivery.
Fun to wear but the print on the right and left shoe does not match.  Would be GREAT if they matched the print!

Perfect for working out in the garden and flower beds.  They are comfortable and keep my feet clean and dry.  Not the most attractive shoes on the planet, but definitely serve their purpose in the garden.  The only fault that I can find with them is the noises they make when I walk.  But that has been a source of entertainment and a few laughs!  :)
These look great and are very comfy! I should have got a half size smaller than my normal shoe since it is a slip on, but otherwise well made in the good ole USA!:)

These rain boots are exactly what I was looking for.  The parking lot at our office is not paved and during the rainy season you need some sort of rain boot.  These boots are easy on and easy off which is what I was looking for at my age.  I did not want to fight with a lace up boot any more.  They appear to be a quality product and I am surre I will get years of use from them.

I first saw these at the Texas State Fair for a much higher price. They were so comfortable, with a great arch support. Luckily, i resisted temptation and bought them from Amazon instead for a lot less money. I wear them a lot with jeans even when it isn't raining. People complement me on the fun shoes.

reviewText: Nice pair of garden shoes! These Sloggers are replacing my 20 yr. old pair. I hope these last that long! Nice design and they're very comfortable. More comfortable than my old pair!
Used to fall back on Crocs in wet weather, however they have a tendency to be slick on some surfaces. These are very comfortable, great traction and look better then crocs!
summary: My new favorite for wet weather

reviewText: I bought these as a gift for my sister in law.  She and my brother have planted their first garden this year and, well, as any gardener knows, she needed a pair of Gardening Shoes.  She got them this weekend and hasn't taken them off yet.  Very comfortable and they look great.  Oh, and the fact that they're made in the USA is another BONUS!

I've seen some posts about the sizes running small - I don't agree with that.  I normally wear a size 7, ordered a size 7 and it fit perfect.  They are very comfortable too.  Sometimes I forget to take them off when I'm doing busy work around the house.  I would buy these again for sure - my new fave.  Good quality and delivers as advertised.

These shoes do a good job keeping your feet dry while walking in wet grass.  Does NOT supply good traction, though, so it is not recommended for hiking.  Your feet will sweat in these shoes so wear absorbent socks. The exterior while shiny and smooth, will crack in about 6 months and water will seep through.  Shoes will not stay on when walking in mud.

I have an old pair of these and I loved them. Still the most comfortable shoe even though it has faded so I thought I would seek out a new pair to have as back up. Well, they are just okay.  They must have changed the design. The heel part is annoying as it is higher than the first pair, and the fabric around the top is unnecessary and uncomfortable. Doesn't seem as cushy either.  The original pair had a satin finish and these are really shiny.

I bought a pair for my very youthful, energetic 80 yr old Mom, and I for different reasons.  My mom is doing extensive landscaping, and these sloggers serves her needs nicely.  Her landscape is currently very muddy, (due to LOTS of rain here in Ohio) and she loves her sloggers because they are comfortable,  warm, keeps her feet clean, and dry while literally walking in mud.  She is a sz 7.5 Narrow, and a sz 8 fits her fine.  I bought the sloggers for myself for rain days, gardening, and dog parks.  I am a sz 8, and the size 8 fits me just fine.  I appreciate a certain level of comfort also, and these sloggers fit the bill. To sum it up these are  a good value for the money.  For once I feel I found a descent quality R & G shoe without paying double the price. For the Sloggers, different prices, depending on the design slogger shoe you choose.  I purchased the blue -PAW sloggers, the PAW is pretty much well blended, basically looks like a nice blue shoe. (looks just like the picture) Has good traction on the sole, and the shoes clean up very nicely.  Definitely recommend.

I bought this garden shoe for my wife. She has a great deal of difficulty finding comfortable shoes of any sort. Nevertheless, when I saw this shoe, I bought a pair for her to try.  Initially, she didn't even want to try them on, but she thought them attractive for yard work and stuck her feet into them.  She looked at me and said "I don't believe it."  "What" says I.  She said "They're great, very comfortable!  She has been using them ever since and finds them good in the yard.

I got these as a gift for my grandmother who is into gardening.  She usually comes inside with wet shoes and so I figured she needed some of these to keep her feet dry when she is working outside.  I ordered a size up because of the reviews I read and they fit her perfectly.  She said they are so comfy she wants to wear them everywhere.  I recommend.

Pretty multi-colored design, fits well and keeps the feet dry.  I really like the product and after looking at other suppliers, your price was in our range; Also, you had the right size.  The fast delivery was appreciated.  Thanks for carrying this shoe.

I love them,good fit,very comfortable and I have 2 pairs ,which will last for a long time . Thank you again for your generosity in allowing me to keep the 2nd. pair ,free of charge. very much appreciated.
The back of the shoe is not high enough. Making the shoe a little unbearable to wear. Also, allowing water  to enter in to the back of the shoe.
I bought these last year for the wife as a gift.  They have held up well and have become her favorite shoe for her morning rituals in the garden.I would buy again!
They are nice and comfortable sloggers. After I ordered them online I found a local store who sold them and a gardening friend when to buy a pair.
Love the clogs....I leave them on the back porch and use them daily when I garden.  Love the varieties too.

These are great for muddy drive ways!  They are a SHOE and not a boot and I realize that every time I think I can make a trip into the cow lot....that's not what these are for, way too low!  One review mentioned that they slip when you walk, and I agree they do some even though the size feels right, but for some reason the slipping factor hasn't bothered me at all.  As I said, I've worn them into mucky cow lots and they haven't slipped off or even had me worried they would.  I do love that I can slip them on with or without socks very easily, sometimes without even bending over so that's fast!  I wore them some in the snow...again, not what these were meant for obviously; one trip around the lot and my feet were ice!  So don't buy them intending to use them in all seasons!
I love these shoes!  they fit true to size, have good arch support AND are pretty!  Oh yeah,  Made in the USA!!!

Priced Sloggers at my local garden center and, with tax, they cost twice as much as Amazon.  I have the boot version of this shoe and recommend wearing a sock for serious gardening.  For that reason, I went up one size (whole sizes only, so 1/2 sizes should size up to the next whole size).  The "clog" version I use for light outside work and wear barefooted.  For these, I ordered my usual size.  The sole is exactly the same on both styles and is substantial enough for digging.  They are comfortable enough to wear all day.  You could order a solid color if you prefer, but why not get a print!  Your neighbors will comment, "How CUTE are your gardening shoes!"  Seriously, GET THESE.
I love these shoes - my second pair!!  I am most pleased with what I received and the quality of the item.
Ordered to walk through the pasture and in the woods in the early morning. Keeps my feet dry and is extremely comfortable. Will order again..
These SLOGGERS rain and garden shoes are perfect. They are sturdy, well made, comfortable and cute. Another big plus is that they are made in the USA! I highly recommend them.

I really like these. I like that they are water proof, skid proof, and made in the USA. I work in a hospital and thought that they would be great to have. The things that I've noticed is 1. They're not as wide as what I would normally wear bit they don't hurt 2. I would like more cushion in the sole. If I had a hospital job where I was on my feet all day, these would not suffice. I still like them though and would buy another pair....

reviewText: Good price, comfy. Long lasting. If they get wet several times, like your socks get soaked, they will mildew insidethe cloth lining. Otherwise, they are waterproof, would consider purchasing them again.

I first bought one of the gardening clogs and didn't care for them since moisture was able to access my arch via open-heel design, thus creating embarrassing 'foot farts' with each step.  I got tired of soaking my shoes some years later as the rainboot fad flooded (sorry.. had to)campus and decided a rubber shoe style was more my speed.  No.. I did not search 'rainshoes' since for some reason, though comprised of the same material, they are grossly over-priced by comparison.  I looked to the garden shoe.  Since my last slogger experience, the manufacturer went from okay to absolutely amazing.  They've redesigned the whole insert, which is such a comfortable platform for my aching feet, I started making excuses to wear them even when it's not raining.  And again, began purchasing them in duplicate, triplicate, and are now pushing them on everyone I know as gifts.  And for twenty bux???  Are you kidding me?  Seriously.  Buy the shoe.  You'll be hooked.

reviewText: I absolutely love this rain shoe. It fits well and the insole is warm and comfortable. And best of all, it is US made.
all the other sloggers fit the same but these black for me ran small

I highly recommend these and will likely return to buy rain boots.
Bought these for when the morning dew is on the ground at camp and the dog needs to go out. I would wear these shoes anywhere though! They look great (very shiny like the pic) and fit great too!!

I love these shoes. They're more comfortable than I ever expected. I wear them around the yard to do whatever I need to do. If they get wet or muddy, I just rinse them off and they look new again. RETURNED THEM COULDNT EVEN GET THEM ON. POOR FIT

love them comfortable shoes that keep my feet dry. great for the garden work and for walking the dogs in the early morning

These work very well for gardening when you do not need a high boot.  Very comfortable and excellent fit, true to my size 8 with a medium weight sock.  Slip on very easily without a sock, but just a bit of a tug with a sock.

But the one review that advised that this shoe is not for a wide foot is the one that rings most true with me.Pros:DesignQualityFlexibility (very very flexible)Con:The width of this shoe is for a narrow to typical footI don't usually wear a narrow shoe, but with these and bare feet my pinky toes hurt all day. reviewText: Sloggers are terrific for gardening.  For years I've used old tennis shoes, but they're a big hassle since I have to untie and tie again going in and out of the house as I inevitably do, plus they're not easy to clean when they're encrusted with mud.  Not to mention, I hate the feel of wet tennis shoes.  It finally occurred to me that I need something waterproof that I can just slip on, so naturally I turned to Amazon.  I found the Sloggers right away and based on good reviews ordered a pair.  Well, they fit great (ordered in my usual size 8), even have some arch support.  Nice and roomy in the toe.  So easy just to slip on and off, super easy to hose clean and they dry quickly (take the insole out to dry).  I ordered a second pair so that I always have one dry pair ready to use.  Very pleased.  Thanks Amazon, you came through again! And thanks, Sloggers, for a product that actually works!

I love my Sloggers.  They are so comfortable with some support too.  The soles are perfect with ridges.  They come in cool colors.  I have a bone spur on top of my big toe and many shoes are painful.  And if they get dirty you just wash them off quickly.  Great for doing errands in.  It's a "Yes".
Good for gardening or a quick run for errands out in the rain - I got a pair for my Mom and myself. Great price, very cute.

I have worn the Sloggers many times in our recent bad weather.  Also, I have worn them inside because of the comfortable instep and insole .  They have been wonderful to have as I have plantar facititis.  May order another pair.
Comfy, but grooved bottoms and mud gets stuck.  DO NOT wear them indoors or you will have mud all over.

I ordered a size 9 because that is my normal size....they were falling off my feet.  I feel a size 8 would hug my feet and not slip off.  Besides that I love them...very comfortable and great for working in the year that is now mushy.  Will update with my size 8 when I receive them.
Not as really great as I had expected.  Shoes were quite tight and not too substantial for barn work. I appreciate the waterproof.

reviewText: These are my "go to"  shoes in the morning dew and in the rain.  Super comfortalbe, easy to clean, reasonqably priced.  I think I will get a few more pair!

I bought these shoes to walk the dog at night. Few people pick up after their dogs and these shoes work well. If I step in poop, I just rinse them off and I'm good to go. They are very comfortable. Love these Sloggers!
Love these shoes.  Bought them in a 7, although my foot size is 6.5, I'm glad I bought larger than smaller.  Feet do sweat in them if you wear them for hours.

Wonderful product for the garden, comfortable to wear, easy to clean, safer than wearing sandals or flip-flops. I would buy this product again.

I purchased these shoes with great hesitation as I am seldom ever successful at purchasing shoes online.  Being I only needed these for gardening I didn't sweat it too much and ordered a size 8 which is a half size larger than my normal shoe size.  The shoes came quickly and packaged well.  I slipped them on right away and noticed they were super cute and slightly too roomy all over, which is what I expected.  A pair of socks solved that problem and stopped them from slipping at the heels, but still provided plenty of toe wiggling room, which I wanted.  After having them on my feet for just a couple of minutes without socks I know I definitely want to wear socks with these anyway so I am happy about the fit.  They are waterproof so sweaty toes are definitely on order if you wear these without socks. If you're ok with that, then by all means rock these puppies raw footed with reckless, wild abandon!  I, however, cannot stand my feet to be wet unless I am swimming or bathing and I really can't stand for them to be wet in shoes, ever!  That leads me to the reason I bought these to begin with....Slugs!  Yes, those gross, nasty, slimy things that ate my Boxcar Willie Tomato down to the ground last night!  When I would go "slug hunting" my toes kept getting wet and it was absolutely maddening!  Thanks to Sloggers, I can now look snazzy, stay dry footed, and comfortable while checking my garden when the grass is wet.  These shoes are very comfortable and I could wear them all day if I didn't care about having a tanned leg and a white foot so I really only use these after dark...that's when the slugs show up for dinner anyway so it works out perfect for me!  Now, before I upset the slug admirers that may come across this review some day let me state for the record that no slug has been harmed, only relocated...unhappily perhaps, but unharmed.  Yes, even the jerk slug that finished poor Boxcar Willie off.  I'll admit, that if I had seen Boxcar Willie murdered in the act, that particular slug may have gotten harmed.  But, this was a ninja slug... I never saw him and he didn't even leave a trail.  He plotted the whole thing because he knew the evidence would be rained away!  Sloggers may not get rid of slugs, but they sure make hunting the nasty things much more comfortable!
THESE SHOES ARE THE BEST! FLEXIBLE AND VERY COMFORTABLE TO WEAR IN THE GARDEN OR WHEN IT RAINS. REASONABLE PRICE TOO AND STYLISH!

The tide porition of the station was not accurate for the west coast locations I would use it in.
