I've had many boonies over the years, ranging from genuine USGI to the hat I am reviewing here.  Some people review these as if they were USGI and I want to point out that this is wrong thinking.  Before I get into that, I'll say I just received my Amazon-purchased hat, and its the same as one I have used as a hot weather hat for many years... so I can and will give an extended use report at the tail end of this review.Now, to the review of the hat:  The thing you have to realize here is this is not a USGI boonie.  It is meant as a light weight, loose-fitting hot weather hat that keeps your brain and skin from being broiled.  Its light weight and loose fit make it as comfortable as can be expected of a cover in extreme heat.I overlaid this hat to a current USGI boonie.  The brim is just a bit wider, by almost exactly the width of the 'hem' material ringing the brim.  That makes it about 1/2" to 3/4" wider overall.  Not a lot but its appreciated if you are snapping up the sides, as this slight extra width keeps a bit of sagging brim over your ears to prevent them sunburning.  You can always bring up the sides of a boonie with the neck strap over your head, but the side snaps make this ... well, a snap.  Snaps simply work better than the tie-the-string- method; and again, whoever placed the snaps did it in such a way that there is still overhang to cover your ears.The material on this hat has been chided by some and lauded by others as very lightweight.  If you remember or are aware of the hot weather uniform issued to the troops during the Vietnam era, this is *exactly* that same weight of fabric.  It is a thin, airy, lightweight ripstop.  For a hot weather hat that is a good thing.  The label reads it out to be 65% polyester and 35% cotton so that gives it something the old-school ripstop fabric didn't have: resistance to shrinkage and maybe better durability than 100% cotton.Yesterday I wore the hat - a 90+ degree day - while working the barbeque at a company event.  Hot!  The hat stayed on and was loose enough of a fit to not soak with sweat or be uncomfortable to the point I wanted to take it off.  Speaking of soaking with sweat... that very lightweight fabric dries quickly.  I took it off when in the shade and by the time I stepped into the sun again the band was noticeably drier.Now for the extended use report on my older version of this hat:  Its still going strong.  No rips or tears.  Its been skrunched up and worn a million times.  Thrown into the wash to clean it up and come out fine.  Its maybe shrunk a little and fits tighter ... that or the one I bought years ago wasn't this large size.  Regardless its still good to go and is in my bag in the car trunk in case I need a quick sunshade.Now that I've found where these things are for sale again I just bought two more.EDIT:  OK so I bought two more.  The Woodland pattern one was just great.  Same lightweight ripstop material.  Same loose fit but the depth of the hat was shallower to more closely fit my head, which I like.  The ACU pattern I bought in the same order also had the same fitment and material, but one button was so loose the brim wouldn't stay snapped, and one of the vents was only partially covered with mesh.  Amazon took it right back no problem.  I ordered another plain green like my first one reviewed above.  This one was made with a thin non-ripstop material nearly identical to the 'extended-use' hat I discussed above.  It also was more form-fitting to my head and this one was less generous in its diameter.  I can see it shrinking fairly tight like my old one.Conclusion:  these are cheap hats well suited to their intended purpose as light weight covers in hot weather.  I expect they are made from whatever materials the mfr can get hold of cheap in a given month.  If you get a loose one made of ripstop you are golden.  If not you're still good... and after all its a cheapie hat so cheap you can buy 3 or 4 and toss one in a backpack, one in the trunk of each car etc.  Me I shave my head and live in a hot climate so the skinhead always wears a hat or bad things happen.  These hats are great for that.

For my birthday, our daughter bought me a pair of Sloggers in a size 9 (I normally wear a 9.5).  They fit okay...a little bit short in the heal with the way Sloggers slope in the back, but still not bad.  However, I was worried that if my feet swelled up in the summer heat, or I ever tried to wear socks with them, my feet wouldn't fit.  So I ordered the size 10 along with the "Half-Sizer" insoles just to see which one fit the best and which one I should return.  The "Half-Sizer" insole is really (and I mean REALLY) thin, but you slide it under the insole that comes with the shoes and it pushes up the foot bed enough to make a difference, albeit a slight one. I'm sure one could cut a Scholl's insert (from the store) to fit as well if they needed something a bit thicker. But for me, I live in the boonies and didn't want to go all the way into town when I could have these delivered right to my door.  And the height was just enough to make them comfortable without being too snug.  Att least I will be able to fit my foot inside should I ever have socks on, which I will come late Fall and Winter.  I absolutely love these shoes for going outside and gardening or taking out the trash.  I leave them by the front door and anytime I want to go outside, I just slip them on.  No laces to tie.  So convenient.  I can't tell you how many other shoes I have messed up going out to water plants and have inadvertently ended up standing in puddles of mud. Tennis shoes have rotted. Suede and leather shoes never look the same.  But Sloggers, they are awesome. If they get dirty or dusty, you just hose them off.  After hearing me rave about them, our daughter who just started gardening this year decided to keep the size 9 for herself instead of returning them. She is really pleased with them too.
If I could wear these to work I would!  SUPER comfortable and I find myself wearing them to run errands just because!

Great support and comfortable clog per the person for whom they were bought. The price was competitive and the option to thave them there the next day for only $3.99 couldn't be beat. Saved me a trip to the store which is always a plus! Good work Amazon.

reviewText: SHIPPING-Just got the watch today- December 26th. I ordered it several days before all of the other presents I bought and yet all the other ones arrived several days earlier. The estimated delivery date was between the 20th and Christmas Eve by 0800. Defiantly not what happened. The stupid thing arrived AFTER Christmas! I was almost upset that they didn't charge for shipping because I most certainly would have demanded my money back. Luckily this was not meant to be a Christmas present, but a birthday present for my best friend. Unluckily his birthday is tomorrow and now I have to scramble to find a new present because of issues that would soon be unveiled.THE PACKAGINGIt came in a grey envelope with a small, black cardboard box inside. Inside the box was one of those do not eat things they put in shoe boxes, the chain and the watch wrapped in bubble wrap.... No instructions... NO INSTRUCTIONS for a MECHANICAL POCKET WATCH! Still all hope was not lost, I figured I could just google the instructions no problem...THE WATCHIt LOOKED quite lovely at first, but it's just plain not. It feels horribly light but with the chain attached you can almost pretend it doesn't feel like a toy.The chain is short, too short for my friends waist coat, I believe. The skeleton case feels really flimsy when opened and the plastic dome covering the watch face turns... like a toys would. There are small scratches everywhere which I expected,  but still not pleased to find.it wasn't too bad though.  I was mad, but surely my friend would understand? His old watch had stopped working and I was sure he'd be happy just to have a new one that, you know, worked... TOO BAD THIS WATCH DOES NOT WORK!!! I googled instructions on how to wind it and tried it out- only the second hand moves, nothing else. No matter what site I go to, I'm winding it right, the other hands just won't budge.IN THE ENDAll it's good for is looks and a faint ticking noise. I was planning on giving my friend his Christmas present and birthday present today but he'll just have to settle with the Christmas present for now. I know he'll understand, but I still feel like I'm letting him down. I'm going to try to contact the seller and get my money back, then I'm going to visit an antique shop and try to find him a proper replacement before I'm left empty handed on my best friends birthday. I could not be more disappointed.
summary: Worst online buying experience I've ever had

It keeps time reasonably well, though it gets about half a minute to a minute ahead in the first couple hours of winding it up and regulates itself towards the end (meaning it slows back down significantly). It doesn't take batteries but winding it only lasts for 24-25 hours (not a lot of wiggle room if you forget even through lunch break). I was very happy with it and had hoped to wear it soon, after owning it for a few months I was about to have an occasion where it might be appropriate.However, after keeping a very scheduled winding for several weeks, careful to not drop it or even let it tap into anything hard, the entire back half came off. there is a very weak seam (you can see in the picture of the back of the watch) connecting the detailed thin circle with plastic in the center to the rest of the watch. This back panel is completely smooth and was held on by the magic of slightly melted plastic in 2 places, each a millimeter wide. The rest of the watch is constructed well enough for $20, but the back panel clearly had less thought put into it than the construction of a happy meal toy.

reviewText: I am pleased with this purchase. The watch performs as advertised after setup. The camo band is understated, which I like. That is to say that it is unquestionably camo, but it does not attract attention as such like, say having every possible camo truck accesory or having a camo recliner in your living room might, if you know what I mean. The watch is a bit larger than I usually prefer, but it is not too large so as to be uncomfortable or attract too much attention. I have a medium/small wrist and fortunately the band fits without extending past the point where the elastic retainer can hold it. So far the rotating bezel has stayed put all but once, when it moved about 15 degrees - likely from going in and out of a pocket multiple times.The key here for me was to have a durable multi-function watch with the compass/alt/barometer functions that is cool looking but doesn't exist purely as a techie or outdoorsman status symbol. This watch was a bit more expensive than some other options, but I wanted a solar powered one that was perhaps a bit less obvious on the wrist than some other options. I actually enjoy and use the moon phase display quite a bit for some reason. The backlight illuminates the entire face and all aspects of the display are readable.In all I reccomend the watch if it falls in your price range. Casio makes a much less expensive model (SGW300HB-3AVCF) that runs on batteries and is not atomic that I would suggest if you wish to have similar features under $75 and don't mind tons of lettering on your wrist. That said, this watch is much much cooler looking, understated, and solar powered...

Only My 2ND Casio & MAGIC. Had to say it twice. At my age I am an analog guy, always wondered why people ever even wanted anything digital. I mean, Analog gives such a better actual "picture" of time. But then I got old, got crippled, got so I was always around my iPad for reminders, alarms etc just to remember when to take meds etc. Yeah, don't get old.The folks who use these on a regular basis can tell you ALL about how they work, but how important it is to first take the time to SET THEM UP CORRECTLY for YOUR specific region of the world. Well I never read direction in 65 years. But I do watch YouTube videos. Trouble is, nobody has one explaining how to set this particular module up that I could find. Luckily, there were tons of videos last week that taught me how to set up my somewhat similar GShock G7900A Rescue Concept Watch. Being a former surfer who surfed all over the world, oh how I WISH I had these watches before I got crippled. But life & War happen....I wanted an Atomic watch since they were invented. Why? No reason, I am just a gadget junkie and HAVE to have everything. Well if you are like me, THIS is your watch! It did take me over an hour to figure it out. I went to bed depressed since I was unable to do any manual set using the Colorado Atomic Clock. I got the L1 signal (the weakest but at least showing me it was seeing SOMETHING. But then after a few minutes got the dreaded ERR error message. I have bought weather stations before that just never got their signal so NEW it would never work. Had all my alarms set, tides and barometer set, moon set etc. But to be honest, the part of my gadget junkie was just seriously let down when I went to bed. Yes, I read all the reviews on watch forums as well as at Amazon about put them in a window and at midnight that magic Atomic Clock Fairy would make everything all work. Yeah right....Or so I thought. Got up at 5 AM this morning and ran for my watch. OK, crawled to my watch. Sure enough, the trick of placing my watch face down and aiming my big honkin sensor towards Denver worked. I was honestly like a teenage kid again. Dumb as it may be, I am just beside myself that I have every single feature on this watch working within 10% of anything my GPS and weather station confirms in ALL categories. I'll be honest, unlike anyone else I read who wrote any review, I really didn't care much if ANY of it was accurate except that stupid Atomic Clock. I just wanted another toy to constantly play with. I am beyond excited it to discover that mine at least is a surprisingly useful tool as well as being a new toy.This watch arrived direct from Amazon with a charge showing at medium battery level. I played with it for a couple hours last night and all morning inside. I then took a 1 hour cruise in 82 degree bright sunshine on my electric mobility scooter. I got home and it now reads FULL. All my alarms for medications worked, all my features worked, and I could not be happier. I was shocked to find this cheaper and DIRECT form Amazon, and not from one of their third party sellers a the next to cheapest price. I bought it for about a dollar more than that third party seller since THAT gives me the full and REAL factory 1 year warranty. Plus I used my American Express Card to pay so if it dies in TWO years, THEY will pay me in full for a new watch. Been there done that twice now with home surround theater systems whose HDMI pass through's failed on me. Saved me a couple thousand bucks now on free extended warranties.The green tinted face on this does make it somewhat harder for my eyes to see. I regret that and knew/expected that ahead of time over the cheaper black version.with a white face. But I wanted the military green with camo band more than anything. My years in the USMC and all the fun I had getting myself crippled for life and all, well, I just didn't want all that fun to stop:-) Honestly, the way they set this watch up is wonderful! (to ME). The band is very dark and the camo very mild & understated. In other words, you don't look like some kind of deranged GI Joe wanna be out waiting for a flashback...This watch is just a very dark, muted and VERY nice looking, expensive and professional looking watch. It looks like exactly what it is. A tool, a tool that you can use in a pinch to do a lot of various things to help you. And if it didn't do a DARN thing, I would still love it since it just looks so darn cool. Maybe I just got lucky? Mine shows Made In Japan, NOT China. Don't know, don't care. If you are worried this looks too military, it does NOT. It still pulls off looking like a piece of professional equipment (again, to ME). The trade off for the muted green over the black, or other color choices, will be the fact that the face sort of washes out the colors. Yet, it also ADDS some color in doing so. In other words, it is a trade off. I still have mixed feelings on that. I somehow think it would look strange if it had the white face of the standard watch? And it is a very light, almost shaded green that you see. However I end up feeling about it, I wouldn't trade it for the world. And now, I can even play with this thing and see what the time & tides are all over that world I used to go surfing in. I don't think you can go wrong with this watch. In ANY color you choose.  The last point I would make is the size of the face. One reviewer here thinks it is too small. NO IDEA WHAT HE WAS COMPARING IT TOO? Maybe a girls watch?  All I can say is mine is actually BIGGER than on my Casio GShock G7900A Rescue Concept Watch. And that is significant since this watch is actually physically smaller than it! I have a smaller wrist than most so that is another huge selling point about this watch. It is thinner and has a smaller diameter than my bright red GSHOCK model. And there is something else. Pick a screen, ANY screen. I have lived 65 years somehow, yet never found any watch that shows CLOSE to as much information on  EVERY screen as this watch. It is simply stunning, just how much info they managed to cram into this double screen set up they created building this computer on your wrist. Also being former Law Enforcement, I will have my eye out for the Dick Tracy Model I expect any day now:-)UPDATE July 4 2014:  I found that I don't even need to place this watch near any window to sync with the Atomic Clock. Last night it did it's thing at 1:04 AM Pacific Standard Time-using daylight savings time. The prior night with it in the window, facing upside down it did it at 12:03 AM PST. So it looks like for me, here in Oceanside California (USMC Camp Pendleton Marine Corps Back Gate Area), this watch has no issues with the Auto Sync Function for me at least.

Aside from that, these slippers make my feet sweat unless I am wearing them in my basement where there is only a cold concrete floor. I have not gotten enough wear out of these in the month I have had them to make me want anything similar in the future. I have to wash them after each wear.
summary: Cute, but a little teensy bit large

reviewText: The item I ordered wasn't what I received. Instead of a Mary Jane style, the slippers were without the top strap. I needed them right away, so I didn't try to return them. Pros: they are comfortable, warm and waterproof. Cons: I have a high arch, so I get gapping between the insole and my foot when walking and occasionally the heel slips from my foot. All things that could be fixed by a top strap.
These fit my size 11 foot.  But they are very close fitting.  Might be good in the winter but not right now.

I wasn't sure about these shoes. But when they came in I was very happy with them. I love to wear these to work if my other shoes hurt my feet. Can't even tell these are "slippers". I bought a different color I was so happy with them.
These are nice. I even wear them out in my yard.They keep my feet clean and don't attract dirt.

I got the wrong size, I thought theyd be big enough, but I got medium and i wear size 9 in womens...dammit...I guess I didnt see Large is 8-11...I'll see if I can return them but I already ripped off the tag, althought I havent worn them but a few steps...they are too tight.

My daughter and I got these shoes as a gift. They are not really made to wear outside, but inside they are great! Light but warm. We love them. You might want to buy a size larger if you don't like them to fit super tight
These are fine, but a bit hot. I was hoping these would help with my plantar fasciitis when wearing a heel cup. They do help, but not as much as I would like. I cannot wear these along at all.

This socks/shoes worked out perefectly for my exercise class where we're moving around and twisting on the ball of the foot quite a bit.  My grippee socks kept getting all balled up under my feet and were really uncomfortable, these give traction while staying in place.  Great buy!
summary: Great shoe for The Daily Method Interval Class

reviewText: I purchased these for travel, to use in hotel rooms (do not like to walk on hotel carpets--who knows what they hold?).  They run on the small side so order "up" when looking at sizing.  They are great for packing as the slippers fold down and are compact.  I ordered several pair--the extra large does not cling to the foot quite as well as the others but overall they are a great product and would be excellent for yoga or gym class or wearing around the house when you want the feel of bare feet.
They are a wonderful item for the air port security area but they run a bit small. Also nice for long car trips. I find they run small so ?💭thinking about going one size bigger.
These are house shoes that are perfect for keeping your feet warm during the cold weather. I have worn them out some but prefer to only wear them in the house.

I wear size 8 or 8.5 shoe (5'3" - 140 lbs).  I ordered size large.  It fits, but barely.  I can get it on, and I did wear it for a long transAtlantic flight, and it machine washes well.  I can't imagine how anyone with larger foot gets it on.  I bought it for flights and will store them until next time.Sizing may be a problem.
Even though the size I ordered was supposed to fit my foot size, they crowed my toes. Wish they would stretch a little more, then they would be comfortable. Really helped with my yoga stability.

I have a chronic condition that causes tripping and foot drop and these slippers are perfect for moving around safely. Let me point out that despite their "anti-slip"description, they only have slightly more grip than socks--but that's exactly what's needed to drag a leg or foot around more safely than a non-slip sole, which can grip and stick and cause trips to happen. It's a trade off, and you have to be careful, but these slippers have made moving around so much easier on my hardwood floors. They're thick enough to protect your feet so it's better than walking around barefoot. They fit snugly and don't slip off the feet, but can be pretty form fitting around bunions or other foot problems, so just be aware of that. The tag says indoor use only, but I'm tempted to try these outside :) I will definitely buy additional pairs to have in my purse and car and other places for when I get tired and can't clear floor or pavement with a hard shoe with leather sole.
I run around all winter in my socks and wear the bottoms out. These are as soft and comfy as socks but have a sole that I hope will last through the winter months on hardwood floors.

I got the wrong item and they promptly sent me a the correct item at no additional charge.  they made it as hassle free as possible for me. I will definitely be ordering more as Christmas gifts for friends and family.
Exactly what I expected, easy and light to mail for gifts, comfortable to wear, different and clever with fun fabric/
The large size was not wide enough to fit comfortably.  May I suggest sizes also include narrow, wide and extra wide.

First of all, I must say that I hope to NEVER see a man wearing a pair of Mary Janes!Having dispensed with that, I must say that I do love these "shoes."  They are the most UN-shoelike shoes I've ever worn!  Wearing them is like going barefoot.  Or maybe a most-beloved pair of well-worn slippers. . .When I first saw these (I had to open the package at the Post Office!) I thought there was NO WAY they they'd fit my Size 8-1/2 feet.  Surprise, surprise ~ they DO!  And with wonderful comfort!  They go on easily and they stretch with no problem.  The bottoms truly are skid-proof.  As for whether the Large would truly fit a woman who wears Size 11, I'd be skeptical.My husband (who is well aware that I own over 200 pairs of shoes) commented, "Those really ARE cute!"  And that is a first!I got pink ones and green ones to go with my favorite lounging pants and wish I had all the available colors!The only negative is that they do initially smell horrible, but once aired out, they are fine.  Trust me:  put up with the smell for a day or so and treat yourself to a pair or four!
These slippers fit well, are very comfy, great price, but unfortunately because the materials are synthetic, feet get hot and (ahem) sweaty.

I got these specifically for a barre class. We have to wear socks that have sticky dots on the bottom so that our feet don't slip.The socks are low and they roll off the back of my foot. The Mary Jane Nufoots do not. I have ordered a second pair and will probably get more as time goes on. I wear an 8-81/2 shoes and the large fits fine.
summary: Very Satisfied, Especially for My Use

reviewText: They are very comfy cozy. Washable.  Fit is perfect to size.  A wonderful gift for everyone.  Loved them so much, I bought a second pair

I keep several pairs of these around to wear in the house. Feels like you are going barefoot but keEps your skin oils off the carpet. They wear out rather rapidly if you wear them continuously - but hey, the price is right. And the different patterns make them fun!
I like to walk around the house without shoes. I wear socks, but they get worn out very quickly. These slippers are the perfect solution.
They are very comfortable and keep my toes warm. I'm glad I read the reviews and ordered the large size. I wear a 7 1/2 shoe but went with the 8-11 and the fit is fine.

These are comfortable, flexible and extremely lightweight. Perfect for airline travel. Fold up easily for a pocket or purse.The sole is the same material as the top but has small, non-slip patches added, so OK on carpet, wood or tile floors. No good for outdoors or wet surfaces and no protection for the sole of the foot. Because I use a transcription system with a foot pedal at work, I bought a second pair which allows me to use the pedal more effectively, rather than slip my shoes off and work the pedal barefoot. Another reviewer mentioned that the sizes came up small.  I wear an 8, and the 8 to 11 is a great fit.  They also have good width at the toe and look really cute.  I don't know how comfortable these would be if your foot was at the higher end of the size range, I don't think they offer an XL.
Light, good fit.  Just wish there were more support on the bottom.  Good inside house, but definitely don't want to stand on anything hard.
summary: Nice, light house shoe.  No support on bottom, but supple.

reviewText: These feel very clammy on the feet - with or without socks.  It doesn't seem like they breathe at all.  I can't even wear them for 5 minutes.

I bought these for my mother. She is 87, and absolutely loves them. She likes the way they feel on her feet. And I am more confident about her safety. I am not as fearful about her slipping and falling.

I've ordered two pairs of these so far and really like the simplicity of them.  I think they will be handy for travel and I am enjoying them around the house.  I ordered the purple this time but they were a different shade than I had expected so that was a little disappointing.  Overall, I think they are great!

I wear a 9 to 9.5 shoe and after reading other reviews decided on the XL 11-13 size.  It's a good snug fit.  Any smaller wouldn't fit.  It's a great product for in the house, pool side or out on the patio.

I found these to hurt my toes even though I purchased a large.  I will not wear them.  I recommend anyone with a size 9 shoe go up to XL or more to get them to fit comfortable.  They are very soft and colorful but the fit is what is important.
summary: bought for comfort around the house

reviewText: The first pair I loved.  The second and third pair I bought I loved.  They are great andeven seem to provide some support, as I walk better with them than barefoot.

I have never seen these before. They fit great and are perfect to slip on when those heels are just killing your feet. I have given a pair to my hairstylist daughter. She even keeps them in her purse for changing out of her high heels.  I plan to order more for my grown children and myself.
summary: Great substitute for shoes! Slips on like socks but looks like shoes!

reviewText: Thought I had lost one of my other pair but found it.  Wear these in Pilates and Physical Therapy.  Great for that.  Very comfortable.
Very comfortable, you don't even realize you have something on your feet.  Work outside for casual wear too, not just slippers...Really love them.

I purchased two pairs, one "print" and one solid color. There is some difference in the shape of the two: the print was tighter in the toes, and the solid was just fine. These are very comfortable, but they DO absorb your foot odors so you need to wash them often, by hand. They will take a good deal of time to dry.

Very comfortable.  Chose size medium & find it fits snugly for a wide foot measuring 9.25 inches from heal to toe, standing. Neoprene has a strong odor which will most likely dissipate with washing & time.

They arrived promptly and feel every bit as comfortable as expected. I wear a size 9 and chose the Large according to the size chart...then I read the reviews that said I should have gone one size larger and was concerned they wouldn't fit once they arrived. Turns out Large is the right size for me; the XL would've been too big. They fit comfortably snug like yoga socks/shoes. I'll be buying them in every color.

I really wish they fit; They would be great for anyone with small feet. I would buy a larger size but these were supposed to be XL and I had already bought the L first. They are not like other L and XL sizes.  They seem more like child sizes.  I give up!
summary: If you can find the size that fits you would like them.

reviewText: I wear these all the time around the house now. I think I will need to get several more pairs. I have not tried them elsewhere yet but just for wearing in the house is enough to convince me that this is the way to go. (I have them on as I write this!).
A bit snug, but very cute.  I think these would work very well in a t'ai chi or yoga class.
summary: Very cute, but a bit snug.

reviewText: They are such a disappointment, they fit too loose and are cut too round at the toe area. If my foot was square it is like the corner is cut off and puts too much pressure on my big toe. I wanted to use them for yoga but I must keep looking for a better solution.

I now have 9 pair of your wonderful shoes.  I use them all the time when at home.  They are wonderful to wear in the garden, you do not feel stones or anything, LOVE AND ADORE THEM.  My husband has been ordering the men's shoes and loves his.  I have given some to family and friends, they also tell me they love them  Keep making the beautiful variety of colors, please.
I have bought these for everyone in my family and it's my gift this year to all my friends.  I have several pair and love them.
These slippers were so very comfortable and soft that I ordered two pair, one for MOM MOM and one for my youngest granddaughter who also loves them..

These shoes have a very strong, almost unbearable odor. That turned me off right away. Plus, I typically wear a size 7, but the toes were too tight. Fortunately, my sister liked them and could wear them, so I gave them to her.
they are devine.. can wear alone or I use them with winter boots and goes over my socks. will buy them again
These are snug and comfy. Great for travel, better than socks and take so little space in luggage. I've bought several pair for gifting.

I bought these for my 93 yr. old mother-in-law, and she loves them.  They fit like a glove, look classy, and have a vinyl sole so you can wear them outdoors. She is going to wear them to bridge and around the house.  She says they are very comfortable and stretch to accommodate any foot problems like bunions. She has them now in 3 colors to match whatever she is wearing.
The size shown on the Amazon website did not match the actual size chart when I received the slippers.  Rather than spend $5 returning them, I gave them away.
Great shoes for gym and around the house. Would not recommend wearing outside. I do wear them like socks w/shoes to the gym and dump the shoes.

I ordered these to wear on a long plane ride and on bare floors.  They feel tighter than socks but not binding.  I wear size 8.5-9 and have narrow, low-volume feet.  Bought these in large which are advertised to fit size 8-11.  I like these but there is a seam at the end of the toes and after a couple of hours, it starts to feel constricting.  I can't imagine anyone with over size 9 being comfortable in these.  The neoprene is more comfy than expected and my feet don't sweat in them.  Overall I like them and feel they'll fit my purposes.  I walk outside on my deck in them but they are primarily indoor shoes.

You will be so surprised at how comfortable and warm these are!  I got myself a pair and loved them so much I ordered five of my daughters a pair. I was able to get everyone a different color or pattern, so no arguments about who is wearing whose slipper! It is like walking barefoot.
I hate wearing shoes.  So this is as close to being barefoot as possible.  The sole will break down if worn on pavement consistently.  Most definitely an indoor shoe.
These are just great for wearing around the house. I even wear them in the basement. I'm gonna buy more colors.

You can't beat these for comfort, especially when you need a little something on your feet but would rather be barefoot. The conform nicely to your feet, provide some protection and warmth, and are non-binding. Not for outside wear, as there is no hard sole of any kind, these just feel good after a day in shoes! They pack beautifully so you don't have to go barefoot in strange hotel rooms either. They can be hand washed to keep them fresh. Try these the next time you need a pair of lightweight footies.

Bought these for travel only, mainly for airplanes and hotel rooms.  Bought both the slipper and the Mary Janes.  Much prefer the Mary Janes, as they stay on my foot better.  Plan to wear with socks for the most past, as they might be a bit uncomfortable due to seams at the toes.  Plan on giving as Xmas presents as well.  Wear size 7 shoe and medium sizing was about right, though my toes touch the front seams.

I bought these to go with my Minnie Mouse costume but they are way too neon. More neon than in the picture.I think they run small. I wear a 9 so I got a large and they feel tight. Tighter than I would like for a comfy slipper to be.I'm not sure what is so special about them. I've had socks with rubbery tread on the bottom that worked just as well. Maybe they'll be useful for dance classes.
These are outstanding, and I love them.  If I could give them more stars, I would.  They are so comfy and cozy!!!

I am wearing them when I do my daily exercises. The grips on the soles keep me firmly planted when I have to exercise standing on carpeting.I'm a size 9 and the large just fit..barely. I just received them so I don't know how long they will last. So far, I'm satisfied.

It is very comfortable but my Size 7 narrow feet couldn't fit into the medium 6-7 so I requested for the large 7-10.  The large size is just a tad loose—would prefer it to be snug—but it fits fine, as long as they don't come off my feet—which they don't—when I do my tai-chi and qi qong for which I bought it.
summary: Prefer it to be more snug but fits fine

reviewText: For the price, I guess I cannot complain too much. Range sizing is always a bad idea. It is very irrational that three to four sizes can be lumped together to fit one size and expect the buyers to be satisfied with the product. The cut out part is unfinished which is another negative for me. I do not know why the makers of this product will not make one for each specific size. I am almost sure that they will sell like hotcakes. They sell a half-baked product and more often than not, people are disappointed and they do not have repeat customers.  This is the case with this Nufoot Mary Janes. I will try them again if they stop doing range-sizing. I would have loved to wear them around the house in place of regular socks....but....
These are great slippers, are comfortable and fit quite well.  I did find, however, that my feet get overheated in them.
summary: Good fit, but my feet get overheated...

reviewText: Love to put them on that the gym to protect my feet from germs at the gym. They fit like a glove.

I really like this product!!! I attempt to go barefoot as much as possible and this product is very close to being barefoot!! It also has a bit of grip on the bottom so it's really good for yoga and Pilates!! Every one of my Pilates class wanted to know where I got them at!! My shoe size is a seven and a half and I have to buy a size large so that's one thing to keep in mind while ordering!! I plan on buying this product again and again!!!

I bought these for a trip to Europe for the plane.  I love them.  I am a person, who is usually barefooted, but when in a hotel, I am uncomfortable with that.  They were great for the hotel.  I am now home, and still using them.  I plan to buy a few more pairs.

I've purchased 2 pairs of these in black and I love them!  I use them at Pilates and around the house when i don't care to go barefoot.  They wash up very nicely (air dry).  The fit is nice.  After reading other reviews, I went with a XL which worked out perfect for my size 10 feet.  My Pilates teacher wants some too!

I love wearing these Nufoot Mary Janes. They are like going barefoot but with a touch of cover. The problem is that when I'm most likely to wear them-in summer- they are too blinking hot where I live. They are a great idea if somehow the material had better ventilation.

I tried the slippers on and they are true to size.  I haven't worn them yet as I purchased them for a upcoming vacation.  I think they will be perfect to pack in my carry on tote bag.  I'm giving this product three stars because I haven't used them yet and can't comment on long term comfort and wear.
summary: The slippers are what I expected based on the description

reviewText: Easy on and off, but just a tad too short in length. I wear a size 8.5 or 9 so ordered accordingly, should have ordered a size larger but was afraid they would be too big. Had to return but considering ordering next size up.

These " footies" are a good idea.  On wood floors the no skid bottom is great.  They are cute and soft.  Older persons will appreciate the sot feel on painful feet.  I ordered large, they were too tight on my size 9 foot.

These are the most comfortable "slippers" I have ever had.  So comfortable and light, I don't even know I am wearing them.  Even better than going barefooted.  I am ordering a pair for my daughter.  I'm thinking of getting them in each color.  These are perfect for the traveler.

reviewerName: CM "Better things to do but this is more fun."
reviewText: I travel a lot and am used to wearing heels 24x7. However, I found NuFoot footwear and now carry them with me for running thru the airport. It's like going barefoot but your feet stay clean.-They fold up (I fold them inside out so they don't get my bag dirty) and I can tuck them away until my next airport run.-When I get home, I throw them in the wash and they're good to go for my next trip.-I have bought them in different colors, to coordinate with my outfits, which is a bonus.-The rubberized tread on the bottom keeps me from slipping on slippery floors, perfect traction.-I'm tall with bigger feet than normal so was concerned the largest size wouldn't fit. However, the L fits fine on my size 10 feet. I don't think they'd fit an 11, however. (probably too short)Issues to consider - they have no support or much padding. This works fine for me but it also means that you can feel the ridges on an escalator, for example.These footies/slippers get a lot of comments. I've been asked repeatedly if they are socks or slippers by flight attendants, gate agents, travelers and even the shoe shine guy in the San Antonio airport.Love them - they're a great value for the price.
The size chart for this product is completely wrong. Purchased the extra large for women  as I normally wear a 10 wide and they are too tight. Not worth the time or effort to return
These slippers are great to wear around the house, I also wear them in the front yard and they seem fine, I will be ordering more colors

I am enjoying the Nufoot Mary Janes.  I wear a size 6 shoe and these medium,  fit perfectly.  I do not think anyone with a larger foot would find these comfortable.  I have NO room to spare, so size 7 - 8 would need a larger size.
summary: these are great for around the house

reviewText: loved this and works very well during Pilates sessions on the reformer.  They also slip into my sneakers so no on and off coming and going.  Great invention, I will probably buy more.

I bought them for everybody on my list this past holiday and everyone loves them.  You can wear them under boots or as slippers around the house.  They run a little small so adjust the size accordingly.  I'm a size 7 shoe and the medium is perfect especially in the winter when I wear them over socks. The colors and patterns are great. They wash well but I haven't put them in the dryer.
Service was great and now I have something to wear around the house that isn't fleecy. They are easy to put on and look like a real shoe. Glad I tried them.
Smells like petrolium and haven't been able to wear tried washing but still had the odor they fit good and if they didn't smell I would wear them but can't

My daughter wore these shoes to an indoor water park.  Within the first 2 hours there were holes worn all the way through on both feet under her toes and the balls of her feet.  There is no rubber or reinforced material on the soles of the shoes at all.  It's a shame.  I'd read such good reviews, but they just are not durable enough to stand up to any kind of walking or rough surfaces (such as concrete ground and stair treads).  They were also VERY small.  We ordered a medium which should fit size 6 - 8.  She wears a 6 and they were very tight.  I can't recommend these shoes.

reviewText: my wife swims daily,,and loves the lightweight, shoes that don't sink, and dry so quickly! We will be buying more!

I love the nufoot shoes.  I actually bought a pair for my sister-in-law so we could take a yoga class together.  I already owned a pair that fit perfectly.  So when I got these new ones, I thought there were a tad small. Just a little too short. But I will keep wearing them, in hopes that with a little wear, they will eventually fit nicely.
I ordered these to wear around the locker room and shower at the gym.  UGH! within a couple weeks they had developed holes and I had to throw them out.

Very light so that I feel like I am barefoot but better.  The fit is a little short but not enough that I would buy the bigger size.  There is no left or right BUT each is cut differently.  I like the feel of them on my feet that I ignore the difference.  I'd still recommend and consider getting another pair in a different color.
These were really comfortable, and I loved wearing them.  Too bad they wore through the bottoms in less than a week; that we really disappointing.  I won't buy them again.
summary: very comfy, but didn't last a week without wearing through the bottom

reviewText: comfortable for house, but a pain when you need to run outside for a sec.  I should have read more before I ordered.

I have a 7 1/2 shoe size. I ordered the 6-8 M and they're a little tight. But I got them for a vacation where I have to watch the weight limit on my luggage so I think they'll work perfectly for that.
summary: One size does not fit all

reviewText: I thought they would be great for traveling and wearing around the house.  I love the weight, but they don't breath. So my feet sweat and then get cold and clammy. I should send them back, but tried wearing them several days, so they don't look new anymore.
summary: Nice idea, but they don't breath.

reviewText: I bought these to wear in a "no-shoes-allowed" kickboxing class. They fit just fine until I started moving around a lot, and then they tended to slide on my foot. I'm a size 6 shoe, so maybe if I'd gone a size smaller than I'd normally wear, they wouldn't have done that.

I thought I would be able to use these in my water aerobics class, but it didn't work well. They are nice to wear around the house and I keep an extra pair in my car when I visit others and need to remove my shoes.
summary: Nufoot Mary Janes Slipper, Green, Extra Large

reviewText: I wear a size 7 and these are snug. I would not recommend this size if you wear a 7.5. They aren't so tight that I cannot  stand to wear them for the length of time I have them on, but they could be a tad stretchier. There isn't any arch support and they are very thin, but that is the point of these little slipper shoes.  The fact that they are neoprene means that they are very durable, but guess what?  Neoprene is used for can and bottle koozies that hold in the heat/cold and doesn't allow said can or bottle to sweat condensation on furniture. So my feet tend to become rather clammy after a while, which is a tad uncomfortable.
summary: Five star if they fit better

reviewText: My daughter has balance issues… and really likes to be barefoot.  As a result, she takes many a fall.  I helped her on with the first pair of these, holding my breath for an instant reject.  Instead, she wiggled her toes and grinned.  When there's a break from orthotics, she gets these… and we've watched as the grip of the sole saves her from many a fall.  This is the first thing she has truly enjoyed on her feet.  Thank you.

Although they tend to run a little small they are comfortable when you size up, they're like walking bafefoot. No more slippers slipping off your feet while going up stairs,  and they're easy to fold up and slip into your purse when going to a friends house so you can take your shoes off at the door and slip these on.
I added these on my order for my daughter and she really likes them and wears them all the time.  They look very comfortable.

I was disappointed in this shoe.  My foot is a true size 6.5, so when I read that this shoe was somewhat small, I figured that a Medium 6-8 would probably suit me just fine.  Being neoprene, S-M-L sizing isn't really appropriate, especially if you are planning to use it for yoga/pilates.  This medium would probably fit a small (size 5.5 foot perfectly.)
summary: Okay as a slipper, not great as a yoga/pilates shoe

reviewText: I wanted slippers for travel and these will suffice but just barely.  The fabric is thinner than expected and the fit was a little short in the large (I wear an 8.5 women's US size consistently) but here are the pluses: I can wear them in a public shower room; they wash in the machine (no dryer); they stretch to accommodate swollen feet from the long flight; they provide some protection from cold floors; and they pack into a tiny space in my suitcase. They are not cute but they are practical for my travel needs.

These are far less shoe-like than they appear in the photo, but they work quite well for what I got them for - to use in the gym.  They're definitely not socks, but not really shoes, either.  They're closer to swim shoes, it feels like having a diving suit on your feet, that close to your skin.  The cut out that makes them "mary jane" style is less attractive than one might hope, but since they STAY at the gym, it hardly matters. It's a fine product, just don't buy them thinking they're suitable for street-wear.

Loved this at first so ordered another style and within a few days both pair had holes in them. This was before they were a week old! I only wore them indoors not outside. The holes were in the same spot on both pair.

These Nufoot Mary Janes are great for yoga.  I hate to go barefoot so needed something that would provide a bit of coverage for my feet and give me just a bit of traction on my yoga mat.  These little slipons are perfect.  I agree with other reviewers that buying a size larger is appropriate.  I normally wear a 7.0 or 7.5, but the large (8.0-11) was the right size in the Nufoot MJs.

I really like these slippers.  I use the for walking around the house in cooler temps, to go out and get the paper or mail, and in the car on my way to my (barefoot) yoga classes.  My ONLY complaint is the fact that they smell funny, and they make your feet smell funny if you wear them for a long period of time and your feet sweat in them.  I just throw them in the wash like I would a pair of socks and they're good as new!

I just received these and right out of the box they looked small, but the tag says the large size will fit a woman's shoe size from 7 to 10. After trying these on I found that to be totally untrue. I wear a size 81/2 and these were very tight to the point that the strap over the instep was impeding my circulation. Also there wasn't enough length and my big toe felt very cramped. Since these are made of neoprene they don't have the give that say socks would have and I think wearing them as snug as they were would only become more uncomfortable. I think they would fit a size 7 foot just fine and maybe even a size 8 comfortably but any foot larger than that would be too tight.The neoprene is thin and not very durable, they don't recommend you were them outside and I agree. I paid $10 for these and I think that is too much considering how cheaply they are made. They are one piece construction and I think the strap would start to tear with repeated use.I returned them and would have exchanged them for the larger size but they don't give you that option, I was only aloud to return for a refund.
I hate wearing shoes so this is a life saver for me u put it on it feels like a glove hateto take it off .Bought two pairs they came so fat . Bought three more
These are very stretchy so buy smaller than your regular size. Good if you don't want to go barefoot in yoga.

These are great, for what they are. They are not outdoor slippers, they do not offer support or padding, think more like a slipper sock. I do hope to wear them while on my standup paddleboard as I really don't like being barefoot, but still want to feel the board under my feet (which real water shoes are to clunky for), I think these will be great for that. They won't make good traditional use water shoes though, as I think over time the roughness of a pool, or sand and rock will wear them out fast, especially so for anyone who drags their feet a little, or runs in them. The seams look really well sewn on my pair, and I think they will also hold up well under normal use. The material itself is also pretty thin neoprene, I would guess only 1 mm thickness. This is great to get the feel of being barefoot, without being exposed to the nasties on the floor.. Highly recommend as a travel slipper to wear in hotels!Size wise: I normally wear a 7.5 womens shoe, though I like to size up with sneakers, I bought these in a Large and they are perfect. They are not tight, they do not slip off at all, and are not stretched out on my foot. IMO, this size would not be comfortable for someone who had a shoe size larger than an 8.  I bought them prime, so free ship and a decent price, they are worth the $10 if you are looking for a thin sock like slipper that let's you feel barefoot but adds traction. In regards to smell, they are neoprene and neoprene smells, I can see how this would bother some picky people, but it does not bother me, I don't really smell them when they are on my feet. Plus I am used to neoprene products/familiar with them, so I expected this.I actually like them enough I will be ordering more, I do think they will be ideal for me to wear paddle boarding. I will update on this use once it's warm enough to get into the water.I give a full 5 stars, because they were exactly what I was looking for, barefoot feel that I can use on my paddleboard, plus good traction from the grippy footprint design on the sole.

They should be named barefeet  because that's how my feet feel. I love these slippers, I had to order more!!!
These slippers are so comfortable, and they fit like a glove, when you wear them your feet completely sinks into them.Thank you very much!Sincerely,Janice
my wife would say all females who  wanted the comfort at night  she is going to buy more  thank you
I've been wearing these the last couple days and I love them! It is very nice to have a pair of slippers that are as comfortable to wear as these!

These are great for yoga when the floor is cold.  You can't spread your toes completely but they are much more comfortable than yoga socks (with the toes).  They stretch to fit your foot.  I wouldn't wear them outside (except maybe in the water or on the beach) as they are just a piece of neoprene, but they are exactly what I was looking for.

I like these slippers a lot. They are comfortable to wear around this house instead of slippers that can be unsafe on carpet or stairs. reviewText: I love my Nufoot Mary Janes they are great to wear indoors and much better than barefoot, I also go out into the yard with them.
summary: Great for indoors or for some outdoors!

reviewText: But I wear them in the house and also in the hottub, so they don't hold up very long (maybe 3 months).  But I do love them.
Very happy with the Mary Janes.  I need to keep my toes warm, so sometimes bare feet don't get it.  These are the perfect solution.  Great for traveling too.
And so soft...you literally forget you are wearing anything on your feet!  Wish there are more oolors to choose from.
In just under 1 month the feet have worn out!  The neoprene needs to be thicker or these 7 prs. I bought were flawed

I bought these for a swim pool pal because she liked the way mine (I have 2 pairs) conformed to my 2 different size feet.  I recommend these for arthritis therapy pool exercises....keeps your feet off the dirty locker room floors and  doesn't let the bottom of the pool scrape up your feet....I love them..I think these will also be good for walking on beach when we head out there...they are washable so you will be able to get all the sand out. I highly recommend these for multiple uses
Since I am spoiled by going barefoot I got these to keep my feet clean. Feel great...do not slide...Great around the house.

Last October someone gave me a pair of slip-on house slippers that were purchased from a big box chain store. Two weeks later, those shoes caused me to fall in the kitchen and fracture my neck. I had been looking for a good pair of slippers and found exactly what I wanted and needed when I bought these Nufoot slippers. They are comfortable, snug without being too tight and have grippers on the bottom so I won't fall while wearing these. The material is breathable and antibacterial. These definitely could be worn in the shower, pool or anyplace else. They recommend them for indoors only so I take them with me when I shop and change shoes before I head into the store. They are like a second skin when it comes to comfort. I definitely recommend these, especially for those with arthritis or other foot discomfort. To wash, you simply drop them in the washer using cold water and let them air dry.

They do run small so offer a size up. I will say, I saw these on the news and the newscasters raved about them. It took me some time to find them and when I did, I was very excited as I wanted to use them in the pool, which they were recommended for. The first day at the pool, the pool tore the bottoms to pieces. Many huge holes in them just in one hour at the pool. I was so very disappointed and sent them back the next day.
Great for flying on any airline and also for swim shoes. It is possible they could be used in a dressy situation also.

My mother was always wanting "ballet type slippers" I wish I had found these before she died, these are exactly what she wanted, they do feel as if you are barefoot, but they keep your feet warm and protected.  I have forgotten they were on and gotten in bed with them.

The Nufoot's fit very comfortably and are a good pool shoe ... unless you are doing concentrated water aerobics for an extended time.  I wore while exercising in a pool vigorously for 45 minutes.  They kept my feet safe from my frequent pool exercise related toe blisters, but the sole was worn through when I was done.  Wish the sole fabric was thicker because they were wonderfully comfortable.
I purchased these for yoga. They are perfect and so cute. Fit perfect and so light and comfortable you will forget you have them on. Great for yoga and much better than in bare feet.

I bought these to keep at work.  I like to run stairs during lunch and my sandals were just not cutting it.  There is no support so I put on the inside a insert.  Now they work perfect.  I would recommend and if you need support just put in one.

These are the best slippers I have found any where.  I have neuropathy and can't feel the floor in shoes and I tend to fall a lot.  These shoes has been a blessing and I can even wear them out.  Wore them to my doctors offer yesterday cause I forgot I had them on.  Don't care for the order I get on my feet when I take them off but it goes away fast. If you have more at this good price I would love to buy one of every color that I don't have. my email is tedwards@usa2net.net
summary: I love these almost barefoot slippers that grip the floor. Everyone should try at least one pair, you will neer wear any other.

reviewText: The vast majority of reviews were so good, I took the bait.  MATERIAL: These shoes are made of a much thinner material than I assumed.  They might be some kind of neoprene...but not the 1/8" kind I was expecting. The soles are the same material as the top...thin.  It was hard to determine the sole construction from the photos, and I was hoping for something a little thicker.  SIZE:  I wear a solid 8.5 and bought the Large (fits 8-11).  These fit.  Just.  I really don't know how anyone with a foot larger than a 9 might even wear these comfortably.  PRICING:  I thought the $9.99 sounded like a fair price.  The shipping (from the nufoot website) was $7.95!!!  They arrived quickly, but the envelope was so light I really couldn't believe I'd paid $7.95 for what could have been sent first class mail for less than $2.00... so the other $5.95 must be handling....really?  Yep, disappointed.  I will try them at Yoga class, perhaps on the airplane and indoors around the house, and maybe they will be OK there.  But I seriously doubt they would work in airports, on the beach, poolside or other places where something with a bit more substance is needed.
Love all of the colors I purchased. I wore them one day to Yoga and everyone wanted them.  Nice for running around the house in also.
Have brought these in the past and love them. I wear them so much that the bottom of the slipper get gigantic holes in them.
They fit great with a size larger than I usually wear.  They do make your feet sweat but they get very soft.  Stretch material.

I plan to use these on the plane during a long trip to Italy in Jan. and as slippers in the hotels while there.  They fold up to almost nothing and can be washed easily so will probably stay in my suitcase from now on.  They were recommended in the San Francisco Chronicle.  I did have to return my first pair for a larger size.  I wear a size 7 1/2 in shoes and ended up needing the larger size, L 8-11.  That was the only problem.

I find these to be very comfortable and use them for around the house.  They are cute and comfortable.  I ordered another pair in black to keep at work.  They are like being barefoot (no support in these)They do smell funny when first open but I aired them out and now they are fine.  I did order a size up based on other reviews worked fine for me.Easy transaction, good product.

I am pleased with the item, but it does fit snugly as some of the reviews suggest.  I normally wear a 7 1/2 narrow shoe and this item is supposed to fit up through size 8.  I had communicated with the company's customer service dept. before ordering because of other reviews advising about the item running small.  Not only was I assured that I could return the 2 pairs I ordered if they were too small -- but additionally, the representative enclosed a large pair for me to try and a personal note (advising that if the large were too big, I could give them to a friend!) - what good service!  I would definitely deal with this seller again.
summary: I really like this shoe/slipper - just what I wanted!

reviewText: Came on time, works perfectly for no shoes allowed dance events which is what I was looking for.  Comfortable even with insoles.

I wear a size 8 shoe. I was skeptical about the fit initially. Once the product arrived, I found that it fit according to the size chart. This is something that is light weight and comfortable. I can use this for yoga. It also looks as though if it becomes wet, it will dry rapidly. The material is a soft stretchy material on top. The bottom material is designed to prevent one from slipping. I ordered 2 pair. They are machine washable.

I bought 2 pairs for yoga class....I don't like to walk on the bare floor in  a public area.  They run very small.  They are still snug on me and my foot, although long is very narrow.  They tend to get hot because of the material.  They are cute and I like them.
Good idea, but fit too short.  I wear a 9 1/2 so I ordered a large and they squish my toes.  Disappointed.
I bought these to use in Tai Chi class.  Very comfortable and appropriate for a classroom setting.  Also, very easy to carry in a handy tote bag.
I love to go barefoot-not so good for the skin.  These are perfect - You can go "barefoot" and still have soft feet.

This little shoes are pretty good, I bought them for my girlfriend and she likes them. The fitting is pretty good and the size reference is about right =)the only thing I personally dont like too much is the fact that this shoes might turn slippery on some floor surfaces.

I got large because of other reviewers saying that that the fit is small.  I gave my daughter a pair who wears a women's 8 1/2 shoe.  She said they were really tight.  Just pick the right size and I'm sure you'll love these.  They have a skid proof bottom so you don't have to worry about falling.  If you wear them all day, your feet may get a little warm.

Wanted to use these for hanging out around the house.  I ordered the largest size but they were very tight.  Love the slippers but they were too uncomfortable to wear. Manufacturer should consider making these slippers closer to actual shoe sizes.
These were labeled  women's size 8 to 10 and my daughter who wears a size 7 could barely get them on.

I love these little slippers!  They do run small, I wear a size 9 ladies shoe and I need these in XL.  They are comfy and cute.  Perfect for around the house and at the airport for security lines.  I also think they will be great for the pool and beach.

I like the little slippers BUT they leave a black ring around my ankle and the toes are a bit scrunchy. They wash beautifully and keep their shape. I love the grippers on the bottom and wear them inside the house and out. I love being barefoot and these are pretty dang close to running around sans shoes. I just wish they didn't leave a black ring around my ankle but other than that they are great!
These fit very well and are very comfortable. They are also easy to carry around. I would get these again.
I have wimp feet and can't walk barefoot so I got these to wear from condo to pool. They're super and wash well. Just tossed them in the washer. Air-dryed.
Wasn't sure about these at first, but they are so great.  Soft and fit so well.  Very comfortable. I wear them all the time.  Take a chance they are great.

I arrived at my destination and was putting them on and discovered I was sent two LEFT shoes.  Nice.  Due to complete lack of quality control I give one star.  Who knows if shoes would last. I didn't notice the smell that a few other buyers were referring to.

reviewText: I was a little concerned when I ordered these because a medium was 6-8 and I thought they might be too large but the fit was perfect. The shipping was right on the mark from Pipeline and I would not hesitate to order from this company again. I use these to exercise and they are great.

Glad I bought two pair! Excellent gift ideas or stocking stuffers. Rugged construction, I'm hard on shoes and there spring back for more.

Got these for my 90 yr old mom. She loves them. Also loves the colour. Fit is perfect. Going to order some for myself.
I ordered the medium/large and they are just a bit tight but I love them. Any larger would be too large
I wear a size 6 shoe so ordered medium size 6-8. There is no way someone with a size 8 would be able to wear this comfortably.  Size up for sure!

I ordered these in a medium and usually wear 6-61/2 but sometimes feet swell. They are so comfortable and yet not too tight and stay on my feet. I actually wear these out at times while I'm recovering. Awesome product!

I have had several ankle surgeries and going barefoot is best for me but sometime dangerous in the yard.  With Nufoot on, I don't worry as much about hurting the bottom of my feet. Also great when walking on hot sidewalks and sand.

My order was delivered days before original due date (Thank you). I bought my first pair of Nufoot at my mom's podiatrist's office and the cost was $15.00 a pair. By purchasing them on Amazon my cost was only $10.00 a pair. I love these slippers, they are like walking on air!!
Fast shipping and item as described.  Seems to run a little small but overall a great purchase and would consider purchasing the same item in a different color
So perfect for Pilates and soooo cute. I have the red and the black already but these make me smile every time I see them.
These are great

My first purchase was four pairs--two of which were immediately taken by my mom. They fit our 8-8.5 feet perfectly, not too tight and not too loose. The treads are just enough to provide grip to keep from sliding on rugs or floors, and the give of the neoprene works nicely for those of us with arthritis in our toes. I did already wear through the sole on one pair, but put a square of colored duck tape over it and they are still gonig strong with very little loss of traction. That said, these are not shoes for bringing the trash out at night! but if you want something more substantial than a sock, and less "shoe-like" than the slippers with hard treads, these are perfect. Though you may find  your feet sweat if you wear them to bed. I have no issues with smell, which is a concern with neoprene. They have held up through weekly washes.
Chose b/c they looked like a good fit and had  flexibility.  Am not disappointed.  Can take w/me in my purse and slip on where ever I may be.

These are great indoor slippers - exactly as described. I'm not sure why people aren't getting this from the description. I am a size 11-12 in women's and I got the XL and they fit great. On the other hand, not as great if your feet tend to sweat a lot.I plan on buying several more pairs for around the house.
These slippers run very very very small. I gave them to my granddaughter. Would not order again unless sizing changes.
I purchased for trip in place of slippers. No space needed while packing; so comfortable = like walking in bare feet, yet there is needed protection.  Hate to take them off.
Way better than the ones with little fingers. So comftable and the pads underneath are strong and work perfectly. I love them!

I LOVED the idea of these shoes and being able to wear them when teaching swim lessons. I hate walking around the pool barefoot and these were a great alternative. I am very disappointed.

reviewText: I have ordered several pairs of Nufoot Mary Janes, and they all fit great except for the two pairs that have a fabric with a pink background.  These pink zebras, and another pair of pink with white polka dots, seem to run a little smaller than all the other pairs which have a black background.  They are a little too tight and when you hold the two colors together, the pink ones are visibly smaller, about an inch or so shorter.  I don't know if it's a coincidence that both pink ones had this problem, if the fabric is different, or what else might have caused it, but while I plan to continue wearing NuFoot Mary Janes, I will stick to the black backgrounds from now on.
I would recommend these to anyone who likes to go without shoes but still have some coverage. I use mine for PT and on air plane trips
My only suggestion would be have a boot type for women. The slippers are as good as I expected. I have no negative comments , however I have not washed them yet.

I love the Nufoot slippers.  They fit just right.  They keep my feet warm.  I would definitely recommend these slippers.

I bought these for my Ballet Sculpt class.  They are better than socks and better than bare feet, but I wish the little no-slip parts on the bottom were better.  If I do a side lunge, my foot will keep sliding, which is less than ideal.

The size medium was just a wee bit short, but the large would be too big.  Other than that, I love the slippers.  When I am wearing them I sometimes have to check to make sure I have them on.  Really comfortable and I love them.

The nufoot is very stylish. I believe a label listing the size as x-lg was just placed on the package. No way are the slippers I received were a size 11-13! To avoid additional charges related to returning the Nufoot, I gave them to my neighbor

because this is neoprene folks. It fits like a wetsuit, well, maybe a little baggier. I used them in Hawaii to keep my tootsies away from sharp rocks, coral and shells. It worked great. And they are light and easy to dry. They make great house slippers too.
these are perfect for what i need them for, non slip and comfortable. thank you, will purchase these again in the future.

they are super cute and super comfortable!i read reviews before purchasing and totally agree not to wear them outside.ouch. rocks

This product is as advertised--cute and gives the feeling of being barefoot while keeping feet from picking up floor dirt. However, there is an unpleasant smell of processed rubber or tar or something chemical about them. I can't see these catching on as a product that will last. Sorry.

These really aren't what I expected.  Not that there is anything wrong with them.  They are a comfortable indoor shoe that I use as slippers.  There is no support so using them at the gym didn't work for me but maybe they would work for yoga.

A lot of my favorite running gear is Asics, and a lot of my most disappointing running gear is Asics.  They are inconsistent with sizing and unless you are trying something on in a store (and probably overpaying at said store), you are taking a gamble on the fit.  After ordering a large shirt and having it fit ridiculously tight despite the fact that I typically wear a large or medium, I ordered an extra large in this shirt.  And it's too big.  But I made it work, because it is a very nice shirt, which is why I still gave it a rating of 4 stars.  I have worn this shirt quite a bit since ordering it recently.  In 50 degree and sunny weather, I can wear this as my only shirt with shorts and run comfortably for a long time.  In 40 degree and sunny weather, I can wear this over a base layer with tights and be comfortable.  However, if it is dark, windy, or wet, this shirt will not provide enough protection from the weather.  As I said, I typically wear medium or large running gear, and ordered this big because of a previously small-fitting Asics shirt.  You should order your true size, or if you are in between sizes, order the larger one (I should have ordered a large).  However, it is convenient for layering for it to be a little big.  They sleeves are a bit long on me, but again, the whole shirt is big, so it may just be due to that.  It doesn't affect me because I either warm up and push mu sleeves up, or if it's cooler I let my sleeves come over my hands.  The shirt is pretty thin; if it is breezy the wind cuts right through the material, which is nice in warmer weather to cool down.  The material dries quickly, which is nice in 50 degree weather so your not sweaty and cold during your cool-down. I am just getting my feet wet into the sport of cycling, so everything that I am getting is entry level quality and thus I have nothing else to compare these shoes to, I have never wore other brand or more expensive cycling shoes.The quick review is that these are the biggest bargain you are going to find out there, order your pair before they run out, remember it is May, the beginning of cycling season, so everybody is buying their gear.Now, the more detailed review:These run a little small in size depending if you have a wide fat foot or long skinny feet. I usually ware 10.5 or 11 USA size depending on the brand of shoes, but I had to order these size 44 which is the equivalent of a 9.5-10 USA size. So, if you have a fat foot or have bunions then order the size 45, but if you have skinny feeds, get the size 44.Comfort. I find these shoes very comfortable for their purpose, as long as you on the bike, you don't feel them, the size 44 fits me very snug and it works well for when I am pulling up on the pedals, I feel my feet, the shoes and the pedals as one piece. Note, because of the big size cleat on the bottom, these shoes are not meant to be walking a lot, and you better be careful on tile floors because you will slip due to the plastic cleats.Quality. These look great, they are not leather, but they look very nice. The craftsmanship is perfect, I don't see anything wrong that could give me a sign of any trouble, except the they only had them in white and they will get dirty soon. But, then again I am gentile with my equipment. I am sure there are people out there that even if you give them steel shoes they will find a way to ware them out and destroy them. But if you careful with your equipment, these look like they can last a very long time.Features.Part of the shoes are mesh opening to keep your feet cool but you can hardly tell. The two bottom laces are velcro, but the top lace has a plastic belt with a nice ratchet mechanism that works really well, and again, as long as you treat it with respect, I don't foresee any trouble there. These use the LOOK system, the cleats attach very well to the shoes and hold very secure to the pedals. Although, the LOOK style has bigger size cleats, it still is a pain to click into the pedals, so shoes with cleats are not meat for high traffic city riding, for that just get regular pedals to be safe.Conclusion.This is the best deal out there for the new comer. Excellent quality for being entry level. I love the LOOK system. The kit includes the shoes, the cleats and the pedals, everything that you need to start riding. These are more expensive then mountain bike version, but are very well worth the extra $20 not only in terms of the LOOK system which is better, but also in terms of the overall quality of the product as a whole.Last but not least, let me school those who like me, have no clue about the difference between a mountain bike vs road bike shoes difference.The cleats, the piece that attaches to the bottom of the shoes is much smaller for the mountain bike type of shoes, and I find two drawback about this style of shoes, first I find it much harder to click into the pedal because one has to be more accurately since the cleat is so small. Second, because the cleats are so small, it doesn't cover a big portion of the shoe sole, and you can feel that when you pulling up on the pedal.On the other hand, the road bike style shoes which these are, use the type "LOOK" system, this style has a much bigger cleat piece that is much easier to click into the pedal and because it is a big cleat, it attaches to a bigger surface of the shoes sole, so when you are pedaling up, the whole shoes come up, it doesn't feel as if you are going to yank the shoe from the petal. In short, the conclusion is for you to go for the LOOK type of shoes, not the mountain bike type.

Well, I ride over a couple larger hills on my way to work, commuting in from the Pittsburgh's South Hills area.  It would be nice to have a clip-less pedal that would reduce the load on my front quads for some of that stretch and make the ride a little easier overall.  Well the cleats on these shoes are absolutely not made for being able to walk on after you dismount, meaning you can't walk into work without changing your shoes (and yes, there are cleats you can walk on, not ideally, but these aren't even close).  Also, the locking mechanism is a little touchy.  You can make some adjustments and with practice get pretty good at it, but if you have to stop more than once every couple minutes which a commute in the city will occasionally require, then this gets cumbersome.Anyway,  I still give 4-stars, because the most common use of these shoes and pedals will be for fitness riding on more closed trail or low traffic environments with minimal stopping, and these are very good for that.  Quality could be a little better on the shoes, but it straps on nice and really isn't bad at all. It seems less stretchy than the tops I own and thus feels a little more snug than I expected.  The scratch factor is non-existent (and I am totally intolerant to wool products so I am sincere in my statement).  In any event, it is everything I wanted and the quality is very good.  I am not a fan of logos, but no one will see it under my three or four other layers.  Athletic and as sexy as wool can get, I am a fan.  Far superior to the other "Smart" brand out there.  I don't know too much about the company's history or plans to dominate the world of wool, but they are making a nice name for themselves.  Buy it up before the company gets so big that they start cutting on quality like the rest of the once great brands out there.  This stuff is made to last.

I love Icebreaker items. I bought the merino wool skirt, which I love, and so bought the Crave cardigan to make a sort of casual suit. I like the sweater, it is same high quality. But it does have a low neckline that makes it less warm. And it isn't quite as stylish looking as the longer, Icebreaker v-neck sweater I love so much.  But perhaps that is partly because It is looser, with very long sleeves - which I love as they cover my hands on cold days. I wear a size 4 in clothing, and the small in this sweater is loose. Usually the icebreaker small is form fitting on me.  There is a VERY slight pilling on this sweater that is not evident on my grey long v-neck icebreaker cardigan - which I have had for a year. I do wash my icebreakers in the washing machine and dry on a hanger. They are amazing for travel - mine have been all over Europe and the Far East. They layer extremely well as they are a flat weave. They work with jeans but can be dressed up for evening.  I wear my Icebreakers almost daily here in Southern California in the winter.
summary: Highly versatile, warm and easy care.
